IZINHLANGANO ezilwa nenkohlakalo kuleli zithi akumangazi ukuthi ucwaningo lwenkohlakalo emhlabeni jikelele luveza ukuthi isadla lubi inkohlakalo eNingizimu Afrika.Lolu cwaningo, olubizwa ngeCorruption Perceptions Index (CPI), olwenziwe yiTransparency International, luveza ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ithole amaphuzu awu-41 kwawu-100 uma kuziwa ekulweni nenkohlakalo.Ngokusho kukaMnuz Karam Singh, onguMqondisi weCorruption Watch, iNingizimu Afrika ibuyela emuva uma kukhulunywa ngokulwa nenkohlakalo.Ubalule ukuthi embikweni odlule iNingizimu Afrika yayinikwe amaphuzu awu-44 okusho ukuthi ayilwi nenkohlakalo ngokwanele."ENingizimu Afrika sinezikhungo ezikwaziyo ukuveza inkohlakalo kodwa inkinga iba sekulweni nayo ngokuthi kujeziswe abeba imali. Kubi ukuthi ngesikhathi iqala ukungena kulolu cwaningo olubheka inkohlakalo emazweni awu-180 ngo-2012, yayinikwe amaphuzu awu-43. Manje isinawu-41. Isohlwini lwamazwe anentando yabantu entengayo,” kusho uSingh.Ugqugquzele abantu bakuleli ukuthi baqhubeke nokuveza inkohlakalo ukuze izinhlaka zomthetho zizojezisa abathintekayo.Uthe kulolu cwaningo amazwe angalwi nhlobo nenkohlakalo anikwa uzero bese kuthi lawo angenayo nhlobo inkohlakalo anikwe u-100.INingizimu Afrika ithole amaphuzu afanayo naweBurkina Faso, Kosovo neVietnam.Amazwe enze kabi ukudlula iNingizimu Afrika yiGabon ethole amaphuzu awu-28, Liberia ethole awu-25, Equatorial Guinea ithole 17, South Sudan yanikwa 13, kwavala iSomalia ngo-11.Amazwe enze kahle ukudlula iNingizimu Afrika yiSeychelles ethole 71, Cabo Verde ngo-64 neBotswana ngo-59.UMnuz Wayne Duvenage, we-Organisation Undoing Tax Abuse (Outa), uthe bebelindele ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yehlelwe ngamaphuzu ngoba akekho ojezisa abenza inkohlakalo.Uthe kuyaphoxa kakhulu ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa wathembisa abantu bakuleli ukuthi uzolwa nenkohlakalo kodwa mancane kakhulu amacala enkohlakalo agweba abadla imali kahulumeni.Ukhale ngokuthi izinkampani zikahulumeni ziwile, umnotho awukhuli, kunenkinga yokuphehlwa kukagesi, amachweba namaguzu ngenxa yenkohlalo.Uthe zonke lezi zinkinga ngabe azikho ukube abeba imali kahulumeni bayaboshwa bashushiswe bese bevalelwa ejele.Uphethe ngokucela abantu ukuthi babike inkohlakalo ngoba imiphumela yayo ishaya wonke umuntu wakuleli.
UPHENDUKE inkundla yokukhankasela i-ANC umcimbi kahulumeni lapho uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ebevula khona ibhuloho enkundleni yezemidlalo eNgilanyoni, eMkhambathini ngoLwesithathu. URamaphosa ubekade eqale eThekwini echwebeni lapho abeyokwethula khona uhlelo lokuhwebelana kwamazwe.URamaphosa ubeze emcimbini ngokuba wumengameli wezwe, hhayi owe-ANC kodwa bekugqanyiswa yona kakhulu. URamaphosa ubezokwethula ibhuloho elakhiwe ngohlelo, iWelisizwe, okuqondwe ngalo ukuthi abantu basemakhaya bakwazi ukuhamba noma kunemvula.Umphathi wohlelo, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka uthe yena akafuni ukugigiyela ngoba i-ANC isebenze kakhulu. UHlomuka ubekhankasa isidana, ebelesele abantu nge-ANC izikhawu eziningi."Uhulumeni we-ANC lona ngoba bonke ohulumeni banezibongo. Bakhona omama ka-Enzo lapha? Mengameli kukhona izingane zakho lapha ezithola isibonelelo,’’ kusho uHlomuka. Ubeze avumise ingoma ethi Kusekhaya la.Kumatasa ezweni kulungiselwa ukhetho lukazwelonke olukhonjwa maphakathi nonyaka.URamaphosa wethulwe wuNgqongqoshe weMisebenzi yoMphakathi neNgqalasizinda, uMnuz Sihle Zikalala. Uthe uma ethula uRamaphosa wathi abantu abangazibhonculi izikhonkwane ezafakwa woyisemkhulu.UMENGAMELI Cyril Ramaphosa efika enkundleni eNgilanyoni eMkhambathini izolo Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPEENDENT MEDIAUZikalala uze wacaphuna izwi ebhayibhelini, waqhubeka lapho walitolika ngokuthi abantu bayibonile imisebenzi ye-ANC eyaqalwa yizingwevu ezingoMnuz Nelson Mandela. UZikalala uze wazithethelela ngokuthi abaningi bacabanga ukuthi bayakhankasa kodwa akunjalo, bona balethe intuthuko njengemihla yonke.UZikalala wethule uRamaphosa naye ohambe khona lapho ekhankasela i-ANC.URamaphosa uthe ucela abantu babhalisele ukuvotela uhulumeni ozoqhubeka nomsebenzi wawo." Uma abe-IEC bevula elinye ithuba, nihambe niyovotela ukuthi kuqhubeke konke lokhu okuhle okwenziwa wuhulumeni. Maduze nje sizogubha iminyaka engu-30 wentando yabantu futhi i-ANC izokuchaza konke ekwenzile,’’ kusho uRamaphosa.URamaphosa ubalele abantu athe kwenziwe yi-ANC, esho ugesi, izikole okufundwa kuzona mahhala, kudliwe kuzona nokunye okuningi akukhumbuze abantu. Uthe bazimisele ngokuqhubeka nokukwenza lokhu kodwa bayaqonda ukuthi basemseni wabantu.
KUKHALWA ngothishanhloko wesikole iGloucester Junior Secondary eGcebeni eMzimkhulu okuthiwa ushaye phansi ngonyawo wathi ngeke zizinuke izincwadi zesikole izingane ezingawukhokhile uR150, wokuxhasa ezemidlalo kulesi sikole.Umzali ocele ukuthi lingadalulwa igama lakhe, uthe selokhu zivuliwe izikole, izingane ezehlulekile ukuza nale mali, zifike ziqhomoloze, zibukele eziyikhokhile ziqhubeka nokufunda.Elandisa, uthe indaba kaR150 iqale nyakenye, emhlanganweni obungo-Okthoba, lapho uthishanhloko enqume khona ukuthi kufanele abazali balesi sikole esingayikhokhi imali yesikole ngokomthetho woMnyango wezeMfundo, babenayo le mali uma zivulwa izikole nonyaka."Sazama ukuzikhalela ngelithi okungenani akube uR150 umuzi nomuzi ngoba eminye imizi enezingane eziyisithupha, kuzobasinda ukukhokha uR150 ingane ngayinye. Wala waphetha uthishanhloko, wathi uyazi ukuthi ayikho ingane engayiholi imali yeqolo,” kulandisa umzali.Uqhube wathi, uthishanhloko waze wasabisa ngokuthi uzobiza abakwaSassa beze esikoleni uma beqhubeka nokunqaba ukuyikhokha le mali.Umzali uthe kwathi uma esekhuluma kanje uthishanhloko, bavele behlela ngezansi abazali.Uveze ukuthi sezivulwa izikole, baningi abazali abahlulekile ukufeza umgomo owabekwa uthishanhloko."Zajikiswa ke izingane ngosuku lokuqala. Ezalapha ekhaya zajikiswa yize sasiziphathise umyalezo wokuthi sizoyikhokha imali ingakapheli inyanga,” usho kanje.Uthe zafika ekhaya zathi uthe uthishanhloko okungenani azibuye nencane ngakusasa."Sazinika uR20 ingane ngayinye, wazinika ke izincwadi zokufunda, kodwa wazidonsa ngendlebe ethi ungashayi uMashi, imali ingaphelelisiwe,” kwenaba umzali.Uveze ukuthi ezingakayikhokhi, yize zingasaxoshwa, kodwa azinikiwe izincwadi zokufunda."Enye itshele umzali ukuthi banikwe i-homework kodwa alikho i-excercise lapho okumele ibhale khona i-homework eyinikiwe,” kusho umzali.Uthe iyabakhalisa le nto ngoba uthishanhloko ukhombisa ukungabambisani nabo bengabazali.Wathi okunye okubamangazayo ukuthi lo R150 kuthiwa awukhokhwe ngisho izingane ezifunda uGrade R.Uthe bathi uma bebuza ngalokho, uthishanhloko wathi, nazo ziyayikhokha ngoba uma sezisemakilasini athe thuthu, sezizibandakanya nezemidlalo, nazo ziyobe zixhaswa uGrade R oyobe ukhona ngaleso sikhathi.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Sihle Mlotshwa uthe othishanhloko bezikole okungakhokhwa kuzo imali yesikole akufanele baphoqe abazali ukuthi bakhokhe imali ethize. "Ukusabisa okuthiwa kwenziwa uthishanhloko akufanele. Ukukhokhwa kwemali ethize ezikoleni okungakhokhwa kuzo, kufanele kwenziwe emhlanganweni wabazali, kube wukuthi kuvunyelwene ngokuphelele," kusho uMlotshwa, othe uluthumele ehhovisi lesifunda udaba ukuze lilusukumele.
UPHUNYUKE ngembobo yenaliti oyiMeya yeTheku elikhungethwe yizinkinga, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, amaqembu aphikisayo ezama ukumkhipha ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe ngoLwesithathu.Bese kungokwesibili uKaunda esinda ngale ndlela. UKaunda usindiswe amaqembu amancane akwazile ukuhlanganisa isibalo esikwazi ukumbuyisela kulesi sikhundla. I-EFF namanye amaqembu bebevotele ukuthi aphume.Emakhanseleni awu-209 abekhona, u-109 uvotele ukuthi angasuswa, kwathi awu-98 aseka ukuthi agudluzwe kulesi sikhundla. AMAQEMBU abesho ukumqeda ngevoti lokungabethembi ubuholi bakhe oyiMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, izolo Isithombe: Khaya NgwenyaIsiphakamiso senziwe wumholi we-IFP uMnuz Mduduzi Nkosi, othe iTheku lisenkingeni futhi litheleke ngehlazo ngezinto eziningi okukhona kuzo ukungayiswa kwentuthuko kubantu. Uthe okukhulu kunakho konke wukuthi kucacile ukuthi uKaunda uhluleke wancama ukuthi abantu abakhele uMasipala weTheku namaphethelo bakwazi ukuphila ngendlela enesithunzi, babe namanzi noma awokuphuza nje."Ngaphansi kobuholi bakho, abantu baseThekwini abanamanzi. Ngaphansi kokuholi bakho abantu bangaphansi kwengcindezi yokukhushulelwa zonke izindleko zikamasipala. Idolobha lisule izigidi ngezigidi zezikweletu obekumele engabe zisiza umkhandlu. Yinqwaba yemali esebenza budedengu. ITheku lisenkingeni yezimali engakaze ibonakale,” usho kanje.IDA yona ithe wuMasipala weTheku okumele usolwe ngokungabi khona kwamanzi ezindaweni eziningi, hhayi ezinye izinhlaka. Ithe akumele kusolwe uMngeni-uThukela Water ngalezi zinkinga zamanzi ... wumasipala weTheku ohluleka ukulawula lolu daba.Umholi weEFF, uMnuz Themba Mvubu, uthe kumele kucace ukuthi ubudlelwane abanabo ne-ANC, akubona obokubusa ngokubambisana. Uthe i-ANC ayibathinti uma ithatha izinqumo. "Kuyingxenye yokubambisana ukuthi uma kunezinqumo enizithathayo, nisazise. Satshela i-ANC ngonyaka odlule ukuthi kungabi khona izinqumo zomkhandlu ozithathayo ngaphandle kokusazisa ngoba akekho obusa ngokuba neningi kulo masipala,” kusho uMvubu. Uthe bazoqhubeka bavote ne-ANC ezintweni abasuke bevumelene kuzona, kodwa kulezo abaziphikisayo, bazoqhubeka nokucacisa ukuthi abahambisani nazo.
ZIZOBHEKWA ngelokhozi wuMnyango wezaManzi neNhlanzeko izinkinga zamanzi eThekwini njengoba uMqondisi Jikelele walo mnyango, uDkt Sean Phillips, ethe kunezinhlelo ezinqala zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola amanzi ahlanzekile.UPhillips uthe njalo kuzoba nombiko oshoyo ukuthi sekwenziwe umsebenzi ongakanani ekulungisweni kwengqalasizinda nasekuxazululeni izinkinga zamanzi ezikhona njengamanje.UMngeni-uThukela Water, uthumela amanzi enele eThekwini kodwa inkinga wukuthi maningi amanzi amoshekayo ngenxa yokuvuza kwamapayipi nokuthi sebebaningi kakhulu abadinga amanzi kuleli dolobha.”Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banamanzi enele, sinyuse udonga lwedamu iHazelmere eliqedwe ngonyaka odlule. Lo msebenzi udle uR820 million. Kuza nohlelo oluzoletha amanzi kubantu abahlala eNingizimu neTheku olubizwa ngoMkhomazi Water Project oluzosebenza ngo-2030. Ngesikhathi sisalinde uMkhomazi Water Project, siyalele iTheku ukuthi lilungise indaba yokuvuza kwamanzi,” kusho uPhillips.Uthe uMasipala weTheku uzomba amanzi ngaphansi komhlaba, ukhuculule lawo asesebenzile ukuze alungele ukusetshenziswa kabusha, ubuye ukhuculule awolwandle nawo ukuze alungele ukusetshenziswa ngabantu.ITheku selakhe izinqolobane zamanzi eziwu-12 ezidle uR500 million kule minyaka emibili edlule.UPhillips uthule uhlu lwezinhlelo ezizokwenzeka okubalwa olokubheka amanzi avuzayo oluzohlale luqhubeka ukuze ezoshesha alungiswe amapayipi avuzayo. Lolu hlelo oluzobheka ingqalasizinda yamanzi evuzayo ngobuchwepheshe besimanje luzoqala ukusebenza ngo-Ephreli.Umasipala uzofaka ama-valve awu-108 azohlela ukuhamba kwamanzi, azolekelela lawo awu-3 000 asebenzayo. Lo msebenzi uzoqala ngoMashi.Kuzobuye kufakwe amamitha amanzi amasha kulawo angasebenzi kahle, kube nobuchwepheshe bokufunda amamitha. Kuthiwa lolu hlelo luqale ngoNovemba nyakenye.Umasipala uzogasela kuzo zonke izindawo ukubheka abeba amanzi. Kuzofakwa namamitha emijondolo ukuze kuliwe nale nkinga.Kuzojutshwa onogada abazoqapha ingqalasizinda yamanzi ebalulekile okubalwa izinqolobane zamanzi neziteshi zamaphampu.Sekuqalwe nohlelo lokufaka ingqalasizinda ewu-plastiki njengoba eyinsimbi yebiwa bese idayiswa njenge-scrap metal.UPhillips uveze ukuthi ukunqamuka kukagesi kunomthelela omubi kwingqalasizinda yamanzi, njengamanje uthe iTheku selisebenzise uR100 million ukuthenga ama-generator awu-30, asiza ukuphampa amanzi uma ugesi ungekho.INtuzuma ayisalanga ngaphandle njengoba yayishelwe yisiteshi sokuphampa amanzi, iTheku lizolungisa le ngqalasizinda ngoR35 million bese kuthi umsebenzi uqale ngoMashi. Ngesikhathi kusenziwa lezi zinhlelo izindawo ezingenawo amanzi, zizothunyelelwa amaloli athwala amanzi.
KUMPHAZAMISILE ezinhlelweni zakhe ukubhadla ijele iminyaka ewu-12, omunye weziboshwa ezintathu ebezidonsa iminyaka ewu-15 ngecala lokubamba inkunzi kuhlonyiwe, esitolo seKFC esikwa-V eMlaza ngo-2011. Bakhululwe ngesonto eledlule emva kokuthi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu ithole ukuthi bagwetshwa kungafanele.UMnuz Ndumiso Xulu (30) nozakwabo uMnuz Bruce Khanyile (31) noMbuso Zulu (32), kuthiwa baboshwa ngo-2011 emva kwesigameko, bakhishwa ngebheyili ngo-2013 emva kokutoka iminyaka emibili. Kuthe ngo-2016 iNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza yabagweba iminyaka ewu-15 umuntu ngamunye. Bese kusele unyaka owodwa basiqede isigwebo.Emva kokungenela kwenhlangano elwela amalungelo eziboshwa, iJustice for Prisoners and Detainees Trust nabameli okukhona kubo nabenkampani iMpungose Attorneys, inkantolo ifinyelele esinqumeni sokusichitha isigwebo badedelwa. UZulu usadonsa ngelinye icala elingahlangene nabaliboshelwe, okuthiwa kulona wayegwetshwe iminyaka eyisithupha.UXulu, elandisa Isolezwe njengoba enesonto engephandle, uthe wayeyisitshudeni eBerea Technical College enza i-Electrical Engineering ngesikhathi beboshwa."Kungiphazamise kakhulu ukuboshwa nakuba ngifike ngaphakathi ngavuka ngazithatha njengoba ngiqale phansi ngenza u-matric neziqu ze-Business Management. Ngibuye ngaphandle sekwashona umama nogogo. Ingane yami engaboshwa ineminyaka emibili isangixwaya kakhulu. Nakuba kunjalo, ngibonga indlela amalungu omphakathi angemukele ngayo.Nabafowethu engiboshwe senza nabo umculo, basekhona ngakho sesivele siqhubeka lapho sasigcine khona,” kusho uXulu.Uthe beboshwa babesesitolo bezothenga ngesikhathi kungena abathile ababeyobamba inkunzi, balalisa phansi bonke ababekhona, okuthe uma beqeda babaleka. Wonke umuntu owayephakathi waphuma bagcina besele bobathu, okwathi uma kufika amaphoyisa avele athi yibona abababopha njalo.UMnuz Thabani Mpungose, okhulumela inkampane yabameli, uthe zinkulu izindleko okungene kuzo laba, bezama ukuvezela inkantolo ukuthi akuhanjiswanga ngendlela."Kutholakele ukuthi kukhona okungahanjiswanga ngendlela ngesikhathi kwenziwa inkombane, akukho zibhamu abatholwa nazo, akekho okuthiwa walinyazwa endaweni yesigameko,” usho kanje. Uthe ubudedengu obunjena abungenisi nje kuphela abasuke beboshiwe ezindlekweni kodwa bubuye kufake nohulumeni kwezinkulu izikweleti njengoba kusuke sekumele akhokhe inhlawulo ethile.Uthe kulolu daba bazofuna inhlawulo engekho ngaphansi kuka-R20 million.
ZIMKHALELE 'umalume’ obhekene namacala okudlwengula abafundi abathuthayo ebahambisa esikoleni esiseNdwedwe. Isigameko kuthiwa senzeke ngesonto eledlule.Umsolwa ona-28 (igama lakhe eligodliwe kuze kuqinisekiswe imininingwane yokuvela kwakhe enkantolo), kuthiwa uboshwe ngoMsombuluko. Bekulindeke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseNdwedwe izolo.Kuthiwa ubethenjwe ngabazali ngokubathuthela izingane zabo ngeveni eziyisa esikoleni esiseNdwedwe, okusolakala ukuthi kunalokho ubegugumba aye nazo kubo, afike azitike ngocansi ngazo, okushiye abazali bethukuthele begane unwabu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uqinisekise ukuthi mathathu amacala okudlwengulwa umsolwa asavulelwe wona."Amaphoyisa aseNdwedwe abophe owesilisa oneminyaka ewu-28 ngamacala axhumene nokudlwengula abafundi abaneminyaka ewu-15, okusolakala ukuthi isigameko senzeke ngoLwesibili nangoLwesithathu ngesonto eledlule. Umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo ngoLwesibili (izolo),” usho kanje.Yize amaphoyisa eqinisekise ukuthi isigameko senzeke ngesoto eledlule kodwa omunye wabazali okhulume neSolezwe, igama lakhe eligodliwe ukuvikela umfundi, uthe uthole ukuthi ingane yakhe yaqala ukudlwengulwa wumsolwa nyakenye. Uveze ngoLwesine ukuthi indodakazi yakhe ayibuyanga ekhaya emva kokuphuma kwesikole. Uzwee ngomakhelwane ukuthi ibonakale ihamba nomsolwa, okuthe uma enikela esikoleni wafike watshelwa ukuthi ibingakaze ilubhade esikoleni izinsuku ezimbili.Unikele kubo kamsolwa, okuwumuzi okhona endaweni wayithola khona, yamlandisa ngokwenzekile. Uthe iveze ukuthi beyivalelwe endlini futhi akusiyona yodwa, zikhona nezinye izingane azenze okufanayo.Nakuba amaphoyisa engaqinisekisanga kodwa kuvele ukuthi bayisithupha sebebonke abafundi ababhekane nesimo esifanayo. Kuthiwa kukhona nabanye okuthiwa bamvulele amacala, okuthiwa waqala ukubadlwengula eminyakeni edlule besafunda uGrade 8 njengoba sebenza u-matric kulo nyaka.
ISINQUMO sokumisa owayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma kule nhlangano, bekuvele kuyizinhloso zakhe zokuthi asebenzise ikhadi lokudatshukelwa.Lokhu kuvezwe ngabahlaziyi bezepolitiki, abathe kufezeka iqhinga lakhe uZuma, ukuze azuze ukwesekwa ngabantu.Ungoti kwezokuphatha futhi ongumhlaziyi ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe kuhlale kuyiqhinga likaZuma ukuthi ahlale ebukeka njengomuntu ohlukunyezwayo."Ngeke kumangaze ukumuzwa esethi kukhona abalalelwayo uma bezwakalisa izikhalazo zabo kwi-ANC kodwa yena uyazitshwa. Lokhu kuyokwenza ukuthi abalandeli bakhe baqhubeke nokuzwelana naye futhi kwenyuse nesasasa eqenjini alesekayo, Umkhonto weSizwe.” UKhumalo usho lokhu nje emuva kokuba uNobhala we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, ememezele ukuthi bayabumisa ubulungu bukaZuma enhlanganweni ngoba waphumela obala ngokuthi nakuba eseyilungu le-ANC kodwa uzovotela iMK.Umatasa kulezi zinsuku wehla enyuka ekhankasela iMK ukuthi idle umhlanganiso okhethweni.Omunye umhlaziyi uDkt Levy Ndou, uthe uZuma wazi kahle kamhlophe ukuthi ngeke akwazi ukungenela esobumengameli kwiMK nakwi-ANC ngeke esakwazi ukubuyela emandleni ngoba sadlula isikhathi sakhe.Uthe usebenzisa wonke amaqhinga ukudida abalandeli be-ANC ngoba efuna ukuthi ingabuyeli emandleni."Bekuvele kuyizinhloso zakhe ukuthi amiswe, ukuze kube nabazomzwela, abonakale njengomuntu ohlushwayo. Ungumuntu ohlale enento azoyisho ukuze adatshukelwe ngabantu.” Uthe uZuma useke waphatha amahlandla amabili kuhulumeni engumengameli, kubukeka sengathi wadinwa ngesikhathi umuntu ayemfuna ukuthi abe ngumengameli we-ANC, esekhala ngaphansi engqungqutheleni kaKhongolose ngoba wayefuna ukuba nesandla. Ekhuluma nabezindaba umengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe ayibafaki amanzi emadolweni eyeMK. Uthe uZuma usengumuntu okhululekile ngoba usenqume ukuya kwelinye iqembu.
BAGXEKA ukubulawa kwabasebenzi abasophikweni lwamanzi komasipala abahlukene kuleli, nasezinhlanganweni ezihlinzeka ngamanzi.Isikhalo sidalulwe yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC, uMnuz David Mahlobo, oyiphini likaNgqongqoshe lezaManzi nokuThuthwa kweNdle, esithangamini nabezindaba izolo emuva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC obuseGoli. Isigungu besibhunga ngezinto ezehlukene okubalwa nenkinga yamanzi, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, nokufukula umnotho. UMahlobo uveze ukuthi bakhathazekile nangezinkampani ezifuna ngodli ukukhokhelwa imali zingasebenzanga ngoba zithi imali eyokuvikela ukuze umsebenzi ukuze uqhubeke ngendlela."Kunenqwaba yabasebenzi asebebulewe komasipala abahlukene ophikweni lwamanzi njengaseThekwini, nakwamanye amabhodi ahlinzeka ngamanzi. Iyasikhathaza eyokubulawa kwabasebenzi, nokusatshiswa kwalabo abahlinzeka ngamanzi nsuku zonke.” Ucacisele umphakathi ngokuthi kumele wazi ukuthi amanzi alethwa yizimoto zamanzi, awadayisi."Nawo amanzi alethwa yizimoto kumele ahlanzeke, kungabikhona isimo sokuthi kukhona ophonse inabukeni lengane phakathi. Abantu kumele baphuze amanzi ahlanzekile.”Ukhale nangokuthi omasipala ababalelwa ku-105 bayahluleka ukuhlinzeka imiphakathi ngamanzi. Uveze ukuthi bakhathazekile ngokucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda yamanzi kuleli."Abenza lokhu kumele bathathelwe izinyathelo. Sithathe isinqumo sokuthi sisebenzisane nabezomthetho, sibe nohlelo lwezokuphepha kanjalo nokuvikela ingqalasizinda yamanzi ngoba kukhona abayicekela phansi, umphakathi ugcine ungasawatholi amanzi.” UMahlobo uthe kunenkinga yokuvuza kwamanzi ngenxa yokuthi ingqalasizinda isindala."Amanzi amaningi okumele ngabe aya emphakathini agcina engasafinyelelanga ngenxa yokuvuza, aphelela emhlabathini. Kodwa omasipala kudingeka bawakhokhele la manzi agcina engafikanga emphakathini ehlukene. Enye inkinga ukuxhunywa kwamanzi ngendlela okungeyona, okuyinto eyenza ukuthi amanzi amaningi alahleke noma agcine engasakhokhelwa. Ngenye yezinkinga esibhekene nazo.” Ubuye wakhala nangenkinga ehlupha abantu abaningi, indaba yesikweletu nokukhokhelwa kwamanzi."Kunenkinga mayelana nokuthunyelwa kwesikweletu samanzi komasipala abahlukene. Izakhamuzi zikhala ngokuthi zithola izikweletu eziphezulu ngokusetshenziswa kwamanzi.”UMnuz Sihle Zikalala uNgqongqoshe wezemiSebenzi yoMphakathi, uthe mkhulu umsebenzi i-ANC esiwenzile wathi kuningi nokunye okusamele bakwenze. Uthe kancane kancane bayayilungisa ingqalasizinda wathi nemigwaqo bayayifaka itiyela."Kwabanye omasipala abaphethwe amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki ayahluleka ukuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi. Uyazikhulumela umsebenzi we-ANC kule minyaka edlule ngokuhanjiswa kwezidingo.”

BATHATHU abasolwa abasale enkundleni ngesikhathi amaphoyisa etholana phezulu nezigebengu emijondolo iLungelani eLa Mercy.Lokhu kwenzeke entathakusa ngoLwesithathu. Alikho iphoyisa elilimale ngesikhathi kudutshulwana. Abasolwa bebefunwa ngecala lokubulala amadoda amabili adutshulwa abulawa ngaphandle kwethaveni eMolweni ngomhla ka-4 Januwari . BAYAZIPHIKISA izincomo ezethulwe yizinhlangano ezilwela amalungelo ngemva kokuthi zethule imibiko ngophenyo lwezibhelu ezenzeka ngoJulayi 2021.Abezinhlaka ezehlukene ezilwa nobugebengu emphakathini banemibono ehlukile ngemibiko eyethulwe ngoMsombuluko, yizinhlangano zamalungelo okuyiSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC), neCommission for the Promotion and Protection of the Rights of Cultural, Religious and Linguistic Communities.Lokhu kwenzeka ngemva kokuthi izinhlangano zamalungelo zisungule uphenyo ngoNovemba 2021, ngemva kwezibhelu ezashiya kukhalwa ngoJulayi, kwashona nabantu abaningi. I-SHRC yahlela izigcawu KwaZulu-Natal, naseGauteng, ezathatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili phakathi kukaNovemba 202, noJuni 2022.Phakathi kokunye okutholwe ngabeSAHRC, nabeCRL Commision ezigcawini abazenze ngesikhathi bephenya ngezibhelu, wukuthi amaphoyisa ahluleka ancama ukubona isimo singakafiki nokusilawula ngesikhathi sesenzeka.UMnuz Njabulo Mgeyane we-Ethekwini Neighbourhood Watch, uthe unombono owehlukile kunalowa odalulwa yimibiko."Isimo sasingaphezu kwamandla awo amaphoyisa. Uma ubuka isibalo samaphoyisa emiphakathini, akukho ayengakwenza ukunqanda isibalo sabantu ababetapa ezitolo, benza nobunye ubugebengu,” kuchaza uMgeyane.Uqhube wathi ukuthi uhlaka lwabo lwasungulwa ngemva kwezibhelu ngenxa yokubona ukuthi awanele amalungu eCommunity Policing Forum (CPF), ezindaweni eziningi."Uthola ukuthi isiteshi samaphoyisa ngasinye sinamalungu eCPF ayisishiyagalolunye. Yini eyayingenziwa ngabantu abayisishiyagalolunye ukulawula lesiya simo okwakubhekenwe naso?” kubuza uMgeyane.Ebuyela kolwamaphoyisa, uthe ukube akhetha ukuzama ukusilawula isimo, kwakuzokhulunywa okunye ngoba ayezosebenzisa indlakadla bese kufa inqwaba yabantu.UMnuz Andile Jali weNtuzuma Neighbourhood Watch, esisabalele nakwezinye izindawo ezakhele iTheku njengeVerulam, uMlaza, KwaMashu naseNanda uvumelane nemibiko, wathi kukhona ukuxega ngasohlangothini lwamaphoyisa.Uthe isimo sasingalawuleka kangcono ukube kwakukhona ukubambisana okuhle nezinhlaka zomphakathi."Kule yokubulawa kwabantu bebala elimnyama ePhoenix, nayo yayinganqandeka ukube kwakukhona lobo budlelwane bokubambisana phakathi komphakathi namaphoyisa,” kusho uJali.Bangaphezulu kuka-350 abantu abashona ngezibhelu, kukhona abangu-36 ababulawa ePhoenix, ezigamekweni eziyamaniswa nenhlese yobuhlanga.Ngokwemibiko kwakhahlamezeka ezomnotho ngemali engaphezu kukaR50 billion, kwalahleka nenqwaba yemisebenzi.

INHLANGANO eyenza ucwaningo ngokubiza kwegilosa, nesimo senhlalo iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice and Dignity Group (Pmbejd) iphakamisa ukuthi inyuswe ngo-11.2% iNational minimum wage (Nmw).I-Nmw, yimali eholwa ngabasebenzi abathathwa njengabahola kancane kunabo bonke ezweni, okubalwa abasebenzi abangenawo amakhono athile emafemini, abasebenza emaplazini, nabasezindlini.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams, obhekelele ukusebenza kwePmbejd, uthe bathumele isiphakamiso kuSihlalo wekhomishana yeNmw, uSolwazi Adriaan van der Walt, bechaza ukuthi abasebenzi bayasindwa ngenxa yokubiza kwezidingo zempilo."Sifisa ukuthi okungenani iNwm inyuke ngo-11.2% ukuze abasebenzi bathole uR28.27 ngehora okuzoba wuR226.18 ngosuku, uma besebenze amahora ayisishiyagalombili. Kumanje abasebenzi abahola ngohlelo lweNmw bathola uR25.42 ngehora okuba wuR203.36, uma besebenze amahora ayisishiyagalombili. Ikhomishana yeNmw inyusa imali ngephesenti elithile ibe isifaka namandla emali. Sifisa lelo phesenti libe wu-11.2%,” kuchaza u-Abrahams.Uqhube wathi imali ngeke yenze umehluko otheni kwabasebenzayo ngoba ucwaningo lwabo luveza ukuthi yize inmw iwuR4 473.92 kepha ayizanele izindleko zabasebenzi.Ubalule ukuthi ngenyanga abasebenzi basebenzisa uR1 555.33 uma beya emsebenzini, bathenge ugesi wekhadi kaR867.11, bachithe uR3 564.19 ngokuthenga igilosa yamalungu amane omndeni.Lokhu kubeka izindleko zabo kuR5 986,64 ngenyanga okuyimali edlula umholo wabo.Uqhube wathi bathwala kakhulu abanemindeni enamalungu amaningi ngoba igilosa yomndeni ibiza uR5 324.86.Ngokusho kuka-Abrahams, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi ukudla kuyaqhubeka nokubiza ngokweqile wathi irayisi, ushukela omhlophe, amazambane, inyama yenkomo, eyenkukhu, impuphu kumba eqolo.Kubiza ngisho ufishi osethinini ngoba ukhuphuke ngo-2% kule nyanga."Ucwaningo lwethu silwenza ebantwini besifazane ngoba yibona abathenga igilosa yemindeni yabo. Basitshele ukuthi badlala izitokofela ukuze ngoJanuwari, bezokwazi ukusebenzisa imali yesibonelelo sezingane ukuthenga umfaniswano wesikole,” kuchaza u-Abrahams.Wathi okubuhlungu wukuthi bahola uR510 ngengane eyodwa, ekubeni ukudla okunomsoco kwengane kubiza uR953.75.Uqhube wathi uma bebheka umfaniswano wesikole nawo uyabiza ngoba ipheya lezicathulo eziqinile libiza uR320 kuya kuR350. Wathi abazali abaciciyelayo bathenga izicathulo zesikole ezibiza uR130 kuya kuR149.99.U-Abrahams wengeze ngokuthi "Siyafisa ukuthi uhulumeni abahlangabeze laba bazali uma kuvulwa izikole ngokuthi afake uchatha emalini yesibonelelo sezingane.”Uphethe ngokuthi bazoqhubeka nokukhankasela ukuthi kunyuswe izibonelelo ngoba umnotho wakuleli ungakwazi ukudala imisebenzi ezokwenela bonke abathwele kanzima.
UGWETSHWE iminyaka ewu-10 ebhadla ejele ummeli waseThekwini, olahlwe yicala lokudla uR2.3 million wamakhasimende ayephunyelwe yimali kwiRoad Accident Fund (RAF).ULangelihle Dube, ugixabezwe ngalesi sigwebo yinkantolo yamacala ezimali, eThekwini njengoba ehlalwe ngamacala okudla imali yabantu ayebamele, okukhona no-R1.4 million owawutholwe yingane eneminyaka engaphansi kuka-18.Kuthiwa le mali wayeyifake kwi-trust account kodwa abantu ayebamele bagcina bengayitholanga imali yabo ephelele.U-R1.4 million wengane kuthiwa kwakufanele athenge ngawo umuzi ngo-2015 kodwa yena wakhetha ukuzithathela le mali.Isikhulu esiphezulu seRAF, uMnuz Collins Letsoalo sithe lesi sigwebo masibe yisixwayiso nakwabanye abameli, ukuthi bazojeziswa kanzima ngokudla izimali zabalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo."Abameli basebenzisa iRAF ukuzicebisa ngokuthi badle imali yabalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo, noma bafake izicelo zokunxeshezelwa ezingekho. Kuyishwa ukuthi abantu bakuleli baqolwa ngabameli okufanele ukuthi bayabavikela. Sizobalandela bonke abakhwabanisa izimali zeRAF, ukuze senze isiqiniseko sokuthi imali iya kubantu abafanele,” kusho uLetsoalo.Uthe ngoFebhuwari kukhona abanye abantu abathathu abazogwetshwa eNkantolo yeMantshi eGoli, abalahlwe ngamacala awu-400 okukhwabanisa izimali zeRAF.Uveze ukuthi iRAF izoqhubeka nokuletha ubufakazi ukuze izinkantolo zijezise abameli abakhohlakele, abasebenzi bezempilo nabanye abantshontsha imali yabalimele ezingozini zomgwaqo.Ngonyaka wezimali odlule, uLetsoalo uthe bakwazile ukuvimba ukukhokhwa kuka-R2.6 billion obuzokhokhelwa abakhwabanisayo njengoba iRAF inophiko oluqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinxephezelo zisemthethweni, bese ezisolisayo zidluliselwa emaphoyiseni ukuze kuboshwe abenza inkohlakalo.Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi uma kwenzeka ngeshwa beba sengozini yemoto, bathinte iRAF ngokushayela u-087 820 11 11 ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, ngabo-7h45 ekuseni kuya ku-4 ntambama. Bangangena ku-www.raf.co.za ukuthola amahhovisi aseduze nabo.
IQALE umkhankaso wokuhambela amajele iKhomishini eyengamele ukhetho kuleli i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) inxenxa iziboshwa ukuthi zibhalisele ukuvota okhethweni lukazwelonke kulo nyaka.UNkk Ntomb’futhi Masinga, isikhulu sekhomishini KwaZulu-Natal, uthe baqala umkhankaso wokuhambela lezi zikhungo namhlanje kuze kube uLwesine.Uthe iziboshwa zivumelekile ukuvota okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe kodwa azivoti kolohulumeni basekhaya."Sinxusa imindeni yeziboshwa ukuthi izihambisele omazisi bazo lapho zigcinwe khona. Zingu-12 izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme esifundazweni, ezine zazo amanyuvesi kuthi eziyisishiyagalombili, kube amakolishi amakhono ama-Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET). Abasebenzi bekhomishini bazoba kuzona lezi zikhungo uma sekwamukelwa izitshudeni ezifikayo.” Usho lokhu nje ngempelasonto kuvulwa ithuba lokugcina lokubhalisela ukuvota ngaphambi kwalolu khetho, okulindwe ukuthi uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, amemezele usuku oluzobanjwa ngalo.UNkk Masinga uthe ezinye zezikhungo abebezisebenzisela ukuvota, zicekelwe phansi izikhukhula nemvula."Sisebenzisana neminyango ehlukene nomasipala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyangeneka ezikhungweni zokuvota njengoba kwezinye izindawo kwacekeleka phansi nemigwaqo. Uma kushaya impelasonto yokubhalisa zingalungile ezinye zezikhungo, sizogxumeka izinto zesikhashana zokusebenzela njengamatende ukuze sisebenze.” Uveze ukuthi ngoMgqibelo neSonto bazozivula zonke izikhungo zokuvota ezingu-4974 esifundazweni kusuka ngo-8 ekuseni kuya ku-5 ntambama ukuze abantu bayobhalisela ukuvota noma bazibheke ukuthi basabhalisile yini."Bangu-14 914 abasebenzi abazobe bematasa nalo msebenzi kanti izinsiza zokuvota seziyathunyelwa. Ukuze ubhalisele ukuvota kumele ube neminyaka engu-16, ube nomazisi noma owesikhashana.”
I-DA KwaZulu-Natal isabisa ngokuya enkantolo iyomangalela uSomlomo weTheku, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose, emsola ngokuyijikela ngesiphakamiso sayo sokuthi kuhlakazwe umkhandlu.Umkhandlu weTheku uphethwe yi-ANC ngokubambisana ne-NFP, ne-EFF emuva kokuthi lingabanga khona iqembu elinqoba ingcaca.Udaba lomkhandlu weTheku luwundabamlonyeni kanti phambilini kuke kwamenyezelwa ukuthi kungenelela uhulumeni kazwelonke. Kwamenyezelwa ukuthi kuzothunyelwa izinkunzi eziluvava kwezokuphatha ziyolekelela. I-DA ithi isixoxe nezinhlaka ezehlukene namanye amaqembu abakholwa wukuthi kufanele umkhandlu uhlakazwe.I-DA yafaka isiphakamiso sokuthi kuvotelwe ukuhlakazwa komkhandlu weTheku, iwusola ngokwehluleka wukusebenzela abantu. I-DA ithi uNyawose useshaya izaququ ngemizuzu yokugcina.USihlalo we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dean Mcpherson ukhulume ngodaba ngoMsombuluko esithangamini nabezindaba eThekwini. UMcpherson, ubehambisana noMnuz Thabani Mthethwa ohola ikhokhasi yeDA eThekwini.Bekulindeleke ukuthi isiphakamiso sidingidwe emhlanganweni womkhandlu okufanele uhlale kusasa bese kuyavotwa.Ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule ihhovisi likaSomlomo weTheku lavuma ukuthi udaba luzohlalelwa emhlanganweni womkhandlu bese kuyavotwa. I-DA ithe isanda kuthola incwadi kaNyawose ethi kukhona abasazama ukukucubungula nethimba labo lezomthetho. UMcpherson uthe uma uSomlomo uNyawose engacacisi bazoya enkantolo bamphoqe ukuthi ahlalise umhlangano."Akuyi ngokuthi yena ufuna kwenzekeni futhi uma engafuni kuhlale umhlangano singafikisana ngisho enkantolo. Siyobehlula futhi kuyofanele akhokhe izindleko zenkantolo yena qobo lwakhe,’’ kuchaza uMcpherson.USomlomo ushayelwe kaningi ocingweni lwakhe lungabanjwa, wathunyelelwa nemiyalezo yangaphendulwa. Uthe uma ezanywa futhi ucingo bese lungasangeni.UMthethwa ohola ikhokhasi uthe bathole ukuthi uSomlomo uNyawose ushaya izaququ ngoba i-ANC iyesaba ukuthi ingase iketulwe emandleni."Inkinga ababhekene nayo wukuthi abazi ukuthi amakhansela e-EFF azovota kanjani. Kunenkinga yokuthi kukhona amakhansela abangasawethembi ukuthi azovota kanjani ngoba ayamaniswa neqembu, uMkhonto weSizwe. Uma bengavumi kuhlalelwe udaba sizothatha izinyathelo zomthetho,’’ kuchaza uMthethwa.KWESOKUNXELE nguSihlao weDA uMnuz Dean Mcpherson, noMholi weKhokhasi yeDA eThekwini uMnuz Thabani Mthethwa Isithombe : STEVE BHENGU/DA
BAWOTHA ubomvu abazali bezingane eziyisithupha ezifunda kwesinye sezikole esiseNdwedwe okuthiwa zidlwengulwe ngu'malume’ ozihambisa esikoleni nsuku zonke.Laba bafundi kuvela ukuthi bangabangani futhi bafunda ekilasini elilodwa likaGrade 9 kulesi sikole.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi lo wesilisa othutha laba bafundi ngeveni, kwesinye isikhathi ubengabayisi esikoleni kodwa agugumbe nabo aye kubo okuyilapho okukholakala ukuthi ubefike abanukubeze ngokocansi. Kuthiwa ubebabuyisa uma sekuphume isikole. Umzali wokuqala okhulume neSolezwe uzwakalise ukukhathazeka, elibeka ngembaba elokuthi uma amaphoyisa engambophi umsolwa, bazozifikela bona mathupha kuye.Lo mzali, ongadalulwanga ukuvikela indodakazi yakhe, uthe uthole ukuthi u'malume’ waqala ukuyidlwengula ngonyaka odlule ingane yakhe, eneminyaka engu-14 yobudala.Ngelanga athole ngalo ukuthi indodakazi yakhe idlwengulwa yilo mshayeli, bekungoLwesine ntambama ngesonto eledlule."Umntwana akazange afike ekhaya ntambama. Ngabuza nakomakhelwane, bathi bake bambona ehamba no'malume’."Ngakusasa ngahamba ngaya esikoleni. Ngabuza nothisha ukuthi uphi umntwana wami, bangitshela ukuthi akakaze afike esikoleni izinsuku ezimbili,'' echaza.Uthe yilapho atshelwa ngezinye izingane ukuthi ingane yakhe isemzini kamalume.Ngesikhathi enikela khona, uthe umntwana wathushuka egcekeni. "Ngahamba ngaya naye ekhaya. Ngathi uma ngibuzisisa, wabhoboka washo ukuthi u'malume’ ndini ubemvalele endlini yakhe emdlwengula. Waveza nokuthi akuyena yedwa kodwa nabanye agibela nabo iveni bagilwa umhlola ofanayo … uyabashintsha, athathe lo aphinde athathe lo,” kuchaza umzali.Lo mzali uthe wathi esathuswe yilokho, wathola ucingo luvela komunye umzali naye ingane yakhe eyagonyuluka kuyena ngalokhu okwenziwa ngumalume kuzona.Uthe bobabili nalo mzali bahamba baya kumshayeli weveni bayombuza ngalezi zinsolo, waphika walala ngomhlane.Bathi ngakusasa lo mlisa wayengasabonwa nangokhalo. Kuyimanje akaziwa muntu, okusolakala ukuthi usebalekele amacala."Lapho esizomthola khona sizozibambela thina mathupha,'' kusonga lo mzali.Omunye umzali uthe naye indodakazi yakhe yehlelwe yilo mshophi. Uthe zihlasimulisa umzimba izinto azixoxelwe yindodakazi yakhe, athe zenziwa yilo 'malume’ emantombazaneni uma ewaqoqele endlini yakubo ewadlwengula. "Umntwana wami ungitshele ukuthi ubebakhumulisa bonke. Aqale ngoyedwa abazungeze bonke aze abaqede bonke,’’ echaza. Umzali wesine uthe unengeke kakhulu ngoba unina womsolwa ufikile ezomncenga ukuba asule icala."Angazi ukuthi usithathaphi isibindi esingaka sokuthi angincengele le nto ebole ngalolu hlobo,'' usho kanje.Umsolwa kuvela ukuthi uneminyaka engu-29 yobudala. Isolezwe lihoshe ukuthi kunezinye izingane zamantombazane esezifunda uGrade 12 nazo ezivule amacala njengoba ziveza ukuthi waqala ukuzidlwengula zisafunda uGrade 8.Abazali bazo zonke lezi zingane bathi abantwana babo abasadli selokhu kuzwakale lolu daba.Ikhansela lakule ndawo, uMnuz Nzuzo Chamane, uthe lolu daba selufinyelelile ezindlebeni zakhe.Uthe banethemba lokuthi umthetho ngeke ubacekele phansi kulolu daba. Ukhale ngokuthi zincane kakhulu ngokweminyaka lezi ngane okuthiwa ziyizisulu.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, usigxekile lesi senzo wathi uMnyango uzoba nezindlela zokungenelela kulolu daba kodwa wakhuthaza abazali bezingane ezithintekayo ukuthi bonke bawavule amacala. Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu Natal, uMnuz Mhlabunzima Memela, uthe izingane bazozilekelela ngosizo lokwalulekwa ngokomqondo.WAITING FOR POLICE COMMENT
UFUNA athathelwe izinyathelo uthisha ofundisa iPhysics esikoleni iMbangazwe High KwaMakhutha, umndeni womfundi ozikhunge ngezinsolo zokuthi ubehlukunyezwa nguthisha. UThandolwethu Ngcobo (15) kuthiwa uzilengise kwenye yezindlu zakubo ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu, esewushaye waphelela umfaniswano wesikole, elungiselela ukuya esikoleni.Kuthiwa utholwe elinye ilungu lomndeni ebeliyobheka okuthile kule ndlu, lazithela phezu kwakhe elenga, lazisa amanye amalungu omndeni.Unina kamufi uNksz Nokulunga Ngcobo, uveze ukuthi ngoLwesine ebusuku, UThando umxoxele waze wakhala esho ukuthi akasafuni ukufunda kwiPhysics"Uthe okungenani angamane ayofunda kwaGeneral. Ngimbuze isizathu sokushintsha umqondo, wathi akasathandi ngoba zizomhlula izifundo zakwaPhysics,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe kumkhathazile emoyeni ukuthi kungani indodana yakhe isishintsha umqondo ekubeni ibihlale icula iculo lokuthi uma iqeda isikole ifuna ukuba wunjiniyela.Uveze ukuthi okubuye kwamxaka ukuthi engxoxweni yabo uThando ushilo ukuthi ikilasi lakwaGeneral abethi ufuna ukuya kulona, kuthiwa seligcwele."Ngizibuze ukuthi kungani agcizelele ukuthi ufuna ukuya kulona yize azi kahle ukuthi seligcwele,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uveze ukuthi emva kokushona kukaThando, ozakwabo abefunda nabo ekilasini bamtshele ukuthi unsuku zonke uthisha wePhysics, ubehlale ebuza umufi ukuthi "uyindoda enjani, ulwelwa unyoko izimpi zakho”."Ngesikhathi ngiyolanda iripoti likamufi kuvalwa izikole nyakenye, uthisha wakhe wakwaGrade 9, wangitshela ukuthi kukhona okuphambene ngamamaki kaThando. Wathi kodwa angingakhathazeki konke kuzolungiswa. Eripotini wayephasile. Kuthe ngosuku lokuqala lokuvulwa kwezikole, ngathola ukuthi umiswe emnyango usuku lonke, wangangeniswa ekilasini lePhysics,” kuchaza uNskz Ngcobo.Uthe washayela uthisha wakhe wakwaGrade 9 ucingo embuza ngalokhu, kodwa waphendula ngokuthi akeze ngakusasa esikoleni uThando, konke sekulungisiwe."Ngesonto lokuvulwa kwezikole, uThando ubebukeka ekujabulele ukufunda iPhysics aze axoxe ngamatemu ePhysics, uma ebhala i-homework. Ngixakekile ngoLwesine uma eseshintsha isigubhukane esethi yena akasayifuni, aze akhale izinyembezi,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Uthe ufuna uMnyango wezeMfundo uphenye ngezinsolo ezishiwo ozakwabo bakaThando okukholakala ukuthi ziholele ekuzibulaleni kwakhe."Kusho ukuthi lo thisha akanalo ubizo lokufundisa uma ekhuluma izinto eziholela ekutheni izingane zigcine zizibulala. Kudingeka inqandwe indlela yokuziphatha kwakhe ukuze angaphinde abekhona omunye umntwana ozozibulala ngenxa yakhe,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe basanda kuzwa ngalolu daba."Siyaluphenya. Esingakusho okwamanje ukuthi sidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini,” kusho uMahlambi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa esifundazweni, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe kuvulwe idokodo lokufa komuntu eliphenywa amaphoyisa aKwaMakhutha, emuva kwesigameko lapho umfana (15) etholwe elenga kubo.
UMENGAMELI we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthi wuyena oliphakamise langaphikiswa igama likaSihlalo wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli kwesombango wesikhundla sikandunankulu.UHlabisa ukhulume nabezindaba ehhovisi le-IFP, eThekwini ngesikhathi bethula uNtuli ukuthi uzongenela umbango wesikhundla sikandunankulu wesifundazwe. Kumatasa ezweni kulungiselwa ukhetho lukazwelonke, olukhonjwa maphakathi nonyaka. UHlabisa uthe uyazi ukuthi abezindaba nabantu nje kade bemagange belinde isimemezelo.I-IFP izoya okhethweni okokuqala ngaphandle komsunguli wayo iNkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi okhothame ngoSepthemba wonyaka odlule, esigodlweni KwaPhindangene. UHlabisa uthe uNtuli ukhethwe ngokuvumelana, akukaze kube khona umdonsiswano ngegama lakhe."Yimina ophakamise igama likaNtuli futhi kube yilona kuphela igama eliphakanyisiwe. Igama lakhe livele emhlangangweni wesigungu esiphezulu senhlangano. Siyameseka sonke kwi-IFP, simethembile ukuthi ufanelwe yilo msebenzi,’’ kusho uHlabisa.UHlabisa ukhuluma kanjena nje, kuhlala kuvela imibiko ethi kabazwani kahle noNtuli futhi kunamaqembu ehlukene abesekayo. UHlabisa uthe sebeyikhulume kakhulu leyo ndaba futhi kusuke kungabantu nje abazama ukuxova abasho njalo.Ngesikhathi kumenyezelwa uNtuli kudume ihlombe, yena ubebukeka ephansi nje eziqoqile ehleli phambili etafuleni eduze kukaHlabisa. bebebuye babonakale behlebelana okuthile, banqekuzise amakhanda bavumelane.UNtuli ngaphandle kokuba wuSihlalo we-IFP esifundazweni, uyiMeya yesifunda iKing Cetshwayo, unguSihlalo weSalga esifundazweni. UNtuli udabuka eVumanhlamvu eNkandla. Uke waba yimeya kamasipala wakhona eminyakeni edlule.Uke waba wuthishomkhulu eHwanqana Combined School, eNquthu naseLushaba Secondary eNkandla. UNtuli ephawula ngokuphakanyiswa kwakhe, uthe konke azokwenza kuzobe kuhambisana nokubeka abantu phambili.Uthe akafuni ukuqhulula izethembiso ngoba iqembu lisazokwethula umqulu wokhetho, emcimbini ozoba senkundleni iMoses Mabhida ngoMashi."Lesi yisikhathi esibaluleke kakhulu ohambweni lwethu njengoba ngemukela ukuphakanyiselwa ekutheni ngihole umkhankaso weqembu esifundazweni, kubhekwe okhethweni. Ngalo mzuzu ngikhumbula uMntwana waKwaPhindandangene owasifaka ezweni lenkululeko,’’ kusho uNtuli.Kulindeleke ukuthi i-IFP yethule umqulu wayo wokhetho eThekwini ngoMashi 10 kanti ithe iyethemba ukuthi izobe igcwele inkundla iMoses Mabhida.KWESOKUNXELE wuMengameli we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Halbisa noSihlalo we-IFP KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Thamsanqa Ntuli ozongenela umbango wesikhundla sikandunankulu Isithombe : SIBONELO NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIA
USESIMWENI esibucayi umfundi waseThokoza eMzinto, odephunwe kanzima yizinja zaseMaromeni (khona eMzinto), okumanje usalaliswe esibhedlela iNkosi Albert Luthuli eThekwini.USthandile Mkhize (16) kuthiwa walunywa yizinja ngoJanuwari 4 nonyaka.Kuthiwa esigamekweni, izinja zamhlephula zombili izindlebe, zamkhipha iso, zalishiya lilenga, zaphinde zamluma umzimba wonke okubalwa nekhanda.Endaweni yesigameko kuthiwa kwaficwa amasingili ayewalukile esaphazeke wonke umgwaqo.Kuthiwa amasingili ayephume nezinwele, nenyama.Kuvela nokuthi igazi laligcwele yonke indawo.Unina, uNksz Nonjabulo Mkhize, uthe uzwa ubuhlungu ngendodakazi yakhe okumanje odokotela bathe kuningi okungeke kusasebenza kuyona."Phakathi kwakho bathe yimizwa yokuhleka engeke iphinde isebenze, enye ingalo engeke isasebenza, neso elingeke lisabona,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Uthe odokotela babuye bamtshela nokuthi abakazi ukuthi uzokhiswa nini esibhedlela uSthandile, njengoba esalokhu ephuma engena egumbini lokuhlinzwa.UMGILWA olunywe yizinja uSthandile Mkhize Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE Echaza ngesigameko, uthe wafonelwa abezimo eziphuthumayo bemazisa ngokuthi indodakazi yakhe ilimele kakhulu.Uthe bamlanda kwayiwa esibhedlela iGJ Crookes, kwagcina ngokuthi uSthandile adluliselwe eNkosi Albert Luthuli.Uveze ukuthi esebuya esibhedlela, waya endaweni yesigameko, eyobheka umkhondo womnikazi wezinja.Uthe watholana nomnikazi, okungumuntu amaziyo kodwa wamfihlela ukuthi izinja ngezakhe."Wathi yena (umnikazi) wazithela phezu kwazo ehamba ngemoto, zibhuquzisa ingane yami, wazikhuza ngebhande, zabaleka,” kulandisa uNksz Mkhize.Uthe wacela lona wesilisa ukuthi amfunise umnikazi wazo, wamthembisa kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wagcina esengena ezintangeni."Ngigcine ngithola ukuthi izinja ezakhe. Uthi nengane isiphapheme, ishilo ukuthi umalume wuye owazikhuza izinja, waze wazibiza nangamagama azo,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Uqhube wathi uthole nokuthi uye lona wesilisa owabiza i-ambulensi, wangabe esavela uma sebefikile abezimo eziphuthumayo esigamekweni.UNksz Mkhize uveze ukuthi okumkhube umoya yindlela asingathe ngayo udaba lona wesilisa.Uveze nokuthi nesenzo samaphoyisa aseMzinto sokuthi angamvuleli icala emuva kokuyalelwa wudokotela, simxove umoya.Uthe ugcine ethola ukuthi umnikazi wezinja wazana namaphoyisa akulesi siteshi, okumenze wasola ukuthi yikho engamsizanga."Ngithe ngiya khona ngokuyalelwa udokotela, elinye iphoyisa langincenga, lathi liyamazi umnikazi wezinja, licela sixoxisane naye ngingalivuli icala,” kulandisa uNksz Mkhize.Uthe wabuyela ngakusasa kulesi siteshi emuva kokuthi udokotela egcizelele elokuthi kufanele livulwe icala."Ngifike lingasekho leli phoyisa elikhulumele umnikazi wezinja, ngafica amanye. Nawo ngibonile ukuthi athatha uhlangothi ngoba avele athi kuzomele kulindwe ingane yami ize ilulame ngaphambi ukuze kuvulwe icala,” usho kanje.Uthi elinye lalawa maphoyisa lize lathi "vele icala aliboli, lingavulwa ngisho emuva konyaka”."Ngifuna ubulungiswa ngengane yami ngoba ngigcine ngithola ukuthi lezi zinja aziqali ukulimaza umuntu futhi ngosuku lwesigameko umnikazi wazo kuthiwa wayevule isango, yingakho zagcina ziphuma ziyolimaza ingane yami izihambela emgwaqweni,” kusho uNksz Mkhize.Imenenja yezokukhangisa kwiDurban and Coast SPCA, uNkk Tanya Fleischer, ithe bona babhekelela kakhulu amacala aqondene nokuhlukunyezwa kwezilwane."Izikhalo ezifuze lezi, zezinja ezihlasela abantu bezihambela emgwaqweni, zibikwa kumasipala wendawo noma emaphoyiseni omgwaqo kumasipala othintekayo,” kusho uNkk Fleischer.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe uzoxhumana nesiteshi saseMzinto ukuthola kabanzi ngalolu dabaUbalule ukuthi uma kuyimpelasonto, bavame ukungabikhona abaseshi ngakho angaze abe nezimpendulo namhlanje.
ZIGQAMISE ukuxhuga kwezobunhloli eNingizimu Afrika nokucwasana ngokobuhlanga izinhlangano ezilwela amalungelo abantu kuleli, zethula imibiko yazo ngezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 eMhlanga ngoMsombuluko.Lezi zinhlangano, okuyiSouth African Human Rights Commission (SAHRC) neCommission for the Promotion and Protection of the Rights of Cultural, Religious and Linguistic Communities, zichithe isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emibili ziphenya ngezibhelu.Zibe nezigcawu KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng ngenhloso yokuthola kabanzi ngezibhelu ezinhlakeni ezehlukene.USIHLALO weCRL Commision, uSolwazi Luka Mosoma uthe abantu abenza izenzo zokucwasa ngokwebala kufanele bajeziswe isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUKhomishana weSAHRC, uNksz Philile Ntuli uthe umonakalo wabhebhethekiswa wukuthi kwakungekho ukuxhumana okuhle ezinhlakeni zobunhloli zikahulumeni kanjalo nokuzilungisela isimo."Uhulumeni waphuza ukuphendula nezinsizakusebenza zazinganele, okwaholela ekutheni isimo singalawuleki,” kusho uNksz Ntuli.Uthe umengameli, ongqongqoshe bezobunhloli namaphoyisa kwakufanele bakulungele ukuthi babhekane nenhlekelele eyabe isiphambi kwabo.UKHOMISHANA weSAHRC, uNksz Philile Ntuli uthi umonakalo wabhebhethekiswa wukuthi kwakungekho ukuxhumana okuhle ezinhlakeni zobunhloli Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBOUqhube wathi bathole ukuthi okwenzeka ngezibhelu kwakuhleliwe. Ubalule ukuvalwa komgwaqo u-N3, ukuhlaselwa kwamabhizinisi,nokuqhunyiswa kwama-ATM.Uthe yize izibhelu zaqondana nokuboshwa kowayengumengameli wezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, kwadwebeka isithombe sokuthi zenzeka ngenxa yalokho kodwa uphenyo lwabo luveza ukuthi akunjalo.Uqhube wathi bathole ukuthi izibhelu zaqala ukuhlelwa ngoDisemba 2020, lapho abathile babehlongoza khona ukususa uthuthuva emizamweni yokususa uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Uthe baphume nesincomo sokuthi kubekwe eqhulwini udaba lokucija amaphoyisa, ukuze akwazi ukukhuza ngendlela efanele uthuthuva emphakathini.Ephawula ngokubulawa kwabansundu ePhoenix, uthe kwabhebhezelwa yinzondo ebilokhu ikhona phakathi kwabomdabu baseNdiya nabamnyama."Sithole ukuthi ibilokhu ikhona inzondo ebilokhu ikhulunywa yizizukulwane ngezikulwane ngempi yango-1949 eCato Manor neyango-1985 eNanda,” kusho uNksz Ntuli.USihlalo weCRL Khomishini, uSolwazi Luka Mosoma uthe abantu abenza izenzo zokucwasa ngokwebala kufanele bajeziswe."Kufanele izinhlaka ezahlukene emphakathini nakuhulumeni zisungule izinhlelo ezizogqugquzela ubumbano emphakathini wamaNdiya nowabansundu,” kusho uMosoma.
KUTHIKAMEZEKE ukufunda esikoleni samabanga aphansi iMakhawula eNdwedwe, abazali bevala amasango, befuna kuvalwe izikhala zothisha abathathu okuthiwa zivuleke nyakenye, ngesikhathi kukhona abasulayo emsebenzini. Abazali abasonga ngokuthi bazoqhubeka nombhikisho wabo, kuthiwa baqale ukuvala amasango esikole kusuka ngoLwesine olwedlule, bathi abafundi emakilasini amane abanabo othisha. Kuthiwa uthishanhloko usezame konke okusemandleni ekutheni kuvalwe izikhala kodwa uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, ubamba uyayeka.UMnuz Zibonele Ngcobo oyilungu lesigungu esengamele isikole, uthe izikhala zalabo thisha zivuleke ngekota yokugcina nyakenye, emuva kokuthi othisha ababili besulile emsebenzini ngenxa yezizathu ezehlukene, kanti oyedwa uhlabe ikhefu lokuyobeletha. Bonke izikhala zabo azikaze zivalwe."Uthishanhloko usenze konke okusemandleni. Sihlanganile nomhloli sambikela wathembisa ukuthi uzoletha othisha abazovala izikhala kodwa kuze kube manje akukho okusenzekile. Uma simshayela ucingo ulokhu eqhubeka esinika ithemba elingekho. Le nto ifake uthishanhloko ingcindezi ngoba bamthembisile ukuthi kunothisha abazobaletha kodwa uma eseyoqinisekisa eSekhethi watshelwa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhala zothisha kusamisiwe,” kusho uNgcobo.UNksz Simangele Shezi naye oyilungu lesigungu esengamele isikole, uthe: "Kubuhlungu ukuthi kuqala izingane ziphazamiseke ngalolu hlobo, zingafundi ngenxa yokushoda kothisha.”Uthe abazali banqume ukubhikisha nje sebekhalela okuthi okungenani umnyango unikeze isikole othisha ababili ukuze izingane zikwazi ukufunda.Uthe bane kuphela othisha kulesi sikole kubalwa nothishomkhulu okulindeleke ukuthi bafundise abafundi abevile ku- 240 njengoba lesi sikole kuthiwa siqala kaGrade R sigcine kaGrade 7.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe udaba lokushoda kothisha kulesi sikole bayalucubungula."Siyalucubungula udaba lwesikole esiseNdwedwe okuthiwa sinothisha ababili kuphela. Siyabheka ukuthi akusona yini esinye sezikole ezinabafundi abancane (ngokwesibalo), esingena ngaphansi kohlelo lwezikole esizihlanganisa nezinye. Sizolusukumela maduze udaba lwakhona bese siyabona ukuthi umhlahlandlela usiholela kuphi,” usho kanje.
Izazi zomlando namasiko zincoma isenzo seSilo SamaBandla uMisuzulu kaZwelithini ngokuqoka undunankulu kaZulu kanjalo nephini lakhe njengoba kuqede ukuqagela obekukhona. ISilo simemezele ukuthi siqoke uMfundisi Thulasizwe Buthelezi, njengondunankulu omusha kaZulu, kanjalo neNkosi Phathisizwe Chiliza waseMadungeni njengephini likandunankulu kaZulu.Bethulwe ngokusemthethweni emgubheni weminyaka engu-145 wempi yaseSandlwana, lapho uZulu ahlula khona amaNgisi.USolwazi Jabulani Maphalala oyisazi somlando namasiko, uthe sekuphelile ukuqagela ngesikhundla sikandunankulu njengoba bese kuphele izinyanga ezintathu isikhundla singenamuntu.Uveze ukuthi akukho okusha ngokuthi undunankulu kaZulu abe nephini."Amasekela ayevele ekhona, ngisho uShaka wayenoNdunankulu uMdlaka esekelwa wuNgomane. UDingane wayenoNdlela kaSompisi esekelwa wuNzobo Dambuza wakwaNtombela, uMpande wayenoMasiphula esekelwa wuMnyamana. UCetshwayo wayenoMnyamane owayengenalo isekela. Ayiyintsha indaba yamasekela. Kwenza umsebenzi ube lula. UThulasizwe uzowenza kahle umsebenzi esebenzisana noChiliza,” kusho uMaphalala.Uthe akukho ukuthi i-IFP izosondela kakhulu eNdlunkulu ngoba phela yize uButhelezi ewumholi we-IFP, kodwa kuyaziwa ukuthi Inkosi uChiliza iyilungu le-ANC, ike yaya ekudingisweni yaze yahola nomkhandlu wamakhosi iContralesa."Okuhle wukuthi undunankulu nesekela lakhe bazosebenzisana kahle ngoba azikho izinqumo abazozithatha bengabonisananga neSilo. ISilo naso siyamazisa undunankulu ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta isizwe. Akukho ukuthi undunankulu uyena oyalela isizwe okuzokwenzeka kodwa bayabonisana. Kuhle ukuthi bavela emaqenjini epolitiki ehlukene. Ngalokhu iSilo besikhombisa abantu ukuthi ipolitiki yinto eyayikhona vele KwaZulu,” kuchaza uMaphalala.Uthe uButhelezi noChiliza bahlalelwe wumsebenzi omkhulu wokulungisa udaba lomhlaba waKwaZulu, owathathwa wenziwa amapulazi ngesikhathi AmaZulu edudulelwa emaweni.Ubalule ukuthi kufanele basungule isikhwama semali esizobhekela imicimbi nokunye okuthinta isizwe samaZulu esizobizwa ngeZulu National Fund, ukuze indlunkulu ingaceli uxhaso uma izokwenza imicimbi yesizwe.USolwazi Sihawukele Ngubane oyisazi somlando, amasiko nezilimi oseNyuvesi yaKwaZulu-Natal, naye uvumile ukuthi akukho okusha ngokuqokwa kwesekela likandunankulu njengoba ayekhona nakudala.Uthe ukuba khona komholi oqavile we-IFP kungaba nomthelela omuhle nomubi ngoba imibono yabantu ihlezi ihlukile."Ukuqokwa kukaButhelezi kuqeda ukuqagela. Uzowenza naye umsebenzi njengondunankulu waphambilini kodwa umehluko wukuthi uShenge (uMntwana wakwaPhindangene) ubesewenze isikhathi eside lo msebenzi. Uzofunda noButhelezi ngoba ubesondele kuMntwana. Ukuba yiMeya yaseZululand nokuba wumholi we-IFP ngeke kuwuphazamise umsebenzi wakhe wokuba wundunankulu. Akuholelwa ukuba wundunankulu kodwa abenza lo msebenzi basuke benothando lwesizwe,” kusho uNgubane.Uthe ukuba khona kukaChiliza kuzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi imibono ye-IFP ayibonakali eNdlunkulu kodwa kwenzeka lokho okubalulekile esizweni.IMbube ithe iqoke laba ngoba benamava futhi uButhelezi ufunde lukhulu kuMntwana wakwaPhindangene.
Namhlanje ngifisa sike sibheke futhi sikhulume ngale nto yowesifazane owumngani nomuntu wesilisa, okubizwa nge-male bestie. Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bayaye bathi abathandi ukuba nabangani besifazane ngoba bangovovo liyakhipha. Ngike ngafunda nasemithonjeni eminingi yezindaba mayelana nezithandani, ngacosha ukuthi ngisho abacwaningi bayishayela amakhala le yama-male bestie. Bathi buningi ubudlelwano bothando obubhidlikayo ngenxa yobungani phakathi kowesilisa nowesifazane.Phambilini ukuba wumngani nomuntu wobulili obuhlukile kobakho bekuyinto engeyona inkinga ngoba kwesinye isikhathi ubuthola ukuthi lo wobunye ubulili uyena okwazi ukuvuleleka uxoxe kangcono naye, bese eyakududuza nawe ugcine welaphekile emoyeni.Umngani wobulili obungafani nobakho ubekwazi ukukusiza engakwehluleli futhi engabheke kuhlomula ngokuthile. Bekuyinto enhle leyo ngoba bekuba lula ukuba nomuntu okwazi ukwethembela kuyena nokwazi ukubika kuyena usizi lwakho uphinde uthole nosizo.Kamuva nje izinto sezishintshile. Ukuba nomngani wobulili obuhlukile abantu sebekusebenzisela ukufeza izidingo zabo zokukhohlakala. Ubudlelwano obuningi bumoshwa iyona le nto yokuthi owesifazane unomngani wesilisa akhalela kuyena nagijimela kuyena uma exabene nesoka lakhe noma kukhona okumcasulile. Lowo mngani wesilisa uyobe esemduduza, amphekele amnakekele kamnandi bagonane bagcine beduduzana nangokocansi. Bayothi beqeda kuyilapho "bebuyelwa ingqondo" noma kube khona othi: "i-wrong kodwa le nto esiyenzile, singaphinde siyenze".Nangempela bavumelane ngalokho buqhubeke futhi nobungani babo. Le nto igcina isiwumkhuba wabo abayenza njalo nokugcina ngokuthi ingapheli kahle. Kwesinye isikhathi iphetha sekukhona okhulelwe ngoba kunjalo alisetshenziswa nejazi lomkhwenyana. Kuxatshanwe khona lapho ngoba omunye useyasiphika isisu, uphakamisa nokuthi asikhishwe.Abacwaningi bathi le nto iyaqhubeka igcine isivela bese imosha ubudlelwano, uthole ukuthi usugcina ulahlekelwa okukhona ngokungekho. Kwesinye isikhathi kuyenzeka uthole ukuthi indaba ye-male bestie iphelela ekuthandaneni kwangempela, abantu bagcine bendawonye futhi bejabulile. Angithi phela ngesikhathi ezokhala kuwe ekubikela konke okumphethe kabi uyamfunda futhi uyazifunda nezinto ezingamphathi kahle bese ugcina usumazi kangcono. Abanye kuyenzeka baze bagcine bethandana ngempela bengakaze balale kanti futhi abanye kuyenzeka bathi bayalalana buvele bumosheke ubungani babo baxabane bangaphinde bakhulumisane. Abacwaningi bayihlaba bayayihlikiza impela indaba yokuthi owesifazane ayokhalela ehlombe lendoda ayibiza ngomngani wakhe uma enenkinga ngoba indaba igcina emashidini.Yize singeke sisho ukuthi abantu abayeke ukuba nabangani bobulili obungafani kodwa sifisa baqaphele izinto ezingabamoshela ubudlelwano abasuke bekubo ngaleso sikhathi. Siyazi futhi ukuthi akusibona bonke abantu besifazane abagila lo mkhuba. KUBUKEKA sengathi iphekwe nenyongo yavuthwa, ayisadleki iyababa odabeni lowayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma nenhlangano ebusayo, i-ANC. Isinyathelo sokuzama ukuqondisa uZuma ubugwegwe kungafana nokucathamela imamba isendlini ngoba ingase ibe yingozi uma uke wayigeja.UZuma umemezele ukuthi usehamba neqembu, uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) futhi ngeke esayivotela i-ANC.i-MK kwakuwumbutho wezempi we-ANC, owasungulwa ngoDisemba ka1961, eGauteng. Phakathi kwabasunguli bawo kwakukhona oMnuz Nelson Mandela noWalter Sisulu. Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi uZuma wamemezela ngeMK ngoDisemba 16 khona eGauteng.Isimemezelo sikaZuma asenze ngoDisemba nyakenye, sidale isiyaluyalu ezweni nasemkhakheni wezepolitiki. Inqwaba yabantu ilibeka ngembaba elokuthi ihamba noZuma, okukhomba ngokusoba ukuthi uyayitheza i-ANC.I-ANC inawo umlando wokuthi kuqembuke abanye abaholi kuyona bayosungula amaqembu kodwa imvamisa bebeqala ngokwesula. OkukaZuma kwehlukile ngoba ujoyine elinye iqembu kodwa engasulile kwi-ANC, okuchaza ukuthi unobulungu obubili ngesikhathi esisodwa.Kwenzeka lokhu nje kumatasa ezweni kulungiselwa ukhetho lukazwelonke, okulindeleke ukuthi lube kulo nyaka. I-ANC ivele iyatabalasa ngokwesekwa ngoba kubonakele kwehla cishe njalo uma kuyiwa okhethweni.Kukhona abakholwa wukuthi kulokhu izobuyela ngenhlanhla emandleni okuphatha izwe ngoba ukwesekwa kwayo kungase kwehle kakhulu.UZuma akuyena umuntu nje ongatheni kuKhongolose kodwa ube ngumengameli wayo amahlandla amabili. Ube ngumengameli wezwe amahlandla amabili.Ngaphezu kwalokho uZuma uchazwa njengomholi onogazi kwi-ANC futhi baningi abantu abakholelwa kuyena abamlandela yonke indawo. Kunenqwaba yabantu abakholwa wukuthi uZuma ungumgilwa kwi-ANC, uyahlukunyezwa.Lokhu kwagqama ngesikhathi eboshiwe ngo-2021, lapho okwabheduka khona udlame, abantu batapa izitolo bethi uZuma uboshelwe ubala.Kulolu daba lwakhe lokuhamba neqembu iMK, uZuma wenze into eshiye abaningi bedidekile ngoba akasulunga kuKhongolose ukuba yilungu. Uthe uzoqhubeka nokuba yilungu ngoba ufuna ukulungisa umbutho wakhe awusebenzela kanzima.Umthethosisekelo we-ANC, ngaphansi kwesigatshana u-25.17.13 ukubeka kucace ukuthi kuyicala ukuzibandakanya nelinye iqembu elimelene noKhongolose. aziphothule iziqu zemfundo ephakeme.Ngokomthetho iNational Qualifications Framework Amendment Act ka-2019, umuntu oqamba amanga ngeziqu zakhe angabhadla ejele iminyaka emihlanu.ISouth African Qualifications Authority (Saqa), eqinisekisa iziqu zabo bonke abafuna ukusebenza kuleli, ithe izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise iziqu zabantu ngaphambi kokubaqokela ezikhundleni.ISaqa iziklelisile iziqu zabasebenza kuyona kanti ithi lokhu kwenzelwa ukuthi umphakathi uyithembe njengenhlangano ebhekelele ubunjalo beziqu zemfundo ephakeme.Ithe inohlu lwabafundile ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kuleli nasemazweni angaphandle.Iveze ukuthi kuwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu ukuthi abike uma kunoqamba amanga ngeziqu zakhe.Umkhuba wokuqamba amanga ngeziqu ithe wenzeka emhlabeni jikelele ngakho wonke umuntu kufanele ahlale eqaphile.Ibalule ukuthi izinkampani yizona okufanele zijezise abasuke beqambe amanga, zisebenzise umthetho wokuthi baboshwe babhadle ejele noma bahlawuliswe.Abafuna ukuqinisekisa iziqu bangangena kwiwebsite yeSaqa ethi www.saqa.org.zaYize uDumisa ethe akaqondi ukuthi kungani abantu beqamba amanga ngeziqu zabo, ubalule ukuthi ukuhlala emabhodini ezinkampani ezizimele kuhambisana nemali ngakho kungenzeka ukuthi abaqamba amanga basuke bezigqwabela imadlana.Udonse ngendlebe abaqashi, izinhlangano zomphakathi nezinkampani ukuba ziziqinisekise iziqu zabantu abasuke beqokelwa ezikhundleni ezithile ngoba lokho kuba nomthelela ekuphathweni kwezinkampani nezikhungo ezihlukene.UDumisa uzibhalile iziqu anazo nokuthi wazithola kumaphi amanyuvesi.UDkt Mafu Rakometsi, wenhlangano ebhekelele izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, uthe kufanele bonke abantu bakuleli bahlale beqaphile njengoba bona beqinisekisa ukuthi abakokotela u-matric bayaboshwa.Kulo nyaka bekopelile baye bamiswe iminyaka emibili bengazibhali izivivinyo zika-matric. Bathe babe sebekhonjiswa imoto ebinenqwaba yezimbobo zenhlamvu kuyo."Abezimo eziphuthumayo bathole abesilisa abathathu emotweni base beyabahlola. Ngebhadi ababili okukholakala ukuthi iminyaka yabo iko-30 bebenenqwaba yamanxeba okudutshulwa emzimbeni, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bafile endaweni yesigameko. Omunye wesilisa naye okukholakala ukuthi uneminyaka eko-30, ubenenqwaba yamanxeba okudutshulwa esesimeni esibucayi,” kusho abe-ALS.Bathe bamxilongile ngaphambi kokuthi aphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.Imbangela yalesi sigameko bathe ayaziwa kodwa amaphoyisa asaphenya.
UMENGAMELI we-International Court of Justice (ICJ), iJaji Joan Donoghue, unqumele i-Israel ugwayi katiki ngokuthi kufanele ilethe umbiko ngezinyathelo ezozithatha ukuhoxisa impi.Bekuchwaza nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana abantu bakuleli bejabulela isinqumo senkantolo, bethi uhulumeni wenze umsebenzi omuhle wasukumela lolu daba.IJaji likhiphe lowo myalelo ngesikhathi lidedela isinqumo senkantolo esivune iNingizimu Afrika ebimangalele i-Israel. Elakuleli belimangalele i-Israel lithi ibhubhise abantu, yaxhaphaza amalungelo abo.Elakuleli belihlanganise inqanawe yethimba labameli abahlonishwayo abafike bethula udaba kwaba nenhlokomo kunconywa ubuchule balo. Ijaji lithe udaba beluhlalelwe amajaji angu17, aluxoxa kabanzi ase ephuma nesinqumo.Ijaji lithe kufanele i-Israel iqinisekise ukuthi ithatha izinyathelo zokuqeda ukubulawa kwabantu ePalestine. Kuphume nomyalelo wokuthi umbutho wezempi uyeke ukuhlasela. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabantu ziyatholakala.I-Israel iyalelwe ukuthi ibhale umbiko ichaze kabanzi ngohlelo ezolulandela ukuthobela izinqumo zenkantolo kungapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 ingakwenzanga lokho.Emuva kokuphuma kwesinqumo, i-ANC ibhale ekhasini layo kuFacebook ukuthi iyasemukela isinqumo senkantolo futhi iyahalalisa. Iqembu eliphikisayo i-DA lithe nalo liyasemukela isinqumo senkantolo layincoma ngokusheshisa udaba. I-DA inxuse i-Israel ukuthi ithobele umyalelo wenkantolo ukuze kume ukubulawa kwabantu.I-DA ithe kufanele izikhulu zase-Israel zingene ezingxoxweni zokuthula.
Luzongena eNkantolo yokweDluliswa kwamaCala eBloemfontein, eFree State udaba lombango wesihlalo seSilo sikaZulu. Ijaji Norman Davis, eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli ligunyaze uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ukuthi asedlulise isinqumo salo.Emuva kwesinqumo sangoDisemba, uRamaphosa wamemezela ukuthi uzofaka isicelo sokusedlulisa ngoba akeneme ngaso, esola iJaji uDavis ngokuphaphalaza. URamaphosa ubefake isinqumo kulona iJaji uDavis lamgunyaza ukuthi angalwedlulisa udaba uma engenelisekile.IJaji uDavis ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule lakhipha isinqumo salo lilahla uRamaphosa ngelokuthi akalandelanga imigudu efanele enika iSilo isitifiketi. URamaphosa wayemangalelwe wuMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu wendlu yaseKhwezi nongumfowabo weSilo esidala.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana u-Afrika Zulu wendlu yasOnkweni, umemezele ukuthi iJaji livune uRamaphosa, nokusho ukuthi udaba luzongena eBloemfontein uma sekuphume usuku."Indlunkulu neSilo bayamuhalalisela uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngokunqoba ethola imvume yokwedlulisa isinqumo sangoDisemba 11. Isinqumo esivuma ukwedlulisa icala sisho ukuthi udaba luzolalelwa eBloemfontein,’’ kusho uMntwana u-Afrika.Umbango wesihlalo seSilo selokhu waqala emuva kokukhothama kweNgonyama endala, uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu eyafulathela leli ngoMashi 2021. Kuhambe kwaze kwafika lapho uRamaphosa enika khona iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini isitifiketi nokwakuchaza ukumemukela njengeSilo.UMntwana u-Afrika uthe iSilo simncoma kakhulu uMengameli uRamaphosa ngokuthi aphikelele angakhathali kulolu daba, afune ubulungiswa. Uthe lokhu kuyakhomba ukuthi umengameli ukholelwa ekutheni umthetho usebenze ngobulungiswa neqiniso.Uthe bafisela ithimba labameli bakamengameli okuhle kodwa uma sebeqhuba lolu daba. Uthembise ukuthi uZulu wonke uzokweseka ithimba labameli ngemikhuleko. Uqhube wathi abangabazi ukuthi inkantolo izolusingatha ngobunono nangobuqotho lolu daba.Okunye okwavela wukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, sanquma ukubuyisa inkampani yabameli iStrauss Daly Attorneys esasikade siyisebenzisa kudala odabeni lombango wesihlalo. Kwenzeka konke lokhu nje, uZulu unomgubho wokukhumbula iMpi yaseSandlwana lapho okulindeleke ukuthi iSilo sethule inkulumo yaso. USEZITHEBENI zePhalamende umgomo woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, wokuzama ukunqanda ukukhulelwa kwabafundi besasezikoleni.UNgqongqoshe womnyango, uNkk Angie Motshekga, wazise uSomlomo wePhalamende uNkk Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ngomgomo osudluliselwe ekomitini lomnyango ePhalamende.Inhloso yawo ngukuthi kunqandwe ukuxoshwa kwabafundi abakhulelwe okunalokho banikwe usizo ngaphambi kokubeletha nangemuva kokubeletha.Izibalo ziveza ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-150 000 abafundi abakhulelwe onyakeni wezimali u-2021/2022 besafunda.Kulezi zibalo kuvela ukuthi kukhulelwe amantombazane angu-396, aphakathi kuka-10 no-14 weminyaka. Umgomo womnyango ubalula ukuthi umfundi osenezinyanga eziyisithupha ekhulelwe, kumele alethe incwadi kadokotela eveza ukuthi uzobeletha nini.Le ncwadi kumele ayinike uthishanhloko noma uthisha wakhe kanti kumele iveze ukuthi abukho ubungozi ngokuthi umfundi abe sesikoleni.Ubalula ukuthi angaqhubeka afunde aze abe nezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili."Uma umfundi okhulelwe engaphansi kweminyaka engu-16, kuzodingeka ukuthi kubikelwe amaphoyisa ukuze kuthathelwe lowo omkhulelisile uma engaphezu kuka-16 weminyaka. Uma kungukuthi ukhuleliswe nguthisha, uyothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho aphinde ashushiswe ngumkhandlu olawula othisha iSouth African Council for Educators,” ngokomgomo womnyango.Ubalula nokuthi abafundi asebebelethile kumele babuyiselwe ebangeni abebelifunda noma badluliselwe kwelilandelayo kanti kuyicala ukuxosha umfundi okhulelwe. UNkk Motshekga uthi bafuna abafundi ababelethile babuyele esikoleni bangasidubi ngoba sebekhulelwe noma ngoba sebebelethileUkhala ngokuthi inkinga yokukhulelwa kwabafundi akuyona eyabo kuphela, nabazali kanjalo nomphakathi kufanele ubambe iqhaza ekulweni nalesi sihlava.KwaZulu-Natal, uMphathiswa wezeMpilo uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uke waveza ukuthi zingu-49 izingane ezibelethwe omama abasebancane ngoKhisimusi nyakenye.Kulabo mama kukhona nababeneminyaka engu-14. NgoNcibijane uthe bangu-50 omama abasebancane ababelethile. Kulaba kukhona owayeneminyaka engu-15. Izibalo ziveza ukuthi esifundazweni onyakeni wezimali u-2022/2023 kukhulelwe abafundi abangu-25 239.
UKHALE ngenkinga yokunqamuka kukagesi, izinkinga emachwebeni nokungabikho kwamaguzu, umphathi weSouth African Reserve Bank, uMnuz Lesetja Kganyago.NgoLwesine uKganyago umemezele ukuthi imalimboleko izohlala ku-8.25%. Okusho ukuthi inzalo ekhokhwa ngabantu uma beboleka imali emabhange izohlala ku-11.75%.Uthe izinkinga zikagesi, amachweba namaguzu zivimbela ukukhula komnotho ezweni.Kulo nyaka umnotho wezwe uthe balindele ukuthi ukhule ngo-1.2%.Uthe okwamanje amandla emali awakabi lapho efuna ukuthi abe khona isikhathi eside. Ufuna abe phakathi kuka-3% no-6%.Ubuye waveza ukuthi izimpi eziqhubeka emazweni ahlukene njengeyaseRussia ne-Ukraine, ephakathi kwe-Israel neHamas zinomthelela omubi kubantu.Ubalule ukuthi kunemikhiqizo eyenziwa eRussia nase-Ukraine kuphela ephazamisekayo uma kunempi futhi imikhumbi isiyasaba ukuhamba eRed Sea njengoba kuqhubeka impi ye-Israel neHamas.Uthe abakhiqizayo bazodlulisela izindleko zokuhamba amabanga amade kubathengi, okusho ukuthi izinga lempilo lingase lilokhu libiza.Ebuzwa ukuthi uzokwenzenjani njengoba i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal isabise ngokuthi izomashela emahhovisi eBhange loMbuso uma imalimboleko ingehli, uKganyago uthe uzokwamukela uhlu lwayo lwezikhalo.Uchaze ukuthi imalimboleko ikulesi sigaba ekusona ngoba kuvikelwa abantu bakuleli.USolwazi Bonke Dumisa, uthe akumangazi ukuthi ibhange aliyishintshanga imalimboleko njengoba kwaziwa ukuthi lihlale libheke amandla emali ukuthi akuphi.Uthe okwamanje njengoba amandla emali eku-5.1% ngeke anyakaze mhlawumbe izoze iqale ukwehlisa imalimboleko ngoJulayi.UMnuz Reuben Maleka wenyunyana yabasebenzi bakahulumeni, iPublic Servants Association (PSA), uthe bebefuna ukuthi uKganyago abe nozwelo, ehlise imalimboleko kodwa-ke kungconywana ngoba akayinyusanga.Uthe ukunyuka umlibe kwemalimboleko kuholela ekudliweni kwempahla yabasebenzi abaqala ukudonsa kanzima ngezikhathi zeCovid-19.Ubalule ukuthi laba basebenzi banokhwantalala ngenxa yokuthi abakwazi ukukhokhela impahla yabo, okubalwa izimoto nemizi.Uphethe ngokucela iBhenge loMbuso ukuthi libe nozwelo, lehlise umthwalo kubasebenzi nabantu bakuleli ngokwehlisa imalimboleko.

UMngomezulu uthe uNtanzi washaywa evunyiswa icala ngenkani, emuva kwalokho uGininda wamthembisa imali."UNtanzi uthe wahlukunyezwa washawa evunyiswa icala, emuva kwalokho wena waxolisa kuyena wase umtshela ukuthi uma engase asebenzisane nawe avume icala uzomnika uR3 million,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.Ngaphambi kwalokho, uMngomezulu uwuqalile umusho wakhe kuthe sekufanele asho isamba semali wathi ucela ukubuza kuNtanzi kuqala, kube yimizuzwana wase ebuya nendaba kaR3 million.IJaji uRatha Mkgoatlheng liqaphele ukushaqeka kukaGininda, lambuza ukuthi umangazwa yizinsolo zokugwaza noma yisamba sikaR3 million.UGininda ephendula lokhu uvele wahleka kancane, wathi kufanele nenganekwane lokhu akuzwayo."Ngishaqekile ukuzwa ukuthi iphoyisa lingathembisa ummangalelwa imali ngoba kwenzenjani Nkosi yeNkantolo? Ophikweni lwethu asinaso ngisho isabelomali esingako futhi ummangalelwa wayezikhulumela nje evuma icala ngokuthanda kwakhe,’’ kusho uGininda.Kuvela izinsolo zomgwazo nje, uGininda ubesanda kumangaza abaningi ephihliza iguncu, eninda uKelly emkhomba njengomuntu owasasazela uMeyiwa ngezinkabi.Icala lisheshe laguqa kunesikhathi esejwayelekile ngenxa yokuthi kukhona amarekhodi okufanele atholakale enkantolo yaseBoksburg. IJAJI uRatha Makgoatlheng litshelwe ngezinsolo zokuthi amaphoyisa athembisa ummangalelwa uR3 million ukuze avume icala lokubulala uMeyiwa Isithombe: OUPA MOKOENA/INDEPENDENT MEDIA
INHLANGANO elawula abasebenza ngemali kuleli, iFinancial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) isiveze ukuthi inkampani esiza abatshala imali kwezemfuyo, iLivestock Wealth, kayinayo imvume yokwenza lo msebenzi.NgoLwesithathu iFSCA ithe isithole ukuthi iLivestock Wealth yenza umsebenzi engagunyaziwe ukuwenza, wokunika abantu amacebo okutshala imali kwezolimo noma kwimfuyo.Iveze ukuthi ayikaze igunyaze le nkampani ukwenza umsebenzi njengoba wonke amabhizinisi asebenza ngezimali kufanele athole igunya nesitifiketi kulandelwa iFinancial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act, ka 2002 (FAIS Act).ILivestock Wealth isebenzisa inamba yokusebenza yenye inkampani ebizwa ngeLivestock FS ewu-FSP 51237.Ithe iyayiphenya neLivestock FS ngoba kufanele ichaze ukuthi inamba yayo isetshenziswa kanjani ngenye inkampani ukuze ihwebe ngezimali.I-FSCA ithe izowazisa konke umphakathi uma isiqede konke ngophenyo lwayo kodwa yakugcizelela ukuthi iLivestock Wealth kayinalo igunya lokusebenza ngezimali.Kwisizindalwazi seLivestock Wealth, kubhalwe ukuthi abantu bangatshala imali ezinhlakeni ze-macadamia noma bathenge izinkomo nenye impahla yezolimo.Abantu bakwazi ukutshala u-R2 000 kuya ku-R18 730. Imali yabo ivuthwa ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kuya eminyakeni eyisithupha, kuya ngokuthi bayitshale kuphi.Isolezwe libathintile abeLivestock Wealth, bacela ukuthi bathunyelwe i-email njengoba bezokhipha isitatimende ngalolu daba. I-FSCA ithe ngaphambi kokuthi abantu batshale imali yabo ezinkampanini ezithi zisebenza ngemali, kufanele babheke ukuthi zibhaliswe ngokusemthethweni, ngokushayela u-0800 110 443 noma babheke ku-https://www.fsca.co.za/Regulated%20Entities/Pages/List-Regulated-Entities- naku- https://www.fsca.co.za/Fais/Search_FSP.htm
ISIKHULU sekhomishini yokhetho kuleli i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), sihlabe ikhwelo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala kwamanye amazwe ukuthi baphume ngothi lwabo ngale mpelasonto bayobhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lwalo nyaka. UMnuz Sy Mamabolo isikhulu esiphezulu se-IEC, siveze ukuthi bevile ku-18 000 abantu bakuleli abahlala kwamanye amazwe asebeqalile ukubhalisela ukuvota.IKHOMISHINI eyengamele ukhetho kuleli inxuse abantu bakuleli abahlala kwamanye amazwe ukuthi baphume ngothi lwabo bayobhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lukazwelonke oluzoba kulo nyaka Isithombe: Henk Kruger/African News Agency (ANA)Ikhomishini ivule ithuba kule mpelasonto ukuthi abantu bakuleli abakwamanye amazwe, bakwazi ukubhalisela ukubhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lukazwelonke, okungakamenyezelwa ukuthi luzoba nini.Ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba izolo, eGoli, uMamabolo uveze ukuthi kusuka ngoDisemba nyakenye, bevula uhlelo lokubhalisa kulabo abahlala kwamanye amazwe, bangu-18 469 abasemazweni angu-101 asebebhalisile."Lolu hlelo lokubhalisa abantu abahlala kwamanye luyaqala ukwenzeka kulolu khetho njengoba phambilini babebhalisa ezindlini zamanxusa. Okhethweni lwango-2019, bangu-21 000 abantu bakuleli abakwamanye amazwe abavotela kulawo mazwe. Sethemba ukuthi ngokuqala uhlelo lokubhalisa sisebenzisa i-online, luzokwenza babe baningi abazobhalisa.”Udalule ukuthi abantu abaningi asebebhalisile abahlala kwamanye amazwe iningi labo lise-United Kingdom ngabangu-(5 938), Netherlands (1 844), Germany (746), United States (821), Ireland (675), United Arab Emirates (1068), China (515), Australia (588), New Zealand (314), Cuba (293), Portugal (284) and Belgium (280). "Emazweni ase-Afrika angu-28 bangu-316 asebebhalisile eMauritius, Lesotho (224) Namibia (148), Botswana (170), Zambia (96), Zimbabwe (77), Kenya (73), Ghana (45) kanti eTanzania (40). Kulabo abavota ngo-2 019, abangu-7 023 babeqala ukuvota.” UMamabolo unxuse abazobhalisa ukuthi bakwenze lokhu kusuka namhlanje kuze kube yiSonto.Uveze nokuthi nalabo ababhalisile bangaya kozibheka ukuthi basabhalisile ezindlini zamanxusa noma ngokusebenzisa i-website yekhomishini.Ukuze ubhalisele ukuvota, uMamabolo uthe udinga umazisi kanjalo ne-passport yakuleli.Udalule nokuthi uMnyango wezoBudlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba, ubazise ukuthi izindlu zamanxusa ezintathu eziKwa-Israel, Sudan, ne-Ukraine, zisavaliwe ngenxa yezimo zezokuphepha."Sinxusa abahlala kulawa mazwe ukuthi babhalise ngokusebenzisa i-website yekhomishini ethi: www.elections.org.za. Kudingeka bagcwalise ifomu elizobe lifuna imininingwane yabo kanjalo nezinye izinto ezithinta ubuzwe kanjalo nendluj yenxusa abafuna ukuvotela kuyona.” Ubonge uMnyango wezoBudlelwano namaZwe oMhlaba ngosizo olunika ikhomishini ukuthola abantu bakuleli emazweni abakuwo.
UMASIPALA waseThekwini unqunyelwe ugwayi katiki yinkantolo ukuba uchaze ukuthi kungani washaya indiva umyalelo wayo wokuba ifake amaphepha aphikisa isicelo seDA sokufuna inkantolo iphoqe umkhandlu udalule uhlelo lokulungisa amapayipi endle avuzayo okuthiwa angcolisa ulwandle.INhloko yamaJaji KwaZulu-Natal, iJaji Thoba Poyo-Dlwati, iyalele umasipala ukuba uchaze ukuthi kungani wehlulekile ukulandela umyalelo ewukhiphe ngonyaka owedlule.UJaji Poyo-Dlwati wayekade eyalele umasipala ukuba ufake onke amaphepha aphikisa isicelo seDA ngoJanuwari 15.Isolezwe libone incwadi ebhalwe uJaji Poyo-Dlwati, ekhombisa ukuthi umasipala awuzange uhlangabezane nomnqamulajuqu obubekelwe wona."Niyalelwa ukuba nilethe incazelo yokuthi kungani nihlulekile ukuhlangabezana nomyalelo owakhishwa yinkantolo ngoMeyi 2023 nowangoDisemba 2023. Incazelo kufanele niyilethe ungakashayi uMashi 8.”Icala lafakwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ngonyaka owedlule kulandela ukuvalwa kwamabhishi amaningi eThekwini ngenxa yokungcola kolwandle. I-DA ifuna ukuba inkantolo iphoqe umasipala ukuba uqhamuke nohlelo ozolusebenzisa ukulungisa amapayipi endle.Kusukela icala lafakwa, iDA ibilokhu ikhala ngokuthi izikhulu zomkhandlu zizama ukubambezela ukuqulwa kwalo.USihlalo weDA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Dean Macpherson, uthe kubajabulisile ukuthi inkantolo inqumele umasipala ugwayi katiki."Akekho obengacabanga ukuthi umasipala ungashaya indiva inkantolo ngale ndlela. Lo masipala awugcini kuphela ngokushaya indiva inkantolo kepha nabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwawo ukhombisa ukungabakhathaleli. Sekuphele unyaka safaka icala. Izikhulu zomkhandlu zenza ngakho konke okusemandleni azo ukubalekela leli cala."Njengoba izikhulu zikamasipala ziqhubeka nokudlala umacashelana, amabhishi avaliwe, indle igcwele imigwaqo. Njengobuholi beDA sizoqhubeka nokulwela ukuthi leli cala lilalelwe ngokushesha. Sifuna kube nesixazululo sasenkantolo esizobophezela umasipala ukuba ubhekane nale nkinga yamapayipi endle.”UJaji Poyo-Dlwati uphinde wakhipha eminye imiyalelo yokuba bonke abathinteka ecaleni bafake amanye amaphepha ahambisana nalo.Usuku lokugcina olubekelwe uMasipala waseThekwini ukuba ufake amaphepha awo uMashi 25.UJaji Poyo-Dlwati uthe kuzokuba nomhlangano wazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo ecaleni ngo-Ephreli 16 lapho kuzokwenziwa amalungiselelo ecala.Leli akusilo elokuqala lapho khona uMasipala waseThekwini ufakwe enkantolo ngodaba oluthinta ukungalungiswa kwamapayipi endle.Kunecala eliqhubeka eNkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, elifakwe amaqembu ezepolitiki afana ne-ActionSA ne-ABC, nawo afuna ukuba umasipala uphoqwe ukuthi ulungise amapayipi endle.
