LIDLULE ngehubo elakuleli ecaleni lapho belimangalele i-Israel ngodaba lwempi nePalestine. UMengameli we-International Court of Justice, uJoan E Donoghue, ukhiphe isinqumo ngoLwesihlanu evuna iNingizimu Afrika.Isimo sishubile phakathi kwe-Israel, nePalestine futhi sekuphume inqwaba yemiphefumulo selokhu kwaqala impi. Elakuleli lamangalela i-Israel, leseka iPalestine lithi lizwelana nayo.IJaji uDonoghue likhiphe isinqumo eThe Hague, eNertherlands, lapho belihambisana khona nenqwaba yamanye amajaji enkantolo. Iphuzu ebelibangwa kakhulu wukuthi i-Israel, yenze isenzo sokubhubhisa abantu yangahlonipha amalungelo abo.IJaji lithe nebala i-Israel, ibabhubhisile abantu futhi lagxila emaphuzwini abekwe yiNingizimu Afrika, lathi ayezwakala. Kukhishwe umyalelo wokuthi i-Israel yenze imizamo yokunqanda konke lokhu okwenzekayo futhi kufanele ithumele umbiko wokuthi izokwenza kanjani.
ISILO uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini sinxusa uZulu ukuba uphelele emcimbini wokukhumbula impi yaseSandlwana ozokuba kusasa.Kulo nyaka kuhlangana iminyaka engu-145 uZulu, ngaphansi kweSilo uCetshwayo, anqoba amaNgisi entabeni yaseSandlwana.Umgubho uzokuba ngaphansi kwentaba yaseSandlwana, eNquthu.Okhulumela ihhovisi leSilo, uMntwana u-Africa Zulu, uthe impi yaseSandlwana ibalulekile kakhulu emlandweni kaZulu."Le mpi isinikeza ithuba lokuba sikhumbule okhokho bethu abanikela ngempilo yabo belwela lo mhlaba. Amabutho alwa impi enkulu. UZulu wanqoba ngamalengiso, futhi ngokomlando kwakuqala ukuba amaNgisi anqotshwe ngale ndlela. Ingakho indlovukazi yamaNgisi yanquma ukuthumela onke amabutho ayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni uZulu ugcine unqotshiwe."ISilo sinxusa uZulu ukuba uphelele uma sesikhumbula labo abasilwela. Ngempi yaseSandlwana sikhumbula abanikela ngempilo yabo. Ukukhumbula impi yaseSandlwana kusinika ithuba lokuba sizikhumbule ukuthi singobani, sisuka kuphi. Impi yaseSandlwana iyisifundo entsheni.”UMntwana u-Africa uthe ibutho likaZulu kanye namalungu eDundee Diehards azolingisa okwenzeka ngesikhathi uZulu utholana namaNgisi.UMntwana u-Africa uthe balindele amabutho aqhamuka kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe."Konke sekumi ngomumo. Amalungiselelo ahamba kahle kakhulu.”Undunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, uthe kuningi abantu abangakufunda ngempi yaseSandlwana."Usuku lwempi yaseSandlwana lusemlandweni futhi uZulu ngeke ulukhohlwe. Impi yaseSandlwana iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi thina singobani. Impi isikhumbuza isikhathi lapho amaqhawe ethu engazange agwaje ngesikhathi ebhekene nethunzi lokufa, alwa. Njengoba sibhekene nezinkinga ezingaka namhlanje, kufanele sibukele kula maqhawe angazange ahlehle ngesikhathi ebhekene nobunzima.”UMphathiswa wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, uthe kubalulekile ukuthi uZulu angalukhohlwa lolu suku."Kwakungokokuqala ukuba isizwe sase-Afrika sinqobe amaNgisi. Amabutho kaZulu ayephethe imikhonto namahawu akwazi ukunqoba ibutho lamaNgisi elalihlome liphelele.”Kuleli sonto ibithe chithi saka imicimbi eyandulela umkhosi wakusasa.Phakathi kwemicimbi ebikhona, uMasipala wesifunda iKing Cetshwayo ube nesikhumbuzo sikaCetshwayo edlinzeni lakhe eliseNkandla, kwathi uMasipala wesifunda iZululand waba nesifundo ngempilo yeSilo sasoNdini.
ISAZI sezomnotho, uDkt Iraj Abedian, sithi ngeke ukhule kahle umnotho wakuleli uma imboni yokukhiqizwa kwempahla ingasebenzi kahle.Uthe lo mkhakha wenza kahle kakhulu ezweni kwazise ucwaningo lwabo luveza ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwezimoto kungenisa u-R207.5 billion ngonyaka.ISIKHULU esiphezulu seProudly South African, uMnuz Eustace Mashimbye sithi abantu mabathenge imikhiqizo eyenziwe kuleli, ukuze kudaleke amathuba omsebenzi Isithombe:SIBONELO NGCOBO"Uma kunganezezelwa ngo-10% imali etshalwa emkhakheni wokukhiza kungadaleka amathuba omsebenzi awu-75 000. Sibheke kakhulu umkhakha wokwakhiwa kwezimoto, owezolimo, owefenisha nowemithi. Uma kukhula ukukhiqiza kukhula neminye imikhakha,” kusho u-Abedian.Udonse ngendlebe uhulumeni, osomabhizinisi nezinye izinhlaka zomphakathi ukuba kusetshenziswane ukuze kuxazululwe inkinga kagesi, eyozokuthutha (amaguzu namachweba) nokunakekelwa kwemvelo.Isikhulu esiphezulu seProudly South African, uMnuz Eustace Mashimbye, sidonse ngendlebe abantu bakuleli ukuthi bathenge impahla eyakhiwe lapha ekhaya ngoba lokhu kudala amathuba omsebenzi.Uveze ukuthi ukuthengwa kwempahla ekhiqizwe kwamanye amazwe kunqinda amandla izinkampani zakuleli.Uthe isitembu seProudly South African asinikezwa noma wubani kodwa sinikwa izinkampani zakuleli ezidala amathuba omsebenzi futhi zithuthukise nomnotho.UMnuz Sihle Ngcwamu oyisikhulu esiphezulu seTrade and Investment KwaZulu-Natal (TIKZN), uthe banezinhlelo eziningi zokusiza osomabhizinisi bakuleli ukuba badayise impahla yabo kwamanye amazwe.Uthe kule nyanga nje kunamabhizinisi azobe ethumela imikhiqizo yawo okokuqala ngqa phesheya kwezilwandle.Ucele osomabhizinisi baKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi bangahambeli kude ne-TIKZN ukuze bazohlonyiswa ngamakhono afanele okudayisa impahla yabo phesheya.UNkk Thuli Cibane ongumqondisi weCibane Consulting, uthe kufanele kushintshwe imfundo yakuleli, kuhlonyiswe abafundi, abasebenzi nabaphathi bezinkampani ngamakhono ezobuchwepheshe.Uthe umhlaba wonke ususebenzisa ezobuchwepheshe kodwa iNingizimu Afrika isasilele emuva njengoba kusafundwa ngohlelo oludala futhi nabasebenzi bengahlonyiswa ngamakhono amasha.
ABAHOLI bamaqembu ezepolitiki abambisene njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lwalo nyaka, bathi bayakwamukela ukusungulwa kwamanye amaqembu ukuze kwande ukuncintisana kwezombusazwe.Laba baholi bathe bafuna ukusebenza namaqembu azokwenza umehluko, hhayi uvucu olungeke lubenzele lutho abantu ezweni.Laba baholi bamaqembu okuyi-DA, IFP, FF Plus, ActionSA, ACDP, ISANCO, UIM, SNP, UCDP, Ekhethu ne-UNP, bathe noma kanjani i-ANC izokhala ngaphansi okhethweni.Bekhuluma emhlanganweni obuseThekwini izolo, bathe nakanjani uphelile umbuso kaKhongolose."Kuphelile ukushaya amaphiko kwe-ANC kuleli naKwaZulu-Natal. Ngemuva kokhetho kuzobe kuphethe amaqembu ahlukene. Siyakwamukela ukusungulwa kwamaqembu amasha kuleli, okubalwa neMK. Siyathemba nayo izosondela ifune ukuzoba yingxenye yenhlanganisela nathi,” kusho umholi we-DA uMnuz John Steenhuisen.UMengameli we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe umnyakazo wokusebenzisana namanye amaqembu bawuqale ngoMeyi nyakenye emuva kokuyothekela ulwazi kwamanye amazwe ngokusebenzisana kwamaqembu.Uveze ukuthi bazocacisa konke abakuphathele abantu bakuleli uma i-IFP isithula umhlahlandlela wezethembiso zokhetho, ngoMashi eThekwini."Abantu ngeke ubadidise. Bayazi ukuthi kumele bavoteleni. Siyakwamukela ukusungulwa kwamaqembu amasha, ukuze kwande ukuncintisana ngakwezepolitiki.” Umholi we-ActionSA, uMnuz Herman Mashaba, uveze ukuthi bahlanganyela ndawonye ukuze bathathe umbuso kwi-ANC.Uveze ukuthi ijoka elibahlalele wukunxenxa izinkumbi zabantu abangabhalisile ukuvota, ukuthi babhalise ukuze bavote."Angingenanga kwipolitiki ngoba ngifuna itoho. Ngingene ngoba ngifuna ukwenza umehluko uma sesisezintanjeni zokuphatha. Sifuna ukushintsha imigomo yezomnotho ecekela phansi abantu bakuleli.” La baholi baveze ukuthi bazophucula imfundo ezweni ngokuqinisa uhlelo lokufunda, kukhishwe ipolitiki kwezemfundo, baqinise ukuqeqeshwa kothisha.Okunye ngukubuyisa abahloli ezikoleni, kube nabaluleka ngezengqondo ezikoleni kanjalo nokuthi abafundi kube nezinto zokubayisa ezikoleni. Baveze nokuthi bazokwehlisa uphethroli, kuncishiswe ukuboleka imali kukahulumeni, iBhange loMbuso lizimele, kukhuliswe amakhono, kubuyekezwe imigomo ethinta ukulandwa kwabanamakhono kwamanye amazwe.
UMCULI wokholo osola umfundisi waseNigeria ngokumhlukumeza ngokocansi esakhula, uCheryl Zondi, udalule ukuthi baningi abafundisi abangamaKhrestu abaxegelwa woziphu nosekumphoqe ukuba angabe esalubhada esontweni. UCheryl ngomunye wabantu besifazane abavulela uMfu Timothy Omotoso nabazalwane abangaphansi kwakhe oLusanda Sulani noZukiswa Sitho, uxhaxha lwamacala amayelana nokudlwengula nokunukubeza ngokocansi njengoba begqigqa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGqeberha, e-Eastern Cape. Ekhuluma kwiJustify Podcast, uCheryl uthe bambalwa abefundisi ababizelwe enkolweni ngokweqiniso. "Ake sithi kubefundisi abawu-10 esengike ngahlangana nabo. Uma nje kimi wathi ungumfundisi, ngiyaphuma kuwe.” Uthe akazi kungani abantu besilisa abangamaKhrestu bazibandakanye nokuhlukumeza ngokocansi. Musa ukufaka ngisho amadlozi!” Uthe laba bantu bathungatha ikakhulukazi izingane zamantombazane ezisuke zingakakhuli kahle ngokomqondo. Uthe emuva kokugilwa wu-Omotoso, wake wamzonda uNkulunkulu. Uthe kwake kwaba nesikhathi lapho ezonda khona uNkulunkulu ngakho konke okwennzeka kuye. "Ngangizibuza ukuthi kungani avumela into enje yenzeke kimi? Wayevumelani umuntu asebenzise igama lakhe ukuhlukumeza abantu. Isikhathi esiningi ngangifuni ukuzwa ngoNkulunkulu. Ngase ngiwumhedeni.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ugcine ebuyelile ekukhonzeni uNkulunkulu kodwa ngendlela yakhe. Yize kubukeka kumambela kahle emculweni kodwa nakhona uthe kunabaculi abadumile abafuna ukusebenzisa udumo lwabo ukumxhaphaza ngokocansi.
BAHLEKA bodwa abafuyi bezinkukhu bakuleli njengoba bezodayisa amanqina ezinkukhu eChina ngo-R300 million njalo ngonyaka.Isivumelwano sokudayiselana sihlanganiswe yinhlangano ebhekele ukuthuthukisa umnotho eWestern Cape, iWesgro.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba yiWesgro, uhlelo luzodala amathuba emisebenzi awu-3 000.Ngaphansi kwesivumelwano, abalimi besifazane abafuye izinkukhu eMpumalanga naseWestern Cape bazothumela eChina amanqina angamathani awu-540 njalo ngenyanga.Kuthiwa amanqina enkukhu ayinyama edliwa womntakabani eChina ekubeni kuleli ethathwa njengokudla kwabampofu.I-Wesgro ithe inkampani yayo ebizwa nge-AskCarlaKote yiyona ehlanganise abalimi, yaqinisekisa ukuthi bahlonyiswa ngamakhono abawadingayo.Iveze ukuthi imatasa ifuna imakethe yawo amanqina emazweni asentshonalanga ye-Afrika lapho nakhona amanqina ehamba phambili.Ithe imakethe yamanqina izokhula ngoba namanye amazwe ase-Asia aseqalile ukufuna amanqina enkukhu kuleli.UNkk Carla Kote ongumsunguli we-AskCarlaKote, uthe isivumelwano sabafuyi bakuleli neChina sizovulela abanye amathuba.Uthe imakethe yaseChina ayikhathazekile ngomkhuhlane wezinkukhu ngoba amanqina abo ayahlolwa ngaphambi kokuthi athunyelwe kwamanye amazwe."I-Wesgro isebenzisana neStandard Bank, abalimi nathi ukuze lesi sivumelwano sihlangane. Iminyango yezolimo eMpumalanga naseWestern Cape nayo izibophezele ukuthi izosebenzisana nathi ngoba eChina bayawathanda amanqina ezinkukhu,” kusho uNkk Kote.Uthe eChina amanqina awagcini nje ngokudliwa wodwa kodwa afakwa kumasobho, adliwe njenge-snack noma enziwe isitshulu.UMnuz Wrenelle Stander, oyisikhulu esiphezulu seWesgro, uncome i-AskCarlaKote ngokuletha isivumelwano esizoshintsha imboni yenkukhu kuleli, sidale namathuba omsebenzi.Omunye wabalimi ozohlomula ohlelweni, uNkk Lebohang Dhluhlu, uthe bazosizakala kakhulu ngoba basuke ekubeni ngabafuyi abancane baba ngabazodayisa umkhiqizo wabo ezimakethe zomhlaba.Umfuyi wenkukhu eWestern Cape, uMnuz Khaya Bruwana, uthe ubuyelwe yithemba lokuthi imboni yenkukhu izothuthuka njengoba sekunesivumelwano esizodayisa amanqina ezinkukhu zabo eChina.
ZIMBALWA izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme kuleli ezizokwamukela izicelo zezitshudeni ezingazifakanga izicelo njengoba sekuqale uhlelo lokubhalisa. Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha, uDkt Blade Nzimande, othe ezinye zezikhungo ziveze ukuthi ngeke zizamukele izicelo ezintsha ngalesi sikhathi njengoba kuphuziwe ukukhishwa kwemiphumela ka-matric.Ekhuluma esithangamini sabezindaba izolo uNzimande, uthe izikhungo okubalwa iNyuvesi yaseZululand oNgoye, DUT, Mangosuthu University of Technology, Rhodes University, Tshwane University of Technology, Cape Peninsula, Fort Hare neWalter Sisulu zizozamukela izicelo ezintsha."Ezinye izikhungo ziveze ukuthi ngeke zizamukele izicelo. Sinxusa abafuna izikhala ukuthi babhalise ohlelweni lomnyango, iCach (Central Applications Clearing House), lokubheka izikhungo ezisenezikhala zokufunda.” UNzimande uthe zibalelwa ngaphezu kuka-270 000 izicelo zokufunda emanyuvesi kulo nyaka."Izikhala ezibalelwa ku-22 000 ngezabafundela ubuthisha. Kwezobunjiniyela bangu-18 000 abazokwenza lo mkhakha.” Uveze ukuthi bangu-572 000 abafundi abaphase u-matric nyakenye.UMqondisi-jikelele womnyango uDkt Nkosinathi Sishi, uveze ukuthi zanele izikhala abanazo zabafuna ukufunda."Kuhlale kunombuzo othi njengoba bebaningi abafundi abaphase u-matric, ngabe sinazo yini izikhala ezanele zokuthi bafunde. Ngifuna ukukuveza ukuthi zanele izikhala esinazo emkhakheni wemfundo ephakeme wokuthi samukele labo abaphase u-matric,” kusho uSishi.UNzimande uveze ukuthi izonyuka nemali etholwa yizitshudeni ezifunda emanyuvesi kulo nyaka njengoba zizothola u-R16 500 ngonyaka.Eyezindawo zokuhlala izoba ngu-R50 000 kulabo abahlala emadolobheni.Uveze ukuthi izitshudeni ezixhaswe yisikhwama iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme zizothola imali yokugibela engu-R7 875 ngonyaka.Izitshudeni zizophinde zixhaswe ngo-R5 460 wokuthenga izincwadi zokufunda ezizoyithola ekuqaleni konyaka.Izitshudeni zasemakolishi amakhono ama-TVET, ezihlala emadolobheni zizoxhaswa ngo-R60 000 wokukhokhela izindawo zokuhlala.​​​​​​​UNzimande uveze ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zizogixabezwa ngo-R4.2 billion, wokuthi zikwazi ukubhalisa izitshudeni.Le mali izofakwa ingakapheli le nyanga. Kuyona amanyuvesi azothola u-R3.2 billion, amakolishi athole u-R1 billion. UNzimande uxwayise abazali nezitshudeni ezifuna izikhala zokufunda ukuthi zingangeni ogibeni lokubhalisa ezikhungweni ezingombombayi.Ubayalele ukuthi baqaphele ukuthi bangakhokhi imali yabo ezogcina ngokuthi ilahleke."I-NSAFS kumanje isixhase izitshudeni ezingaphezu kuka-600 000. Kuvalwa ekupheleni kwenyanga ukufaka izicelo zoxhaso kulesi sikhwama.”

ZINYUKILE izinombolo sabafe ezingozini zomgwaqo KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba, uma kuqhathaniswa nangesikhathi esifanayo ngo-2022/2023.UNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kuzwelonke, uNkk Sindisiwe Chikunga, ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ebambe isithangami nabezindaba eGoli, obekuhloswe ngaso ukunekela umphakathi ngezibalo zezingozi ezenzeke emigwaqweni yakuleli phakathi kukaDisemba 1 nyakenye noJanwari, 13, 2024.Lesi sifundazwe singesinye sezine okubikwe kuzo ukukhula kwesibalo sabafe ezingozini zomgwaqo njengoba kuthiwa sikhuphuke ngo- 4.2% uma kuqhathaniswa nokwenzeke ngesikhathi esifanayo ngo-2022/2023. I-Western Cape yisona sifundazwe esikhuphuke kakhulu isibalo ukuqhathanisa nezinye njengoba kube u-22.6%. Kwezinye izifundazwe lo mshophi wehlile, i-Eastern Cape kuthiwa ukuphela kwesifundazwe esikwaze ukwedlule umgomo esasibekelwe wona wokwehlisa izinga abantu abafa ezingozini zomgwaqo okungenani ngo-18.6%, njengoba sikwazile ukwehlisa ngo- 21.5%.Nakuba kunjalo, uNkk Chikunga uthe zehle ngo- 2.3% izingozi zomgwaqo okufe kuzona abantu ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba ka-2023/2024. Bangu-1 184 abadlule emhlabeni kuzwelonke, ukuqhathanisa nabangu-1 212 ngo-2022/203."Isibalo sezimoto ezintsha ezibhalisiwe ngamaholidi kaDisemba nyakenye, ukuqhathanisa nangesikhathi esifanayo esedlule, sikhombisa inqubekela phambili eyenzekile ukuhlangabezana nazo zonke izingqinamba. Kusuka ngoDisemba 1, nyakenye, zingu-13 133 035 izimoto ezibhalisiwe ukuqhathanisa nezingu- 12 968 430 okusho ukuthi kube nezimoto ezingu-168 000 ezintsha emgwaqweni,” kusho uNkk Chikunga.Uthe ngamaholidi, bekudlange imvula enemandla nesichotho okubenomthelela ezingozini ezenzekile. Okunye akuvezile, yisibalo esiphezulu sabashayeli abasha abathole izincwadi zokushayela njengoba bengu-15 343 067 ngoDisemba odlule, ukuqhathanisa no-14 897 925 wangoDisemba 2022.Uveze ukuthi ngoDisemba 20 nje kuphela, isibalo sezimoto emgwaqweni senyukela ku-853 564. Kuthiwa izingozi eziningi zenzeke ngesonto lokuqala kuDisemba, elesithathu lapho abaningi bebevala emsebenzini nelesine, okuyisonto likaKhisimusi ebelinempelasonto ende.Uthe izingozi ezingi bezenzeka kuyiSonto okuyinto entsha. Izikhathi obekuvame ukwenzeka ngazo izingozi yiphakathi kwehora lesikhombisa ebusuku no-10. U-80.8% wezingozi kuthiwa udalwe ubudedengu babantu emgwaqweni, u-10.4% kube ngenxa yemvula enamandla nesichotho kanti u-8.8% udalwe ukungabibikho esimeni kwezimoto ezisebenzisa umgwaqo.Kuthiwa bangu-7 820 abashayeli ababoshiwe, okukhona phakathi kwabo abebeshayela bephuzile, abahamba ngesivinini eseqile nabebenezincwadi eziwumgunyathi.Umshayeli oboshwe ehamba ngesivinini sika-225km/h endaweni evumela u-120km/h ku-N1 e-Settle Bridge, eLimpopo, kanti otholakale ukuthi uphuze kakhulu enotshwala obungu-2.48 ml egazini, uboshwe e-Eastern Cape.
KUSHONE elayizolo kunesiphithiphithi izwe lonke nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana kuvela igama likaKelly Khumalo, ukuthi nguyena owanika izinkabi itoho lokuqeda ngoSenzo Meyiwa. Umholi wabaphenyi becala, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, izolo uphihlize iguncu enkantolo eveza ukuthi uKelly wuyena owakhokhela izinkabi ukuthi ziyise uMeyiwa kwagoqanyawo, elekwe ngesoyi.Ubufakazi obethuliwe buthi uKelly wayenezinombolo zocingo ezehlukene ezine, ayezisebenzisa edidiyela izinkabi futhi wawafihlela amaphoyisa ngazo. Uphenyo lwezobuchwepheshe kuthiwa lwaveza lezi zinombolo, okuthiwa yizona ayexhumana ngazo nabamangalewa ababili.UNgoti wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, uthe lokhu okuvele enkantolo ngoKelly akukabi wumazihlokoza ezinsolweni zokubulala.UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wafa ekubo kwentombi yakhe ewumculi, uKelly eVosloorus, eGauteng ngobusuku buka-Okthoba 26, 2014. Ukubulawa kukaMeyiwa, owayeyisilomo sikanozinti we-Orlando Pirates neBafana Bafana, kwashiya abaningi beshaqekile.UZikalala uthe njengamanje kusabangwa indaba yokuthi izitatimende zokuvuma icala zabamangalelwa zizomukelwa yini ukuba wubufakazi."UKelly usaphephile okwamanje ngoba lokhu okudingidwayo akuhlangene naye. Uma befuna ukumhlanganisa necala, kuyofanele bambophe athweswe amacala kulethwe ubufakazi obunzulu enkantolo,’’ kusho uZikalala.UZikalala uthe kube yishwa lakhe uKelly ukuthi anindeke kanje kodwa ayikho into angayenza manje ukuvimba lokhu ngoba kuqulwa icala. Uthe uKelly kufanele alinde, abone ukuthi isiphetho kuzoba yini.UGininda unguMkhuzi wophiko iNational Cold Case Investigative Unit ehhovisi lomkhuzi wamaphoyisa ekomkhulu ePitoli. Umshushisi u-Adv George Baloyi, uqale wamxwayisa uMngomezulu ngokufundwa kwesitatimende kodwa waphikelela wathi asifundwe. UGininda ungene kusona isitatimende wasifunda, waveza ukuthi uphenyo lukhomba ukuthi wuKelly umqashi wezinkabi.Uthe lokhu kwavezwa wummangalelwa wokuqala, uMuzikawukhulelwa Sibiya ngesikhathi ehlambuluka evuma elokubulala uMeyiwa."Ngesikhathi evuma icala ummangalelwa wokuqala, wakubeka kwacaca ukuthi babethunywe wuNksz Kelly Khumalo ukuthi babulale uMeyiwa. Ummangalelwa wahamba wayokhomba endaweni yesigameko, wachaza konke nokuthi ubani wayemi kuphi,’’ kusho uGininda.Uthe nommangalelwa wesibili, uBongani Ntanzi waphinda walidalula igama likaKelly, ethi wuyena owabanika itoho lokuqeda ngoMeyiwa. UGininda uthe ngesikhathi kuphenywa ucingo lukaMthobisi Mncube, ongummangalelwa wesithathu kwatholwa isithombe sesikhwama semali. Uthe leso sithombe sesikhwama semali satholakala nasocingweni lukaKelly, sifana nse futhi sisendaweni efanayo.Kuvele ukuthi ummangalelwa wesine, uMthokoziseni Maphisa yena wayenikwe umsebenzi wokugada ngaphandle komuzi nesibhamu esincane, ngesikhathi kubulawa uMeyiwa. Kuvele nokuthi ummangalelwa wesihlanu uFisokuhle Ntuli yena wabathutha ngeVW Polo ayesele kuyona ngaphandle ebalindile.UGininda uthe uKelly wayeke waxoxa nodadewabo uZandi ngo--2013 ethi uzonda kabi uMeyiwa futhi uyazisola ukuthi wayeyekeleni ukumbulala ekuqaleni. UGininda uthe uyakholwa wukuthi uKelly wubhongoza.Bekungaqali ukuthi uKelly anindwe wubufakazi njengoba bathi beqala abamangalelwa ukuvela enkantolo, kwaputshuka iphepha elithi kufanele kuhlolwe amarekhodi ezingcingo zakhe.Emuva kwalokho ungoti wamaselula wethula ubufakazi bokuthi uKelly wayexhumana ngocingo nabamangalewa. INYUNYANA yabahlengikazi ixwayisa abafuna ukufundela ubuhlengikazi ukuthi baqaphele izikhungo mbumbulu ezingoqhibukhowe ezivamise ukuvumbuka ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka.UMnuz Sibongiseni Delihlazo okhulumela iDenosa, uthe izikhungo zokuqeqesha ezingekho emthethweni, zivamise ukwanda ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka ngenxa yokuthi ziyazi ukuthi baningi abafundi abaphase u-matric abasuke befuna izikhungo abazoqhuba kuzo izifundo. "Labo abafuna ukwenza izifundo zobunesi kuyenzeka balahlekelwe imali, ngoba baye bakhokhe kulamakolishi mbumbulu bebhalisela ukufunda,” kusho uDelihlazo.Uthe inyunyana ifisa ukuqwashisa abafundi ngokuthi mabaqaphele bangaqali babhalise uma bengenaso isiqiniseko sokuthi amakolishi ababhalisa kuwo asemthethweni."Zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezifundisa umkhakha wobuhlengikazi ezisemthethweni, umthetho uthi kumele zibhaliswe futhi zigunyazwe iSouth African Nursing Council (SANC), okuyinhlangano elawula ezobuhlengikazi,” usho kanje Uqhube wathi zonke izikhungo eibhaliswe iSANC zibhaliwe kwi-website yayo. "Abaphothule u-matric kumele babhekisise. Uma bengenaso isiqiniseko, bangatxhumana ne-SANC ngocingo ku-012 420 1000,” kusho uDelihlazo.
UKHALA ngokulinda umnyama ongenafu umfundi ka-matric obanjelwe imiphumela nozakwabo ngoba kusolwa ukuthi bakopela. Lo mfundi, obefunda esikoleni esiseKlaarwater, eMariannhill, ocele ukungadalulwa, ukhala ngokuthi babanjelwe imiphumela bonke abebenza iBusiness Studies esikoleni sabo ngenxa yalezi zinsolo. Uveze ukuthi uthe ngqu esikoleni eyolanda isitatimende semiphumela ngesonto eledlule, wafike wadumala uma etshelwa ukuthi ngeke bayithole ngoba bayaphenywa. "Ngithukile ngoba sinabanye ebesenza nabo lesi sifundo sitshelwe ukuthi siyaphenywa. Kuthiwe sisazofonelwa sibuzwe ukuthi sakopela noma cha. Asizange sikopele, angazi kungani sibanjelwe le miphumela. Abebengayenzi iBusiness Studies bayitholile eyabo imiphumela." Lo mfundi uthe akazi ukuthi uphenyo luzothatha isikhathi esingakanani njengoba sekuqaliwe ukubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. "Asazi ukuthi silinde into yanini. Kuyavalwa maduzane ukubhalisa ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme kanjalo nokufaka isicelo soxhaso esikhwameni iNSFAS (National Students’ Financial Aid Scheme). Kuyacaca ukuthi umuntu uzogcina engafundanga uma kungukuthi uphenyo ludonsa isikhathi eside.” Ukhale ngokuthi ayashabalala amathuba okuqhuba izifundo zakhe.Okhulumela uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uMnuz Elijah Mhlanga, unxuse abafundi ababanjelwe imiphumela ngoba besolwa ngokukopela ukuthi bathi ukulinda ngoba kusaphenywa. Sifuna ukuzanelisa ukuthi akukho okwenzeka.” Uma umfundi kutholakale ukuthi wakopela, imiphumela yakhe ithathwa njengento engekho bese emiswa ukubhala u-matric iminyaka emibili.
AMAPHOYISA abezulazula ehlola isimo endaweni azithele phezu kwesidumbu sesikhulu sikaMasipala i-Alfred Duma, eMnambithi, sinenxeba lokudutshulwa. UMnuz Thulani Brian Xaba, obeyisikhulu kwezokuHlela iNtuthuko nokuHlaliswa kwaBantu, utholwe ebulewe eKuvukeni, eMnambithi.Kuvela ukuthi ubulawe nabanye abesilisa ababili okungaziwa noma ubehamba nabo abatholwe beshonile bude buduze nalapho etholwe khona. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ukubulawa kwakhe kushiye abantu beshaqekile benemibuzo ngoba akwaziwa ukuthi bekwenzenjani.UMasipala i-Alfred Duma esitatimendeni sawo osithumele kwabezindaba, ukuqinisekisile ukufa kukaXaba wadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kamufi. Umasipala uthe uXaba usebenze ngokwethembeka nokuzikhandla kuzo zonke izikhundla aziphathile kumasipala.Bathe wayelokhu efike kwamasipala ngo2012 wasebenza eshintsha izikhundla njengoba eze wabulawa esebenzela umasipala. Bathe bakhulekisa umndeni ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uqinisekise lesi sigameko wathi amaphoyisa ayaluphenya udaba." Amaphoyisa aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala emuva kokuthi kutholwe abantu bebulewe emgwaqweni uHelpmekaar, eMabhekazi. Amaphoyisa abezulazula ehlola indawo ngesikhathi ezithela phezu kwesidumbu somuntu, okuthe uma kubhekisiswa kwatholwa ezinye izidumbu ehlathini,’’ kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe imbangela yokubulawa kwabo ayikaziwa kodwa kuyaphenywa futhi bacela umphakathi ukuthi uma kukhona okwaziyo usebenzisane namaphoyisa.UMasipala i-Alfred Duma awuqali ukwehlelwa wumshophi wokubulawa kwesikhulu sawo ngoba ngo2019 kwadutshulwa kwabulawa uMnuz Oscar Hlatshwayo. UHlatshwayo owayeyisikhulu kwezobunjiniyela, wadutshulelwa emgwaqweni ehamba ngemoto.Washawa ngoyaba lwezinhlamvu waphelela khona lapho nokuyinto eyathusa abaningi.UMUFI uMnuz Thulani Xaba obeyisikhulu sikaMasipala i-Alfred Duma eMnambithi odutshulwe wabulawa abantu abangaziwa Isithombe : SITHUNYELWE
AZOGQUNYWA ezitokisini amaphoyisa amahlanu asolwa ngokushaya abulale amadoda amabili okuthiwa abamba inkunzi iphoyisa eCradock, e-Eastern Cape.Abasolwa baboshwe ngesonto eledlule, base bevela enkantolo yemantshi yakuleya ndawo ngoLwesibili.Lawa maphoyisa athweswe amacala okungamabili okubulala, elokuthumba nelokushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza.Abasolwa okungoSergeant Melikhaya Madubedube (42), Constable Ibanathi Jack (33), Constable Ndumiso Mpondo (33), Sergeant Vuyane Mahlasela (31) noSergeant Khulile Damane (46) bazobuyela enkantolo ngoFebhuwari 23, 2024.UMnuz Phaladi Shuping ongumkhulumeli wophiko oluqaphe izenzo zamaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (IPID), uthe kunezinsolo ezithi elinye lamaphoyisa lalingekho emsebenzini."Kusolakala ukuthi leli phoyisa labanjwa inkunzi isigejana samadoda. Emuva kwezinsukwana futhi selibuyele emsebenzini, kusolakala ukuthi lahlangana nozakwabo bathungatha lawa madoda, bathola amathathu,” kusho uShuping.Uthe kusolakala ukuthi lawa maphoyisa athatha la madoda ayanawo esithe, afike awashaya.Emuva kwalokho, kuthiwa abagilwa bayiswa emahhovisi amaphoyisa ophiko olugcina ukuthula emphakathini lapho kusebenzela khona abasolwa.Kubikwa ukuthi omunye wabagilwa, uMnuz Thabang Mbovane (29) waquleka kodwa amaphoyisa amshiya kanjalo esephuma emsebenzini."Waze wabonwa amanye amaphoyisa ayekade ezongena emsebenzini. Kwabizwa abezimo eziphuthumayo abafike bamhlonza njengomuntu oseshonile umgilwa,” kusho uShuping.Uqhube wathi umgilwa wesibili uMnuz Sindile Makoa (34) ushone ngoMsombuluko.
UMKHANDLU wamabandla eNingizimu Afrika uhalalisela abafundi abaphase u-matric ngo-2023, ubabiza ngabanqobi.Umyalezo ukhishwe yihhovisi likaNobhala-Jikelele weSouth African Council Of Churches (SACC), uMbhishobhi Malusi Mpumlwana.Umkhandlu uthe nakuba izingane zakuleli lizwe zikhula ngaphansi kwezinselelo eziningi kodwa ikilasi lika-matric 2023 lingabanqobi."Lena kube yimiphumela emihle, esinikeza ithemba lesizukulwane esikhethekile futhi esiphokophelele phambili,” kuchaza isitatimende.Ukuhalalisa kwabamabandla kuqhubeka kuthi imiphumela idweba isithombe esiqhakazile ngezwe.Uqhube wathi imiphumela emihle ngale ndlela iyabakhuthaza."Kufaka ugqozi futhi kukhuthaze ukuthi leli lizwe lizoba nabaholi bangomuso abangeke bavumele kube khona okumi endleleni yabo kuze kube bazuza lokhu abasuke bezibekele ukukuzuza,” kusho iSACC.I-SACC ibe isishayela ihlombe abazali nothisha ngeqhaza abalibambile ngokubambisana ekuzuzeni le miphumela.Umkhandlu uthe ukubambisana kwabo kwenze kwaba nesimo esivumela abafundi ukuba bavelele.Ikilasi likamatric lango-2023 lizuze u-82.9% okuyisibalo esikhule ngamaphesenti angu-2.8 uma kuqhathaniswa nango-2022.Bangu-897 775 sebebonke abafundi ababhala izivivinyo zeNational Senior Certicifate (NSC)Isifundazwe, iFree State, siphume phambili ngokuphasa kwabafundi bakamatric, sazuza u-89%. Kulandele iKwaZulu-Natal ngo-86.4% kwathi iGauteng yalala isithathu ngo-85.4%.
UWAPHIKE wonke amacala awu-162 afaka phakathi nawenkohlakalo athweswe wona umengameli weziNkantolo zeziFunda KwaZulu-Natal.Imantshi Eric Nzimande, emisiwe emsebenzini, ivele phambi kwesigcawu sokuqondisa izigwegwe izolo. Isigcawu siqale ngoMsombuluko eNkantolo esePhoyinti, eThekwini, njengoba umqashi kulindeleke abize ofakazi abangu-14. Kokunye umqashi asola ngakho uNzimande ukuthi wayegembula ngesikhathi somsebenzi, enukubeza ngokocansi nokugwazisa.UNzimande usolwa ngokuthi wayegwazisa abantu ababezobamba izikhundla zokuba yizimantshi.Kuthiwa nguyena owayeluleka ungqongqoshe wezobulungiswa ngaleso sikhathi, ukuthi wobani okwakumele bavale izikhala.Inhlangano engenzi nzuzo, enakekela izilwane nemvelo, kulindeleke ukuthi ifake isicelo sokuba umngani wenkantolo, ibe yingxenye yesigcawu.Ifuna kujeziswe uNzimande ngezinsolo zokuthi uyathinteka ekubulaweni kobhejane, ukuze kutholwe izimpondo zabo.Isicelo sizolalelwa yiJaji Jeremiah Shongwe osathatha umhlalaphansi ngoLwesine.Sizobe sesihlehliselwa uLwesihlanu isigcawu, ukuze ithimba elimele uMbuso nelimele uNzimande bashintshane ngemiqulu edingekayo.U-Adv Lisle Mboweni, ohola ithimba elimele umqashi, ucele kuhlehliswe isigcawu ngoba kunemininingwane eshodayo emqingweni wabo wamakhasi evile ku-400, okumele bayilande ePitoli.Uthe uma kuqhutshekwa engekho amaphepha abawadingayo, lokho kuyocindezela uNzimande.Ummeli kaNzimande, uMnuz Ravindra Maniklall, uvumelene nesicelo sikamqashi wathi bathemba ukuthi ngesonto elizayo bazobe sebenikiwe imininingwane.UShongwe ucele izinhlangothi zombili, wathi uyakuqonda ukuthi kunemininingwane okumele kushintshiswane ngayo kodwa lokhu kumele kwenzeke ngokushesha.Uthe lolu wudaba oseluthathe isikhathi eside futhi akathandi luqhubeke lubambezeleke."Kubalulekile ukuthi kunikwane ngale mininingwane esikhathini okuvunyelwene ngaso ukuze kugwenywe okunye ukuhlehliswa kokulalelwa kwesigcawu,” kusho ijaji.
KUVELE inkinga yokushoda kwemali yokukhokhela ummeli wakhe ecaleni lobeyikhansela le-ANC eThekwini ngoMsombuluko.UMnuz Mkhipheni Mzimuni Ngiba (46), obekade eyikhansela e-ward 101 eMayville, ubevele nabamangalelwe abane eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.UNgiba uboshelwe amacala amabili, okuzama ukubulala namabili okubulala amalungu e-ANC oMnuz Siyabonga Mkhize noMzukisi Nyanga ngo-Okthoba 2021 bekhankasa eCato Crest.UMkhize walunqoba esekobandayo ukhetho lwamakhansela, ngoNovemba 2021. Kwaphoqa ukuba kube nokhetho lokuchibiyela, i-ANC yase ifolosa ngoNgiba owanqoba.Uxoshwe ekubeni yikhansela ngoSepthemba ngonyaka odlule futhi wagcina ngayo leyo nyanga ukuhola.Ummeli kaNgiba, u-Adv Andrew Matlamela utshele iJaji Nicholson ukuthi kube nenkinga yokuthi akhokhelwe."Kungenzeka ummangalelwa agcine esesizwa wummeli wamahhala kahulumeni. Sincane isikhathi esivumelane ngaso ukuthi uzobe eseyitholile imali esivumelane ngayo, ukuze angikhokhele,” kusho uMatlamela.Isolezwe limlandelile uMatlamela laphuma naye enkantolo lacela ukucaciseleka ngenkulumo ayisho enkantolo.Uqhubekile wathi uNgiba akasasebenzi futhi ayikho imali ayitholayo."Sivumelane ngesikhathi esingamasonto amabili ukuthi sikhokhelane, uma ehluleka kusho ukuthi ummeli wamahhala kahulumeni wuyena okuzomele azoqhubeke necala,”kusho uMatlamela.UNicholson ulihlehlisele uFebhuwari 15 icala khona kuzokwenziwa izethulo ezindlalela ukuqulwa kwecala, okuhlelelwe u-Ephreli nonyaka.Izethulo bezihlelelwe ukuba zenziwe izolo kodwa uMbuso wacela lihlehliswe icala khona kuzobuya umshushisi walo, u-Adv Elvis Gcweka okuvele ukuthi kunelinye icala alenzayo.Ijaji lithe ukuhlehla kwecala kuzosiza nabanye abamangalelwa enkantolo okuvele ukuthi nabo badonsa kanzima ukukhokhela abameli babo.Ngenyanga eyedlule uNgiba naboshwe nabo bachithwe yinkantolo okwesibili esicelweni sabo sebheyili.Ngawo uDisemba i-ward ibe nokhetho lokuchibiyela olunqotshwe nguMnuz Simphiwe Khanyile we-ANC, okulindeleke afungiswe kule nyanga.UNgiba selokhe agqunywa ezitokisini kusukela eboshwa ngoMashi 2022. UNgiba ongumsolwa wesithathu, ugqunywe ejele Ebongweni, eKokstad, nabanye abamangalelwa oMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo (38), Sandile Mzizi (40) noSifiso Mlondo (37).Ummangalelwa wesihlanu, uMnuz Phathesakhe Ngiba (25), oyisihlobo sikaNgiba, utoke ejele laseWestville.
UNQABE ukufaka isicelo sebheyili oyedwa kwababili abasolwa ngokuhlahlela amalungu amahlanu omndeni owodwa wasesiGodini, eMgungundlovu.UMnuz Siphesihle Xulu (24) ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu izolo noMnuz Philani Shezi (39) asolwa naye, yena okuthiwe uzosifaka ngoFebhuwari 7 esakhe isicelo sebheyili.Basolwa ngokubulala isaguga uNkk Thokozile Gumede (85), indodakazi yaso uNksz Fikile Gumede (45), abazukulu uZiyanda Gumede (9), u-Ayanda Gumede (11) no-Asanda (11).Laba batholwa yilungu lomndeni bedindilize exhaphozini legazi ngoLwesine. Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, leli lungu liveze ukuthi lalikade livakashe ndawana thize ngobusuku okwenzeka ngabo isigameko. Imbazo okukholakala ukuthi bahlahlelwa ngayo, nayo yatholakala endaweni yesigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, elandisa ngokuboshwa kwabasolwa, uthe emva kwesigameko amaphoyisa athatha abantu ababili ukuyobaphosa ngemibuzo."Emva kokuphekwa ngemibuzo, bobabili babekwe icala,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.Uthe bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu namuhla (esho izolo). Umuntu ngamunye ubhekene namacala ayisihlanu okubulala nelilodwa lokuphanga esebenzisa indlakadla."UXulu usilaxazile isicelo sakhe sebheyili, uShezi yena kulindeleke ukuthi asifake ngoFebhuwari 7 esakhe isicelo sebheyili,” kuchaza uNetshiunda.UMkhuzi wamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ukushayele ihlombe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwethimba labaphenyi, kwaboshwa abasolwa ngokuphazima kweso.Uyalele ithimba ukuba liqhubeke nokuqinisa uphenyo lwalo ukuze liqinisekise ukuthi abasolwa bathola isigwebo esifanele ngesenzo sabo asichaze njengesinonya."Ukuboshwa kwabasolwa ngokushesha kuyancomeka. Silishayela ihlombe ithimba labaphenyi ukwenza umsebenzi oncomekayo ngesikhathi esifishane. Kumele benze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenzeka,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Ubuye wathi kufanele baphenye nokuthi abekho yini abanye abasolwa abathinteka kulesi sigameko abasengaphandle ukuze nabo bezobhekana nengalo yomthetho.
UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uthi sebezofunda ngohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe abafundi abangaphumelelanga ku-matric abazobe belungisa imiphumela yabo. Umnyango unohlelo lokusiza labo abasuke bengaphumelelanga ngesikhathi kubhalwa u-matric ukuze balungise imiphumela yabo. Umnyango ulokhu ulishumayele njalo ivangeli lokuthi abangaphumelelanga bangacabangi ukuthi kuphelile ngabo ngoba zikhona izinhlelo zokuthi bavuke bazithathe.Kulezi zinsuku kuyahalaliswa ngenxa yemiphumela emihle yabafundi baka-matric abebebhala ngonyaka odlule. Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal senyuse imiphumela sathola u86.36% sisuka ku-83% wango-2022. Ngokwemiphumela kazwelonke iKZN ilale isibili ilandela iFree State ethole u-89%.Ukumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yaseKZN bekuhanjelwe nawuNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo kuzwelonke, uNkk Angie Motshekga, obebabaza umsebenzi omuhle.Bangu-167 247 abafundi abebebhala ngonyaka odlule kwase kuphumelela abangu-136 366. Kuvele nokuthi isibalo esikhulu sabafundi abaphase ngo-Bachelor siqhamuka KwaZulu-Natal. Isifundazwe siphinde sibe nabafundi abaningi kunazozonke ebezibhala u-matric.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, exoxa neSolezwe, uchaze kabanzi ngalolu hlelo lwabazolungisa imiphumela yabo."Kuvelile ukuthi abanye abafundi bagcina bengayi emakilasini ngenxa yokushoda kwemali nokuthi kukude. Sibe sesisungula uhlelo lokuthi bafunde belapho bekhona ngezobuchwepheshe. Kuzoba nothisha ozongena afundise kuqoshwe nesifundo sakhe baphinde bakwazi futhi ukuxoxa naye,’’ kusho uMahlambi.UMahlambi uthe bazokhipha isiqeshana sombhalo ochaza kabanzi ngokuzokwenzeka. Uthe kufanele baqale babhalise labo abafuna ukufunda kuze kube wuFebhuwari. UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Frazer, naye ukugcizelele ukuthi labo abangaphumelelanga ngeke babalahlise okwenyongo yenyathi kodwa bayabenzela inhlelo zokuthi balungise isimo.Sezivele zivuliwe izikole kulo nyaka, usuqalile umshikashika wokufunda ezweni lonke kanti nalabo abafuna ukulungisa imiphumela kulindeleke ukuthi baqale maduze.
Usola ukuthi uthengelwe izinkabi ukuba zizombulala umndeni wowesilisa oyilungu leSikebhe odutshulwe wafa esemzini wakhe oQaqeni KwaMaphumulo ngoLwesine.UMnuz Thulani Mhlongo (69) kuthiwa uhlaselwe abantu abangaziwa ngezikhathi zantambama, bambulala, kodwa bangathatha lutho.ISikebhe inhlangano engenzi nzuzo, elwa nobugebengu bokwebiwa kwemfuyo ezindaweni ezehlukene KwaZulu-Natal.Inkosikazi yakhe, uNkk Thembelihle Mhlongo, ilandisa ngesigameko, ithe bebekhona bonke ekhaya ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko."Besihleli ekhishini, ubaba ecambalele kwazise ubesanda kushayisa etohweni lakhe. Kuqhamuke abesilisa, abafike bambuza kumzukulu, ophendule ngelithi usacambalele,” kulanda uNkk Mhlongo.Uthe umzukulu unikele kumufi, eyomvusa, emazisa ukuthi kukhona abamcelayo."Uthe angafika kubona, ezozwa ukuthi bakhala ngani, bambuza umbuzo owodwa, bathi 'uyiSikebhe wena?’, akabange esathola nethuba lokuwuphendula, bamdubula,” kusho uNkk Mhlongo.Uthe konke lokhu kwenzeke phambi kwakhe nezingane ezivele zahlakazeka zayocasha."Bebengazifihlile ebusweni kodwa engikuqaphelile ukuthi abantu esingabazi. Ngiyasola ukuthi bathathwe ndawana thize ukuthi bazombulala, ngoba asibazi,” kuchaza uNkk Mhlongo.Uqhube wathi babone sebehamba ukuthi kanti bebefike ngemoto."Ibipakwe emgwaqweni,” kusho uNkk Mhlongo.Uveze ukuthi indawo yaKwaMaphumulo ibhekene nesihlava sokwebiwa kwemfuyo, wathi yingaleso sizathu umyeni wakhe waze wajoyina iSikebhe esikhathini esingangonyaka esedlule.Uthe sibashiye bethuthumela isigameko kangangoba izingane ezifundayo azilubhadi esikoleni."Zinovalo lokuthi mhlawumbe bangahle babuye. Yena lo ababuze kuye ubaba, waze wayomvusa, ubukeka ethikamezekile ngisho nasemoyeni,” kusho uNkk Mhlongo, othe ufuna ubulungiswa ngokufa komyeni wakhe, wakhala nangokuthi abazi ukuthi bazomngcwaba ngani.Okhulumela iSikebhe, uMnuz Joseph Manyathi, uthe babikelwe ngokubulawa kukaMhlongo.Uthe zike zibe khona izigameko zokuhlaselwa, kubulawe amalungu enhlangano yabo."Kuyasikhalisa ukuthi thina uma sibamba umuntu ngemvubu, kuduma izwe lonke, kodwa uma sibulawa, kuyathuleka,” kusho uManyathi.Uveze ukuthi igatsha labo laKwaMaphumulo alikabi naso isikhathi eside libunjiwe, wathi liqalwe emva kokudlanga kokwebiwa kwemfuyo kule ndawo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMaphumulo aphenya icala lokubulala kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-69."Udutshulwe wafa Oqaqeni ngoLwesine,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.
Umholi wabaphenyi becala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, uthe ummangalelwa wokuqala walidalula igama lomuntu owayebathume ukuyosoconga umufi.UGininda udalule lokhu eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli lapho abethula khona ubufakazi bakhe izolo. UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wafa ekubo kwentombi yakhe ewumculi, uKelly Khumalo, eVolsoorus, ePitoli ngobusuku bango-Okthoba 26,2014.Icala libuyele enkantolo okokuqala kulo nyaka selokhu laguqa ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule ngesikhathi ummeli, u-Adv Thulani Mngomezulu ebika ukugula. Ngesikhathi limiswa kwakusingethwe uhlelo lokuthola ukuthi izitatimende zokuvuma icala zifanelwe yini ukwemukelwa enkantolo njengobufakazi.Izolo kuqale ngokuthi u-Adv Mngomezulu apheke uGininda ngemibuzo ngencwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwabamangalelwa, okuyinto ebangwe kakhulu. UMngomzeulu uthe uGininda kufanele achaze ukuthi kungani wafaka isicelo sencwadi yokubopha abamangalelwa ekubeni ayebazi ukuthi baboshiwe ngamanye amacala.Kuphikiswane kwaze kwaba yiJaji Ratha Makgoatlheng elinquma ukuthi kufundwe isitatimende sikaGininda asihambisa emantshini, efaka isicelo sencwadi. UGininda wenekele inkantolo ukuthi abamangalelwa bathinteka kanjani ngamunye ecaleni.Uthe abamangalelwa bayizinkabi ezaziwayo embonini yamatekisi. UGininda efunda isitatimende, uveze ukuthi uMeyiwa wathengelwa izinkabi hhayi indaba yenganekwane yokuthi kwakubanjwa inkunzi."Ummangalelwa wokuqala esitatimendeni sakhe esibhaliwe evuma icala, washo izinto ezithile ezaphoqa ukuthi senabe nophenyo. Wakubeka kwacaca nokuthi wubani owabayalela ukubulala uMeyiwa,’’ kusho uGininda.UGininda uveze nokuthi ummangalelwa wesibili, uBongani Ntanzi wavuma konke, waze wadalula nabanye abathintekayo. Uqhubekile uGininda watshela inkantolo ukuthi wuNtanzi owangena endlini ngobusuku besigameko, wayezimisele ukuba wufakazi woMbuso, achakide abanye abamangalelwa.UGininda uqhubekile wathi ummangalelwa wesithathu, uMthobisi Mncube, wuyena owangena endlini ephethe isibhamu ngobusuku besigameko owagcina edubula uMeyiwa. "Ummangalelwa wesithathu udonsa iminyaka engu-35, ngecala lokubulala umuntu. Umbiko wesibhamu uveza ukuthi yisona abulala ngaso kulelo cala futhi yisona esabulala uMeyiwa,’’ kuchaza uGininda.Uchaze nangommangalelwa wesine, uMthokozisi Maphisa, wathi yena wayesele ngaphandle egadile ephethe isibhamu esincanyana. Ummangalelwa wesihlanu, uFisokuhle Ntuli kuvele ukuthi yena wayesele emotweni elinde ukuthi uma kuqedwa ayishaye izule.Kuvela ukuthi uNtuli wayeshayela iVW Polo empunga ngombala futhi wayeke wabonakala ehamba ngayo ngaphambi kwesigameko, waphinda wabonakala nangemuva kwaso. UGininda uthe ukubulawa kukaMeyiwa kwahlelwa ehostela eVosloorus futhi kwayiwa khona nasemuva kwesigameko.Uveze nokuthi iselula kaKelly eyathathwa yalandelwa, yagcina inyamalala ngakhona koVosloorus, yacinywa yangaphinde yavulwa. Icala lisheshe laguqa ngoba abameli bekufanele banikwe ithuba lokubheka amadokodo amanye amacala abamangalelwa abathinteka kuwona. Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo namuhla.
Umphathi woKhozi FM, uSbongi Ngcobo usethumelele u-Owen Ndlovu ngencwadi eyisivimbelo senkantolo emyalela ukuthi angalokothi amsabise noma amhlukumeze.Le ncwadi, Isolezwe linayo ikhophi yalo, kuthiwa ihanjiswe yisikhonzi senkantolo kuNdlovu ngabo-6 ntambama ngoLwesibili.Kuyona kuvela ukuthi uNdlovu uyisayinile futhi inesigxivizo sesiteshi samaphoyisa aseBrixton, eGoli.Kuthiwa uNdlovu uzovela eNkantolo yaseRandburg ngoFebhuwari 20 mayelana necala lokuhlukumeza.Encwadini uyalelwa ukuthi angalokothi asabise ummangali."Ungenzi izitatimende ezingamanga noma ugxibhe ummangali. Ungafaki imiyalezi, amavideo noma yini ezinkundleni zokuxhumana,” kusho incwadi.Umbango kaNdlovu noNgcobo usuka emncintiswaweni owawenziwa ngu-Owen obizwa ngeSABC Summer Song of the Year owawuba eziteshini zale nhlangano ngoDisemba. UNQABE ummeli wamahhala olaxaze uqweqwe lommeli ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengunobhala jikelele we-ANC Youth League, uMnuz Sindiso Magaqa.Ummangalelwa wesine, uMnuz Sibusiso Ncengwa, utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngeke amdinge ummeli wamahhala ngesikhathi eyazisa ukuthi uzoshintsha ummeli.UNcengwa ubekade emelwe wuqweqwe lommeli, u-Adv Shane Matthews, omele abanye abasolwa ababili kuleli cala.Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, uNcengwa ubuziwe ukuthi uzomdinga yini ummeli wamahhala njengoba eselaxaze uMatthews.Uphendule ngokuthi uzoziqashela owakhe.UNcengwa utshele inkantolo ukuthi uhlose ukuqasha inkampani, iShoba Attorneys, ukuba kube yiyo eqhubeka nokumumela."Ngake ngakhuluma naye phambilini, ngimbikela ukuthi ngifuna ozongimela."Akazange asidalule isizathu sokulaxaza uMatthews.Umshushisi omkhulu ecaleni, u-Adv Lawrence Gcaba, uthe bazozama ukuxhumana nabameli abasha, ukuze babazise ukuthi icala likusiphi isigaba.UGcaba uthe bafuna ukuthi kungabambezeleki ukuqulwa kwecala.UGcaba ubuye waveza ukuthi sebesifakile isicelo sokuba ummangalelwa wesithathu ecaleni, uMnuz Mlungisi Ncalane, ayohlolwa umqondo.UGcaba uthe usembhalelile umphathi wesibhedlela sabagula ngengqondo, iFort Naiper, ecela ukuba amukele uNcalane."Konke sekusezandleni zomphathi wesibhedlela. Sitshelwe ukuthi ujwayele ukusheshe aphendule. Ngakho-ke sibheke ukuthi impendulo siyithole maduze."UNcalane kunqunywe ukuba aphinde ayohlolwa umqondo emva kwesicelo esifakwe uMatthews.NgoMsombuluko uMatthews utshele inkantolo ukuthi uNcalane ubukeka ephazamisekile emqondweni, wakhala ngokuthi uvele aqhunsule amehlo uma kukhulunywa naye.UMatthews uthe usaba ukuthi uNcalane akakwazi ukulandela okwenzeka enkantolo ngenxa yokuphazamiseka emqondweni.UNcalane wake wahlolwa umqondo ngo-2022 kodwa umbiko wathola ukuthi uhlushwa wukuphuza ngokweqile nokubhema insangu.Icala lizobuyela enkantolo ngoFebhuwari 6, lapho kuzozwakala khona ukuthi uNcalane uzokuya nini ukuyohlolwa umqondo.Ngalo lolu suku kuyokuba sekunqunywa usuku okuzoqulwa ngalo icala.Abanye abasolwa ecaleni oMnuz Sbonelo Myeza, noMbulelo Mpofana.UMagaqa wasocongwa ngo-2017, wadutshulwa ebuya emhlanganweni wamakhansela.Ukuqulwa kwecala sekubambezeleke izikhawu eziningi.
Ukuhlolwa kwezindawo ezikhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula njengezivelelwe yinhlekelele, kuzophoqa ukuthi omasipala abathintekayo bahlele kabusha isabelomali sabo ukuze kulungiswe ingqalasizinda ecekeleke phansi.Lokhu kuza ngemumva kokuthi uNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke, uNksz Thembi Nkadimeng, ehambele eMnambithi eyohlola umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula.UNksz Nkadimeng uthe omasipala abafana noThukela, iLembe, Ugu, uMzinyathi neTheku bahlonzwe njengezindawo zenhlekelele.Uthe uMasipala wasoThukela yiwo okhahlamezeke kakhulu, ngesibalo sabangu-26 abashone ngenxa yezikhukhula.UMPHATHISWA wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi noNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuzwelonke uNksz Thembi Nkadimeng, behambele eMnambithi beyohlola umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE "Ngokugunyazwa uMthetho wezeziNhlekelele, ukuhlonzwa kwalezi zindawo njengezivelelwe inhlekelele kuzonika igunya omasipala bazo ukuthi bahlele kabusha isabelomali sabo ukuze babeke eqhulwini umsebenzi wokulungiswa kwengqalasizinda ekhahlamezekile,” kusho yena.Uqhube wathi lokhu kuzophinde kulekelele ekutheni labo masipala bakwazi ukuthola uxhaso lwemali eyengeziwe kuhulumeni wesifundazwe kanjalo nakuhulumeni kazwelonke ukuze bakwazi ukulungisa ingqalasizinda efana nemigwaqo, amabhuloho nemizi yabantu ekhahlamezekile.Uthe yize amathimba ezinhlekelele esaqhubeka nokuhlonza umonakalo odalekile kodwa imibiko engakapheleli iveza ukuthi ungadla izigidi ngezigidi umonakalo uma kubukwa isifundazwe."Okwamanje umbiko osaqoqwe oThukela, uveza ukuthi ingqalasizinda ekhahlamezekile ingaphezu kukaR2 billion. Kulokhu kubalwa imigwaqo, amabhuloho, izikole nemizi yabantu,” kusho uNksz Nkadimeng.Ubuye wabalula nokuthi amabhuloho ekhele uthelawayeka uN11 eMnambithi akhahlamezekile, wathi ukulungiswa kwawo kufanele kwenzeke ngokushesha.Uthe kuyakhathaza nokho ukuthi ngesikhathi bephezu kwezinhlelo zokulungiswa komonakalo kodwa izikhukhula azikapheli.Uphethe ngelithi, kuzothi uma sebeqoqe lonke ulwazi ngomonakalo, balandela nayo yonke imigudu efanele, bese befaka isicelo kuMengameli wezwe uCyril Ramaphosa ukuthi amemezele ngokusemthethweni ukuthi izingxenye ezithize zesifundazwe ziyizindawo zenhlekelele ukuze noMgcinimafa neminye iminyango kahulumeni izolekelela.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, uthe bakushayela ihlombe ukusondela kukahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke ukuzozibonela umonakalo odalwe yizikhukhula.Uthe kungabathokozisa ukuthi uRamaphosa amemezele ngokusemthethweni ukuthi lezi zindawo zivelelwe inhlekelele ngoba umonakalo odalekile ubiza izindodla zemali, omasipala abakhahlamezekile abangenayo.
I-ANC isola i-IFP ngokuzama ukuphazamisa umcimbi ebiwenzele izaguga eVryheid, izolo.I-ANC ithe izaguga zicishe zabuyela emumva zilambatha emva kokuthi amalungu e-ANC evale amasango eSasko, lapho bekwenzelwe khona umcimbi.Lo mcimbi ubuwenziwe ngabe-ANC abangamalungu esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal.Isolezwe libone i-video yalesi sigameko, lapho kubonakala amaphoyisa ezama ukuhlukanisa amalungu e-ANC nawe-IFP abefuna ukubambana ngezandla.Kule-video amalungu alezi zinhlangano achaphana ngenhlamba, aze adunuselane.USotswebhu omkhulu esiShayamthetho, uMnuz James Nxumalo, uthe bafike endaweni yomcimbi amalungu e-IFP evimbe endaweni yokungena.UNxumalo uthe kuhlule ngisho sekubizwe abakwasidlodlo, amalungu e-IFP aqhubeka nokuphazamisa umcimbi wabo.AMALUNGU e-IFP asolwa ngokuphazamisa umcimbi obuhlelwe i-ANC Isithombe: SithunyelweUNxumalo uthe isenzo samalungu e-IFP siphambene nemithetho yokhetho."Siyayigxeka indlela amalungu e-IFP aziphathe ngayo. Siyanxusa amalungu e-IFP ukuba abekezelele ezinye izinhlangano. Zonke izinhlangano zinelungelo lokukhankasa ngokukhululeka. Le nto eyenziwe amalungu e-IFP ayigqugquzeli ukuthula. Siyanxusa ukuthi ngokuzayo kungabi bikho abantu abazophazamisa uma kuneqembu elinomcimbi.”UNxumalo uthe okubajabulisile ukuthi umcimbi wabo ugcine uqhubekile."Ogogo nomkhulu bajabulile kakhulu. Uma bengase batshelwe okusolwa ukuthi bazovalelwa omazisi babo ngoba besolwa ngokuthi ngabomgunyathi, bangaqhubeka benze ubugebengu ngabo ngaphambi kokuthi bavalwe.Lokhu kushiwo uNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezeseKhaya, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, ephawula ngesinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Inkantolo ithe umnyango akufanele uvale ukusebenza komazisi babantu ngaphandle kokubazisa, ukuphenya ukuthi izinsolo ezikhona ngaleyo nombolo kamazisi ziyiqiniso yini.Iqhube yathe umnikazi kamazisi kumele anikwe ilungelo lokudlulisa isinqumo uma engenelisekile ngoba lokho kungukwephula ilungelo laleso sakhamuzi elikuMthethosisekelo.IJaji Elmarie van der Schyff, leNkantolo eNkulu yasePretoria, lithe uMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango wezaseKhaya unomthwalo wokuvikela isithunzi somqulu okubhalwe kuwo bonke abantu bakuleli.Lithe akulungile "ukubeka umaka” kunoma yimuphi umazisi osolisayo, ukuvimba ukusebenza kwalowo mazisi, ngaphandle kokulandela inqubo efanele.Icala belifakwe nguNksz Phindile Mazibuko, othintekayo ekuvalweni komazisi, osebenzise iLawyers for Human Rights neLegalWise South Africa. UMnyango wezaseKhaya nomqondisi-jikelele womnyango bebethi akukho okuphambene nomthetho okwenziwa wumnyango, ngokuvala omazisi abasolisayo. Abafake izicelo xokulalelwa kodaba enkantolo bebethi bangamakhulu abantu abakhala ngokuthi omazisi babo bavalwa ukuthi basebenze, ngaphandle kokwaziswa ngaphambi kokuthi bavalwe futhi kungekho zizathu ezibekiwe.Ngenxa yalokho abakwazi ukuthola izincwadi ezibavumela ukuthi bavakashele ngaphandle kwezwe, abakwazi ukuvota, ukuthola usizo lwezempilo, imfundo noma ukuvula ama-akhawunti emabhange. Bathi izingane zabo ezibhaliswe izitifiketi zazo ngomazisi babo zihlukumezeke ngendlela efanayo.Ijaji lithe abameli babamangali bathe umnyango usanda kuvula omazisi abangaphezu kuka-1.8-million ababevaliwe kodwa ngesikhathi kulalelwe isicelo ngoSepthemba nyakenye, bekusenomazisi abangu-700 000 abavaliwe.UMotsoaledi , uthe amabhange athe uma kungase kuvulwe omazizi abangu-700 000 azoshona ngoba abenza omazisi bomgunyathi baboleka imali emabhange besebenzisa bona labo mazisi."Ukubazisa ngaphambi kokubavala omazisi abasolekayo nakhona kungabeka amabhange engcupheni yokuthi benze ubuqola ngabo, sebazi ukuthi bazovalwa. Siwumnyango sizozama ukuthi sibuyele etafuleni sibheke ukuthi umthetho, i-Identification Act singawulungisa kanjani," kusho uMotsoaledi.

Udidekile umndeni wesaguga sasoBengwane, eNquthu, esinyamalale sisohambweni oluyingcwele lwaseKhenana lwamaNazaretha aseBuhleni.UNkk Sphepho Mbatha (70) kuthiwa wagcina ukubonwa ngoJanuwari 5, 2024, KwaNodwengu, eNdwedwe, ehamba namanye amakholwa.Indodakazi yakhe, uNkk Bonakele Khuzwayo, ithe ngoJanuwari 5, ilungu lomndeni lashayela ucingo isaguga, lisibheka ukuthi singene kahle yini onyakeni omusha."Uthe uma engishayela, washo ukuthi uzwa umama ekhuluma into engahlangani, usola sengathi uphithanelwa yikhanda,” kusho uNkk Khuzwayo.Ekhungathwa ilokhu, uthi naye wasukumela phezulu, wazama ukumshayela ucingo ngokwakhe kodwa wathola ukuthi ucingo seluvalekile.UNkk Khuzwayo uthe unikele eKhenana, ngoJanuwari 8, wavukela kumkhokheli kanina ngakusasa, yaqala yakhulunywa eyokuthi unyamalele."Izingane zifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zisho ukuthi umama unyamalele,” kuchaza uNkk Khuzwayo.Uthe kukhona abaphendule bathi bambona ephambana nabazalwane, ebuyela emumva, bathi uma bembuza ukuthi uyaphi, wathi uyolanda isikhwama sakhe.UNkk Khuzwayo uveze nokuthi abanye baveze ukuthi ukhona omunye umzalwane owawa washona, wathathwa amaphoyisa."Sizamile ukulandelela lokho ngasemaphoyiseni kodwa sithole ukuthi kungamampunge, ngoba amaphoyisa alandulile,” kulandisa uNkk Khuzwayo.Uthe kukhona omunye umkhondo abasanda kuwuthola womuntu okuthiwa waphelelwa amandla wangena emzini othize, abakhona bamphuthumisa esibhedlela. Wathi wona bekusenzima ukuwulandelela kwazise abanazihlobo eThekwini, kanti yena uhlala eMsinga, akanayo imali yokuzobheka esibhedlela. Wayegqoke iphinifa eliluhlaza, ebophe umchilo wesonto omhlophe,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.Uthe amalungu omphakathi angaba nolwazi ngokuduka kwakhe, angathinta umphenyi, uLieutenant Colonel Zulu enombolweni ethi: 032 532 2356 noma kweyamaphoyisa ethi 08600 10111.
Othishanhloko basezikoleni ezintulayo ezenze kahle ku-matric ngo-2023, bathe basebenzise izinsiza ezincane abanazo, bangachitha isikhathi bebalisela izinto abangenazo.INdukwenhle High iphase ngo-100% okuthuse abantu abaningi ngoba lesi sikole phambilini, besaziwa ngokuthi kukwampunz’edla emini. Uthe bekudliwa izidakamizwa kubhenywa insangu, kubanjwa abafundi inkunzi bengaphakathi esikoleni nokunye. UMbonambi obonakale kumavideo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana edansa ngenxa yenjabulo, uqale ukuba uthishanhloko obambile kulesi sikole ngo-2021, kodwa ufike ngo-2014 ezofundisa iMaths, ephuma eVelabahleke High.Lesi sikole asibiyiwe, amakilasi angu-16 awanawo ugesi, asinalo ucingo lwezokoxhumana. Kusetshenziswa iselula yakhe uma kuthintwa abantu ngocingo, amadeski awanele, othisha nabo kabenele.UMbonambi uthe yena usebenzisa lokho okukhona, akalibali ukubalisa ngezinsiza ezenza ukuthi kube lula ukufunda.Ngo-2021, u-matric uphase ngo-87.9%, ngo-2022 waphasa ngo-96.6 njengoba kukulo nyaka sithole u-100% "Asikwazi ukufunda ebusuku njengezinye izikole ngoba amakilasi kawanawo ugesi. Singena ngo-6 ekuseni siphume ngo-6 wantambama, sifunde nangezimpelasonto," echaza.Uthe uthathe izintambo kulesi sikole othishanhloko abangaphambi kwakhe sebeqalile ukuzama ukusibuyisela endleleni kodwa abazali besemanqikanqika ukuletha izingane zabo.UTHISHANHLOKO waseMzuvele High, KwaMashu, uMnuz Charles Khuzwayo, emukela indondo yokuthi lesi sikole sibhukule kunazo zonke eThekwini kwiMeya uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, nyakenye ISITHOMBE: SITHUNYELWE " Lesi sikole sike saba nabafundi abangu-250. Ngiqale ukuphatha sinabafundi abaphakathi kuka-600 kuya ku-700, sabambisana nothisha ngokuba nezinhlelo zokungena ekuseni, siphinde sibe nohlelo lwabafundi abangaphasi yize benza konke okwenziwa abanye. Bona sibalekelela ngokuthi sibacathulise, siphinde sithole ukuthi imaphi amakhono abanawo bese sibafakela izicelo emaTVET. "Uma sebemukeliwe sibafakela izicelo esikhwameni esisiza abafundi ngemali yokufunda. Lolu hlelo lusiza kakhulu ngoba lwenza ukuthi umfundi onjalo aqale ukuyofunda eTVET esenokuzethemba ngoba sinezinhlangano eziningi ezisilekelekayo ukuze lube impumelelo," kuchaza uMbonambi.Ngo-2022, uthe imiphumela ka-matric yayingu-87.9% okwaheha abafundi, manje sebengu-1 200 nothisha abangu-16 kodwa ngokwesibalo sabafundi badinga abangu-25.Uthe into edlangile ukugqekezwa kwesikole ngoba isikole siseduze kwemijondolo."Ugesi ufakwe ekupheleni konyaka odlule emakilasini wonke, ngoDisemba, zantshontsha izintambo, nyakenye sasinikelelwe ngezihlalo namatafula okuhlala abafundi, amatafula antshontshwa. Ngo-2022 kwebiwa ama-laptops enye kwakungeyami eyayinomsebenzi wonke wesikole. Ukube ngangingalwenzanga uhlelo lokugcina umsebenzi kwenye i-App ngabe abafundi abawatholanga ama-riphothi.UMnuz Charles Khuzwayo uthishanhloko waseMzuvele High KwaMashu, uthe kunzima satshe ukushintsha abafundi abebazi ukuthi bafika noma ngasikhathisini esikoleni baphinde bahambe uma sekuthi abahambe.Uqale ukuphatha lesi sikole ngo-2021, ephuma eSivananda Technical High School, ngalowo nyaka u-matric waphasa ngo-31%. Nyakenye uphase ngo-77%, kwathi kulo nyaka waphasa ngo-93.4%.Nyakenye, siklonyeliswe iMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ngokuba yisikole esibhukule kunazo zonke eThekwini. Uthe othisha bafundisa amakilasi engeziwe aba sekuseni, ntambama, ngezimpelasonto nangamaholide ukuze bathole imiphumela abayitholile. Uthe waqala ngokushintsha izinto ezincane ezenza abafundi bangazimiseli."Ngigcizelele ukuthi umfaniswano ugqokwe uphelele, ukuthi uma umfundi efika sesingenile isikole akhombise ukuthi usephutheni agijime akhombise ukulangazelela ukufunda, uma engakwenzi lokho athole isijeziso Kube nzima ukufaka lelo siko ngoba bebazi ukuthi bazenzela umathanda, obekwenza ukuthi nabafuna ukudayisa izidakamizwa esikoleni bakwazi ukukwenza kalula. Ngesikhathi sesiqalile ukuqinisa isandla kubafundi kwaze kwagwaza nothisha ngoba kwase kubonakala ukuthi siyaphela isidleke kanti nesikole sesibiywe ngothango oluwucingo olwenza ukuthi ubone kahle," usho kanje. Uthe umbono wakhe ukuthi enyuse izinga lokuphasa kuka-matric eminyakeni emithathu eqalile ukuphatha, kwelandelayo asebenzele ukuthi ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu uMzuvele ube usuyisikole abafundi abaningi abafisa ukufunda kuso."Ukubambisana nothisha, abazali, osomabhizinisi nabaholi nomphakathi yikhona okusenze safika kuleli zinga. Njengamanje bonke abafundi ngo-7.30 basuke sebesesikoleni, uma sebengaphakathi singothisha senza isiqiniseko sokuthi bayafunda. Abazali nomphakathi benza isiqiniseko sokuthi kuphephile esikoleni. "Sinokuncintisana okuhle nezinye izikole ezikwiSiyingi saKwaMashu. Uma kukhona engikubonile kusebenza kwesinye isikoleni ngiya kuleso sikole ngiyobuza ukuthi basebenzise ziphi izindlela ukuze baphumelele," kusho uKhuzwayo.
Ukusungula iqembu lezepolitiki kukaDuduzane Zuma kuthathwa njengokwakha umgoga wokukhama iqembu elibusayo i-ANC, hhayi ngoba lizoba nethuba lokuwina ukhetho. Usho kanje umhlaziyi wezepolitiki ozinze eNyuvesi iNelson Mandela, uSolwazi Bheki Mngomezulu, othe izicagogwana zamaqembu ziqonda kahle ukuthi zizothwala kanzima ukuheha abalandeli - kodwa ubhedu olukhulu ukuketula i-ANC emandleni.Lokhu kulandela ukumenyezelwa kweqembu i-All Game Changers (AGC), eliholwa yindodana yowayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uDuduzane. UMngomezulu uqagule ukuthi i-ACG izohluleka ukuheha abantu njengoba kwenza iqembu elikhankaselwa nguyise, uMkhonto weSizwe. Eqinisweni ubona ekugcineni kungenzeka uDuduzane athasisele emgodleni owakhiwa uMsholozi onhloso yawo ukudlalisa injeje uKhongolose ungawini kalula."Inhloso yabo (amaqembu amancane) ukuphazamisa ukuthi kungabi khona iqembu elizowina ukhetho ingcaca. Wonke la maqembu asungulwayo azama ukuphazamisa i-ANC ukuthi ingaluwini ukhetho ngamalengiso. Inhloso ukuthi kungabi khona iqembu elizokuba ungqo-shishilizi,” kubeka uMngomezulu."Ngesikhathi kusungulwa uMkhonto weSizwe kwake kwaba namahlebezi okuthi uDuduzane uyena ozoba ngumholi kodwa wakuchitha lokho. Mhlawumbe emva kokhetho bazobuye basebenzisane.”Umbono kaMngomezulu wesekwe umhlaziyi ozimele uMnuz Thabani Khumalo othe ubona kuzokuba yingcosana ezojoyina iqembu likaDuduzane."Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazididekele, bacasukile, bafuna amakhaya amasha. UDuduzane uzobathola labo ababili abathathu abazididekele. Nobani nobani uma ezokwethula iqembu elisha, uyaye afike nalo idlanzana labantu abasuke bedidekile,” kusho uKhumalo.Lo mhlaziyi uthe usola ukuthi okwenze ukuthi uDuduzane angawujoyini uMkhonto weSizwe ukuthi ubesaba ukuthi kungase kwenzeke engemukeleki kahle kule nhlangano. "Kukhona engike ngakhuluma naye oyilungu loMkhonto weSizwe, wathi bona baseka uZuma ngoba bazi amagalelo akhe. Uthe abawazi amagalelo kaDuduzane.”Nasezinkundleni zokuxhumana bakhombise ukungayinambithisisi kahle eyeqembu likaDuduzane, abanye bethi bekufanele ajoyine uMkhonto weSizwe.UKhanyo Mangethe uthe: "Awume kancane ndodana usadinga ukukhula, dedela ubaba wakho enze umsebenzi wakhe.”UKhehla Lami uthe: "Sazi ubaba wakho wena mfana, thina asikwazi wena.”USikhanyiso Mkhize uthe: "Ayi khohlwa Duduzane, thina sifuna ubaba wakho.”USimtholile Simmy uthe: "Asifuni yena sifuna ubaba wakhe.”USlomo Magci SA uthe: "Usebhayizile ke, bekumele angene lapha kubaba wakhe.”UDuduzane uthe usezinhlelweni zokwethula ngokusemthethweni i-AGC.Umqulu wokusungulwa kwe-AGC uveza ukuthi leli qembu lisungulwe emva kocwaningo lweminyaka emithathu lapho khona abaholi balo bebekhuluma nabantu, bezwa izinkinga ababhekene nazo.Phakathi kwezethembiso ezisemqulwini weqembu, kukhona ukuxazulula inkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, ukwakhiwa kabusha kwezimboni, ukubuyiswa komhlaba, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi nemfundo yamahhala."Ngesikhathi sikhuluma nabantu, bebethi 'siyazazi izinkinga kepha iziphi izixazululo?’ Ingakho ke sibeka phambili izixazululo,” kusho isitatimende se-AGC.
Abaholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal bahlasele ngamazwi iqembu elikhankaselwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngesikhathi bephume umkhankaso wokuxoxa namalungu eqembu.Ubuholi obuphezulu kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal bebuthe cithi saka kule mpelasonto, njengoba bekuhlelwe imicimbi yokukhuluma namalungu e-ANC kuzo zonke izifunda.Kuphinde kwaba nomcimbi obuhanjelwe ababengondunankulu baKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sibusiso Ndebele noSihle Zikalala, lapho bekukhunjulwa khona amalungu e-ANC abulawa ngesikhathi sodlame lwezepolitiki KwaSonkombo, Ndwedwe.Abaholi be-ANC baphume kanje nje, umbuso wale nhlangano uyazanyazanyiswa esifundazweni njengoba uMkhonto weSizwe ufike kwezwakala.Kepha abaholi bakhombise ukungethuswa yizigi zoMkhonto weSizwe.UMtolo uthe uZuma kusafanele axolise kwi-ANC njengoba ethe le nhlangano yaqala ukwehlelwa isibalo sabavoti ngaphansi kobuholi bakhe.UMtolo uthe ezinye zezinto ezazenziwa uZuma izona ezenza ukuthi abanye abantu bangayivoteli i-ANC."I-ANC yenza kahle ngaphansi kukaMbeki, yaqala ukwehla ngaphansi kukaZuma. UMbeki washiya i-ANC yenza kahle. Kuyamangaza ukuzwa uZuma ehambe ethi i-ANC iqale ukwehla ngaphansi kukaRamaphosa (uMnuz Cyril). Iqiniso ukuthi i-ANC yaqala ukwehlelwa amavoti ngaphansi kukaZuma. Ngakho uZuma kufanele axolise kwi-ANC nakuRamaphosa.”Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma namalungu e-ANC ngaphansi kwesifunda Inkosi Bhambatha.UMtolo uthe uZuma wajikela bonke abantu ababemeseka ngaphambi kokuthi abe umengameli, nokwenza ukuthi abanye babo bagcina sebeyishiya i-ANC.UZikalala yena usole abasungule uMkhonto weSizwe ngokuzama ukuntshontsha amagugu e-ANC."UMkhonto weSizwe kuyaziwa ukuthi uyifa le-ANC. Kungani laba bantu abasungule uMkhonto weSizwe bengazibizi ngenye into njengoba kwenza amanye amaqembu ezepolitiki amasha?”UZikalala ubekhuluma nezintatheli emva kokuhambela umcimbi wokukhumbula izingqalabutho ze-ANC, oMnuz Million Meyiwa, Thabani Luthuli, noNhlamvana Ngcobo, abangabaseNdwedwe.UNdebele uthe la maqhawe anikela ngempilo yawo."Ngaleso sikhathi wawungeke ucabange ukuthi i-ANC iyoke ifike kuleli zinga KwaZulu-Natal. Nakuba i-ANC siyayibona ikuleli zinga eKZN kungenxa yemisebenzi yala maqhawe.”
Kubulawe ngokudubbula unogada ngasenxanxatheleni yezitolo edumile eMlaza, eThekwini, ngoMsombuluko ntambama.Ngokusho kwabezimo eziphuthumayo, be-ALS Paramedics Medical Services, owesilisa okukhokakala ukuthi uneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-30, utholakale enemanxeba okudutshulwa futhi akukho obese kungenziwa ukumhlenga."Omunye unogada okukholakala ukuthi uneminyaka elinganiselwa ku-30 ubenamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa futhi esesimeni esibucayi,” kusho abe-ALS Paramedics.Bathe uxilongiwe ngaphambi kokuphuthunyiswa esibhedlela, ukuthi alashwe ngokusheshayo."Okwamanje okuholele kulesi sigameko akukaziwa kodwa amaphoyisa abesendaweni yesigameko futhi azophenya.”
UMHOLI wabaphenyi becala lokufa kukaSenzo Meyiwa, uBrigadier Bongani Gininda, uthi abamangalelwa kuleli cala babehamba bexoxela abangani ngolwazi lwabo lokufa kukanozinti, okwaholela ekuboshweni kwabo.Icala belibuya okokuqala kulo nyaka selokhu laguqa ngonyaka odlule kugula ummeli.UGininda ubethula ubufakazi eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli lapho kuqhubeka khona ukuqulwa kwecala lokufa kukaMeyiwa. UMeyiwa wadutshulwa wafa ekubo kwentombi yakhe, uKelly Khumalo, eVosloorus, eGauteng ngo-2014.UGininda ubephekwa ngemibuzo wummeli u-Adv Thulani Mngomezulu. Bekubangwa ukuthi uGininda wayithola kanjani incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwabamangalelwa. Kube yisikhathi eside kubangwa lolu daba, uMngomezulu esola uGininda ngokuthi wathola incwadi ngokungemthetho.Umbango usekutheni sasikhona yini isidingo sokuthi kukhishwe incwadi egunyaza ukuboshwa kwabamangalelwa, ekubeni kwaziwa ukuthi babeboshiwe ngamanye amacala.IJaji Ratha Makgoatlheng liyalele uGininda ukuthi afunde isitatimende esifungelwe asihambisa emantshini, eyagunyaza incwadi yokuboshwa kwabamangalelwa. Ngesikhathi uGininda efunda isitatimende, uchazele inkantolo ngokuthinteka kommangalelwa ngamunye."Abamangalelwa babehamba bexoxela abantu nabangani babo abasondelene nabo futhi kunabanye abangani abaxabana nabo, base beyobaceba emaphoyiseni ngalolu daba. Omunye wabamangalewa wayehamba ekhuluma emakhaya KwaNongoma,’’ kusho uGininda.
Kushaqeke abantu abaningi uMbhishobhi webandla iSithelo SikaJehova, uBhongolwethu "Dkt Khehlelezi” Mzo, egonyuluka ngokuzifela ngocansi lwabantu abathathu. UKhehlelezi, obuye abe yinyanga edumile eThekwini, ubephendula ngezinsolo zokufunwa lolu hlobo locansi ngomunye umuntu wesifazane. Ekhuluma kwiPodcast and Chill, uKhehlelezi ubuzwe wuGogo Skhotheni ukuthi wagcina eyile yini ocansini nentokazi eyayimfuna ocansini oluhlanganyelwe nomunye umfundisi waseZimbabwe. UMBHISHOPHI webandla iSithelo SikaJehova, uDkt Khehlelezi, uthe akekho umuntu othanda ucansi njengesangoma Isithombe:FACEBOOKEsikhundleni sokuphendula ngempendulo eqondile, uKhehlelezi uvele wangena ezintangeni. Kunalokho udalule ukuthi engakashadi ubezitika ngocansi nabantu besifazane abevile koyedwa ngenxa yokuthi abantu abadala bayaluthanda ucansi. "Ngoba nginesithembu ngingalwenza lolu hlobo locansi namakhosikazi ami. Ukukhuluma nje iqiniso, abantu bazothi ngiyisangoma esinjani esithanda ucansi. Abantu abadala bayakuthanda ukuya ocansini. Akekho umuntu othanda ucansi njengesangoma.”Ebuzwa ukuthi abantu abashadile bangaya yini ocansini oluhlanganyelwe, uKhehlelezi uvumile ukuthi kungenzeka uma bezwana ngoba akusoze kwenzeka uma beyinkukhu nempaka. Kwenzeka lokhu uKhehlelezi usematheni kulezi zinsuku emuva kokuba umholi we-ANC embize ngeqola ebelisanda kukhala ngokufetshelwa ngenye yamakhosikazi alo. Lo mholi wathi uKhehlelezi weza kuye emnxusa ukuba amkhuzele isikhulu sikamasipala ukuba sihlukane nomkakhe. Eziphendulela, uKhehlelezi uthe wamuzwa lo mholi futhi wamxaka ngoba wayeselwa naye siqu ngoba esuke wagxeka i-ANC esidlangalaleni. Uthe noma bengakhuluma kabi kanjani ngaye kodwa yena akasoze adalula izimfihlo zabaholi be-ANC ngoba usemdala kwipolitiki.
KUBOSHWE abasolwa abaningi ngamacala okukhona kuwo awokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, ukubamba inkunzi nokushaya ezindaweni ezahlukene eNorthern Cape, phakathi koLwesine neSonto.Amaphoyisa abeqhuba umkhankaso, i-Operation Shanela ngesikhathi ebopha abasolwa. Umkhankaso ubuhlanganisa ukusesha izimoto, ukumisa abantu baseshwe, ukuhlola ukuthi imigomo iyalandelwa yini ezindaweni nokulandela umkhondo ngabasolwa.Kuboshwe abasolwa abangaphezu kuka-300. Amanye amacala ababoshelwe wona ngawokugqekeza, ukutholakala nezidakamizwa, ukutholakala nezikhali eziyingozi, ukushayela bephuzile noma bedle izidakamizwa, ukutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni, ukudayisa utshwala ngaphandle kwemvume nabantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho.Ebantwini abang-309 ababoshiwe, abangu-154 kubo bebefunelwa amacala amadala futhi bebebalekela amaphoyisa."Amaphoyisa athathe inqwaba yotshwala nezikhali eziyingozi emashibhini angekho semthethweni nakwezinye izindawo ezaziwa ngobugebengu,” kusho isitatimende samaphoyisa.
LINGAVUNA okuhle nokubi izwe lethu ngemva kokugadla kwethimba labameli bakuleli eNkantolo yoMhlaba (International Criminal Court) e-The Hague, ngenxa yobucayi bodaba obeludingidwa.UNgqongqoshe wezoBulungiswa, uMnuz Ronald Lamola, uhole ithimba lezingqalabutho zabameli abebemele iNingizimu Afrika, ecaleni ebelidingidwa eHague, eNetherlands.INingizimu Afrika imangalele i-Israel, iyisola ngokubhubhisa abantu basePalestine, ngaphansi kwezinhloso zokucwasa nokubandlulula. Impi okumanje isatholene phezulu isishiye inqwaba yabantu enkundleni. Izwe lethu kalihlonizi ngokuthi lizwelana nePalestine.Impi iqubuka ngesikhathi kusazanywa ukubhula umlilo phakathi weRussia, ne-Ukraine onomthelela omubi nakwamanye amazwe.Impi iqale ngo-Okthoba 2023, lapho okufe abantu futhi idonse amehlo omhlaba kanti iyehlukana imibono yamazwe ngoba aseka izinhlangoti ezehlukene.Ngaphambi kokuthi izwe limangalele i-Israel, kwaqala ngokuthi i-ANC iphumele obala ihole umkhankaso wokuzwelana nePalestine. Yabonakala ifake izikhafu zakhona isabalalisa imiyalezo nezithombe zokuzwelana nayo.INingizimu Afrika ididiyele ithimba lezingqalabutho zabameli elifike lagadla kwezwakala, lethula udaba eNkantolo yoMhlaba. Bekuduma inhlokomo ezingxenyeni ezehlukene zezwe kubatshazwa ubuyoninco nesisoka sethimba labameli bakuleli.Kubonakale ngenhlokomo abahlangatshezwe ngayo abameli sebefika kuleli esikhumulweni sezindiza. Bamukelwe njengamaqhawe ashaye into ecokeme eHague, abeka igama lezwe kwelinye izinga.Wehlulekile ukuzibamba uMengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, wancoma iqhaza nomsebenzi wethimba."Bengiqala ukuzizwa ngiziqhenya kangaka ngesikhathi ngibuka ithimba labameli bethu lethula udaba enkantolo. Ngivele ngaziqhenya ngensizwa yaseMpumalanga uLamola ngesikhathi ngiyibona yethula udaba enkantolo,’’ kuphawula uRamaphosa.Umengameli uqhube wathi izwe lenza lokho elakufundiswa ngumengameli wokuqala omnyama uMnuz Nelson Mandela, owayeshumayela ivangeli lokuthula noxolo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Bangobani abameli abebemele elakuleli?Kukhona u-Advovate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi SC, ongummeli ozakhele igama kwezomthetho wakuleli ngobuyininco bakhe bokunqoba amacala. Ungummeli ogxile kwezomthethosisekelo. Unentshisekelo kakhulu ngodaba lomhlaba nokubuyiselwa kwawo ebantu abafanele futhi useze washicilela incwadi ngaleso sihloko.Kukhona uSolwazi Max du Plessis, ongungoti womthetho wamazwe omhlaba ogxile eCantham House, eLondon. Ubuye alekelele ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njengaseNyuvesi iCape Town, naseNyuvesi iNelson Mandela. Ubuye abambe iqhaza esikhungweni i-Institute for Security Studies, esihlonishwa kakhulu kwezocwaningo ngezokuphepha nobugebengu. LIGADLE kwezwakala ithimba labezomthetho lakuleli ebeliseNkantolo yoMhlaba, limangalela i-Israel ngokubulala abantu basePalestine, ngoba libacwasa Isithombe : FACEBOOK/SA GOVERNMENTUseke wasebenza emacaleni aseNkantolo yoMhlaba, African Commission on Human and People’s Rights, SADC Tribunal, ne-East African Court of Justice.Kukhona uNksz Lerato Zikalala, osebenze eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo. Ugxile kwezomthetho wokusebenza kukahulumeni nokuzimela. Unentshisekelo ngomthethosisekelo nezokuphatha.Kukhona uNkk Sarah Pudifin -Jones, ongumhleli wencwadi ekhuluma ngamacala ombango. Ubhala kakhulu kwezomthetho nasemabhukwini ashicilelwayo. Ugxile kwezomthethosisekelo, ezokuphatha, ukuncintisana, ezezimali nomthetho wamazwe ngamazwe.Kukhona uMnuz Tshidiso Ramogale, ogxile emthethweni wezinkontileka nezokuncintisana, umthetho kahulumeni nemigomo. Usebenze emacaleni aphezulu ezinkantolo ezehlukene.USolwazi Vaughan Lowe, ongummeli ohlonishwayo ogxile kwezomthetho wamazwe ahlukene kanti usebenze kakhulu eNkantolo yoMhlaba. Usebenze kwi-European Court of Human Rights. Ubuye afundise ezomthetho eNyuvesi i-Oxford.Kukhona uNksz Blinne Ní Ghrálaigh, osebenza ngomthetho wamazwe. Usebenze kakhulu eNkantolo yoMhlaba futhi unetshisekelo yokuvikela amalungelo abantu.Kufanele ukuthi iNingizimu Afriika, ilindele ukuthi igxathu layo lokumangalela i-Israel, lingaba nomthelela othize. Okokuqala nje abaningi basaba ukuthi elakuleli lingase lihlaselwe noma lifakwe unswinyo.URamaphosa uke waphawula ngalokhu wathi akanalo uvalo lokuthi kungase kube nonswinyo kwezohwebo. Wathi elakuleli limile ekutheni i-Israel, kufanele ithweswe amacala okubulawa kwabantu ngenxa yokubacwasa.Ngaphandle kwalokhu konswinyo kungaqhamuka nokunye okuhle ngoba iNingizimu Afrika, izibeke ebalazweni lomhlaba ngegxathu elithathile elikhombise isibindi. Kungenzeka kube namazwe abuka elakuleli njengezwe elinohlonze kube lula noma sekuyoshela abatshalizimali bakhona.Isinqumo seNingizimu Afrika sesekwe ngamanye amaqembu aphikisayo anezwi njenge-EFF. Ithe incoma uhulumeni wakuleli ngegxathu alithathile. Ithe nayo iyazwelana nabasePalestine, yabachaza ngokuthi bacindezelwe yi-Israel."Kuyigxathu elihle lokulwela amalungelo abantu ngoba kunenqwaba yabantu bakwa-Israel abafile okubalwa nezingane lapho. Laba bantu banesihluku bahlasela ngamabhomu anzima besebenzisa nezikhali zembubhiso,’’ kusho i-EFF.Ikhale ngokuthi i-Israel, kayihloniphi ngisho inkululeko yabezindaba ngoba ibulala nezintatheli ezicoshelayo. I-EFF ithe iNingizimu Afrika, ihlasele ngamaphuzu azwakalayo uma icela inkantolo ikhiphe umyalelo wokuthi kumiswe ukuhlasela kwe-Israel.Ngaphandle kwalokhu, i-EFF ike yamashela ezindlini zenxusa lase-Israel, ifuna ukuthi kumiswe ukuhwebelana nezinkampani zakhona.Indlela ithimba lakuleli elisebenze ngayo, kuyacaca ukuthi noma ngabe inkantolo ivuna noma ilahla bani ngecala kodwa kuyosala umsizilo. Elakuleli selingenile emabhukwini omlando womhlaba.Uma izwe lingase liqhubeke nokusingatha izindaba zomhlaba kanje, kuningi okuhle elingakuzuza kodwa nawo amagabade abheke ngakulona, azohlala ekhona.

Ubengakaze azicabange entweza emoyeni ngebhanoyi noma ehleli etafuleni linye nezitatanyiswa, uyise womunye wabafundi abaphila nokukhubazeka abachonywe uphaphe lwegwalagwala wuNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyiSisekelo, uNkk Angie Motshekga.UMnuz Ephraim Mchunu waKwaFelekisi, eManzimtoti, onguyise ka-Asanda Mchunu (17) obefunda esikoleni sabaphila nokukhubazekile, KwaThintwa School for Deaf eCato Ridge, eThekwini, uthe uswele amaphiko okundiza ngenxa yenjabulo emva kokuthi indodana yakhe ithole isimemo esivela kungqongqoshe, okuqinisekisa ukuthi ingenye yezingane ezenze kahle ngesikhathi kubhalwa izivivinyo zika-matric, nyakenye.U-Asanda nozakwabo abafunda naye KwaThintwa, uXoliswa Nkabinde (19) abakhubazeke ngokungakhulumi nokungezwa, bebeyingxenye yesidlo sakusihlwa noNkk Motshekga ePitoli, izolo, okuwumcimbi walo mnyango ezingeni likazwelonke okuhloswe ngawo ukukhuthaza abafundi abaqhamuka ezifundazweni ezihlukene kuleli, abaphumelele ngamalengiso ezifundweni ezithile abazibhale ngonyaka owendulelayo.UXOLISWA Nkabinde"Ngendlela engijabule ngayo angazi ngingachaza kanjani. Nakuba besikulindele ukuthi aphase kodwa besingakaze sizitshele ukuthi uzosenza siziqhenye ngalolu hlobo. Bengingazi ukuthi ngiyoke ngigibele ibhanoyi ngaye,” usho kanje.Uthe ikhono lakhe belivele limangalisa kangangoba unekhanda elilula ngendlela yokuthi entweni okuthiwa akeyenze, wenza kudlulele obekwenza othisha bamtuse kakhulu ngobuhlakani anabo.U-Asanda kuthiwa unothando lwe-Visual Arts.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, unina kaXoliswa uNksz Feziwe Ximba waseMnambithi, uthe ngenxa yesimo sendodakazi yakhe inothando lokungena emkhakheni weFashion Design noma ibe wuthisha."Sijabule kakhulu siwumndeni ngayo. Noma besikuthola kunzima ukumlekelela ezifundweni zakhe ngenxa yokuthi asiluqondi kahle ulimi i-Sign Language kodwa bese sikwazi ukubona kokunye. Unekhono elihle futhi lokudweba, ziyaziqhenya kakhulu ngaye,” usho kanje.Isikole iKwaThintwa School for Deaf, sekujwayelekile ukuthi sivele ohlwini lwezikole ezenza kahle njengoba abafundi bakusona bevamise ukuthola izimemo zikangqongqoshe minyaka yonke.Oyi-Departmental Head kulesi sikole, uNksz Stephanie Paul, ushayele ihlombe laba bafundi ngokwenza kahle kwabo."Kube ukuzimisela nokuzinikela okubenze bazibona sebekuleli zinga abakulona manje. Lizovulwa kuze kube yinyanga ezayo ithuba lababhale izivivinyo zika-matric nyakenye kepha abangagculisekile ngemiphumela ezifundweni ezithile futhi abakubona kunesidingo sokumakelwa kabusha nokubuyekezwa kwamamaki abawatholile.Ngokolwazi olushicelelwe kwi-website yoMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, kuzovalwa ngoFebhuwari 2, ukufakwa kwezicelo zokumakelwa kabusha. Umfundi ongagculisekile kuthiwa kumele asifake esikoleni abebhalela kuso isicelo noma emahhovisi omnyango ezingeni lesifunda. Izicelo zingathunyelwa ngokohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe kanti ulwazi lutholakala kwi-website yomnyango ethi: www.education.gov.zaKuthiwa ukumakelwa kabusha kubiza uR120 ngesifundo ngasinye kanti ukubuyekezwa kabusha kwamamaki kuwuR129.Izicelo zokubuyekezwa kwamamaki ezifundweni zizokwenziwa uma sekuphothulwe izinhlelo zokumakelwa kabusha nokubhekisiswa kwamamaki futhi isikhishiwe imiphumela yokwenze njalo kanti kubiza uR234. Ukufakwa kwezicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe amaphepha abebhalwa, kuvalwa ngemva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kuphume imiphumela yokumakelwa kabusha. Kulindeleke ukuthi imiphumela ikhishwe ngoMashi 15, nonyaka kanti izotholakala ezikoleni noma ezikhungweni lapho abafundi abebebhalela khona izivivinyo zika-matric.Uhlelo lokubhala kabusha izifundo kulabo abafisa ukuphucula imiphumela yabo olwaziwa nge-supplementary examination selizoba ngoMeyi/Juni kuphela kanti usuku lokugcina lokufaka izicelo zokubhala kabusha uFebhuwari, 8 nonyaka.Ngobani abangakwazi ukufaka izicelo ngaphansi kohlelo:-Abanesifiso sokubhalisa izifundo abangenzanga kahle kuzo ngesikhathi kunezivivinyo zika-matric ngoNovemba nyakenye.-Abangakwazanga ukubhala izifundo ezithile ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo zanyakenye ngenxa yezizathu ezibambekayo, okubalwa kuzo ukugula, ukuphazanyiswa ukushona kwelungu lomndeni elisondelene naye, noma esinye nje isizathu esiqinile.- Yinoma yimuphi umuntu obhale izivivinyo zika-matric kusuka ngoNovemba 2008 kuze kube nyakenye, onesifiso sokuphucula imiphumela yakhe noma umphumela esifundweni esithile, naye angabhalisela ukubhala kwalokhu kuhlolwa.-Umfundi osabanjelwe imiphumela yakhe ngenxa yokuthi kwaba nezingqinamba ezithile ngesikhathi kubhalwa iphepha, naye uyakwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhala kabusha leso sifundo ngesikhathi kusalindwe imiphumela yophenyo.- Ongakwazanga ukuqeda ukubhala iphepha ngenxa yokugula, ukulimala noma ukushona kwelungu lomndeni.Imibuzo mayelana nokudedelwa kwemiphumela kumele ithunyelwe emnyangweni zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30, ngemva kokudedelwa kwayo.Abebebhala izivivinyo nyakenye, kumele baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo okungaba yizinombolo zikamazisi noma amagama abo, abhalwe ngendlela efanele, uma kukhona amaphutha, kuthiwa kumele babikele umnyango ngaphambi kuka-Agasti 30, 2024.
