WAQOKWA ngothisha esafunda ugrade 10 bamelusa njalo u-Olwethu Kuhlekonke Khumalo, obashaye emakhanda abafundi bakamatric KwaZulu-Natal. UKhumalo obefunda eMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence, eNdumo uklonyeliswe emcimbini obuse-ICC, eThekwini.Uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, ubememezela imiphumela kamatric emuva kokuthi imenyezelwe kuzwelonke. Isifundazwe sithole u86.4% okusho ukwenyuka ngo-3.4% uma kuqhathaniswa nemiphumela edlule.Ngaphandle kokuphasa kakhulu uKhumalo, ungumholi ngoba ubengumengameli wesikole futhi engumengameli wezikole zesifunda sakhe uMkhanyakude. Exoxa neSolezwe ngeMpelasonto, uthe ubona sengathi kwasiza ukuthi othisha bakhe basheshe bamhlonze bese bemelusa."Othisha banginaka ngifunda ugrade 10, bangitshela ukuthi kukhona okufufusayo kimi uma ngingaqinisa nje ngingagila izimanga. Ngakhuthala kakhulu ngoba bebengilandelela emuva kwalokho. Bengihlala ngaphakathi esikoleni nalokho kungisizile kakhulu,’’ kusho uKhumalo ngokukhulu ukuzethemba nokukhalipha.UKhumalo uthe uzimisele ngokwedlulela eNyuvesi iCape Town (UCT) lapho ayokwenza izifundo ze-Acturial Science. Uhambe eyikazela yizipho uKhumalo ngoba ubelokhu ephindela amagemugemu.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Mbali Frazer, uthe isifundazwe sigile izimanga kungalindele muntu. Ubonge kakhulu othisha nabo bonke abasebenzi bomnyango."Phezu kwezingqinamba ebezikhona, iCovid 19, izikhukhula nokushoda kwemali kodwa abasebenzi abakaze badikibale. Sithandaza ndawonye nabasebenzi, sisebenze ndawonye bese siphumelela ndawonye,’’ kusho uNksz Frazer.UMphathiswa uthe ebafundini abangu-167 247 abebebhala, kuphase abangu-136 366. Uthe isibalo sezikole ezithole u100% sinyukile sisuka kwezingu-214 safika ku-246. Ubalule nokuthi izikole ebezithola ngaphansi kuka40% zinciphile zisuka kwezingu-29 zafika kwezingu-18.Isifunda uMkhanyakude sizishaye emakhanda ngo-90% kulandele Ugu ngo89.5%, kube Ilembe ngo88. 58%, lulandela iZululand ngo87.6%, kube yiHarry Gwala ngo87.05, kube Amajuba ngo87% kube uMzinyathi othole 86.6%, kube uMlaza othole 86.1, uMgungundlovu uthole 85.06%, kuvale iKing Cetshwayo ngo86.4%.UNDUNANKULU waKwaZulu-Natal uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, ukhombise ukuziqhenya ngomsebenzi kaKuhlekonke Khumalo waseMandla Mthethwa School of Excellence Isithombe : SIBONELO NGCOBO INDEPENDENT MEDIA
SIQHUBEKILE nokwenza ezibukwayo isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal, sithola u-86.4% emiphumeleni ka-matric wangonyaka odlule.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi uNgqongqose weMfundo eyiSisekelo kuleli, uNkk Angie Motshekga, ememezela imiphumela yaleli banga yezifundazwe emcimbini wokubungaza abafundi abenze kahle obusePitoli, izolo.Izinga lokuphasa kuka-matric kulesi sifundazwe likhuphuke ngo-3.4% uma kuqhathaniswa nemiphumela yango-2022, lapho sithole khona u-83.0 %. Kungokoqala eminyakeni eyishumi nangaphezulu eyedlule lesi sifundazwe sithola imiphumela engaphezu kuka-80% iminyaka ilandelana.Le miphumela emihle beyivele kuyinto ebivele ilindelekile kwazise ikilasi lika-2023, lingelokuqala ukusuka ngo-2020 elinabafundi abangazange bachaphazelwe kangako wubhubhane iCovid-19.Ngesikhathi kugasela lesi sifo kuleli ngo-2020, iningi labebebhala ngonyaka odlule belifunda uGrade-9, kanti eminyakeni emibili edlule, lolu bhubhane bese lungasenawo amandla, isimo sesibuyele kwesijwayelekile.Yize lesi sifundazwe senze kahle, uhlaka olubhekelele izingabunjalo lemiphumela ka-matric, Umalusi, liqinisekise ukuthi kunemibiko yokukopela kwabebebhala abangu-763 okukholakala ukuthi babhale izimpendulo ezifanayo emibuzweni ethile ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo, kodwa umqondisi jikelele ehhovisi loMnyango weMfundo eyiSisekelo ekhuluma nabe-eNCA izolo, uthe lolu daba luyaphenywa okwamanje."Izinga lokukopela kwabafundi ngokwamaqoqo lehlile. Izifundazwe iMpumalanga neKwaZulu-Natal okuyizona ezivela kulezi zinsolo ezivezwe Umalusi, udaba lwakhona luyaphenywa. Othisha okuzotholakala ukuthi benze okuphambene nomthetho bazothathelwa izinyathelo,” usho kanje.Uthe amanye amaphutha okuvamise ukuthi kuhlangatshezwane nawo okunesidingo sokuthi ancishiswe, yilawo enziwa abasuke bebhala uma befaka imininingwane yabo, okufana namagama nezinombolo zikamazisi.Bevile ku-723 000 ababhale izivivinyo ngokugcwele kuleli kanti eKZN bangu-170 637.Imiphumela yezikole ezizimele ngaphansi kwe-Independent Examination Board, ibe ngu-98,46 % kuzwelonke.
ABAPHATHISWA bezeMpilo bakhuza izitshudeni nabafundi ngokuzibandakanya nocansi.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uthe iningi labantu abasha abazobe beqala ukuya emanyuvesi kulo nyaka belinakekelwa ngabazali impilo yalo yonke."Ekhaya kunesikhathi esibekiwe sokubuya, isikhathi sokudla nokunye. Manje impilo iyashintsha, intsha izobe iziphethe bengekho abazali abayibhekile. Ngalesi sikhathi kuningi okungenzeka okungamosha ikusasa lomuntu omusha uma engaqaphelanga. "Ukuhlalisana kuyenzeka. Lokho, siyakwazi . Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abasha abasenyuvesi bazi ukuthi yini abazoyenza emanyuvesi. Kunamantombazane amaningi, abafana abaningi , iziphazamiso eziningi," kusho uMphathiswa. Uqhube wathi iningi lalaba bantu abasha baseneminyaka engu-18 noma engu-19 kungakuhle ukuthi bazithibe ocansini."Ukungayi ocansini akusho ukuthi kokhona okungahambi kahle ngawe noma awuhambisani nemfashini. Empeleni kusho ukuthi uhlakaniphile, futhi uyazi ukuthi ufunani empilweni.” kuqhuba uMphathiswa.Uqhube wathi uMnyango uzovuselela uhlelo lwawo oluthi "Graduate Alive” okuhloswe ngalo ukukhuthaza abantu abasha ukuthi baziphathe kahle bangasheshi bathole izingane besebancane bazivikele nasezifeni zocansi."Inhloso yalolu hlelo ukukhuluma nentsha ngokuzinakekela, uma ingeke ikwazi ukuzithiba ikhethe indlela yokugwema ukukhulelwa kweziningi ezikhona okungamaphilisi, ukusebenzisa amakhondomu, ukufaka i-Implanon egwema ukukhulelwa iminyaka emithathu, ukuyikhuthaza ukuthi isebenzise amaphilisi akuvikela kwi-HIV uma kwenzeka uya ocansini nomuntu onayo iPre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP).” kuchaza uMphathiswa.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo eGauteng uNkk Nomantu Nkomo-Ralehoko, unxuse abafundi ukuthi bakhumbule ukuthi bazalwa bekhululekile akumele bazifakele ingcindezi ngokuya ocansini besebancane. UMPHATHISWA wezeMpilo eGauteng, uNkk Nomantu Nkomo-Ralehoko , uthe ukuya ocansini kwabafundi besebancane kudala izinkinga eziholela ekutheni baphazamiseke ezifundweni zabo Isithombe: SIGCINIWE Ubesho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabafundi baseNkumbulo Primary, Ekurhuleni ngesikhathi kuvulwa izikole, ngoLwesithathu."Imfundo iwumgogodla nensika ekukhuleni kwakho, inamandla okuguqula impilo yakho ibe ngcono. Ingakuvulela amathuba obungeke uwathole uma ungafundile. Ukuya ocansini usemncane kungenza ukhathazeke kuphinde kuphazamise ikusasa lakho, ngokuthi ukhulelwe ungahlelile, uthole izifo ezithathelanayo zocansi okungaphazamisa ukufunda kwakho.Uthe lokhu ukusho ngoba kulesi sifundazwe kunezingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-14 no-19, ezibelethele ezikhungweni zikahulumeni."Njengoba unyaka uqala nje zingaphezulu kuka-13 700 izingane ezizalwa omama abasebancane ezizalwe kulesi sifundazwe," kusho uNkk Nkomo-Ralehoko.
KUGQUGQUZELWA abazali ukuthi bangafakeli izingane ebezifunda u-matric ingcindezi ngokuziqhathanisa nezinye ebezifunda nazo.ISouth African Depression and Anxiety Group (Sadag), esiza abantu abanezinkinga ezehlukene okubalwa ukusindwa yizimo zempilo, ukhwantalala nezinye izifo zengqondo, ithe ukuqhathanisa izingane kwengeza ingcindezi uma sekuphume imiphumela kamatric.ISadag ithe ukungaphumeleli komfundi noma ukuthola imiphumela abengayilindele akusho ukuphela kwempilo.Ithe izoba nezithangami ezehlukene ezinkundleni zayo zokuxhumana ukuze inike abafundi nabazali amasu okubhekana nezingqinamba zokungaphumeleli ku-matric.Ngaphandle kokululekwa ngamasu okubhekana nesimo sokungaphumeleli umatric, abafundi bazocetshiswa nangezinto okufanele bazenze ukuze baphothule u-matric.Abafundi abafuna ukuba ingxenye yalezi zithangami bangangena ekhasini leSadag kwiFacebook elithi: @TheSADAG, Instagram: @sadag_official, Twitter: @TheSADAG,LinkedIn @The South African Depression and Anxiety Group,Tik Tok: @sadag_official ISadag ithe abazali kufanele babe abangani bezingane zabo ukuze uma kukhona uguquko abalubonayo basheshe basukume.Abazali kufanele basheshe basukume uma izingane zabo sezilala kakhulu noma zingalali nhlobo, uma sekunoshintsho endleleni ezidla ngayo nasemzimbeni.Ithe ezinye izingane ziqala zibe nokungahlaliseki kahle okuholela ekutheni zize zingalali bese zigcina sezinokhwantalala ngenxa yemiphumela ka-matric.Iveze ukuthi abafundi basuke bezibuza ukuthi njengoba bengenzanga kahle, ngabe abazali babo bathini.Icele abazali ukuthi bangasebenzisi amagama okuthi umfundi ufeyilile uma engenzanga kahle kumatric kodwa bamgqugquzele ukuthi avuke azithathe.Abazali nabafundi abadinga ukukhuluma nomuntu othile bangashayela iSadag ku-080 056 7567 noma bathumele iWhatsApp ku-087 163 2030 kusukela ngo-8 ekuseni kuya ku-5 ntambama.
IKHATHAZEKILE iSouth African Federation of Trade Unions (Saftu), ngokuthi u-13 million wabafundi bakuleli uzobuyela ezikoleni ezingenayo ingqalasizinda esezingeni elifanele.ISaftu ithi akuyona ingqalasizinda eyizakhiwo kuphela engekho ezingeni elifanele kodwa nezinsiza zokufunda ezikoleni zikahulumeni kazigculisi.UMnuz Trevor Shaku, okhulumela iSaftu, uthe izikole eziningi zikahulumeni azikwazi ukusebenza uma ungekho ugesi, ezinye azinawo amakhompyutha nezinye izinsiza ezibalulekile.Uqhube wathi ucwaningo lweNational Education Infrastructure Management System (NEIMS) olushicilelwe ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule, ludalule ukuthi ezikoleni eziwu-22 597, ziwu-635 kuphela ezinawo ama-generator asebenza uma kunqamuke ugesi.Kuthiwa ucwaningo lusibeka obala isimo sezikole ezweni."Kubuhlungu ukuthi izigidi zabafundi zibuyela ezikoleni ezingenayo ingqalasizinda esezingeni. Kumanje sikhala ngenkinga yamathoyilethi omgodi ngoba abafundi bafela kuwona e-Eastern Cape naseLimpopo. Uhulumeni akazimisele ukuwaqeda ngoba izikole eziwu-3 932 zisenamathoyilethi omgodi. Eziwu-16 714 azinayo imitapo yolwazi, eziwu-18 671 azinawo ama-laboratory, eziwu-14 949 azinawo amakhompyutha, kanti eziwu-9 733 kazinazo izinkundla zemidlalo. Yizibalo ezishaqisayo ezweni jikelele lezi,” kukhononda uShaku.Uqhube wathi uhulumeni unciphise imali eyabelwa uMnyango weMfundo eyiSisekelo, okusho ukuthi isimo sisazoba sibi."Ukungabibikho kwengqalasizinda esezingeni nezinsiza-kufunda yikona okuholela ekutheni abafundi bethu bangakwazi ukufunda ngokuqonda indlela yokwenza izibalo ezilula ezenziwa ngozakwabo kwamanye amazwe. Kusiphethe kabi ukuthi imali eyabelwe uMnyango weMfundo eyiSisekelo incishisiwe ngoba kusho ukuthi izingane ngeke zithole imfundo esezingeni. Yikona okuholela ekutheni izingane zingaphumeleli,” kusho uShaku.Ukhale ngokuthi njengoba nezinkulisa sezingaphansi koMnyango weMfundo eyiSisekelo kuzoba nzima uma imali incishiswa ngoba kufanele isisekelo sokufunda siqale kahle ezinkulisa.UShaku uphethe ngokuthi iSaftu izoqhubeka nokutshela uhulumeni ukuthi ayeke ukunciphisa imali eyabelwa uMnyango wezeMfundo, nokuthi angasenyusi isibalo sabafundi ezikoleni kodwa othisha bebe bencishiswa."Sizoqhubeka nomkhankaso wethu olwa nokuncishiswa kwemali kuhulumeni. Sifuna kwandiswe isibalo sothisha, kutshalwe imali yengqalasizinda yezemfundo nezinsiza kufunda ukuze abafundi bezophumelela,” kuphetha uShaku.

KUFE abantu abangu-11 ezigamekweni ezimbili ezehlukene KwaZulu-Natal ezenzeke eNanda naseMgungundlovu. Esigamekweni sokuqala, okukholakala ukuthi senzeke ngoLwesibili ebusuku, kwaze kwezwakala ngaso ngoLwesithathu, kubulawe amalungu amahlanu omndeni owodwa eMgodini, e-Edendale, eMgungundlovu. Kuthiwa bobahlanu bahlahlelwe ngembazo.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Robert Netshiunda, ilungu lomndeni ebelivakashe ndawana thize, kuthe uma libuya, lazithela phezu kwezidumbu."Izidumbu azificile esikagogo (85), indodakazi yakhe (45), izingane zendodakazi ezintathu okukhona kuzo amawele (11) nenye (9),” kusho uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi bonke ababulewe bebenezingozi ezihlasimulisa umzimba emakhanda, kanti nembazo okukholakala ukuthi bahlahlelwe ngayo itholakale endaweni yesigameko."Imbangela yokubulawa kwabo ayikaziwa okwamanje. Amaphoyisa anxusa noma ubani ongaba nolwazi olungalekelela ekuphenyweni kwaleli cala, noma ongaba nolwazi ngabasolwa ukuthi athinte amaphoyisa aseduzane noma ashayele inombolo yamaphoyisa ethi 08600 10111,” kusho uNetshiunda.Kwesinye isigameko esenzeke entathakusa izolo, amaphoyisa athele othulini abasolwa abayisithupha eMachobeni eNanda ngesikhathi kuba khona ukudubulana phakathi kwawo nabo.Kulesi sigameko kuboshwe abasolwa abathathu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa uBrigadier Jay Naicker, uthe amaphoyisa athole umkhondo ngabasolwa ababhace kule ndawo ebebefunelwa amacala ehlukene.UNaicker uthe phakathi kwawo kukhona awokubamba inkunzi, awokubulala, awokuphangwa kwezitolo nokudunwa kwezimoto."Umkhondo uholele amaphoyisa endlini eseMachobeni eNanda. Emva kokumemezela ukuthi asefikile, aphendulwe ngentululwane yezinhlamvu iqhamuka kubasolwa. Nawo abe esebuyisela ngayo inhlamvu,” kusho uNaicker.Uthe emva kokutholakala kwezidumbu eziyisithupha, amaphoyisa athole abasolwa abathathu ebebephila okukhona kubona abesilisa ababili nowesifazane (31) oyedwa, ababopha."Kukhona iphoyisa elilodwa elihuhuluzwe yinhlamvu esandleni kanti endaweni yesigameko kutholwe izibhamu ezintathu, imoto eyayidunwe KwaDabeka ngoDisemba. Abasolwa ababoshiwe bazovela enkantolo maduze,” kusho uNaicker.Ikhansela laseMachobeni, uMnuz Derrick Mngadi, lithe budlangile ubugebengu kule ndawo."Ubugebengu bokubanjwa kwabantu inkunzi ezindlini nasemgwaqweni budla lubi kule ndawo. Amalungu omphakathi aze aqhamuka nesu lokuthi kusungulwe i-neighbourhood watch okuyithimba eliqapha ubugebengu kule ndawo ngaleso sizathu,” kusho uMngadi.Uqhube wathi bathatha noma yini abasuke bebona ukuthi bayayidinga. Abaye bakuthathe, imali, amaselula nokunye.Ilungu le-neighbourhood watch yaseNanda, lithe ukudubulana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nabasolwa kuqale ngabo-11 ebusuku ngoLwesithathu."Abaningi bavuswe umsindo wokuqhuma kwezibhamu. Sinikele endaweni yesigameko, sathola ukuthi amaphoyisa ophiko lweNational Intervention Unit (NIU) abetholene phezulu nabasolwa, kwafa abayisithupha, abathathu baboshwa,” kusho ilungu.Uthe indlu okwenzeke kuyo isehlakalo inamagumbi amabili kanti akucaci kahle ngomnikazi wayo.Uthe okubashiya nemibuzo ukuthi bebehlala kanjani abantu abayisishiyagalolunye kuyo ibe incane.

Nokho angimangali, ubevele eyingane ehleze iphuma phambili esikoleni ngakho ubehlakaniphe sidalo,” usho kanje.Izindaba zokuthola isimemo sikangqongqoshe, zenze ubuholi kuMasipala wasoNdini buholwa yiMeya uMnuz Wilson Ntshangase buhambele kubo buyomxhawula.USimlindele uthe isifiso sakhe ukwenza izifundo zobudokotela kanti usevele wamukelwe emanyuvesi amathathu, wakhetha i-University of Cape Town ukuba enze kuyo izifundo zakhe kodwa ne-Wits University ne-University of KwaZulu-Natal bebevule izandla bemamukela."Bengizinikeza isikhathi sokufunda. Okungisize kakhulu ukugxila ekubuyekezeni amaphepha ayebhalwa eminyakeni edlule nokuyinto ebingenza ngihlale ngiqonde indlela okubuzwa ngayo. Okunye okungilekelelile ukuthi sifunde singamaqeqebana kanti othisha benze umsebenzi omuhle kakhulu ukusicija ngesikhathi kusondela izinsuku zokubhalwa kwezivivinyo,” usho kanje.Ubenza i-Maths, Physics, i-Life Science, i- Accounting , isiZulu, English ne-Life Orientation.Kuzothi namuhla uMphathiswa wezeMfundo kulesi sifundazwe uNkk Mbali Frazer. amemezele izikole nezifunda ezenze kahle kanye nezifundo eziphaswe kakhulu, emcimbini oseNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre, eThekwini.
I-IFP isinxuse umphakathi ukuba abambisane nezinhlaka zomthetho ukuze kuboshwe abasolwa ngokubulala induna nabanye abathathu eMadlangeni. Esitatimendeni uSihlalo we-IFP, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uthe beyi-IFP eKZN bayasigxeka isigameko futhi bayezwelana nemindeni yabashonile. Kubulawe induna uNkk Lucia Nonina Mahlaba, indodana yakhe uThando Mahlaba, umngani wayo u-Asanda Zikhali kanye nomakhelwane obethi uzolekelela ngoba ezwa uNkk Mahlaba ecela usizo uNkk Shonaphi Mbatha.I-IFP ithe ishaqekile ngesihluku esikhonjiswe ngabasolwa kanti idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini wakwaMahlaba nomndeni wakwaZikhali nowakwaMbatha.UNtuli okwenzekile akukhona ukulahlekelwa kwemindeni ethintekayo kuphela kodwa kuyifu elimnyama emiphakathini yethu, sisikaza ngejozi uzinzo ezinhlakeni zobuholi bendabuko.I-IFP ithe ihlale njalo ishumayela ivangeli lokuvikelwa kwabaholi bendabuko, ngokuthi kukhunjulwe iqhaza elibalulekile abalidlalayo ekugcinweni kwesiko namagugu kanye nokugqugquzela ubumbano emphakathini."Ukubulawa kwenduna uNkk Mahlaba kukhombisa ukuthi kunesidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthi kudingidwe udaba lwezokuphepha lwabaholi bomdabu. I-IFP inxusa izinhlaka zomthetho eKZN ukuthi zisheshe futhi ziphenye kabanzi ngalokhu kubulala okunesihluku.”I-IFP ithe kumele kwenzeke ubulungiswa, abathintekayo baboshwe ukuze babhekane nengalo yomthetho."Siyayibonga imizamo yomakhelwane abenze ubuqhawe bengenelela, bezama ukusiza umndeni wakwaMahlaba. Kuyadabukisa ukubona kwanda izigameko zokubulawa kosopolitiki, ikakhulukazi amakhansela nabaholi bomdabu esifundazweni.”I-IFP inxuse imiphakathi ukuthi ibambisane ukulwa nodlame futhi ibambisane ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwemiphakathi nokugcinwa kwamagugu.
UMASIPALA wesiFunda iZululand uthi sekuyihaba ukuthi kuntshontshwe uR33 million ebhange lawo kodwa kukhona ozame ukungena kulona ngokungemthetho wagcina engaphumelelanga. Kuzohlupheka abantu basemakhaya ngalesi simo ngoba yibona abalisebenzisa kakhulu iposi nengqalasizinda yalo,” kuchaza uMzileni.Uveze ukuthi abantu basemakhaya bonga imali yabo ePostbank etholakala emaPosini, babuye bathumele impahla ngalo, balande imithi kanti abanye bebehola nezibonelelo zabo khona."IPosi liseduze nabantu basemakhaya ngoba izinxanxathela zezitolo baze bazithole edolobheni. Iningi labo lihola izibonelelo zikahulumeni ePosini, longa khona imali futhi lilanda impahla esuke ithunyelwe isuka emadolobheni. Kubuhlungu ukuthi kuzodilizwa abantu kodwa kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi kuzohlupheka abantu bakithi emakhaya,” kubeka uMzileni.Uthe bazozama ukuhlenga imisebenzi yabantu ngoba bazoba yingxenye yezingxoxo zokudilizwa njengenyunyana enamalungu amaningi.UNksz Helgard Cronje, oyiPhini likaNobhala wenyunyana iSolidarity, uthe kunezingxoxo eziqhubekayo zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi eSapo."Simatasa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ethu awaphumi engazitholanga izimfanelo zawo eSapo. Amalungu ethu akweletwa imali yempesheni, eye-medical aid nokunye okuningi. Ukuvalwa kwamaposi kusho ukuphela kwemisebenzi, ukufadabala komnotho wasemakhaya njengoba izinkampani eziningi zizothatha umsebenzi obuwenziwa yiPosi. Kubi ukuthi iSapo iyawa ekubeni amaposi esiza izigidi zabantu emakhaya,” kusho uCronje.

Ngiyahambisana nokuthi kuthathelwe izinyathelo labo okuzotholakala ukuthi baphule umthetho.”Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma nezintatheli emva kokuyohlanganisa amehlo nemindeni yamalungu e-ANC ashona engozini yomgwaqo elubangise emcimbini wokugubha iminyaka engu-112 kwasungulwa i-ANC.UNzimande usevulelwe icala emaphoyiseni, udaba lwakhe lwabikwa ezinhlakeni uphiko oluphenya amacala enkohlakalo, iSpecial Investigating Unit (SIU), nehhovisi lomvikeli womphakathi.URamaphosa uthe kuyabakhathaza nokuthi kunenqwaba yabafundi abangakazitholi izibonelelo zabo zangonyaka owedlule.Ngokusho kwe-NSFAS kunabafundi abangu-20 000 abangazange bazithole izibonelelo zabo zanyakenye.Laba bafundi babhala izivivinyo zabo zokuphela konyaka bengazitholile izibonelelo zabo.Lesi khwama besikade sizibophezele ekukhokheni zonke izibonelelo kuleli ngoMsombuluko kodwa i-NSFAS ayizange ifune ukuphumela obala ngesikhathi ibuzwa ukuthi isithembiso sigcine sifezekile yini.URamaphosa uthe ufuna ukuba kuphenywe ukuthi kungani lezi zibonelelo zingakhokhwanga ngesikhathi."Iyasikhathaza indaba yokungakhokhwa ngesikhathi kwezibonelelo. Udaba lokuxhaswa kwabafundi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, lubucayi kakhulu. Yingakho sifuna ukuthi kuphenywe, bese kuthathwa izinyathelo ezifanele.”

UKUNGAFIKI ngesikhathi kwezinsiza-kusebenza ezifana nezincwadi kwezinye izikole kube enye yezinkinga eziphazamise ukuqala kahle ngosuku lokuqala ezikoleni KwaZulu-Natal. Ngaphandle kodaba lwezincwadi, nemvula ibingazibekile phansi, ina iphazamisa ukuhamba emgwaqweni okwenze kuvaleke imigwaqo namabhuloho amancane okuwela.Kuvame ukuthi kube wusuku olukhulu kubazali nabafundi kuphithizela, kulethwe izingane ezikoleni. Odado bavame ukususa isidumo bekhala ubumaye uma sebehlukana nabazali babo ngosuku lokuqala.Imvula ebilokhu ibambe ngamoya munye iphoqe ukuthi uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ukhiphe umyalelo wokuthi abafundi basheshe badedelwe. Umnyango ubukhombe ukuthi kungadluli ihora lokuqala bengadedeliwe kodwa washiyela ezandleni zothishanhloko ukuthi banqume ngokubona kwabo isimo.Abesimo sezulu bebevele beyibikile imvula enkulu, bexwayisa abantu ukuthi baqaphele baphephe. Isifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal sijwayele ukuhlushwa yisimo sezulu esibi kuze kube nezikhukhula kufe abantu. Kujwayele ukuthi kuphazamiseke izikole ezinye ziphephuke.Izinyunyana ziphawulile ngosuku lokuqala ezikoleni;UMengameli weNatu, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, uthe abeneme ngezinto eziningi ebezingahambi kahle ezikoleni kuvulwa. UMalinga uthe banethimba abebelikhiphile ezindaweni ezehlukene ukuyobheka isimo, kwabuya imibiko engemihle.Uthe othisha nabafundi bebenomdlandla bezimisele ngokuqala ukufunda nokufundisa kodwa kwakhona izinto eziphoxayo."Kukhona izikole ezazilokhu ziphazanyiswe yiziphepho ngonyaka odlule koMnambithi kodwa azikalungiswa. Kukhona izikole okungafinyeleleki kuzona ngenxa yesimo semigwaqo nokuna kwemvula. Kwezinye izinsiza-kusebenza kazifikanga kahle nemali ifike emuva kwesikhathi,’’ kusho uMalinga.Uthe uma imali yezinsiza ifika emuva kwesikhathi, kuyobe kuthengwe nini izinto ezidingekayo? Ukhale nangokushoda kwezincwadi zabafundi, wathi kuwukubuyela emuva njengezwe ukuba nenkinga enjalo."Uma sithi njengezwe lentando yeningi kufanele imfundo ivuleleke futhi ibe mahhala kodwa bese kushoda izincwadi, kusho ukuthi asithuthuki. Okunye nje okuxakayo wukungavalwa kwezikhala zothisha ngoba labo ababebambile umnyango ubakhiphile,’’ kusho uMalinga.Uthe kunenqwaba yothisha abafunde bagogoda abajika nelanga okufanele ngabe bayaqashwa bafundise kodwa akwenzeki lokho. UMalinga uthe abazimisele ngokwemukela ukuthi uhulumeni awunamali.Ukhale kakhulu nangokwehliswa kwesabelomali somnyango, wathi kubuyisela emuva ezemfundo. Uthe bazoqhubeka nokulwela ukuthi konke kuhambe kahle. UMalinga uthe akufanele ngabe kusakhulunywa ngezinto ezifana nokusikwa kotshani ezikoleni ngoba yizinto ezaziwayo.UNobhala weSadtu KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe babone sengathi kuqale kahle ukufunda ezikoleni."Kuqale kahle, akubanga nezinkinga ngoba vele abanye othisha bebevele bekade baqala ukusebenza. Into ethande ukuphazamisa yimvula kodwa ngoba umnyango uthe akusheshe kuphunywe, kube ngcono,’’ kusho uNksz Caluza.Uthe nakuba kuqalwe kahle kodwa zikhona izinkinga ebezithanda ukuvela kodwa basebenza zanqobeka nokunye bazohamba bekulungisa ngendlela."Bezikhona izinkinga ezindala zangonyaka odlule, yingakho phela saze samasha ngo-Okthoba, ngoba izinto ezifana nemali yezidingo zesikole zazingekho. Umnyango ubukhale ngemali engekho saxoxa noNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uNkk Peggy Nkonyeni, walungisa isimo yangena imali,’’ kusho uNksz Caluza.Uthe basazoqhubeka nokukhuluma ngezindaba zezokupheha ezikoleni futhi basalinde nemali okufanele ikhokhelwe abanye othisha.UMnyango ezeMfundo KwaZulu- Natal uthe ngokwawo wenze konke okusemandleni ukuthi ukufunda nokufundisa kuqale ngaphandle kwezihibe.UNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyiSisekelo kuzwelonke, uNkk Angie Motshekga, ubehambele isikole iKgatoentle Secondary, eGa-Rankuwa, lapho ekhulume khona ngezinhlelo zomnyango. Uthe bewumnyango bakulungele ukuqala umshikashika wokufunda nokufundisa kulo nyaka.Umemezele ukuthi banohlelo lokuthi kube nezivivinyo zikaGrade 9 ezintsha lapho abaphumelele bazothola khona izitifiketi. Uthe akagqugquzeli ukuthi bashiye isikole kodwa kusewuhlelo nje abasaluzama abasazochaza kabanzi ngalo.Uyale abafundi ngezinto okufanele baqhele kuzona uma befuna ukuphumelela."Utshwala nezidakamizwa ningasondeli kukhona ngoba umthelela wakhona uba mubi kakhulu. Ngiyazi nokuthi kunenkinga yokukhulelwa kwabafundi, kufanele sisebenzisane nabazali kulokho. Udaba lwabafundi abangamabhoklolo kwabanye, kufanele kuphele lokho,’’ kuxwayisa uNkk Motshekga.Uthe ulindele ukuthi abafundi baphase ngezinga lika-100% ngoba yibona ikusasa lezwe abazobe bephethe umnotho walo. Uthe bazofaka imali ukweseka izikole kodwa balindele imiphumela emihle, hhayi izinkinga zabafundi abahluphayo.BEKUBUKEKA kumnandi ngesikhathi uNkk Bongekile Sokhela evalelisa indodakazi yakhe u-Aphelele Sokhela, ebizoqala uGrade R eKamalinee Primary, eLotus Park, eThekwini Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/Independent Media U-ELIHLE Hlangu no-Asembo Mkhize bejabulela ukuqala uGrade R eKamalinee Primary eLotus Park Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent Media
KUDLULE emhlabeni ngokuminza abesilisa ababili ngesikhathi benza umcimbi wokugeza emfuleni uMvoti, KwaDukuza, ngoLwesithathu.Laba abesilisa abaneminyaka engu-23 no-27, kuthiwa babhekane nobunzima ngesikhathi benza umcimbi wokugeza base beyamuka.I-IPSS Search and Rescure, KDM Marine Safety, Durban SAPS Search and Rescue neMhlali K9 Search and Rescue, bazamile ukubathungatha ngasosebeni lomfula usuku lonke. Bekunendiza enophephela emhlabe ebilekelela."Ngebhadi laba besilisa bebengakatholakali futhi uphenyo kuphoqeleke ukuthi lumiswe ngenxa yesimo sezulu esingesihle,” kusho i-IPSS Search and Rescue.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, imifula ingenisile ezindaweni ezahlukene KwaZulu-Natal, ngenxa yemvula enamandla.Izangoma zezulu zakwaSouth African Weather Service zikhiphe isexwayiso ngemvula enamandla engadala izikhukhula kulesi sifundazwe.
OWESIFAZANE ushayiswe iloli e-Ottawa, eVerulam emuva kwalokho waphangwa iselula yakhe amadoda amabili obekungathi azomsiza elele phansi.Lokhu kudalulwe abezimo eziphuthumayo benkampani yonogada iReaction Unit South Africa (Rusa).Isigameko sokushayiseka kowesifazane oneminyaka engu-23 senzeke ngoLwesithathu emini emgwaqweni uR102.Owesifazane ona-23 ushayiswe iloli lamanzi maqede wakhuthuzwa emgwaqweni e-Ottawa, eVerulam Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEOkhulumela iRusa, uMnuz Prem Balram, uthe omunye wonogada babo ubeqaphe ubugebengu endaweni kanti uzozithela kowesifazane olimele elele phansi emgwaqweni."Iloli lamanzi lakwaPowerstar beliqhele ngebanga elingu-200 meters nalapho kulele kukhona owesifazane. Kusolakala ukuthi owesifazane ubewela umgwaqo ngesikhathi eshayiswa iloli,” kusho uBalram.Uqhube wathi umshayeli weloli udle phansi ngezinyawo walishiya kanjalo iloli.Kuthiwa ngesikhathi elinde usizo owesifazane obelimele, kube sekuqhamuka amadoda amabili afike amkhuthuza ashaya achitha neselula yakhe iHuawei Nova.UBalram uthe umuntu obedlula ngendlela futhi ozibonele kukhuthuzwa umgilwa, uchazele onogada babo abebekule ndawo ukuthi abebukeka kanjani amadoda.Kuthiwa onogada babe sebephuma inqina bethungatha abasolwa kodwa babuya belambatha."Owesifazane ube esenyangwa khona endaweni yesigameko, wase ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela,” kusho uBalram.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi lenyuke izinga lezibalo zabafundi abenze kahle uma uqhathanisa nabekilasi lika-2022, uma sekumenyezelwa imiphumela ka-matric, okulindeleke imenyezelwe wuNgqongqoshe woMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo uNkk Angie Motshekga namhlanje ebusuku.UMnuz Mathanzima Mweli onguMqondisi-jikelele ehhovisi lomnyango, uthe ikilasi lika-2023 lingelokuqala ukusuka ngo-2020, elinabafundi abangazange bachaphazelwe kangako wubhubhane iCovid 19.Ngesikhathi kugasela lesi sifo kuleli ngo-2020, iningi labebebhala ngonyaka odlule belifunda u-Grade-9, kanti eminyakeni emibili edlule lolu bhubhane bese lungasenawo amandla, isimo sesibuyele kwesijwayelekile.UMathanzima obekhuluma nabeziko lezindaba lakwa-eNCA ngaphambi kokuqala kwesidlo sasekuseni emcimbini wokuhlonishwa kwabafundi abenze kahle osePitoli namhlanje, uthe: "Ngesikhathi ngikhuluma nabo, ngithe basendaweni engcono yokwenza kahle uma kuqhathaniswa nozakwabo abebefunda eminyakeni edlule ngenxa yalesi sizathu. Ngakho silinde ukubona leyo miphumela,” usho kanje.Imiphumela ka-matric 2023, ilindwe ngamehlo abomvu, kanti abezikole ezizimele ezingaphansi kwe-Independent Examination Board, baphase ngo- 98,4%.
UKUKHULA eyintandane nokuba yisigqila sokwelusa izinkomo, kwamenza waba nothando lwabantu oseyintandokazi yabaningi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. UNkk Thandeka Mzobe (40) waseKukhanyeni, ngaseMariannhill, oshade noMnuz Bongakwakhe Mzobe, usezakhele ugazi ngokuqopha ama-video kwiTik Tok eqhulula amahlaya, izinkulumo ezakhayo aphinde azivocavoce.Lokhu kumenze waba nabalandeli abangaphezulu kuka-190 000 kanjalo nama-views angaphezu kuka-3.3 million. Ngokuqopha la ma-video wayefuna ukuthoba amanxeba kwabanezinhliziyo ezophayo njengeyakhe kulandela indlela akhula ngayo. Uveze ukuthi washonelwa unina eneminyaka emibili, ngonyaka olandelayo kwashona uyise. Lokhu kwaphoqa ukuthi akhule elusa izinkomo, eshaywa kanzima nokuthe eseneminyaka ewu-13, waphendulwa isigqila emajalidini."Ngithole indlela yokuzelapha nokukhipha ukhwantalala ngoba uma ngingabheka emuva ngingazaca. Ngazitshela ukuthi ngifuna ukuba ukukhanya empilweni yabantu ngoba ngiyakwazi ukuhlala ngingaphathekile kahle emoyeni. Ukuthola umyeni onothando nongesekayo kungenze nganethezeka futhi uyangilekelela angishuthe," kusho uNkk Mzobe.Laba abashadile asebeneminyaka bethandana neminyaka eyisikhombisa beshadile, babusiswe ngamadodana amabili namadodakazi amabili, kanti bayazifela ngenkonzo njengoba uMzobe ewumfundisi Ekuthuleni Church of Zion. UMzobe uthe zamangala izingane zabo beqala ukuduma kodwa ngenxa yokuba umndeni onothando ziyabaseka. "Into engiyithanda ngositufuza wami unothando, uyangeseka nento uyayibhekisisa. Ungenza ngihlale ngijabule nezingane,” kusho uMzobe.Okwamanje abasebenzi bobabili kodwa uMzobe ubamba itoho losuku olulodwa ngempelasonto bese uNkk Mzobe yena adayise ama-chips ukuze baxoshe ikati eziko.Uthando abaluveza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngisho ekhaya uma ubavakashele yiso leso. UNkk Mzobe ubelokhu emnakekele njalo umyeni wakhe obematasa nokupenda emnyango. Ngisho bekhuluma babhekana emehlweni elokhu eqhulula amahlaya unkosikazi. Isifiso sikaNkk Mzobe ukukhulisa isitolo sakhe, akwazi ukuba nendawo esesimweni esikahle sokusebenza, aphinde abe nesitokwe esanele. Ephetha, uNkk Mzobe uthe uyazi ukuthi akugcinanga ngaye ukuba intandane kodwa uyafisa ukuthi bonke abafana naye babe isibonelo esihle nosizo kwabanye abantu. Yize engenalutho namanje kodwa uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi kukhona olala ehleka ngenxa yakhe. "Ngivuka ngovivi ngidlalise abantu ngoba ngajwayela ngivuswa ngenduku. Manje sengivuka ngipheke ugalo ngijabule,” kusho uNkk Mzobe. Ukubuyela esikoleni ngenye yezinto aqale ukuyenza nyakenye, kanti uphase u-level 5 njengoba agcina esikoleni samabanga aphansi ukufunda. Lesi sikole sesithuthele kude, sekuyaphoqa ahlabe ikhefu ngoba akanawo uR36 wokugibela ngosuku. Unethemba lokuthi isibonelelo sikaR350 uzogcina esitholile njengoba selokhu simi ndawonye isicelo sakhe.
