Usomaabhizinisi odume ngokuphuma engena njengenaliti emaqenjini ezepolitiki uDkt Ziba Jiyane, uthe kunyakaze uhlanga lomzabalazo wanquma ukujoyina iqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe. Iqembu uMkhonto weSizwe elisematheni, lethulwe owayengumengameli uJacob Zuma ngoDisemba wonyaka odlule.UZuma kumanje uphansi phezulu ukhankasela uMkhonto weSizwe unyundela i-ANC uthi abantu abayishalazele okhethweni.UJiyane owake waba sebuholini be-IFP, uthe ujoyine uMkhonto weSizwe emasontweni amabili edlule. Uthe kunyakaze uhlanga lomzabalazo lwamnqoba waziyela yena eqenjini likaZuma."UMsholozi sasinaye kudala emazweni angaphandle mina ngikwi-Apla okungamasosha ePAC, sasinabanye abaningi, oMoses Mabhida. Uma uZuma eseqhamuka naleli qembu livele layithola indawo kimi,’’ usho kanje.UJiyane wayephethe isikhundla sikanobhala-jikelele kwi-IFP, waphinda waba wusihlalo wayo kazwelonke ngaphambi kokuphuma inxiwa. Wasungula iqembu iNational Democratic Convention (Nadeco) nakuyona kwaba nezinkinga kwaqembuka abanye.UJiyane uke wayamaniswa neDA eyilungu layo kodwa nakhona wabuye washiya wazama ukubuyela kwi-IFP. Kule minyaka edlule uke wavuka wathi efuna ukuba wumengameli we-IFP.UJiyane, othe usewumfundisi webandla iNdlu yaMandla, eNseleni eMpangeni, uveze ukuthi akajahe sikhundla, uzoba yilungu nje elejwayelekile. Uthe ubona uMkhonto weSizwe uzoba yikhaya lakhe lezepolitiki elikahle ngoba kwamanye amaqembu uxoshwa yimikhuba emibi."Kukhona abantu abavalela abanye bengafuni bangene babambe iqhaza emaqenjini. Kade sengizihlalele nginake isonto ngingasayingeni eyepolitiki kodwa ngibone uMsholozi eseqhamuka nento enhle. Mina ngiyisishoshovu senkululeko nginentshisekelo ngezwe,’’ kulanda uJiyane, egxile kakhulu esingisini uma ekhuluma.Uthe ngesikhathi kuvela izindaba zokujoyina kwakhe kube nesasasa eqenjini uMkhonto weSizwe amalungu ethi amfuna kwesobuholi. Uthe akuyona into ephambili leyo ufisa ukuba yilungu nje athunywe noma kuphi lapho kufuna khona iqembu.
OWESILISA uvele enkantolo ngamacala ayisithupha okubulala ngokungenhloso amalungu ayisithupha omndeni kaNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha eNingizimu Afrika.UMnuz Celumusa Ngwenya (36) uvele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMnambithi ngoLwesibili.Icala libe selihlehliselwa uFebhuwari 14 ukuze uNgwenya ezokwazi ukuxhumana kahle nommeli wakhe futhi ahlinzekwe ngamaphepha aqukethe imininingwane yecala.Kubikwa ukuthi uNgwenya uzithola esenkantolo nje, ubethunyelelwe amasamanisi abembizela khona.Okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe icala lithinta ingozi yangoJulayi 17, 2022.Uthe abashona kwakungamalungu omndeni kaNkk Chikunga ayeneminyaka ephakathi kuka-40 nemine."Emuva kwengozi kwaqalwa uphenyo olwaluholwa umshushisi oluholele ekutheni agcine ebizelwa enkantolo ngamasamanisi uNgwenya. Enkantolo uNgwenya ucele ukuba ahlinzekwe ngommeli wamahhala wakwaLegal Aid,” kuchaza iNPA.UNkk Ramkisson-Kara uthe uNgwenya udedelwe inkantolo ngesexwayiso sokuba abuyele enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo.Phambilini kwavela ukuthi kwakuyindodana endala kaNkk Chikunga, inkosikazi yayo nabantwana babo abane abaphangalala engozini eyayinyantisa igazi.Ingozi yenzeka kuyimpelasonto ebusuku emgwaqweni onguthelawayeka uN11 eMnambithi.Kuthiwa uNkk Chikunga zamethusa kakhulu futhi zamushiya ephatheke kabi izindaba zokudlula emhlabeni kwamalungu omndeni wakhe ngale ndlela.Isitatimende soMnyango wezokuThutha, owawuholwa uMnuz Fikile Mbalula ngaleso sikhathi, sathi abashona babekade besuka esifundazweni iMpumalanga belibangise KwaZulu-Natal kanti bazohlangabezana nengozi eyayimbandakanya iveni nemoto eyi-sedan.
Ibulawe nabanye abathathu induna yaseCharlestown, eNewcastle, ehlaselwe emzini wayo ngabantu abangaziwa abebehlome beyizingovolo ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko kufe induna uNkk Lucia Nonina Mahlaba (42), indodana yakhe uMnuz Thando Mahlaba (22), umngani uNksz Asanda Zikhali (19) nomakhelwane obebizwe yinduna ukuthi azobasiza, uNkk Shonaphi Mbatha (50).UNkk Mahlaba kuthiwa ubeyinduna esizweni sakwaShabalala.Ngokusho kwelungu lomndeni elicele ukungadalulwa, abasocongi bajikise umufi (Asanda Zikhali) obesevalelisile kade evakashele uThando (naye oshonile)."UNkk Mahlaba uvule umnyango, ezwa izwi lika-Asanda, ezitshela ukuthi ukhohlwe okuthile. Uthe uma evula, baqala kuye u-Asanda, balandela ngaye uNkk Mahlaba, okwazile nokho ukuphulukundlela abaleke,” kuchaza ilungu.Liqhube lathi uThando yena udutshulwe ngesikhathi ephuma ekamelweni lakhe ezobheka ukuthi kwenzekani. Lithi ubuzwe ukuthi sikuphi isisefo semali nesibhamu, akulandulile wathi abanakho.Libuye lathi ubengakaze abatshele uNkk Mahlaba ukuthi impilo yakhe isengcupheni kodwa laveza ukuthi kukhona amanye amalungu omndeni amabili, adutshulwe ngendlela efanayo nyakenye kuyo lendawo.Umakhelwane ocele ukuthi angadalulwa uthe, uNkk Mahlaba ubalekele ensimini eseduze, wabamemeza ukuthi bazomsiza.Uthe baphume bonke bathi uma befika kuye, wacela ukuthi bamphuthumise esibhedlela washo nokuthi ucela kuyobhekwa nasekhaya ngoba ushiye abahlaseli bedubula abebesendlini."Besisathi siyambamba siyamphakamisa ngesikhathi abahlaseli bebona ukuthi siyamsiza, baqala phansi badubula bebhekise ngakithi. Sibaleke sagcwala yonke indawo, kwasala uNkk Mbatha yena ongakwazi ukugijima, kwaba udutshulwa kanjalo. Ushonele endaweni yesigameko kanye noNkk Mahlaba abamqedele.UNgqongqoshe woMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, uthe kuhlasimulisa umzimba ukusocongwa kwenduna yesifazane nabathathu."Kuyakhathaza ukuthi umuntu wesifazane ongenawo amandla okuzivikela nabesilisa abasebancane babulawe ngendlela enesihluku ngale ndlela,” kusho uNkk Sithole-Moloi.Uthe bayasibonga isibindi somakhelwane abazame ukusiza esigamekweni esinesihluku, wathi badlulisa amazwi enduduzo kuyo yonke imindeni yabashonile.Uthe kuyakhathaza nokho ukuthi kuphinde kwenzeke isigameko sokubulawa kwenduna yesifazane, kungakapheli zinyanga ezitheni kubulewe iNkosi uKhumalo nomkayo, uMaDlamini waseMadlangeni, nabo ababulawa ngendlela efanayo."Izigameko ezifuze lezi zitshala ukwesaba emphakathini, zenze ukuthi kungabi bikho uzinzo ezindlini zobukhosi bomdabu,” kubeka uNkk Sithole-Moloi.Uphethe ngelithi banxusa izinhlaka zomthetho ukuthi ziphenyisise ukuze kwenzeke ubulungiswa emindenini elahlekelwe.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Njabulo Nkosi okhulume neSolezwe esendleleni eya emndenini wakwaMahlaba, uthe kukhulu ukukhathazeka okukhona emphakathini kulandela isigameko.Uveze ukuthi lokhu kwenziwa ukuthi seziyinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba izigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabantu emakhaya endaweni."Cishe bayisishiyagalolunye abantu asebebulewe kusuka ngoNovemba nyakenye. Abantu bathuswa nawukuthi le ndawo isemakhaya, akulindelekile ukuthi ibe nezigameko ezifuze lesi” kusho uNkosi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseCharlestown aphenya amacala amane okubulala kulandela isigameko sokudutshulwa kubulawe abane ngeSonto."Kuthiwa abasolwa abangaziwa bahlasela abagilwa, babadubulula, bababulala. Imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa,” kusho uNetshiunda.
Amaphoyisa abophe abasolwa abangu-11 kusukela kuqale impi embonini yamatekisi ePort St Johns, e-Eastern Cape ngoLwesibili.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesiya sifundazwe, uColonel Priscilla Naidu, uthe abasolwa baboshelwe amacala okukhona kuwo awokubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, ukucekela phansi impahla, ukudubula emphakathini nodlame emphakathini. Uthe bazovela enkantolo maduze."Kutholwe nezibhamu ezingu-15 okukhona kuzo ezincane, ama-AK47, nezibhamu ezinkulu nezinhlamvu ezungu-328,” kusho uNaidu.IZINHLAMVU ezithathwe ngamaphoyisa kwabasolwa ngempi yamatekisi ePort St Johns Isithombe: SITHUNYELWEUmkhuzi wamaphoyisa esifundazweni, uLt-Gen Nomthetheleli Mene, uthe amaphoyisa nabathintekayo babe nezingxoxo nososheshini bamatekisi abalwayo, ngenhloso yokuqeda ngengxabano."Amaphoyisa ethu azoqhubeka nokuba sendaweni futhi singamaphoyisa siyazibophezela ekuphepheni kwabo bonke abantu endaweni,” kusho uMene.Izolo amaphoyisa abike ukuthi ososheshini ababili babe sempini kudutshulwana erenki ePort St Johns.Kuthiwa kufe onogada abathathu bakasoseshini owodwa waseLusikisiki, kwalimala nabantu abahlanu abadubulekile basohlangothini lwasePort St Johns. Kushiswe izimoto ezintathu.Kuthiwa osomatekisi ababangayo ngabasebenzela eLusikisiki nasePort St Johns.
UMNTWANA uSimakade Jackson kaZwelithini noMengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, bafuna ukuyodelisana inkani eNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyona amaCala.UMntwana uSimakade noRamaphosa benze isicelo sokuba banikezwe igunya lokudlulisela phambili isinqumo senkantolo esachitha isinqumo sikaRamaphosa sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini.Lesi sicelo basenze phambi kweJaji uNorman Davis, okunguye owakhipha isinqumo esiyalela ukuba kuqokwe ithimba elizophenya umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.Izicelo zabo bezilalelwe eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, izolo.URamaphosa ufuna ukuphonsela inselelo cishe zonke izingxenye zesinqumo esathulwa uDavis, kanti uMntwana uSimakade yena ufuna ukuphonsela inselelo izingxenye ezithize zesinqumo angajabule ngazo.Abathinteka kuleli cala bebengakwazi ukuthi baphonsele inselelo isinqumo sikaDavis khona eNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, lapho udaba lwabo beluzolalelwa amajaji amathathu.Kepha uRamaphosa noMntwana uSimakade bathe bafuna ukuthi icala liyolalelwa eNkantolo okuDluliswa kuyona amaCala.Ummeli kaMntwana uSimakade, u-Adv Alan Dodson, uthe zikhona izingxenye zesinqumo sikaDavis abavumelana nazo."Kwasijabulisa ukuthi inkantolo inqume ukuchitha isinqumo sikamengameli sokuvuma ukuqokwa kweSilo. Sakujabulela ukuthi inkantolo inqume ukuthi akuqokwe ithimba elizophenya udaba lombango wesihlalo sobukhosi. Kwasijabulisa futhi ukuthi inkantolo ithi umengameli akakhokhele izindleko zecala."Okungasijabulisanga ukuthi inkantolo ingabeki imibandela okufanele umengameli ayilandele uma eseqoka ikomiti. Sifuna ukuba sikwazi ukuphawula ngabantu abazoqokwa umengameli ukuba baxazulule umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi. Sifuna ukukwazi nokuphawula ngesikhathi okufanele sithathwe ikomiti ukuphenya udaba.”UDodson uthe bafuna nokuthi inkantolo inqume ukuthi ikomiti elizophenya ngeke libophezelwe isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lapho iJaji uMjabuliseni Isaac Madondo, lanquma ukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu yisona esifanelwe isihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu.UMadondo wayekade elalele amacala ayethinta kakhulu amafa ashiywa yiSilo esesakhothama, uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.UDodson uthe ikomiti elizoqokwa bafuna ukuba likushaye indiva okwashiwo uMadondo."Uphenyo (ngombango wesihlalo sobukhosi) kufanele luqalwe phansi.”Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uRamaphosa yena uthi isinqumo sikaMadondo saqeda nya umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi.UDavis uzonquma esikhathini esingangesonto ukuthi uyazinikeza yini lezi nhlangothi igunya lokudlulisa icala.
UPHOXEKILE umndeni wesitshudeni esadutshulwa sashona eMthwalume nyakenye ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha phambili indoda ebikade ithweswe icala lokubulala.Umndeni kaMnuz Nkanyiso Mbhele (27), owayenza unyaka wokugcina weziqu zeBA Community Development futhi esebenza kwaLove Life, uthe usulilahlile ithemba lokuthi uyotholakala umbulali.Kubikwa ukuthi izolo inkantolo ibuchithile ubufakazi obethulwe wofakazi abane boMbuso, yathi abuhlangani.Lo mndeni uthe kucacile emuva kwesinqumo semantshi ukuthi ngeke uphinde ulazi iqiniso ngokufa kwelungu lawo. Ngosuku abulawa ngalo uMbhele kuthiwa wayekade etitinye abantu ababekade bembize ngesitabane. Isihlobo sikamufi, esicele ligodlwe igama laso ngenxa yokuphepha, sithe indoda ededeliwe ibikade isesitokisini kusukela yaboshwa."Siwumndeni asiyiboni into engasiqhatha nomsolwa ngoba akukho ebesikwazi. Ukuboshwa kwakhe kwakungeve kuxhumene nomndeni, kodwa sabikelwa amaphoyisa ukuthi useboshiwe,” kusho isihlobo.Isihlobo sithe bese bethembile ukuthi uzogwetshwa umsolwa ngoba babetshelwe ukuthi utholakele.Uchaze umufi njengeqhathanzipho elalinothando lwabantu futhi lingabaxwayi.UNkanyiso wayewumuntu ophila kakhulu nabantu, ebeka isinkwa etafuleni ekhaya, esiza kakhulu emphakathini. Labo abebehlupha nabangene ezidakamizweni wayekhuluma nabo bashintshe, ehambela nezikole eyala abafundi,” kusho isihlobo.Siqhube sathi uMbhele wayengathandani nabobulili obufana nobakhe futhi engabaxwayi abantu noma ngabe bawuhlobo luni.Umndeni uthe okwakwenza abantu basole uMbhele ngokuthi uyisitabane yingoba wayezithanda kakhulu futhi ezinaka.Kusolakala ukuthi uMbhele wasuka lapho ayekade eqashe khona waya ethaveni eyothenga utshwala ayezobuye abuphuze endlini.Ethaveni, kubikwa ukuthi wafica abesilisa abamchapha ngenhlamba wagcina ediniwe wabashaya bonke wabahlula.Lawa madoda kuthiwa abaleka kodwa amsongela uMbhele ngokuthi azoziphindiselela. Kuthiwa lawa madoda afikela uMbhele endlini ebusuku ngesikhathi kucinywe ugesi ngenhloso yokuwonga, afike amdubula washona.UMbhele washiya emhlabeni indodakazi yakhe eyayineminyaka eyisithupha. Wabulawa ngoMeyi 26, 2023.Ngaleso sikhathi amaphoyisa athi umufi wayenamanxeba amaningi okudutshulwa emzimbeni.
ABAZALI nabafundi sebemi ngomuno ngosuku lwanamhlanje njengoba kuvulwa izikole KwaZulu-Natal. Leli phephandaba izolo livakashele isitolo semifaniswano yezikole iGem, e-Overport eThekwini lapho odado bebelinganisa imifaniswane yabo. Abazali baveza ukuthi lesi sikhathi noma sihambisana nokuba matasa nokudinga imali kodwa bayasithakasela.UNkk Snenhlanhla Zuma Ndwalane waseNewlands East, ongunina kaKhanyisa Zuma oyofunda uGrade R, eBriardale Primary ubengomunye wabazali ebebematasa nokulungisela lolu suku."Siqalile isikhathi sokuvusana ekuseni silungiselele isikole. UKhanyisa ngimshintsha isikole ngoba uzokwazi ukufunda kulesi esisha aze aqede kanti lesi esidala asinawo amanye amakilasi. Nomfaniswano wesikole yikho ngiwuthenga ngosuku lokugcina sekuphithizela kugcwele ezitolo. Kumele sibambisane singabazali ngalesi sikhathi. Uma ungene kuqala kumele ulinganise ingane yakho ngokucabangela nabanye abazali," uNkk Zuma Ndwalane.UKhanyisa ubejabule ehluleka nokuzibamba ebona umfaniswano wakhe wesikole. Ngemvume kanina utshele leli phephandaba ukuthi ujabule kakhulu ukuyofunda uGrade R. Ngaphandle kwakhe noSinothando Gqeba waseRidge View, uthe usejahe ukuya esikoleni eSpringfield Model Primary lapho eyokwenza khona uGrade 5.Omunye wabasebenzi baseGem, uNksz Kwanele Ntuli waseNanda uveze ukuthi abazali abathenga umfaniswano wesikole behluke kakhulu ngoba banesineke. Lokhu uthe kwenza umsebenzi wabo ubelula futhi bawenze ngothando. UMSEBENZI onothando onakekela odado eGem, uNksz Kwanele Ntuli othathwe elinganisa umfaniswane wesikole uSinothando Gqeba, oyokwenza uGrade 5 eSpringfield Model Primary Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIAOMUNYE wabazali onengane eqala isikole samhlanje, uNkk Snenhlanhla Zuma Ndwalane nendodakazi yakhe uKhanyisa oyofunda ugrade R eBriardale Primary eNewlands Isithombe: SIBONELO NGCOBO/ INDEPENDENT MEDIA
INkantolo eNkulu eThekwini, ivune iDA yabe isiyalela imenenja kaMasipala eMdoni, ukuthi ikhokhele izindleko zecala embangweni wesihlalo sekhansela esigungwini esilawula umkhandlu. I-DA ibimangalele umasipala iwusola ngokukhwabanisa isihlalo sayo ngokusinikeza i-ANC.Ijaji alihlalanga isikhathi eside lifike lamemezela ukuthi isinqumo salo sivuna iDA, lase lifunda amaphepha lapho lenabe khona ngesinqumo, labhala phansi laphuma.UMasipala Umdoni ozinze eScottburgh, ungaphansi kwesifunda Ugu, uphethwe amaqembu ngokubambisana kanti udaba lwezibalo zezihlalo luyinto enkulu. Alikho iqembu elakwazi ukunqoba umasipala ingcaca emuva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya ngo-2021.Isihlalo esigungwini esiphezulu esilawula umkhandlu siyinto eqavile ngoba sinamandla okubeka iphuzu uma kuthathwa izinqumo.Umbango wesihlalo uhambe waze wafika enkantolo okuyiyona enqume ukuthi iDA ibuyiselwe kusona. Ngesikhathi kuzokhishwa isinqumo bekukhona izikhulu zeDA esifundazweni okunguSihlalo wayo uMnuz Dean Mcpherson, namakhansela aseMdoni.UMcpherson uthe bayajabula kakhulu ngokuthi ekugcineni kwenzeke ubulungiswa odabeni ababekade bekhala ngalo."Okubaluleke kakhulu wukuthi imenenja kamasipala izophoqeleka ukukhokhela izindleko zenkantolo ngemali yayo ngoba ijaji likholwa wukuthi izinto azenziwanga ngendlela efanele,’’ kuchaza uMcpherson.Uqhube wathi uyabona ukuthi bekuzanywa ukuqhwaga isihlalo sabo esigungwini esiphezulu kodwa bona, bebengeke bakuvume lokho yingakho beye enkantolo. UMcpherson uthe osekusele wukuthi umasipala uthobele isinqumo senkantolo, ulungise umonakalo owenzeka phambilini, ngokuthi ufake ikhansela leDA endaweni efanele.Umholi wekhokhasi yeDA eMdoni, uNkk Shara Singh, uthe banqobile futhi babonga inkantolo ukuthi yenze ubulungiswa. Uthe baxwayisa kaningi ngesinqumo sokuqhwaga isihlalo seDA kodwa akekho owake wabalalela njengoba baze baya enkantolo.
Kuvuke umunyu, izinyembezi zagcwala amehlo kwamanye amalungu omndeni wowesifazane waseDondotha eMpangeni kulandela ukuvela kowayeyisoka eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini ngoMsombuluko, osolwa ngokumbulala.UMnuz Mlamli Michael Qaba, waseNtabankulu e-Eastern Cape, usolwa ngokugwaza uNksz Zama "Girlie” Mthembu amanxeba angu-25 emijondolo yaseKenville ngoDisemba 16, wonyaka odlule.Isigameko kuthiwa senzeka endlini kamngani kamufi lapho umsolwa amfica khona, phambi kwengane eneminyaka eyisithupha.Kusolwa ukuthi wenza lesi sehlo ngoba engafuni ukwaliwa wumufi.Okulethe umunyu kunina kamufi, uNkk Lindiwe Mbhele, amagama kanina kammangalelwa, uNkk Nombeko Qaba, emva kokuhlehla kodaba enkantolo, luhlehlela uLwesihlanu.UNkk Qaba uvumile ukuthi into eyenziwe yindodana yakhe ibuhlungu, wathi uyakuqonda ukuthi unina kamufi ubelindele ukuthi ingane yakhe ibuye ize ekhaya ngamaholidi kaDisemba kodwa yabuya seyilele ngomqolo.UNINA kammangalelwa, uNkk Nombeko Qaba Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent Newspapers"Nami njengomama ngiyazwelana nonina kamufi,” kusho uNkk Qaba.Uthe ngisho umsolwa angafaka isicelo sebheyili, yena ngeke ayikhokhele ibheyili indodana yakhe, ukukhombisa ukuthi uzwelana nomndeni kamufi."Yena kufuneka ajeze ukuze nabanye bafunde isifundo ukuthi umuntu wesifazane akabekwa isandla. Okwakhe kubi kakhulu ngoba uze wabulala. Njengoba eboshiwe ngibuhlungu, kodwa ngizokweseka umndeni kamufi,” kusho uNkk Qaba.Uqhube wathi umsolwa ulivumile kuye icala."Ngamfonela ngimbuza ngesigameko emva kokuthi ngangikhonjiswe ingane yakwamakhelwane obekubhalwe ngaye ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kuthiwa uyafuneka ngecala lokubulala obeyintombi yakhe."Ngathi uma ngimbuza ukuthi bekwenzenjani, wathi akazi, kodwa ubephuzile. Ngambuza ukuthi ubusungaze umbulale pho? Ngambuza ukuthi, wathi useNtabankulu,” kuqhuba yena uNkk Qaba.Uveze ukuthi wamtshela ukuthi abuye, ayozinikela emaphoyiseni esiteshini esiseduze, wathembisa ukuthi uzobuya."Into ayenzile ayingiphathanga kahle ngoba nami ngingumzali. Ingane yakho njengomzali uma iphumile yayosebenza, uba nethemba lokuthi izokuvusela umuzi, kodwa yena isihluku asenzile, kwamina sangigulisa. Zaphela izinsuku ezintathu ngingadli, ngishaywa wuvalo. Ngathi uma ngibuka ingane yami yentombazane, ngacabanga le eyomuntu engasekho,” kusho uNkk Qaba.UNkk Mbhele ongandanga kakhulu ngenkulumo, uthe umsolwa umzwise ubuhlungu, ulunge evalelwe ngapakathi futhi engayifuni ibheyili.Uthe kusebuhlungu abakwenziwe wumsolwa, wathi ingane kamufi encane yiyo esakuthola kunzima ukwamukela ukuthi unina akasekho.Ngaphakathi enkantolo, iMantshi uSicelo Zuma ilihlehlisele uLwesihlanu udaba emva kokuthi umsolwa efike yedwa enkantolo, idokodo lakhe lasala ngemumva.Kuvele ukuthi umsolwa, obebukeka ezikhululekele, uthe ngeke asifake isicelo sebheyili okwamanje.
INHLANGANO elwela umphakathi, i-AfriForum isiphakamise ukuthi kuqedwe nya ngamalayisensi ethelevishini.UMnuz Ernst van Zyl obhekelele ezokuxhumana kwi-AfriForum, uthe awukho umehluko owenziwa wukukhokhelwa kwamalayisensi ethelevishini eNingizimu Afrika."I-SABC ayinayo imali, lokhu kwenzeka uhulumeni ebuka. Njengamanje sithola ukuthi u-87% wabantu bakuleli awuwakhokheli amalayisensi ethelevishini. Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi yinto okufanele iyekwe lena ngoba ayisebenzi. I-SABC iyakwazi ukwenza imali ngezikhangiso ngakho akusetshenziswe leyo mali, kuyekwe abantu bakuleli babuke ithelevishini mahhala,” kusho uvan Zyl.Uthe abagcini ngokukhuluma kodwa umbono wabo bawubhale phansi bawuthumela ekomitini lezokuxhumana nobuchwepheshe ePhalamende njengoba kunomthetho sivivinywa othinta ukuxhaswa kwe-SABC.Uveze ukuthi ngokwabo iSABC kufanele iphathiswe okwenkampani yezokusakaza ezimele njengezinye izinkampani ezikulo mkhakha ezenza imali.Uthe ukube inkohlakalo ayikho eSABC nakuhulumeni ngabe le nhlangano kahulumeni inayo imali, akulokhu kucelwa ukuba itakulwe.Uphethe ngokuthi uhulumeni kufanele ucabangele abantu abampofu abasakazelwa yiSABC ukuthi abanayo imali yokukhokhela amalayisensi.Ubalule ukuthi kwisibonelelo sikahulumeni esitholwa ngabampofu, kuphuma imali yokuthenga igilosa kuphela, hhayi eyokukhokhela ilayisensi ye-SABC ephindaphinda izinhlelo zakudala.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi iSABC yaveza ukuthi wu-13% kuphela wabantu bakuleli abanamathelevishini abakhokhela amalayisensi. Lokhu kungenisa imali ewuR815 million.U-87% wabantu awukhokhi kanti iSABC ikweletwa ngaphezu kukaR44 billion.Kuthiwa mancane amathuba okuthi izokwazi ukuyiqoqa le mali njengoba isisebenzise uR73 million ukuzama ukulandelela abakweleta amalayisensi ethelevishini.
Uhlaka olubhekele izingabunjalo lemiphumela ka-matric, Umalusi, luthi awekho amaphepha ezivivinyo zaleli banga aputshukile kuzona zonke izifundazwe zakuleli, ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukubhalwa kwazo ngonyaka odlule yize kukhona uphenyo ngezinsolo zabakopelile ezifundazweni ezimbili.Lokhu kuvezwe yisikhulu esiphezulu kulolu hlaka uDkt Mafu Rakometsi ngesikhathi benesithangami nabezindaba ePitoli ngoMsombuluko.Lolu hlaka lugunyaze ukudedelwa kwemiphumela yaleli banga okulindeleke ukuthi imenyezelwe wuNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo kuleli uNkk Angie Motshekga ngoLwesine.URakometsi uveze ukuthi nakuba kungekho maphepha aputshukile, kodwa zikhona izingqinamba ezivelile ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukubhalwa kwezivivinyo, okubalwa kuzo nokuboshwa kwabebebedayisa izitifiketi zaleli banga ezingombombayi.Uthe okunye okubikiwe okusaphenywa, abafundi abangu-927 okusolakala ukuthi bakopelile, kanti abangu-763 abaKwaZulu-Natal bese kuthi abangu- 164 abasesifundazweni iMpumalanga. Uveze ukuthi ngokombiko abawutholile, kulezi zinsolo kuvela ukuthi abafundi babhale izimpendulo ezifanayo, kokunye izimpendulo ezifanayo ezishaya khona noma okungeyizo. Okwamanje akukathathwa sinqumo ngalezi zinsolo ngoba kusacutshungulwa. "Kusukela ngesikhathi sibize isithangami nabezindaba ngo-Okthoba wanyakenye ukucacisa ngokulungela kwethu ukuqalwa kokubhalwa kwezivivinyo zika-2023, bangu-11 abasolwa asebeboshwe amaphoyisa ngokudayisa izitifiketi ezingombombayi. Umalusi uzoqhubeka nokusebenza namaphhoyisa ngazo zonke izindlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi laboabakhiqiza izitifiketi zomgunyathi bathathelwa izinyathelo,” kusho uRakometsi.Uthe kube khona amaphutha kwamanye amaphepha ayebhalwa, abale kuwo elesiZulu nephepha lesibili lePhysical Science. Uveze ukuthi imibuzo okutholakale ukuthi ibenamaphutha yeqiwe ngesikhathi kumakwa.Uthe ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukubhala kwezivivinyo nokumakwa kwamaphepha, bebeqhubeka nokuhlola izikhungo okubhalelwa nokumakelwa kuzo nokubheka ukuthi ukumakwa kwawo kuqhubeka ngendlela.Ubonge izinhlaka ezehlukene ezisebenze ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ukuhlolwa kwabafundi kwenzeka ngempumelelo, okubakwa kuzo uMnyango weMfundo eyisiSekelo, owezeMfundo ePhakeme , ukuQeqeshwa nezobuChwepheshe, i-Independent Examination Board ne-South African Comprehensive Assessment Institute nezinyunyana.Oyisikhulu esiphezulu wenyunyana yothisha i- National Professional Teachers' Organisation of South Africa, uthe izinsolo zokukopela ziyakhathaza kakhulu ngoba zilimaza isithunzi sokukhishwa kwemiphumela, wathi bazolindela imiphumela yophenyo.Phambili, uNkk uMphathiswa wezeMfundo esifundazweni uNkk Mbali Frazer ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabafundi kwesinye sezikole ayesihambele ngaphambi kokuqalwa kwezivivinyo zokuphela konyaka, wabaxwayisa ngezigwebo abangabhekana nazo uma kwenzeka kutholakala ukuthi bakopelile, okukhona kuzo nokumiswa isikhathi esithile obanjwe ekopela engavumelekile ukusondelna nezinto ezithinta ukubhalwa kuka-matric.Bangu- 723 971 abafundi baka-matric ababhale izivivinyo ngokugcwele zanyakenye, bebengu- 129 064 abebengafundi ngokugcwele.
Uqhubekile nokuhlonishwa ngezindondo emazweni aphesheya, uthisha wakuleli odume ngokufundisa ngendlela ehlukile izifundo ezithathwa ngokuthi zilukhuni, i-Maths nePhysical Science.UDkt Khangelani Sibiya, ongowokudabuka eRichards Bay udle umhlanganiso ekhala emuka nezindondo ezintathu emazweni ahlukene, okuyi-United States ,i-Dubai neCanada.Eminyakeni edlule uSibiya ubelokhu eqoqa izindondo emazweni aphesheya emikhakheni ehlukene ekufundiseni lezi zifundo. Uthe bekungokukuqala ephakanyiswa emazweni amabili, okuyi- USA ngendondo yokuba wuthisha ovelele, emcimbini obungesonto eledlule, i-IOER International Pinnacle Awards, nasemkhakheni ofanayo emcimbini wezindondo i-Asia Pacific Global Achiever obuseCanada, emasontweni amabili adlule.NgoLwesihlanu uhlomule ngendondo emunxeni i-Outstanding Educational Influencer kuma-AKS Education Awards, eDubai. USibiya, ongumsunguli wesikhungo esilekelela kubafundi kulezi zifundo, i-KWV Maths and Science Training naso esihlonishwe ngendondo eminxeni yezikhungo ezenza kahle, uthe lokhu kumjabulisa kakhulu."Lokhu kuyangithokozisa ngoba kusho ukuthi kuyabonakala ukuthi izwe (lethu) lenza kahle kakhulu uma kuziwa kwezemfundo. Ukunqoba emkhakheni lapho uqhathwe khona namazwe anazo zonke izinsiza, kukhombisa ukuthi siyizwe eliya phambili,”usho kanje.USibiya akaqali ukuhlabana, njengoba nangonyaka odlule ubeke wahlabana ngokuba nguthisha ovelele kumaGlobal Education Awards, eDubai.
LUYAQHUBEKA uphenyo mayelana nengozi yokushayisana kwamaguzu ngeSonto ekuseni.Ngokusho kwenkampani kahulumeni, eyengamele izitimela ezithutha impahla, iTransnet, ithe ingozi yenzeke eLubana, eMabhuyeni eMpangeni.Esitatimendeni esithumele abezindaba, iTransnet ithe amaguzu ashayisana mahlanze aphuma emizileni abehamba kuyona."Emuva kwengozi kuthunyelwe amathimba ethu ngokushesha, kwabe sekuqala uhlelo lokutakula. Akekho umuntu olimale kakhulu,” kusho iTransnet.Kubikwa ukuthi abasebenzi abalimala kule ngozi baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuze bayonyangwa.Inkampani ithe amathimba abhekele ukunakekelwa kwemvelo nawo anikela endaweni yesigameko ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi iyalandelwa imithetho ngesikhathi sokukhuculula.Zigcwale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana izithombe zale ngozi eziveza indawo yesigameko kuwubusaphasapha.Ezinye izinqola zeguzu ziphumele ngaphandle emzileni zachitha ilahle elibonakala ligcwele phansi.
Kudonswe ngendlebe omalume no-anti abathutha izingane zesikole ukuba baqiniseke ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimeni esifanele njengoba kuzovulwa izikole.IRoad Traffic Management Corporatation (RTMC), ithe kubalulekile ukuthi izimoto ezihambisa abafundi ezikoleni zihlale zisesimeni esifanele ukuze bafike bephila lapho beya khona.Idonse ngendlebe abathutha abafundi ukuthi bahambise izimoto zabo ukuba ziyohlolwa ukuthi zisebenza kahle, ziyabhreka, amathayi asesimeni esifanele futhi namalambu asebenza kahle.Ithe kufanele kube segazini lomalume no-anti ukuhlola izimoto zabo ukuthi zisesimeni nokuzihambisa ezinhlanganweni ezifanele ezenza lo msebenzi.Kuthiwe kufanele baqiniseke ukuthi ama-disc awaphelelwe yisikhathi futhi uma sekusondele isikhathi sokuyivuselela bangene kwi-online.natis.gov.za.Iveze ukuthi lolu hlelo lokuvuselela i-disc lwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi ilethwa ngqo kuloyo ofake isicelo.Kugqugquzelwe ukuthi abashayela izimoto ezithutha abafundi bahlale beqeqeshwe ngendlela efanele, babe nezimvume ezisemthethweni zokuthutha umphakathi.I-RTMC ithe izimoto kufanele zibe nezinsiza zokuphepha, okubalwa ezokucisha umlilo nebhokisi losizo lokuqala.Iphethe ngokuthi njengoba izulu lilokhu lina umlibe, kubalulekile ukuthi izimoto zingabi namasondo ayizimpandla, zibe nama-wiper asebenzayo, amalambu akhanya bha nakho konke okusesimeni esifanele ukuze abafundi bahlale bephephile.
Kuboshwe iphoyisa ngezinsolo zokubulala intombi (28) nonina (44) wayo nokuzama ukubulala isingababa layo ngemuva kokuthi belikhuze ngokushayela ngesivinini esiphezulu.Lesi sigameko senzeke eCaroline, eMpumalanga, ngeSonto.Ngokusho kohlaka oluphenya amacala athinta amaphoyisa i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (Ipid), iphoyisa (33) elisolwayo linguConstable."Isingababa lihanjiswe esibhedlela nenxeba lokudutshulwa ehlombe. Kusolwa ukuthi iphoyisa lifelwe yimoto labe selizoyishayela ucingo intombi yalo ukuthi lizoyisiza ngokuthi idonswe. Intombi iyile ukuyolisiza ihamba nonina nesingababa layo," kusho i-iPid.Kuthiwa kusuke ingxabano kulaba bobathathu nephoyisa njengoba belishayela ngesivinini esiphezulu."Iphoyisa kusolwa ukuthi libadubule bobathathu. Lizovela enkantolo namhlanje (ngoLwesibili) libhekene namacala amabili okubulala nelilodwa lokuzama ukubulala."
IMeya kaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ixwayise abantu ngokwakha imizi yabo eduze kwemifula.UKaunda izolo ubeyohlola umonakalo eZwelisha eVerulam.Le ndawo ikhahlanyezwe imvula enamandla ngoMgqibelo.Kuyona kuphume izidumbu ezimbili ngenxa yemvula, konakala ingqalasizinda kagesi, eyamanzi kanjalo nemigwaqo.Isidumbu sikaNksz Ncamisile Zungu (52) nesikaSelu Zungu (3) zitholwe ngaphansi kwendlu kathayela abebehlala kuyo. Kuthiwa bacindezelwe wudonga obelubiye umuzi kamakhelwane.Ekhuluma nabezindaba, uKaunda uthe: "Siyaqhubeka nokuxhumana nemiphakathi yethu ukuyixwayisa ngokuthi akulungile ukwakha osebeni lomfula.”UKaunda uthe ukwakha indlu ngasemfuleni akulungile ngoba uma kufika imvula enamandla, ibeka impilo yalabo abasuke bakhe kuleyo ndawo engcupheni. Ube esecela amalungu omphakathi wale ndawo ukuthi agade izingane, zingadlaleli emfuleni ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi kube khona izinto ezehlukene ezingabeka impilo yazo engcupheni.Uqhube wathi kungaba nokungcola okungazigulisa kanjalo nezilwane eziyingozi okungenzeka ukuthi zimuke namanzi avela kweminye imifula njengoba kube nemvula enamandla.Ubuye waveza nokuthi amathimba avela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene zikahulumeni aphansi phezulu ahlola umonakalo, wathi bazokwazi uma eseqedile ukuthi ubemkhulu kangakanani.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthe isibalo sabashone ngezikhukhula zangoMgqibelo sesenyukele kwabayisithupha.Uthe bonke laba kuvele ukuthi bakuMasipala weTheku.
Abahlaziyi bezepoliti bathi uRamaphosa uhlulekile ukuchaza ukuthi i-ANC izozixazulula kanjani izingqinamba ezibhekene nabantu bakuleli, okukhona kuzo ukusweleka kwemisebenzi nenkinga kagesi.NgoMgqibelo, uRamaphosa utshele izinkumbi zabantu akade behambele umgubho weminyaka ewu-112 kwasungulwa i-ANC eMbombela, ukuthi awabethusi amaqembu amasha epolitiki.Uthe kuningi okuhle osekwenziwe yi-ANC selokhu yathatha uhulumeni ngo-1994, okubalwa ukwakhelwa kwabantu izindlu eziwu-4.7 million, ukuhlinzeka abantu ngamanzi ahlanzekile, ugesi, izinsiza zempilo zamahhala nemfundo yamahhala.Ubuye waveza ukuthi ngo-1994, babewu-8 million abantu ababeqashwe ngokugcwele kodwa manje sebewu-16 million.Uveze ukuthi i-ANC iyabasiza abantu nangezibonelelo zikahulumeni njengoba bebalelwa ku-28 million abazitholayo uma sekufakwa nesibonelelo sikaR350 wabangasebenzi.Umhlaziyi wepolitiki ozimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, uthe uRamaphosa vele uzothi akawesabi amaqembu amasha kodwa-ke unakho ukukhathazeka ngokuhlubuka kwabantu kwi-ANC.Uthe kuhle ukuthi i-ANC kukhona umehluko ewenzile empilweni yabantu kodwa uRamaphosa akazange anike abantu ithemba lokuthi uhulumeni uzoyidala kanjani imisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi njengoba kungabantu abasha abahleli emakhaya."Njengamanje iNingizimu Afrika inenkinga yokunqamuka kukagesi. Ziyawa izimboni zikahulumeni ngaphansi koMbuso we-ANC. Osozimboni abazimele bakhala ngokuthi ukunqamuka kukagesi kuyabashaya, abanye sebediliza abantu. Bekufanele uRamaphosa asho ukuthi bazokwenzani ukudala amathuba omsebenzi amasha, angagcini nje ngokucela osomabhizinisi ukuthi bangadilizi abasebenzi,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe uRamaphosa nohulumeni ka-ANC abanawo amasu okuqeda inkinga kagesi kuleli ngoba bafuna ukuhlakaza i-Eskom kodwa abasho lokhu kuzoletha muphi umehluko ekuphehlweni kukagesi obekwenziwa yi-Eskom eyasungulwa eminyakeni ewu-100 edlule.Ukhale ngokuthi i-ANC ibukela kuwa kwePosi, Denel, South African Airways, Eskom nezinye izinkampani zikahulumeni ebeziqashe inqwaba yabantu.USolwazi Musa Xulu oyisazi sepolitiki nezimo zenhlalo, uthe yiqiniso elingephikwe ukuthi i-ANC iwulethile umehluko kubantu bakuleli ngokubakhela izindlu, ukuletha ugesi, amanzi, izinsiza zempilo nokunye.Uthe kungakuhle ukuthi uRamaphosa nethimba lakhe baqale beze nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthi izoqedwa kanjani inkinga kagesi bese kuqashwa nabantu abawaziyo umsebenzi wabo."I-ANC iyakwazi ukuthembisa abantu impilo engcono nezisombululo ezinkingeni ezithile. Inkinga yayo ayiqashi abantu abazokwazi ukufeza izithembiso zayo. Inkinga kagesi angiyiboni iphela ngoba akucaci ukuthi uhulumeni oholwa yi-ANC uhlela ukuyiqeda kanjani. Amathuba omsebenzi asazosweleka ngoba imfundo yakuleli ayibahlomisi abantu abasha ngamakhono adingekayo ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele,” kusho uXulu.Uthe imfundo yakuleli kufanele ishintshe ize nezifundo zobuchwepheshe nokunye okudingwa yizimboni.Uphethe ngokuthi vele uRamaphosa awamqwashisi amaqembu amasha epolitiki ngoba umlando uveza ukuthi alikho eselike lathola amavoti adlula awe-ANC."Vele kuzoba wukhetho olunzima lolu kodwa amaqembu amasha awavamisile ukuthola amavoti ahlula awe-ANC. Kusukela kwi-UDM, Cope ne-EFF, wonke la maqembu awakaze ahlule i-ANC ngamavoti,” kusho uXulu.
Sizoqala kuwo lo nyaka (2024) isigaba sokuqala sokuxhaswa kwezitshudeni ezaziwa nge-missing middle ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.Lokhu kuvezwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme, iSayensi namaKhono, uDkt Blade Nzimande, esithangamini sabezindaba ngeSonto.I-missing middle yilezo zitshudeni ebezingakwazi ukuthola uxhaso lokufunda esikhwameni esilekelela abafundi iNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) ngenxa yokuthi abazali bazo bebehola imali engaphezu kukaR350 000 ngonyaka.Echaza kabanzi uNzimande uthe imali okuzoxhaswa ngayo izitshudeni iyimali-mboleko, okuzofanele ziyibuyise uma sezisebenza."Lesi sikhwama sizoxhasa izitshudeni ezizalwa abazali abahola phakathi kukaR350 000 noR600 000 ngonyaka umholo wabo usuhlanganisiwe. Lezi zitshudeni bezingakwazi ukuxhaswa isikhwama seNSFAS ngoba sona sibhekelela izitshudeni ezinabazali abahola ngaphansi kukaR350 000 ngonyaka. Lesi siyiqalo esihle ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kubhekelelwa wonke umuntu odinga uxhaso,” kusho uNzimande.Uveze ukuthi ngokolwazi abanalo, zingu-11% izitshudeni ezingena ngaphansi kwe-missing middle."Isigaba sokuqala sizoqalwa manje ngo-2024, njengoba kuzoxhaswa izitshudeni ngoR3.8 billion. Uhhafu (ka-11%) wezitshudeni uzoxhaswa kuwo lo nyaka,” kuchaza uNzimande.Uqhube wathi kuzoxhaswa izitshudeni ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme okukhona kuzo namakolishi, wathi ngale kokuthi abazali kufanele bahole umholo othile, kuneminye imigomo ebekiwe ukuze izitshudeni zikwazi ukuphumelela ezicelweni zazo."U-70% wemali-mboleko kuzobhekelelwa ngawo izitshudeni ezifuna ukufundela imikhakha yePhysics neMathemathics bese kuthi u-30% kuhlomule izitshudeni ezifuna ukuqhubeza izifundo zazo emkhakheni we-Humanities,” kusho yena.Ubuye wabalula nokuthi ukuze isitshudeni sikwazi ukuqhubeka sithole uxhaso, kuzofanele siphase ngo-60%."Uma isitshudeni siqede iziqu zaso ngesikhathi esibekiwe, saphinde saphasa izifundo zaso ngo-70% nangaphezulu, u-50% wemali-mboleko uzophenduka umfundaze, isitshudeni sigcine sibuyisa imali engu-50% uma sesisebenza,” kusho uNzimande.Uthe banethemba lokuthi lokhu kuzonciphisa neziteleka eziye zibonakale ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njalo uma kuqala unyaka.Uveze ukuthi bazobambisana nezinhlaka ezehlukene okukhona kuzo eminye iminyango kahulumeni, osomabhizinisi abazimele kanjalo nazo izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme.Uthe eminye imininingwane ngalolu hlelo, bazoyimemezela kahle uma kudlula ukumenyezelwa kwemiphumela ka-matric.
Silokhu sanda isibalo sababulawa imvula enamandla elokhu idala umonakalo ezakhiweni nakwingqalasizinda ezingxenyeni eziningi zeKwaZulu-Natal. Ngokusho koMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisa neziNdaba zoMdabu, bayisihlanu abantu okuqinisekiswe ukuthi bashonile kulandela imvula ngoMgqibelo ebusuku, kanti babili okubikwa ukuthi basadukile.Okhulumela umnyango, uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthe bonke laba bangaphansi koMasipala weTheku.Uthe ababili abaseFolweni bashone emva kokudilikelwa wudonga, owesithathu kube owakwaK eMlaza, naye odilikelwe yindlu abehlala kuyo, kanti ababili kube abasoThongathi abadilikelwe umjondolo ebebehlala kuwo, khona oThongathi kuthiwa kuduke ababili emva kokuthi umjondolo wabo umuke namanzi.UMngadi uthe amathimba ezinhlekelele okukhona kuwo iSearch and Rescue, SAPS K9 Unit, IPSS Medical Rescue neReaction Unit SA aphansi phezulu nokucinga abadukile.Uveze ukuthi kuMasipala waseThekwini ingu-250 imizi ekhahlamezekile okuhlala kuyo abangaphezu kuka-1000."KwaDukuzaa ingu-70 imizi ethintekile, okuhlala kuyo abantu ababalelwa ku-300. ENdwedwe nakhona kukhahlamezeke amakhaya angu-70,” kusho uMngadi.Uveze ukuthi eThekwini avalwe wonke amabhishi aseningizimu, ngaphandle kwelaseMgababa.Khonamanjalo: Isolezwe lithole ukuthi kukhona ababili abashone ngoMgqibelo eZwelisha, eVerulam, bembozwa udonga obelubiyele umuzi wakwamakhelwane.Kulesi sigameko kushone uNksz Ncamisile Zungu (52) noSelu Zungu (3).Indodana kaNksz Zungu, uMnuz Bonga Zungu, uthe aluqali ukudilika udonga olubulale unina nendodana kamfowabo."Ngezikhukhula zika-2022, lwadilika uhhafu, sasho kumakhelwane wethu ukuthi luyingozi luzobulala abantu ngelinye ilanga,” kusho uZungu.Uthi akubanga khona mnyakazo ngasohlangothini lukamakhelwane ukukhombisa ukuthi uyakuzwa abakushoyo."Njengoba selugcine lubabulele ngempela ke umama nendodana kamfowethu. Nokho akukho ke esingakusho ngoba umonakalo usuvele wenzekile,” kusho uZungu.INDAWO yesigameko lapho uNksz Ncamisile Zungu noMelu Zungu bembozwe khona wudonga olubiyele umakhelwane Isithombe: RUSAUthe ubengekho ekhaya yena ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko, uthole ucingo olumbizela ekhaya ekuseni izolo.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Nkosiyezwe Mhlongo elithe libizelwe endaweni yesigameko emva kokuthi lo wesifazane nomzukulu bebengabonakali ekubeni kukhona udonga oluwele endlini yabo kathayela."Kususwe ama-blocks aloludonga, kwaqale kwabonakala isandla sengane, kuthe uma kuqhutshekwa nokususwa kwama-blocks, batholakala bobabili, sebeshonile,” kusho uMhlongo.Uthe yize besaqoqa ulwazi ngomonakalo kodwa kukhona inqwaba yezindlu ezidilikile, kwalimala ingqalasizinda kagesi namanzi, kwabuye kwakhahlamezeka nemigwaqo.Kusenjalo, zitholakale eceleni komgwaqo uN11 eMnambithi izidumbu zamalungu amathathu omndeni wakwaHlongwane eBergville, owaduka ngoNcibijane.Abafi, uMnuz Mandlendoda David Hlongwane (43) owakwakhe uNksz Andiswa Zikode nengane yabo uMalusi, kuthiwa bagcinwa bebuyela eVryheid, lapho okusebenza khona uHlongwane.Ngokuqhubeka kwezinsuku, umndeni wathola ukuthi abazange bafike eVryheid njengoba bathola ucingo kwabasebenza noHlongwane bembuza ukuthi ukuphi ngoba akafikanga emsebenzini.Umfowabo kaHlongwane, uMnuz Celani Mahlobo, eqinisekisa izindaba zokushona kwabo uthe babizelwe lapho kutholwe khona imoto."Sithe uma sifika, impela sayibona imoto ukuthi eyakhe ubafo. Sibe sesidluliselwa emakhazeni kahulumeni lapho obese kuyiswe khona izidumbu zabo, nebala safike sakuqinisekisa ukuthi yibo, izidumbu zabo sezithanda ukonakala ngenxa yokuhlala emanzini isikhathi eside,” kusho uMahlobo.Uthe batshelwe ukuthi izidumbu zikhishwe khona emotweni. Wathi kuthiwa imoto ibonwe abasebenza eduze nalapho itholakale khona, kulandela ukuncipha kwamanzi kule ndawo enomfula.UMahlobo uthe basola khona ukuthi bavinjezelwa yimvula besemgwaqweni, imoto yabo yamuka namanzi.Uthe nakuba kubuhlungu okubehlele kodwa sebebonga khona ukuthi batholakale."Sizokwazi ukufihla ithambo labo ngendlela enesizotha,” usho kanje.Imindeni yomibili ithe izoludinga usizo lokubafihla abafi kwazise kubukeka kuwumsebenzi omkhulu ukungcwaba abathu abaningi kanye kanye.UMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, ukuqinisekisile ukutholakala kwabathathu eMnambithi. UNgqongqoshe womnyango, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, udlulise amazwi enduduzo emindenini eshonelwe nabalahlekelwe ngenxa yesimo sezulu. Uthe amathimba abo amatasa nokuhlola umonakalo futhi bahlangana neminye iminyango ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nalesi simo. Uthe bazoqhubeka nokusiqapha isimo njengoba kusalindeleke imvula.
Umelaphi wendabuko odume ngokungena ezizibeni ezesabekayo, ukhuza umkhuba wabamlingisayo ababeka impilo yabo engozini, okuthiwa sekuholele ekuphumeni kwezidumbu kukhona abaminzayo.UMnuz Sethembele Ndlovu (24) odume ngeleNdlondloyamanzi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ongowokudabuka eHluhluwe kodwa ohlala oThongathi, engxoxweni yakhe neSolezwe, uthe isenzo sabantu abazenza yena ekubeni bengaluqondi ubizo lwakhe sibi kakhulu, ngoba kugcina sekuphuma izidumbu.Ukusho lokhu kulandela ukusabalala kwezithombe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abantu beshutha besemanzini emifuleni benza Indlondlo yamanzi challenge okunemibiko engaqinisekiswanga amaphoyisa eveza ukuthi sekunabathathu asebedlule emhlabeni ngenxa yalesi senzo.Esigamekweni sakamuva okukholakala ukuthi senzeke eSouth Beach eThekwini ngoLwesihlanu, owesilisa osemncane kuzwakala kwi-video omunye wabangani bakhe embiza ngendlondlo yamanzi, ngaphambi kokuthi agxumele olwandlwe esuka ebhulohweni elakhelwe ukuma kulo abasuke bezipholele ebhishi.Othatha i-video okukholakala ukuthi ngomunye wabebehamba naye, uzwakala encoma isibindi sakhe, emgqugquzela ethi akaphume kodwa amagagasi agcina ngokumshovela maphakathi nolwandleUMNUZ Sethembele "Indlondloyamanzi” NdlovuUNdlovu uthe lokhu kuwumkhuba okumele abantu beziqhelise nawo, ongaba nesiphetho esibi kwazise abangena emanzini ngale ndlela ngenhloso yokulingisa yena, basuke bengazazi ukuthi bahlanzeke kangakanani ukwenza njalo."Engihlale ngikusho, ukuthi abantu abangawasabi amanzi kodwa bawahloniphe. Ukungena emanzini kungekho into ekuyalele ukuthi wenze njalo, kodwa ngoba ulingisa omunye kuyingozi. Kimina kuwubizo engalunikwa amakhehla akithi ukusiza abantu ngale ndlela. Ukungena emanzini nasezizibeni okuthiwa akungenwa kuzo angikuqali manje, yinto endala kangangoba i-video engiyifake okokuqala enkundleni yokuxhumana i-Tik Tok ngingena edamini iJozini, bese kungokwesithathu ngingena kulo ngokuthunywa nangenhloso yokubamba umhlangano nabanikazi besiziba leso, ngoba angivele ngivuke nginqume ukuzingenela esizibeni nje ngenhloso yokuyoshutha nginameke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kodwa kuwubizo kimina,” usho kanje.Uthe ngokuthatha ama-video nezithombe usuke ehlose ukubhala umlando njengenkosi yamanzi, ukuze ubonwe yizizukulwane. Uveze ukuthi ukwelapha ngamanzi ukuqale ngo-2022, emva kokuthi ethole lolu bizo esanda kuphothula iziqu zakhe ze-Business Management azenze eThekwini College.Uveze ukuthi akukho lapho ethatha khona isinqumo sokuthi yisiphi isiziba noma impophoma azongena kuyo njengoba eyalelwa abadala kangangoba kwesinye isikhathi usuke engabazi ubungozi nomlando waleso siziba kwazise usuke "eyohlangana nabanikazi baso ngaphansi kwamanzi’’.Uthe baningi abelaphi bendabuko abamgxekayo ngoba bethi akazange ayothwasa, wathi njengenkosi yamanzi akudingeki athwase kodwa uhamba nabathwasisayo. Uqinisekise ukuthi welapha ngamanzi kuphela futhi bayinqwaba abantu ababuyayo bezobonga.
KULINDELE ukuthi avele enkantolo maduze umsolwa wesilisa wasePolokwane ngecala lokubulala ngempelasonto. Kubikwa ukuthi lo msolwa (33) ubesebenza esitolo esiseRefiloe Station eMamaila ngoMgqibelo.Umsolwa kuthiwa ugence umufi (25) ngesikhali esicijile. Okhulumela amaphoyisa uColonel Malesela Ledwala, uveza ukuthi amaphoyisa athole umbiko ngowesilisa otholwe elimele kanzima."Amaphoyisa aphuthume endaweni yesigameko, afica umgilwa elimele kakhulu engasakwazi nokukhuluma. Kubizwe i-ambulensi ngokushesha endaweni yesigameko, waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela iNkhesani ukuze athole usizo ngokushesha. Umgilwa ugcine eshona ekhona esibhedlela ngenxa yokulimala," kusho uCol Ledwaba.Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ephenya athole ukuthi umufi ubevame ukufika esitolo njalo athathe izinto ezidayisayo ngaphandle kokukhokha, bese esabisa nomsolwa. Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje ubezokwenza okufanayo, athathe izimpahla angakhokhi. Yilapho okubikwa ukuthi umsolwa ubesemgenca ngesikhali esicijile. Kuthiwa umsolwa ubevala esitolo maqede wadla phansi, okuholele ekutheni amaphoyisa amthungathe. UCol Ledwaba uthe umsolwa ubanjwe eBolobedu ngaphansi koMkhandlu waseMopani ngeSonto."Umsolwa uzovela maduze eNkantolo yeMantshi eBolobedu ngecala lokubulala. Amaphoyisa ayaqhubeka nokwenza uphenyo," kusho uCol Ledwaba.
UMasipala weTheku uthi ushaqekile ngokuvela kwe-video ekhombisa umsebenzi wawo elele eze elenga ngaphandle kwesihlalo somshayeli emotweni yomkhandlu, eduze kwakhe kunebhodlela likabhiya.UNkk Gugu Sisilana okhulumela uMasipala weTheku, uthe yize bengazidingidi emphakathini izindaba zabasebenzi bomkhandlu kodwa imenenja kamasipala, uDkt Musa Mbhele, isijube ukuba kube nophenyo oluyisipesheli ngalolu daba.Kule video eshuthwe yisakhamuzi saseThekwini, kuvela ukuthi bekuwo-2 ntambama ngoLwesihlanu, enxanxatheleni yezitolo iWatercrest eseHillcrest, ngesikhathi izakhamuzi ebezikhathazekile zibona imoto yomkhandlu ivulwe izicabha zathi uma ziyobheka zathola ukuthi kunomsebenzi olele, eceleni kwakhe kunebhodlela likabhiya.Obeshutha uzwakalise ukunengeka wacela ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo ngobudedengu balo msebenzi.UMasipala weTheku uthi uyaluphenya udaba lomsebenzi okusolakala ukuthi ubedakiwe ehamba ngemoto yomkhandlu 🎥Izinkundla zokuxhumana pic.twitter.com/F2lqmZ90Zx— Isolezwe News (@IsolezweNews) January 14, 2024 Ukhale ngokuthi kuyacaca ukuthi ubeshayela edakiwe njengoba eze wakwazi ukupaka enxanxatheleni yezitolo.Le moto ibipakwe yatsheka, ingemuva layo lancika kakhulu kukhonkolo ongasekugcineni yendawo yokupaka. Ukhiye wemoto ubufakwe kwi-ignition. UMbhele uthe iTheku likuhambisa phambili ukuthunyelwa kwezidingo kubantu ngakho alihambisani nokuthi kuxhashazwe izinsiza kusebenza zomkhandlu."Njengamanje le moto ebonakala kwi-video ipakiwe ophikweni lwethu lwamapaki kodwa selukhona uphenyo esilwenzayo. Esingakusho wukuthi izindaba zabasebenzi nophenyo olusuke lwenziwa azidingidwa nezinye izinhlaka njengoba umasipala usuke ulandela umthetho,” kusho uMbhele esitatimendeni sabezindaba.
UMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uthi usukulungele ukuvulwa kwezikole esifundazweni, ezizovulwa ngokusemthethweni ngoLwesithathu.Esitatimendeni esithunyelelwe abezindaba, umnyango uthe phakathi kokunye osuvivele ngakho ukuqala unyaka wokufunda,ukugcwaliswa kwezikhala ezivuleke ezikoleni ezehlukene ngenxa yokushiya kothisha okubangelwe izizathu ezehlukene okubalwa kuzo ukuthatha umhlalaphansi, ukugula, ukushona nabakhushulelwe kwezinye izikhundla nezinye izizathu."Zevile ku-3 000 izikhala ezikhangiswe ngoSepthemba, nyakenye. Ukugcwaliswa kwezikhala ezikoleni ngokwezincomo zezigungu ezilawula izikole, sekudluliselwe emahhovisi omnyango ezifundeni. Kuzothi labo abaphumelele baqale emsebenzini ngoLwesithathu,” kubhalwe kanje.Umnyango uqinisekise ukuthi uhlelo lokwamukelwa kwezicelo zabafundi ezikoleni olwenziwe ngonyaka odlule luhambe kahle, kangangoba bonke abafundi bakwazile ukuthola izikhala ngaphandle kwezinkingana ezimbalwa ezibikiwe lapha nalaphaya, umnyango ozisukumelayoUveze ukuthi imali yokuthenga izinsizakufunda nokwenza eminye imisebenzi ezikoleni, izokhokhwa kothishomkhulu kusasa, ukuze bakwazi ukukhokhela abasebenzisana nezikole. Kuthiwa zingu-59 izikole ezikhahlanyezwe yizikhukhula ezifundeni eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanti umnyango uthe zikhona izaba ezenziwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda akuphazamiseki. Ugcizelele ukuthi uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni lumi ngomumo, njengoba zizothi zisuka nje ngoLwesithathu, kuzobe kukhona kuzona zonke izikole ezingaphansi kwalolu hlelo esifundazweni.Khonamanjalo: Lo mnyango uxwayisa othishomkhulu ezikoleni zikahulumeni, abanqaba ukwamukela abafundi ngoba kuthiwa abayikhokhile imali yesikole nasebefeyile ekilasini elilodwa kwaze kweva ezikhathini ezimbili, ngokuthi akukho emthethweni ukwenze njalo.Lokhu kuza emva kwezikhalo zabazali ngesinye sezikole esifundazweni okuthiwa uthishomkhulu unqabele abafundi asebezophinda ikilasi okwesithathu kuya phezulu ukuthi abasamukelekile esikoleni, sekumele bafune izikhala kwezinye izikole."Ukuphoqa abazali ukuthi bakhokhe imali ethile ezikoleni zikahulumeni okungakhokhwa kuzona nokubasabisa ngokuthi ngeke izingane zabo zithathwe, akuvumelekile. Umfundi ongaphumelelanga kungaba kanye, kabili noma ngaphezulu kwalokho bese etshelwa ukuthi angabuyi eskoleni, lokho kuphambene nomthetho,” kubhalwe esitatimendeni.Kuvezwe ukuthi uma umfundi obekade enza elinye ibanga okungesiwo u-matric esikoleni abefunda kuso nyakenye, unelungelo lokubuyela esikoleni futhi aphinde lelo kilasi uma nje esenothando lokuqhubeka nokufunda. Kuthiwa uma kwenzeka kutholakala ukuthi umfundi unenselelo ethile okukholakala ukuthi iyimbangela yokungaphumeleli kwakhe, kunohlaka olukhona ngaphansi komnyango okumele laziswe ukuze lulekelele uma kudingeka.Uthe ukubanjwa kwemiphumela ngoba kuthiwa umfundi akayikhokhile imali yesikole, nakho akuvumelekile.
Iqembu lezepolitiki elisanda kusungulwa i-Gap Fixers of South Africa, lithi kusekukhulu ukuphathwa ngendlela engalingani kwabamhlophe nabansundu, elithi kwenziwa uhulumeni wakuleli.Lokhu kuvezwe wuSihlalo waleli qembu ongomunye wabasunguli balo, uMnuz S’bu Mpisane, ngesikhathi libambe isithangami nabezindaba ehhotela i-Hilton Garden Inn, eMhlanga, ngoMgqibelo.Nakuba uMpisane evumile ukuthi kukhulu uhulumeni wakuleli asekwenzele umphakathi selokhu izwe langena ekubusweni ngentando yeningi, kodwa zikhona izikhala ezingakagcwaliswa."Ziningi izinto ezisasilele emuva. Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka i- Codesa (Convention for a Democratic South Africa), abaholi bethu bavumela umthetho owagcizelela ukukhohlwa okwenzeka, kuqalwe ikhasi elisha obizwa nge- Sunset Clause, okuyinto eyashiya inqwaba yabantu abansundu besabhekene nokuhlupheka. Uhulumeni wethu usabambelele emandleni ezombusazwe ngesikhathi iningi labamhlophe libambelele emnothweni kuze kube yimanje,” kusho uMpisane.Ubehambisana nobuholi baleli qembu obekhona kubo uMengameli walo, uMnuz Themba Buthelezi.UButhelezi ugcizelele ukuthi balinganiselwa ku-52 million abantu abansundu kuleli kodwa umnotho usasezandleni zabamhlophe isibalo sabo esingu-4 million kuleli."Sifana nomhlambi wezinkomo oweluswa umalusi oyedwa. Uma ukhuluma ngalo mthetho odlulisa okwenziwa abelungu ngesikhathi sobandlululo, abaholi bethu abafuni nokuyizwa. Bakubuza ukuthi kungani ubuza ngawo, ekubeni uvuna abamhlophe,” usho kanje.Leli qembu elisungulwe nyakenye, lithi phakathi kokunye okuwumgomo walo, ukuthi imfundo kumele ibemahhala kusuka ingane iqala ukungena esikoleni kuze kube semazingeni aphakeme ezemfundo. Likholelwa ekutheni isikhathi esiningi, uma izingane zabantu abansundu ziqeda imfundo yamazinga aphakeme, zifunwa amava kulowo mkhakha ekubeni ezabelungu ziphathwa ngendlela ehlukile. Leli qembu lizimisele ukuvala lezo zikhala njengoba lingelinye lamaqembu angenele ukhetho lwalo nyaka.
ULAXAZE isicelo sebheyili ngesikhathi evele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseThekwini namuhla, ngoMsombukuko, owesilisa osolwa ngokugwaza abulale owesifazane owayeyintombi yakhe ngenyanga eyedlule.Isigameko esathatha impilo kaNksz Zama 'Girlie’ Mthembu waseDondotha eMpangeni senzeka ngoDisemba 16, 2023 emijondolo yaseKenville eThekwini.Ummangalelwa, uMnuz Mlamli Michael Qaba ongowokudabuka eNtabankulu e-Eastern Cape kodwa obehlala khona eKenville, kuthiwa wagwaza umufi amanxeba angu-25 emfica endlini kamngani wakhe.Ngesikhathi evela namuhla enkantolo, iMantshi uSicelo Zuma ithe izolihlehlisela uLwesihlanu icala ngoba yize eselethiwe phambi kwenkantolo uQaba, idokodo lona alikafiki.Abameli bakhe batshele inkantolo ukuthi ummangalelwa uthe ngeke ayicele ibheyili okwamanje.Umsolwa (44) wakhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela emva kokubhadanywa ngamaphoyisa esenyangeni yaseNtabankulu e-Eastern Cape ngoJanuwari 5.Ngesikhathi eboshwa kuthiwa waficwa eqimbile nommese, okusolwa ukuthi wabulala ngawo umufi.Emva kokwenzeka kwesigameko kwavela ukuthi umufi ubesemalile ummangalelwa kodwa wangakwamukela ukwaliwa njengoba aphetha ngokuthi amgwaze ambulale.Ngosuku ambulala ngalo kuthiwa kwakukhona ingane (6) kamngani kamufi endlini, okuthiwa wamgwaza phambi kwayo.
Kuyacaca ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bazoba ngamabekankosi emva kokhetho lukazwelonke olubhekwe ngabomvu, olukhonjwa maphakathi nonyaka. Amaqembu ezepolitiki aqavile asevele ememezelile ukuthi azokwethula imiqulu yezethembiso zawo zokhetho kulesi sifundazwe.Umqulu wokhetho usuke uqukethe izethembiso futhi ufana nezagila iqembu elizingela ngazo ekuhlwayeni amavoti. Iqembu neqembu lisuke lizama bonke ubuciko ukuze umyalezo walo uhehe.Sekuvele kuqaliwe kushanelwa amabala, wena owabona kuzongena umlobokazi, kulungiselwa ukhetho lukazwelonke olubhekwe ngabomvu. Amaqembu aseqalile azishelela abavoti, ayanyundelana kunjeyaya, ukuze azakhele ugazi.Kubukeka sengathi inyanga uFebhuwari izoba nesiphithiphithi esihlobene nepolitiki ngoba nabe-IEC bazophinde bavule ithuba lokubhalisela ukuvota ngayo le nyanga.Inhlangano ebusayo i-ANC imemezele ukuthi izobe ikanise KwaZulu-Natal lapho ezokwethula khona umyalezo wezethembiso zokhetho. I-ANC ithi usuku olukhulu kuyoba wuFebhuwari 24 enkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini.I-ANC ibukeka izothwala kanzima kulolu khetho, kangangokuthi baningi abakholwa wukuthi isengozini yokuphuma emandleni. Okunye osekuyicindezela kakhulu wukuhlamukwa owayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma, osehamba neqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe.I-ANC, nakuba yabuyela emandleni ngo-2019, kodwa kwagqama ukwehla kokwesekwa kwayo. Ngo-2021 ilahlekelwe omasipala abaningi okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.UMENGAMELI we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa kulindeleke ukuthi ahole umkhankaso weqembu lakhe enkundlei iMoses Mabhida ngoMashi Isithombe: KHAYA NGWENYA/INDEPENDENT MEDIA Ngaphandle kwe-ANC ezozama amavoti eThekwini, kukhona i-EFF nayo esivele izinzile esifundazweni. I-EFF izokwethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho ngoFebhuwari 10 khona enkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida.Umholi we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi bafuna ukuthola inkindlane yamavoti bangene kuhulumeni wesifundazwe. Uthe uyethemba ukuthi kuzokwenzeka lokho ngoba basebenza kanzima usuku nosuku.Kuthe kusabhekwe i-ANC ne-EFF abayizimbangi ezinkulu, kwavela ukuthi i-IFP nayo ibheke khona eMoses Mabhida iyokwethula wona umyalezo wayo wezethembiso zokhetho.I-IFP izokwethula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho ngoMashi 10 kuyo le nkundla yodumo lweNdebe yoMhlaba ka-2010.I-IFP iyiqembu eliphambili kwaphikisayo KwaZulu-Natal futhi inenqwaba yomasipala ebaphethe. Okhethweni olwedlule ibonakale yenyukelwa wukwesekwa okhethweni. NJENGOBA kuqala unyaka, ngifuna sike silikhulume nje iqiniso noma libaba kanjani. Kuyiqiniso elingephikwe ukuthi anisafuni nhlobo ukusebenzisa ijazi lomkhwenyana. Ngisho kuwo wonke umuntu, angikhethi bulili. Indoda ithi iqala ukuhlangana nentombi, ingabuzi lutho, ikhale khona. Kube yinyama enyameni. Naleyo ntombi ayibuzi lutho, zilima ziya etsheni. Ngifuna ukuphinde nginikhumbuze bakwethu ukuthi izifo zocansi ezithelelanayo zisekhona.Kodwa kuleli sonto ngifuna sigxile kuleli qiniso: ukuzitika ngocansi olungaphephile nabantu abahlukene kuwubunuku! Angiphinde futhi ngisho kanje, ukuzitika ngocansi nomuntu owazi kahle ukuthi ulala nabanye abantu abehlukene, kuwukungazithandi wena uqobo. Ubunuku obuphindiwe!Akugcini-ke lapho, niyazi yini ukuthi kwasitho sakho sangasese sigcina siyinto enyanyekayo nje. Noma ngabe awungenwanga-ke yizifo ezithelelana ngocansi kodwa uma ungowesifazane, isitho sakho sangasese sigcina sinuka kabi nje. Phela imbewu noma uketshezi olushintshana lungena luphuma kusona lushiya izinto eziningi ezahlukene nalo oluzicoshe ezindaweni eziningi. Izifo zocansi zigcina zilimaza izitho zethu zangasese futhi zigcine zidala nephunga elingelihle. Ezinye zazo singakwazi ukuzigwema ngokuthi sizinakekele, siphinde sizivikele uma senza ucansi. Ziningi-ke izifo zocansi ezikhona nezilimaza izitho zangasese. Ezinye zigcina zingalaphekanga kanti ezinye uthole ukuthi ziyalapheka kodwa isitho sisala nephunga elibi elingapheli. Owesifazane uyalunywa ngaphansi kwesinye isikhathi kuze kube noketshenzi olunganuki kahle, olunuka samvubelo.Izintwala: Zona ke ziyahluka, kukhona ezesichitho bese kuba khona ozithola kumuntu owenze naye ucansi uma naye ebenazo.Zonke lezi zifo ziyinkinga futhi zingalimaza isitho sakho sangasese, yingakho kufanele sizivikele uma senza ucansi siphinde sinakekele izitho zethu zangasese. UMnyango wezeMpilo uyazama ukukhuthaza abantu emphakathini ukuthi bazibandakanye nocansi oluphephile. Siyawabona namabhodi lapho ugqugquzela khona ukusetshenziswa kwejazi lomkhwenyana. Zikhona nezinye izinto ezisiza ukuthi isitho sakho sangasese sihlale sihlanzekile futhi ikakhulukazi thina bantu besifazane. Yebo, namankwahla ayanuka futhi nowesilisa uyazithola izifo kodwa okwethu bantu besifazane kuthanda ukuba bucayi kakhulu ngoba inanazi iyindawo ebucayi. Kumele sizijwayeze nokudla izinto ezinempilo kanjalo nezinto esigeza ngayo inanazi yethu ukuthi ihlale ihlanzekile inganuki iphunga elixakile.Singavumi ukuba nezifo ebesingakwazi ukuzigwema, sizijwayeze nokushefa iziboya kanjalo nokuvakashela udokotela wabesifazane okungenani kanye ngonyaka ngisho ngabe akukho lapho kubuhlungu khona enkomeni. Uthi kudokotela ake akuxilonge nje ukuthi ngabe konke kusahamba kahle yini. Ukuhlala uhlola inanazi yakho ukuthi isawumqemane yini kungadala ukuthi izifo eziningi zingakuhlaseli unganakile. Phezu kwakho konke, ngiyalishumayela leli vangeli futhi kulo nyaka nginalo shaqa. Asiyekeni ukuhambe sizitika ngocansi nabantu esingabazi. Asiyekeni ukuzitika ngocansi nenqwaba yabantu. Noma ngabe uyindoda, akukho okukugunyaza ukuthi uhambe ulala, ikakhulukazi unaye nomuntu oqondile. Asiwuyeke umkhuba wokulalwa nokufuna ucansi ematshwaleni. Elawini LikaMaGumede sigqugquzela ukuziphatha ngendlela ehloniphekile nokuzithanda. Sigquqguzela ukuhlanzeka nokunakekelwa kwezitho zethu zangasese njengoba kuqala unyaka. Kulo nyaka nje asiyeke ukuhambe sibhabhalala!

Sekuphele izinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili kwaqalwa uphenyo ngodaba oluthinta ukuphakelwa kwezikole kodwa umbiko ngalo awukethulwa. Njengoba izikole zivulwa ngesonto elizayo, i-IFP izokubhekisisa ukuthi udaba lokuhanjiswa kwezincwadi ezikoleni nokuhlinzekwa ngokudla, kwenzeka ngendlela efanele,” kusho uNtuli.Esithangamini sikaNdunankulu uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube nabezindaba ngoDisemba nyakenye wathi kusuka ngoMsombuluko izikhala zothisha ezivuleke ezikoleni eziningi zizobe sezivaliwe.
Umengameli wezwe, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe bamunyunga ukushaya umthetho ozophoqa izinkampani ukuba ziqashe intsha ebhuquza neziqu.URamaphosa uthe bafuna kuphele ukubhuquza kwentsha efundile.Lokhu ukusho ngesikhathi ekhuluma nentsha ehlomule ngenxa yemithetho eshaywe wuhulumeni ophethwe i-ANC, ngoLwesine.Kulo mcimbi obuseMpumalanga, uRamaphosa uhlangane nentsha egogode ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme emva kokuthola imifundaze eminyangweni kahulumeni wakuleli.Abanye balaba abahlangane noRamaphosa bafunde emazweni aphesheya.URamaphosa uzwe ukuthi iningi labo libhuquza emakhaya yize liphethe iziqu emikhakheni okuthiwa kuyashoda kuyo, efana nobudokotela nobunjiniyela.URamaphosa uthe uhulumeni uzoqhamuka nezinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthi intsha eneziqu ingabe isabhuquza."Kubuhlungu futhi kuyasikhathaza ukuthi inqwaba yenu ayisebenzi yize seniphothule izifundo zenu. Lena inselelo enkulu kuthina njengohulumeni. Sizoyixazulula le nkinga ngokuthi siqhamuke nohlelo lokuthi kungabi khona intsha ebhuquza neziqu.”URamaphosa uthe impumelelo yalolu hlelo izoncika ekutheni ikhona yini imali."Okunye okuzolekelela ukuba sibambisane nezinkampani ezizimele. Izinkampani ezizimele izona eziqashe abantu abaningi. Kufanele sibambisane nazo ukuze sishaye imithetho ezophoqa ukuthi ziqashe intsha eneziqu. Asifuni ukuthi intsha ihlale emakhaya neziqu. Lapha sinodokotela abaneziqu kodwa abasebenzi. Sinonjiniyela abangasebenzi. Lena inselelo enkulu. Sifuna ukuyilungisa ngokushesha.”URamaphosa uthe angeke bayishiye ngaphandle nentsha engenazo iziqu."Sifuna ukubhekana nodaba lokungasebenzi kwentsha. Zikhona izinhlelo esesiziqalile, lapho sikhuthaza khona izinkampani ukuba ziqashe intsha. Lezi zinhlelo seziqalile ukuthela izithelo ezinhle.”UMengameli we-ANCYL, uMnuz Collen Malatji, uthe intsha ebhuquza emakhaya ingaba isisombululo ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezwe."Kuyasikhathaza ukuzwa ukuthi kunonjiniyela abangasebenzi kodwa kunezinkinga eziningi e-Eskom. Satshelwa ukuthi i-Eskom kunonjiniyela abaningi abashiyayo. Ngapha kunenqwaba yonjiniyela abangasebenzi. Thina singakunika onjiniyela abangasombulula izinkinga ezibhekene ne-Eskom. "Angeke sitshelwe ukuthi kushoda odokotela ezibhedlela nasemitholampilo ekubeni kunenqwaba yentsha ebhuquza neziqu. Mengameli, intsha ilangazelele imisebenzi. Sicela uxoshe bonke abantu abahonqayo emisebenzini, bese uqasha intsha.”I-ANC iyaqhubeka nokuhlangana nezinhlaka ezahlukene njengoba ilungiselela umcimbi wokugubha iminyaka engu-112 kwasungulwa le nhlangano ozokuba ngoMgqibelo.Ngaphambi kokuhlangana netsha, uRamaphosa uhlangane nosomabhizinisi.Uphethe usuku lwakhe ngokwethula inkulumo esifundweni ngempilo yomholi we-ANCYL ongasekho, uMnuz Peter Mokaba.
Kufe abathathu, kwalimala abayisikhombisa ngoLwesine ngesikhathi abantu abangaziwa bevulela ngenhlamvu erenki yamatekisi engaphandle kwenxanxathela yezitolo iMidway Crossing eNewslands West.Kwabaphangalele kukhona owesilisa obeyimenenja yamatekisi aseNewlands njengoba kule renki kulayisha amatekisi aya ezindaweni ezehlukene ezisondelene nale nxaxathela yezitolo okubalwa, iLindelani, Newlands naKwaMashu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe sekujutshwe amaphoyisa ukuthi athungathe abasolwa abadubule abathathu bashona, baphinde balimaza abayisikhombisa ababadubule bedlula ngemoto eNewlands ngoLwesine emini."Esisakutholile okwamanje ukuthi abagilwa bebehleli ngasohlangothini lomgwaqo uNtuzuma Express, ngaphesheya kwenxanxathela yezitolo. Kuthiwa kuqhamuke iVW Polo e-silver, ebebephakathi bavulela ngenhlamvu bebhekise kubagilwa, babulala abathathu khona endaweni yesigameko,” kwenaba uNetshiunda.Uqhube wathi abayisikhombisa abalimele, baphuthunyiswe emtholampilo wendawo ukuze banikezwe usizo lwezempilo olusheshayo.Uthe imbangela yokudubula ibingakaziwa okwamanje, kodwa kunezinsolo zokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ihlobene nodlame lwamatekisi.Imenenja yenxanxathela yezitolo iMidway Crossing, uNksz Onesisa Phephetha, ithe isigameko senzeke emgwaqweni oseduze nenxanxathela, ayenzekanga ngaphakathi ngakho akakwazi ukuphawula.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, ngoLwesibili kudutshulwe omunye usomatekisi kwa-J KwaMashu. Naye uhlaselwe abantu abangaziwa, abagasele esitolo sakhe esikule ndawo. Ubulawe nabanye ababili, bona ebebezozithengela okuthile esitolo. Oyedwa wabo ufele endaweni yesigameko, omunye washonela emtholampilo iPolyNgaphambi kwalokho Isolezwe like labika nangomunye usomatekisi odutshulwe wabulawa eMnambithi ngoLwesine olwedlule.
Ushenxile esikhundleni usihlalo webhodi lesikhwama esixhasa abafundi, i-NSFAS, uMnuz Ernest Khosa, osolwa noNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uSolwazi Blade Nzimande, ngenkohlakalo.UKhoza uzoshenxa esikhundleni kuze kuphothulwe uphenyo ngezinsolo ezenziwe yinhlangano elwa nenkohlakalo, i-Organisation Undoing Taxi Abuse (Outa), zokuthi yena noNzimande bagwazelwa yizinhlangano ezahlomula ngamathenda kwi-NSFAS.UKhosa wazise ibhodi le-NSFAS ngokushenxa kwakhe esikhundleni emhlanganweni obungoLwesithathu.Ibhodi le-NSFAS lithe likwamukele ukushenxa kukaKhosa.Esitatimendeni, ibhodi le-NSFAS lithe uKhosa usaba ukwenzakaliswa, laveza ukuthi yena nomndeni wakhe basatshisiwe emva kokuvela kwezinsolo."Sisamukele isinqumo sokushenxa kwakhe, sabe sesazisa uNzimande ngokushesha. Sekusele kuNzimande ukuba aqoke ozobamba isikhundla.”Ibhodi le-NSFAS lithe akushenxa kukaKhosa akusho ukuthi unecala."UKhosa ushenxe esikhundleni ukuze kungaphazamiseki uphenyo. Lesi yisinqumo azithathele yena, okukhombisa ubuqotho. Siyambonga ngokuthi abe nesibindi sokuthatha lesi sinqumo. Usichazelile ukuthi akakaze agwazelwe yizinkampani ezihlomula kwi-NSFAS.”Ibhodi le-NSFAS lithe lizoqoka inkampani ezimele ukuba iphenye izinsolo ezibekwa wuKhosa."Inkampani ezoqokwa izothula umbiko wayo emva kwezinsuku ezingu-30 iqokiwe. Sizolimemezela maduze igama lenkampani ezoqokwa. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa abantu bakuleli ukuthi lolu daba sizoluphatha ngobunono.”I-Outa ithe iyakwemukela ukushenxa kukaKhosa.Isikhulu esiphezulu se-Outa, uMnuz Wayne Duvenage, sithe ukusula kukaKhosa kukhombisa ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi kwi-NSFAS."Ukube uKhosa umsulwa, ubengeke ashenxe esikhundleni. Ukube ngiwuyena, bengizobatshela ukuthi ngeke ngishenxe esikhundleni ngoba ayikho into engiyenzile. Ngicabanga ukuthi ibhantshi lizogcwala umoya maduze kuKhosa.”UDuvenage uthe basamile ekutheni bafuna ukuthi uNzimande ashenxe esikhundleni."Miningi imibuzo uNzimande okufanele ayiphendule. Ingakho sifuna ukuthi ashenxe esikhundleni kuze kube kuphothulwa uphenyo.”UNzimande uvele usevulelwe amacala emaphoyiseni, kwaphinde kwacelwa izinhlaka ezifana neSpecial Investigating Unit, nehhovisi loMvikeli woMphakathi ukuba ziphenye izinsolo abhekene nazo.UDuvenage uthe banabo bonke ubufakazi obungalekelela emacaleni abhekene noNzimande."Sinethemba lokuthi izinhlaka zezomthetho zizothatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Siyethemba ukuthi umengameli nehhovisi lomphakathi bazolusukumela lolu daba.”Amaqembu ezepolitiki, i-DA, EFF ne-ActionSA, akushayele ihlombe ukushenxa kukaKhosa, kepha athi afuna ukuthi uNzimande naye ashenxe esikhundleni.
NKOSIKHONA CELEIBHODLA umlilo iNkosi yamaQadi, uMqoqi Ngcobo ngemayini yetshe eseMachobeni, eNanda, iQala Quary, ekhala ngokuthi ihlomulisa abathile ekubeni ngesikhathi iqala kwakuvunyelwene ngokuthi izohlomulisa umphakathi.NgoMsombuluko, uNgcobo ubize umhlangano ehholo lasemaChobeni obuhanjelwe ngamalungu omphakathi.Kule mayini kuthiwa kuqhekezwa itshe ebese kuphuma amatshe amancane okulungisa umgwaqo nokwakha ukhonkolo. Lawo matshe kuthiwa adayiselwa izitolo ezidayisa izinto zokwakha.Inkosi ayichithanga sikhathi, zithe zisuka yethula inkulumo yazisa amalungu omphakathi ngenhloso yomhlangano.Ilibeke ngembaba elokuthi umhlangano umayelana nabathile asebegweva nemayini futhi esihlomulisa bona bodwa."Angitholi ngisho isenti elimnyama leli kule nto. Kuthiwa ayikho imali eyenziwa khona. Esikhwameni kunoR1 000. Kodwa kunabantu abasebenza kuyona abahola imali enhle kabi,'' usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe angeke aze awudle loyo R1 000, naye akawufuni.Uveze ukuthi ukuze athole ukuthi kunamanyundululu nenkohlakalo eqhutshwa ngaphakathi emayinini esendaweni yakhe, kuze kwadingeka ukuthi aqashe inkampani ebicwaninga amabhuku i-Apex."Le nkampani itholile ukuthi iningi imali eyenziwayo negcina kungaqondakalanga ukuthi iphelelaphi,'' echaza.Igama likaMfu Bhekisisa Sibisi inkosi ibisabe ilimemeze njalo, ikhala ngaye ithi nguye oyihlinzele ezibini."USibisi usethathe yonke le nto wayenza kwaba ngeyakhe. Imali itholwa nguyena nemayini, sekuvela ukuthi ngeyakhe. Okusho ukuthi usengidlele into yesizwe sami,'' echaza.Uthe ngesikhathi ithulwa ngokusemthethweni kwakukhona owayeyimeya yeTheku, uMnuz Obed Mlaba.UMnuz B Myeza ongummeli wesizwe samaQadi, uveze ukuthi impilo yakhe seyisengcupheni ngenxa yalo mbango wemayini.Ukusho wangananaza ukuthi ibonakala inkulu inkinga ngalo mbango njengoba kubonakala ukuthi kunabahlomulayo esikhundleni sokuthi kuhlomule isizwe sonke.Uthe ngaphambi kokuba avume ukumela isizwe wathola ngenkosi ngomlando wale mayini."Kumele sonke njengesizwe siyilungise le nto. Kodwa inkinga ukuthi kukhona asebefuna ikhanda lami ngenxa yokuthi ngimele isizwe samaQadi,'' usho kanje.Uveze ukuthi batholile ukuthi kunezindodla zemali ezenziwa yile mayini.Amalungu omphakathi abehambele umhlangano abezwakala ethukethele kakhulu ngesikhathi esenikezwa ithuba lokuba abuze ngale nkiyankiya.USibisi ethintwa yiSolezwe, uthe uzwile ngomhlangano obizwe yinkosi. Wazihlangula kukhona konke obekushiwo ngaye.
Inhlangano ebhekelele amanzi adayiswa esemabhodleleni emhlabeni, i-International Bottled Water Association (IBWA), ithi phansi amaphaphu ngocwaningo oluveze ukuthi amanzi asemabhodleleni anezinhlayiya zeplastiki.Isitatimende esikhishwe ile nhlangano sithe okwamanje umphakathi awungaqali uthuke ngoba abebenza lolu cwaningo abashongo ukuthi lezi zinhlayiya zeplastiki ziyingozi kangakanani emzimbeni womuntu ophuze lawa manzi.Lesi sitatimende sithe le nhlangano ibihlaziya lolu cwaningo obelwenziwa ngososayensi beNational Academy of Sciences, okusikhungo sesayensi esihlanganise i-US University of Columbia neRutgers University olushicilelwe ngoMsombuluko.I-IBWA ithe ngokubona kwayo, zimbili izinto ezingahambanga kahle ngamanzi ahloliwe; okungukungalandelwa kwesilinganiso sezinga elifanele lokuphepha komkhiqizo nomthelela wezempilo, kodwa okwamanje umphakathi akumele wethuke ngoba ososayensi abashongo ukuthi kungenzekani kumuntu ophuze wona.Kulolu cwaningo, abacwanigi bathole ukuthi ibhodlela elinamanzi ayilitha anezingcezwana zeplastiki ezingabonakali ezilinganiselwa phakathi kuka-110 000 kuya ku-400 000 kuye ngokuthi lawo manzi akhiqizwe ngeyiphi inkampani.Obehola lolu cwaningo nombhali walo uDkt Phoebe Stapleton, ongungoti ocwaninga ngobuthi eRutgers University, uthe abakwaziyo okwamanje ukuthi lezi zinhlayiya zeplastiki ziyangena kuma-tissues cells omuntu noma isilwane esiphuze amanzi akula mabhodlela."Sisenza ucwaningo olubheka ukuthi uma lezi zinhlayiya sezingenile zenzani," kusho yena.Akukhona okokuqala lezi zikhungo zenza lolu cwaningo, phambilini zalwenza ucwaningo olwaveza ukuthi kunezinhlayiya zeplastiki emanzini asemabhodleleni kodwa ucwaningo lwangaveza ukuthi zingakanani ebhodleleni ngalinye.UDkt Naixin Qian weColumbia University, ongomunye wabacwaningi, uthe abakutholile ukuthi izinhlayiya zisuke zisebhodleleni uqobo nasesivalweni esisuke senzelwe ukuthi kungangeni ubuthi.Uthe amanzi ahloliwe akhiqizwa yizinkampani ezintathu zase-US angeke azidalule ngoba abacwaningi basafuna ukuthatha amanye amasampula.Ngo-2022, iNyuvesi iSefako Makgatho Health Sciences University esePitoli yenza ucwaningo olwaveza ukuthi amanye amanzi adayisa esemabhodleleni ezitolo ezinkulu zasePitoli anezinsalela zensimbi nezinga lePH elitholakala kuwo lingaphezulu kwalelo elivumelekile, i-IBWA eyathi awakulungele ukuphuzwa umphakathi ngoba angadala izinkinga zezinso, amaphaphu nesisu. Nyakenye, iSouth African National Bottled Water Association ixwayise umphakathi mayelana namanzi athengwa ezitolo abantu abafika nezigubhu bezozigcwalisa ngokuthi angangenwa ngubuthi ngoba izivalo zawo zisuke sezize zavulwa.

UZuma ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi usehamba noMkhonto weSizwe, uzovotela wona okhethweni.UNyhontso oyilungu lePhalamende, uxoxe neSolezwe ngoLwesithathu, ngesikhathi behambele entabeni iKhenana, eNdwedwe, lapho kubuthene khona ibandla lamaNazaretha ohlangothini lwaseBuhleni. Bathelwe amachaphazelo ento abangayazi ababili abadutshulwe bafa kanye nosomatekisi kwa-J KwaMashu ngoLwesibili.Kulesi sigameko kufe usomatekisi uMnuz Fakazi (54) igama lakhe elingatholakalanga, uMnuz Thokozani Nyawo (24) noNksz Nosipho Gumede (28).Isolezwe lithole ukuthi ngaphandle kokuba namatekisi ahambela eNdwedwe naseThekwini ngaphansi kukasoseshini waseKenville, uFakazi ubengumnikazi wesitolo adutshulelwe kuso.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lifika kule ndawo, isitolo besivaliwe. Eceleni bekubonakala izimbobo esakeni elimboze igumbi okuthiwa yilo obekuye kuhlalwe kulo nokuyilo abadutshulelwe kulo. Abantu endaweni bebesababaza isihluku nomsindo othusayo abawuzwile ngesikhathi kuhlaselwa. Esinye isaguga (74) esizwe ukuqhuma kwesibhamu sithe size saphendukelwa yisisu ngenxa yokwethuka.Ngokusho kukamfowabo kaNyawo, uMnuz Chris Nyawo, ngokwabo umfowabo ubesendaweni engafanele ngesikhathi esingafanele."Sizwa kuthiwa baqale badubula yena usomatekisi, babe sebedubula nabehleli nabo, obekukhona kubo nobafo. Umuntu obefuneka uyedwa, bona bafele ukuthi bebehleli naye,” kusho uNyawo.Uqhube wathi umfowabo ufele emtholampilo ePoly, kanti laba ababili bafele endaweni yesigameko.Ilungu lomndeni, uMnuz Christopher Nyawo, limi eduze kwesitolo okwenzeke kuso isigameko Isithombeni: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent MediaUveze ukuthi umfowabo ubedubuleke kwesingenhla.Uthe ngokujwayelekile kuye kuthi ngezikhathi zantambama abantu baye kulesi sitolo beyothenga okuya ngasethunjini njengoba kudayiswa ama-fried chips nokunye okuvuthiwe, kuphinde kudayise notshwala."Uma uthanda uyathenga udlele khona, kuhlalwe kuxoxwe. Ubafo ujwayele ukuthi aye nathi lapha ngoba yena kahle hle uqashe kwa-K kanti thina siqashe khona lana kwa-J,” kwenaba uNyawo.Uthe isigameko senzeke bona besemqashweni wabo, basizwa isibhamu sisho, futhi bezwa ukuthi siqhuma ngakuphi.Ukhale ngobuhlungu abakubo njengomndeni ngesehlo athe sibehle ngaphezulu.Umthombo othi uzibonele kwenzeka isigameko, wacela ukungadalulwa, uthe ubebudebuduze nesitolo ngesikhathi ebona owesilisa eza ngendlela engezansi kwesitolo."Uthe esuka wangena endleleni encane engemumva kwaso isitolo ehamba ngenhla kwensimu kaFakazi. Ufike wathi ukuma khona, maqede wabuyela emumva emotweni abehamba ngayo, wabuya esezoma maqondana nesitolo, waqala wadubula ephindelela. Uthe uma eqeda wazihambela kahle wayongena emotweni yakhe wahamba,” kusho umthombo.Umndeni kaFakazi wale waphetha ukukhuluma neSolezwe, walibuza ukuthi kuzobasiza ngani ukukhuluma ngoba ngeke esavuka.Nomndeni kaNksz Gumede nawo unqabile ukukhuluma, uthe kuningi osekubhalwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana okubadinile, abasafuni ukukhuluma.Kwenzeka lesi sigameko nje, kusanda kubulawa usomatekisi waseMnambithi ngoLwesine olwedlule.Okhulumela iSouth African National Taxi Association (SANTACO) uMnuz Sfiso Shangase, uthe bazwile kancane ngesigameko, wathi kuyakhathaza ukuthi yize ubuholi benhlangano buhlale bushumayela ivangeli lokuthi uma kukhona okonakele akungalungiswa ngesibhamu kodwa kuyaqhubeka.Uthe bayawukhuza lo moya, wathi bazwelana kakhulu nemindeni elahlekelwe ikakhulukazi eyabadutshulwe kanye nosomatekisi, wanxusa ukuthi ababone ukusuka nokuhlala kwesigameko bahambise ulwazi abanalo emaphoyiseni.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala kulandela lesi sigameko esenzeke emgwaqweni uMthombothi ngoLwesibili.Uveze ukuthi umuntu ongaziwa uqale wakhuluma nomnikazi wesitolo, ezenza umuntu ofuna ukuthenga ugwayi."Umnikazi wesitolo umtshele ukuthi akawudayisi ugwayi, lona wesilisa waphindela emotweni yakhe, kwabe sekuphuma amadoda amane ehlome ngezibhamu bamdubula umnikazi wesitolo,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe ufele endaweni yesigameko kanye nomunye wesifazane, kwathi owesilisa naye odubulekile waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela washonela khona"Akukho okuthathiwe kubona noma esitolo,” kusho uNetshiunda.
Luyaqonga udaba lwabahleli bemicimbi KwaZulu-Natal abasematheni kulezi zinsuku ngezinkulumo abazenze kwiFacebook, njengoba inhlangano yabesifazane kulesi sifundazwe, iKwa-Mthaniya Women’s Activist Movement, isibhalele ihhovisi likandunankulu.Umholi wale nhlangano, uZibu MaSotobe Sibiya, uthe kumanje kunohlu lwezikhalo lwabesifazane olusayinwe ngabesifazane abangu-3000 abafuna uNdunanku Nomusa Dube-Ncube angenele kulolu daba."Sekuyisikhathi eside isithunzi sabesifazane sidicilelwa phansi kusetshenziswa inkolo nesintu. Le nto kudala bayiqala uXolani Mcineka noKini Shandu njengoba banento abayibiza ngesihlahla somganu. Lapho babekhombisa ukubukela phansi abesifazane. Okubuhlungu kukhuluma abantu abanezingane ngaphandle komshado, maqede bayothatha amatshitshi esontweni. Uma sebekhuluma bathatha abesifazane abanezingane ngaphandle komshado njengezilwanyazana, njengoba bebabiza ngemidlambila. UZIBU MaSotobe Sibiya wenhlangano yabesifazane iKwa-Mthaniya Women’s Movement esibhalele ihhovisi likandunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal ikhala ngesenzo sabahleli bemicimbi bakulesi sifundazwe Isithombe: FACEBOOKOkubuhlungu wukuthi bobabili baphakanyiswe wuhulumeni ngokuxhasa imicimbi yabo. Kumele engabe bayisibonelo esihle kwabanye abesilisa. Bafaka umoya ongalungile ebafaneni abancane, abagcina sebevumelana nabakushoyo kwiFacebook, okuthunaza isithunzi sabesifazane,” kusho uMaSotobe Sibiya.Encwadini ebhalelwe undunankulu, Isolezwe elinayo ikhophi yayo, bakhala ngokuthi le nkulumo elumelayo kwabesifazane ikhulunywe ngabantu abathola uxhaso kuhulumeni ngemicimbi yabo abayenza minyaka yonke.UXolani Mcineka uneMpucuzeko Maskandi Festival, uKininonke Shandu unemiklomelo yezindondo zabesifazane, amaSebenza Women’s Awards. Yonke le micimbi ixhaswa wuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal ukuthi ibe yimpumelelo minyaka yonke.Encwadini uMaSotobe Sibiya, uthe bafuna laba bahleli bemicimbi babizwe eshashalazini ukuzochaza ngenkulumo yabo futhi baveze ukuthi bazowulungisa kanjani umonakalo osuwenzekile, kunokuthi bayaxolisa nje kuphela okuyinto enganele. Uthe ngakolwabo uhlangothi sebevule ne-App lapho abesifazane befaka khona izikhalo ngezimo ababhekene nazo ezindaweni abakuzona ngokubukelwa phansi nokuhlukumezeka.Umkhulumeli kandunankulu obambile KwaZulu-Natal, uJoseph Cubai ukuqinisekisile ukuthi sebeyitholile incwadi ephuma enhlanganweni yabesifazane, iKwa-Mthaniya Women’s Activist Movement."Silungisa isitatimende ngalolu daba. Uma undunankulu esesibonile sizosithumela kwabezindaba, siveze ukuthi simiphi ngalo,” kusho uCubai.Kuthintwa uKini, uthe njengoba esexolisile akukho okunye asazokusho ngalolu daba.
