Usihlalo we-ActionSA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Zwakele Mncwango, unqumele uMasipala weTheku ugwayi katiki ukuthi uphendule ngezimoto zamaphoyisa omkhandlu ezibonakale ziphelezela aboMkhonto weSizwe. UMncwango uthe izimoto akhuluma ngazo bezisemcimbi weMK KwaMashu, ngempelasonto.Isolezwe linayo incwadi ebhalwe wuMncwango eyibhekise kuMnuz Musa Mbhele, oyimenenja kaMasipala weTheku. UMncwango encwadini, ucela uMbhele ukuthi aphendule, uze amnike izinsuku eziyisikhombisa ukwenza lokho.UMkhonto weSizwe yiqembu elisanda kwethulwa owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ethi usehamba nalo akasayingeni eye-ANC. Leli qembu liphansi phezulu liyakhankasa ezindaweni ezehlulene.UMncwango uthe amaphoyisa oMkhandlu weTheku abeyingxenye yohide lwezimoto zoMkhonto weSizwe ekuqaleni kwaze kwaba sekugcineni. UMncwango uthe uyakuqonda ukuthi amaphoyisa omkhandlu ayalekelela ukuhamba kwezimto kodwa unemibuzo."Babesifakile yini isicelo sokuthi kuze amaphoyisa ezobalekelela? Safakwa wubani, nini, kanjani? Mina selokhu ngaba khona angikaze ngibone amaphoyisa kamasipala eba yingxenye yezimoto zeqembu likhankasa,’’ kusho uMncwango. UMncwango uthe uyithumelile incwadi kuMbhele, wathi uyitholile uyedlulisele ezikhulwini zamaphoyisa omkhandlu ukuthi zichaze ngalolu daba. Uthe okumenza asole kakhulu wukuthi iMeya yeTheku uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ike yayamaniswa naleli qembu, isolwa nangokuthi iyalekelela ngezisinsiza. UMncwango uthe akanabo ubufakazi bokuthi uKaunda uhlangene naleli qembu kodwa amahlebezi akhona.UKaunda uphendulile ngalokhu ecacisa ukuthi akahlangene naleli qembu futhi akukho ake alixhasa ngakho.UMncwango uthe uyazi nangodaba losopolitiki abagadwa amaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku kodwa bebe bengeyona ingxenye yomkhandlu, wathi nalo basazolusukumela kube ncane indawo.Ibamba likaKhomishana wamaphoyisa omkhandu weTheku, uSibonelo Mchunu, uthe amaphoyisa abo ayemenywe wuphiko lweSAPS emhlanganweni wokuhlela ezokuphepha. UMchunu uthe ngokuyalelwa wumthetho amaphoyisa abo aya futhi iqhaza lawo kwakuwukuqinisekissa ukuthi izimoto zihamba ngendlela.Uthe lokhu kusuke kwenzelwa ukuphepha kwawowownke umuntu ngaleso sikhathi. Uthe umthetho uyabagunyaza ukuthi balawule izimoto ezisuke zisemgwaqweni womphakathi ukugwema izingozi.
Owaziwa ngokubhala izingoma ezeseka i-ANC ezifana nethi Asinavalo, uGamelihle Mbuyane, ulaxaze le nhlangano ekhala ngokuxhashazwa.UMbuyane ukhale ngokungazuzi lutho kwi-ANC yize noma izingoma zakhe zishukumisa abantu emicimbini yenhlangano.UMbuyane useyalele i-ANC ukuba ingabe isazidlala izingoma zakhe emicimbini yenhlangano.Lokhu kuqukethwe encwadini yokwesula kwi-ANC kaMbuyane ebhekiswe kuNobhala we-ANC eMpumalanga, uMnuz Muzi Chirwa.Le ncwadi iphinde yathunyelwa nakuMengameli we-ANC, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, nakuNobhala Jikelele, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula.UMbuyane waziwa kakhulu ngokunandisa emcimbini ye-ANC, kanti phakathi kwezingoma adume ngazo ethi, Asinavalo, Asiwafuni amagwala, ne-Unity.UMbuyane ukhale ngokuthi akazuzanga lutho ngalezi zingoma azibhala."I-ANC iyaqhubeka nokudlala ingoma eyabhalwa yimi, i-Unity kodwa mina angitholi lutho ngalokho. Ngizamile ukuxhumana noMbalula kodwa ngangasizakala.”UMbuyane uthe iculo i-Unity walibhala emva kwengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi be-ANC eyayingo-2017, lapho kwanqoba khona uRamaphosa.Ngesikhathi enza le ngoma amalungu e-ANC ayehlukene phakathi njengoba kwakukhona lawo ayeseka uDkt Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, owayegaqele ukuhola i-ANC.Le ngoma inxenxa amalungu e-ANC ukuba abumbane, aseke uRamaphosa. UMbuyane uthe wayenza ukudala ubumbano kumalungu e-ANC, wathi kwachwaza inkundla yonke ngesikhathi eyidlala kwi-Januwari 8 ye-ANC yango-2018.UMbuyane uthe okwamcasula kakhulu ukuthi i-ANC yamshaya ngesithende, yaqoka uChicco Thwala ukuba kube uyena oyenzela le ngoma ekubeni kunguye owayibhala."Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi i-ANC ibabukela phansi abaculi. Ngiyazihluphekela kodwa ikhono nginalo. I-ANC kufanele engabe inikeza abaculi amathuba ukuze abaculi bangeke bafe behlupheka.”UMbuyane ubebonakala kakhulu emicimbini ye-ANC ngesikhathi kusaphethe uZuma.Encwadini yokwesula uthe kukhona kwi-ANC abakholelwa ukuthi akufanele anikezwe ithuba ngoba weseka uZuma."Mina ngiwumculi, akufanele ngibizwe ngomuntu kasibanibani.”UMbuyane usongele i-ANC ngokuyithathela izinyathelo zomthetho uma ingayeki ukudlala izingoma ezinezwi lakhe noma ezabhalwa wuye."Uthe umthetho ovikela amalungelo abaculi awukuvumi ukuthi kusetshenziswe izingoma zabaculi ngaphandle kwemvume.”UChirwa uthe ubengakayitholi incwadi yokwesula kukaMbuyane."Ngakho ke angeke ngikwazi ukuphawula ngalokhu othi ikuqukethe.”
Ufuna kwenzeke ubulungiswa ngelungu lawo umndeni wowesilisa okukholakala ukuthi ushone emva kokuncishwa umoya ngamaphoyisa, okuthiwa amfake uplastiki ekhanda amfutha nangesisi esikhalisa unyembezi, ngesikhathi ephume umkhankaso wokukhuculula ubugebengu, eNkolongwane eHlobane ngoMgqibelo.UMnuz Mzomuhle Zwane (20), okuvele ukuthi ubenesifo sofuba lomoya kuthiwa kumenele esendleleni ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela, emva kokuthi amaphoyisa abephume umkhankaso kuthiwa amncishe umoya ngoplastiki afutha nesisi esikhalisa unyembezi, emfica nomngani wakhe bezilalele ngezisu phansi komthunzi wesihlahla esiseceleni komuzi abethole umkhondo ngawo ukuthi kukhona othile onesibhamu kuwona.Ugogo kamufi uNksz Nonhlanhla Dlamini elandisa Isolezwe, usole amaphoyisa ngendluzula njengoba ethi umzukulu wakhe ubengahlanganise lutho nomuzi amaphoyisa abebabele kuwo."Kuthiwa ngesikhathi ebabona aqonde kubona efuna ukubasesha, owesilisa obehleli nomufi wabaleka kwasala yena, okuyilapho kuthiwa amseshile ethole iphakeshana lensangu ekhukhwini, aqala amhlukumeza amfaka uplastiki ekhanda afutha nesisi esikhalisa unyembezi.Kuthe uma equleka amqukula amlalisa emotweni angamnaka aqhubeka nokunye akwenzayo kanti uwumuntu onesifuba,” usho kanje.Uthe emva kokulunywa indlebe ngelinye ilungu lomphakathi, uphumile eyobheka wambona umzukulu wakhe edindilize ngemuva emotweni yamaphoyisa, okuthe uma ebabuza ukuthi awamsizi ngani njengoba engasanyakazi, angamnaka."Elinye iphoyisa lithe baficwe bebhema izidakamizwa, kodwa ngokumazi kwami usebenzisa insangu kuphela nayo usanda kuyiqala futhi, ngoba ethi kukhona owamxoxela ukuthi iyasiza esifweni sesifuba somoya. Ngithe amaphoyisa okungenani awangikhombise okungenani atholwe nakho, kodwa ngigcine ngikhonjiswa iphakeshana lensangu. Ngesikade azame ukuhamba naye ehlangabeza i-ambulensi. Ngathola umyalezo othi ushone esendleleni ephuthunyiswa esibhedlela,” usho kanje.Uthe okumphatha kabi kakhulu wukuthi selokhu kwenzeke lesi sigameko amaphoyisa awazange afike ezobikela umndeni, kuhlule noma eyobuza esiteshini samaphoyisa eHlobane, ubeshoniswa ngapha nangapha, kungacaci ukuthi isidumbu sikamzukulu wakhe sigcinwe kumaphi amakhaza.Uthi kuze kwasiza ukungenela kwamalungu omphakathi avale umgwaqo odlula ngakulesi siteshi ngamathayi avuthayo ngoMsombuluko, efuna izimpendulo, kwayikhathi evunyelwa ukubona isidumbu sikamufi obekulokhu kuthiwa sisahlolwa.Okhulumela uphiko olubhekele ukuziphatha kwamaphoyisa, i- Independent Police Investigative Directorate uMnuz Phaladi Shupping, uthe: "Amaphoyisa aseVryheid abophe umsolwa obephethe okungalungile. Udlikizile ngesikhathi esemotweni yamaphoyisa ibheke esiteshini, waphuthunyiswa emtholampilo ngebhadi kutholakale ukuthi useshonile.”Uthe lolu phiko luyaphenywa.
Kuvela isizathu okusolakala ukuthi kube yisona esiholele ekutheni isosha lombutho wezempi wakuleli, iSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF) lidubule libulale umkalo ngoJanuwari 3.Isolezwe libike ngokuvela eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown kukaMnuz Lwanda Mxolisi Zungu (37) osolwa ngokudubula abulale umkakhe, uNkk Tania Msane-Zungu (36).Ilungu lomndeni wakubo kwesosha elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo liveze ukuthi uZungu ubulale umkakhe ngoba esethole ngomjolo wakhe nomuntu amaziyo.Kuvela ukuthi umufi bese kuphele isikhathi eside ejola nalo wesilisa obephinde asondelane kakhulu nesosha."Bekungesikhona okokuqala isosha limbamba ukuthi uyajola umkalo. Eqinisweni, bese kungokwesithathu. Kodwa ngenxa yokuthi belingumuntu ebelimthanda kakhulu belihlale njalo limxolela,'' usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe kulokhu bayazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi kungani egcine esethatha isinqumo esinzima kangaka sokuthi amane ambulale.Uthe kodwa babuye baziphendule bona ngempendulo yokuthi kungenzeka ukuthi isosha kulokhu licikwe ukuthi umkalo ujola nomuntu osondelene nabo bobabili."Isosha kulicasulile kakhulu ukuthi umkalo ajole nalo muntu wesilisa. Okokuqala lo muntu wesilisa okuthiwa ubejola naye bebezwana kakhulu. Kusho ukuthi lokhu kumane kwalilimaza kakhulu emphefumulweni lamane lahluleka nawukuzibamba,'' echaza.Omunye obesondelene nalaba ababili, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi wagcina esejwayelana nomkhwenyana kodwa waqale wazwana nomufi.Uchaze isosha njengowesilisa obelungile futhi emazisa kakhulu umkakhe.Uthe nabo zikhona izikhawu lapho abake bazama khona ukuthi uphele lomjolo oseceleni kamufi kodwa kwaba nhlanga zimuka nomoya.Uthe kodwa uyazi ukuthi uma seliqulwa icala kuzovela ukuthi eqinisweni yini eholele kusona sonke lesi simo.Isolezwe lithole ngamalungu omndeni wesosha ukuthi umufi naye wayeyisosha.Aveza nokuthi laba ababili batholana khona enkambini yamasosha base bayathandana.Umufi kuthiwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ugcine ekuduba ukuba yisosha ekhala ngendlela abaqeqeshwa ngayo ethi inzima.Icala libuyela enkantolo ngoJanuwari 17. Owayengungqongqoshe wamaphoyisa uMnuz Nathi Nhleko, uthi uNobhala-Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uhlinzele ezibini inhlangano ekhuluma into engekho ngodaba lomuzi wowayengumengameli uMnuz Jacob Zuma. UNhleko uxoxe neSolezwe ephendula ngenkulumo kaMbalula esuse umsindo.Uthe ubengalindele ukuthi lolu daba luzoba lukhulu kangaka, abantu bebembuza bekhuluma nangalo esidlangaleni, wabona ukuthi kufanele aqondise ukukhuluma.UMbalula ngempelasonto utshele izintatheli ukuthi uZuma bamvikela, baze baqamba amanga ngezokuphepha ezazifakwe emzini wakhe. Ngesikhathi kunomsindo ngomuzi oseNkandla, uNhleko wayesewungqongqoshe.UNhleko wuyena owayechazela iPhalamende ngodaba lwaseNkandla olwaludla lubi, amaqembu aphikisayo evutha. Umsindo wawususwe wukuthi ngesikhathi kuqiniswa ezokuphepha kwaZuma, kwakhiwa izinto ezazishayisa amakhala kwabaningi, bethi kumoshwe imali kahulumeni.UNhleko uchaze indaba yedamu lamanzi elakhiwa kwaZuma, okwakuthiwa ngelokubhukuda."Unjiniyela wathi amanzi asemzini kaZuma awenele ngoba umuzi ufulelwe ngotshani. Kuyoba nzima uma kuqubuka umlilo. Wabe esephakamisa ukuthi kwakhiwe idamu lamanzi okubhula umlilo ukuze kwengezwe amanzi,,’ kusho uNhleko.Uthe kwakhiwa idamu kulandelwa isiphakamiso sikanjiniyela. UNhleko uthe imibiko ngodaba lwaseNkandla yayethulwa kuMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa owayeyiphini likamengameli futhi ewusihlalo wekomiti lezepolitiki."Uma ethi ngaqamba amanga egameni le-ANC, akakhombe umholi owangithuma ukuthi ngiqambe amanga. Kusho ukuthi uchaza ukuthi mina ngephula isifungo sokwethembeka engasithatha ngemukela isikhundla. Uyenzele phansi i-ANC ngoba abantu bazoyethemba kanjani uma kuthiwa ibuye iqambe amanga? ” kusho uNhleko.UNhleko uthe izibaya lezi okwakukhalwa ngazo kwaZuma, waphenya wathola izimpendulo ngazo. Uthe kwaba nesidingo sezibaya ezintsha, ukuthi zithi ukuqhela ezindlini ngoba kwakucushwa ama-alamu, kwakungafuneki ukugcaluza kwezilwane.Uthe isenzo sikaMbalula sihlinzela ezibini kwayena uRamaphosa uqobo ngoba wuyena ohola umbutho njengamanje. UNhleko uthe uMbalula ungunontandakubukwa, uze agamanxe enze amaphutha.Okhulumela i-ANC, uNkk Mahlengi Bhengu-Motsiri, uthe uNhleko uma enesikhalo kufanele axhumane nenhlangano akhulume ngaphakathi ezinhlakeni.
Afakwe isamuku amalungu ePhalamende azobe ethamele inkulumo kaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ebhekiswe ezweni kulo nyaka.IPhalamende limemezele ukuthi uRamaphosa ucele ukwethula inkulumo ngoFebhuwari 8 ngo-7ebusuku. Inkulumo kamengameli ebhekiswe ezweni iba minyaka yonke futhi isuke isho ukuthi iPhalamende lisuke selivulwe ngokusemthethweni. Kusuke kuwumcimbi odlisa ngomswenko lapho amalungu ePhalamende lapho ehloba ngemisiko ehlukene.Umengameli usuke echazela izwe ngokuthi isimo sinjani nokuthi yikuphi okungalindeleka ukuthi kwenziwe wuhulumeni futhi usuhambe wafika kuphi kulokho okwakuvunyelwene ngakho.Inkulumo kamengameli ivame ukuphazanyiswa ngamalungu e-EFF asuke efuna izimpendulo uma kunodaba angeneme ngalo. Ngonyaka odlule yanyomfeka inkulumo kamengameli kwaze kwasukuma abaqaphi bakhe bamzungeza ngoba kubonakala ukuthi sebexwayile.Abe-EFF babesho ukugibela esiteji lapho kwakuhleli khona umengameli kwaze kwaphoqa ukuthi kungenelele abezokuphepha.Amalungu e-EFF aze akhishwa phandle ngendluzula. Ayekhala ngodaba lwepulazi likamengameli iPhala Phala, lapho okwagqekezwa khona kwebiwa imali engamadola.Okhulumela iPhalamende uMnuz Moloto Mothapo, uthe kunomthetho omusha ochitshiyelwe othi uma umengameli eseqalile ukwethula inkulumo yakhe, kusuke kungasavunyelwe muntu ukuthi akhulume noma aphazamise.Amalungu e-EFF ayisithupha asanda kulahlwa ngamacala okuphazamisa lo mcimbi, agwetshwa ngokuthi amiswe. Lokho kusho ukuthi ngeke akwazi ukuhambela umcimbi nonyaka. Abe-EFF bathi abayingeni indaba yaleso sigwebo ngoba abeneme ngaso futhi bazimisele ngokusiphosela inselelo.IPhalamende liphinde lacacisa ukuthi uyaqala umsebenzi wokulungisa isakhiwo esangqongqiswa ngomlilo. IPhalamende lithe ibalelwa kuR 2 billion imali elizoyisebenzisa ukuvuselela izakhiwo ezadliwa wumlilo.

UMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ayimqwashisi eyokuthi kungase kwenzeke elakuleli linswinywe kwezomnotho noma lihlaselwe izikhondlakhondla zamazwe njengoba livulele elakwa-Israel icala.URamaphosa uvikele isinqumo sakuleli sokumangalela elakwa-Israel eNkantolo yamaCala aMazwe oMhlaba, wathi akanendaba nokuthi lesi nqumo singase sicasule amazwe ayizikhondlakhondla kwezomnotho.Elakwa-Israel lidlelana namazwe ayizikhondlakhondla kwezomnotho.Izwe elidlelana nelakwa-Israel, iMelika, livele seliphumele obala lagxeka isinqumo seNingizimu Afrika.INingizimu Afrika imangalele i-Israel ngamacala okufa kwezinkulungwane zabantu empini eqhubeka eGaza.Kusukela kuqale le mpi lapho elakwa-Israel lilwa nezihonga zeHamas, sekushone abantu abangaphezu kuka-23 000.URamaphosa uthe elakuleli ngeke lisonge izandla ekubeni kubhubha abantu eGaza.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma emcimbini owandulela umgubho weminyaka engu-112 kwasungulwa i-ANC.URamaphosa uthe isimangalo esifakwe yiNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi elakuleli lizimele."Ngiyazi abanye bathi lento ingase yenze ukuthi sinswinywe kwezomnotho noma sihlaselwe, kodwa ke ngeke sibukele izinto zonakala. Ngeke sithule kubulawa abantu.”URamaphosa uthe okwenze ukuthi balusukumele lolu daba ukuthi bayazwelana nabantu basePalestine abacindezelekile."Baseseka ngesikhathi nathi sicindezelekile. Siyakwazi ukuthi ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezelo akukuhle.”Icala lapho elakuleli limangalele khona elakwa-Israel lizongena eNkantolo yamaCala aMazwe kusasa.Icala lizoqulwa izinsuku ezimbili.Elakuleli lizokube limelwe yithimba eliqinile elifaka izazi zomthetho wamazwe.Ethimbeni elimele elakuleli kukhona ungoti womthetho wezamazwe omhlaba, uSolwazi John Dugard, uSolwazi Max du Plessis, nabameli uAdvocate Tembeka Ngcukaitobi no-Adila Hassim.Amazwe omhlaba ahlukene phakathi ngaleli cala.Iningi lamazwe ayizikhondlakhondla akhombisa ukweseka elakwa-Israel, kanti isicelo seNingizimu Afrika sesekwa kakhulu amazwe ase-Asia.Amazwe asephumele obala azwakalisa ukweseka isiphakamiso seNingizimu Afrika yiTurkey, Jordan neMalaysia.Kusukela kwaqala impi, elakuleli belilokhu ligxeka izenzo zelakwa-Israel.Kube nemibhikisho eminingi kuleli eyeseka abantu basePalestine.IPhalamende lathatha isinqumo sokuthi uhulumeni wakuleli uvale izindlu zenxusa lakwa-Israel.

BANGAPHEZU kuka-50 000 abantu ababoshiwe ngamacala anhlobonhlobo ngamaholidi okuphela konyaka, okukhona kuwona awokubulala nokudlwengula.Kulesi sibalo, kubikwe amacala angu-8 001 okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza avulwe emaphoyiseni kusukela ngoDisemba 17 kuya ngoJanuwari 7 nonyaka. Kuphinde kwavulwa amacala angu-2 812 okushaya.Lokhu kudalulwe amaphoyisa esitatimendeni mayelana nezokuphepha ngamaholidi asithumele abezindaba izolo.Kubikwe amacala angu-1 252 okudlwengula, awu-1 682 abebeshayela bephuze utshwala nabawu-1 232 abebedayisa utshwala ngokungemthetho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe angu-3 976 amacala okutholakala nezidakamizwa avuliwe.Uqhube wathi kuvulwe amacala okubulala nawokuzama ukubulala angu-1 390 ngesikhathi esifanayo."Ekhaleni lemikhankaso yethu wukuthola abasolwa abafunwa uthuli, ukuvundulula izibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, izidakamizwa nempahla ewumbombayi. Sibopha nabashayela bephuzile, abantshontshayo nabaduna izimoto,” kusho uBrig Mathe.Amanye amacala avuliwe kube angu-3 317 awabokufika abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli, angu-575 okudayisa izidakamizwa nangu-546 okutholakala nesibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.UBrig Mathe uthe lokhu bakwenze beqhubeka nomkhankaso wabo olwa nobugebengu owaziwa nge-Operation Shanela.Lo mkhankaso wethulwa ngoMeyi 2023 kanti sekuboshwe abantu abangaphezu kuka-314 000 kusukela waqala.Amaphoyisa athi imikhankaso yawo iyaqhubeka kwazise abantu babuyela ezindaweni abahlala kuzona futhi kulungiselelwa ukuvulwa kwezikole.UMkhuzi wamaPhoyisa kuzwelonke, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, uthe namanje bawavulile amehlo ukuze balwe ngempumelelo nobugebengu noma ngabe obaluphi uhlobo."Asifuni ukuthatha amashansi futhi sibonga imiphakathi ngokusebenza ngokubambisana namaphoyisa nangokuwahlinzeka ngolwazi oluholele ekuboshweni kwezigebengu ngesikhathi samaholidi,” kusho uMasemola.Uthe amaphoyisa azoqhubeka aphithizele emiphakathini njengoba siqhubeka isiphithiphithi sasemigwaqweni futhi bazoqapha nesimo uma sekukhishwa imiphumela ka-matric, eqondane nokuvulwa kwezikole.

ISOSHA lombutho wezempi wakuleli, iSouth African National Defence Force (SANDF), elisolwa ngokudubula libulale unkosikazi walo, lichazwe njengendoda enodlame ebihlukumeza unkosikazi wayo uNkk Tania Msane Zungu (36) ongcwatshwe ngeSonto.UNKK Gwen Msane ongunina kamufi uNkk Tania Msane-Zungu, ezwakalisa ubuhlungu ngokubulawa ngesihluku kwendodakazi yakhe Isithombe: Pakkies/ Independent Newspapers.Isosha, uMnuz Lwanda Mxolisi Zungu, livele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePinetown, izolo, emuva kokuzinikela emaphoyiseni. UZungu onomzimba oyisidlakela, usolwa ngokudubula abulale unkosikazi wakhe ngoJanuwari 3, ngesikhathi izingane zabo ezimbili nogogo wazo, uNkk Gwen Msane, besendlini. Emuva kwesigameko wabaleka.UNkk Msane ekhuluma nephaphandaba elinguzakwazo weSolezwe, iDaily News, uthe ngosuku lwesigameko wayevakashele laba abaganene njengoba babekade bendawonye ngosuku lokuhlukanisa unyaka."Ngijwayele ukuphuma ekameleni ukuze ngiyogeza emuva kokugeza kukamkhwenyane wakwami ngoba ngiyamhlonipha kodwa ngalolo suku angizizwaga izigi zakhe. Ngalinda kwaze kwaba ngu-9.30 ekuseni kodwa wayengakaphumi ekameleni lakhe,” kuchaza uNkk Msane.Uthe waqhubeka walinda kanti ngesikhathi elindile yilapho ezwa khona indodakazi yakhe immemeza, ithi uZungu uyayishaya. "Ngesikhathi ngiphuthuma egumbini labo ngezwa kuqhuma isibhamu kaningi, izingane zase zivele zisivulile isicabha sekamelo labazali bazo. Uveze ukuthi kuke kwaba nesikhathi lapho uZungu edlulisela khona isibhamu esontweni njengoba wayethi wayeseqala kabusha futhi baze bavuselela izifungo zabo ngoMeyi 21, nyakenye, ngosuku lokuzalwa lukaTania, bekhombisa ukuthi baqala kabusha.UNkk Msane uqhube waveza ukuthi usanda kuthola ukuthi uZungu wabuyela esontweni wayolanda isibhamu sakhe kanti kuthiwa waveza ukuthi wayezosidayisa. Uthe uZungu ngesikhathi enyamalele emuva kwesigameko, ubexhumana nezingane zakhe kanti uma zimbuza ukuthi ukephi ubezitshela ukuthi akubalulekile ukuthi ukuphi kodwa uzama ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi aziyi ekhaya lezintandane.Okunye okuvelile ukuthi uZungu ubeba nesihluku uma kwenziwa inkonzo yasekameleni ngoba ethi ufuna ukuzwa ukuthi inkosikazi yakhe ayisali yini igange uma esahambe ngokomsebenzi. Kuthiwa umufi ubangasakuthokozeli ukuhlangana naye nokungezinye zezinto ebezibangwa. Uthe ukhathazekile ngokuphepha kwakhe nokwezingane uma uZungu angase adedelwe ngebheyili. Yize kunjalo, ukubalulile ukuthi uZungu wayenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izingane zakhe zinakho konke ezikudingayo futhi zifunda ezikoleni eziphambili. "Ngangimtshela ukuthi ngijabule kanjani ngendlela anakekela ngayo izingane zakhe,” kusho uNkk Msane.Udadewabo kaZungu, uNksz Lwandile Zungu, uthe akukho lula emndenini wakhe ikakhulukazi njengoba kukhona izingane esezisele zingenabazali. Ayikho imininingwane evelile ngalesi sivumelwano."I-Action SA ithe ifuna ukwazi ukuthi isikweletu sikhokhwe kanjani nokuthi sikhokhwe ngesivumelwano esisemthethweni yini."Kubalulekile nokuqonda ukuthi ngobani abanikelile nokuthi laba noma i-Ezulweni Investments izozuza yini ngokwenza umsebenzi nohulumeni ngomuso."Ithe encwadini yayo iveze ukungenami kwayo ngokukhetha ukulandelwa kwalo mthetho.

Ukwesekwa akutholayo uMsholozi kusukela amemezela ukuthi uzovotela uMkhonto weSizwe, kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi abantu bakuleli bayamethemba.”UMavundla uthe i-ABC yeseka yonke imizamo yokuba kube nobumbano kubantu abangumsinsi wokuzimilela."Kuyasikhathaza ukuthi nakuba labo abangumsinsi wokuzimilela bekhombisa umdlandla wokungena kwezepolitiki, bahlukene kakhulu. Lokhu kukhonjiswa ukuba khona kwamaqembu amaningi ezepolitiki. Lesi simo senza ukuthi abantu abamnyama baqhubeke nokucindezeleka kwezomnotho."Njenge-ABC, sinxusa ukuba abantu abamnyama babumbane ukuze siqede ingcindezelo. Sekuphele iminyaka engu-30 abantu bakuleli bevota kodwa abantu abamnyama bayaqhubeka nokubhuqwabhuqwa ububha.” UMavundla uthe kungenzeka i-ABC ibe nokubambisana noMkhonto weSizwe."Igama le-ABC neloMkhonto weSizwe anomlando uma kuziwa emsebenzini wokukhulula abamnyama ongakapheli. Kwenza umqondo ukuthi lezi zinhlangano zihlale phansi zibonisane.”UMavundla uthe isigungu esiphezulu kwi-ABC sizokwenza isimemezelo ngodaba oluthinta uMkhonto weSizwe emva komhlangano ozokuba kule nyanga.

Inyunyana yabasebenzi bezempilo iSouth African Medical Association Trade Union (Samatu) ikhathazekile ngokuduva emakhaya kodokotela abanamakhono, asebephothule ukuqeqeshwa kwabo emiphakathini. Umbiko wocwaningo ukhombisa ukuthi bangaphezu kuka-800 odokotela abaqeqeshwe bagogoda abangasebenzi emuva kokuphothula iminyaka yabo emibili yokuqeqeshwa ngokusebenza ezikhungweni zezempilo kanye nowodwa wokusebenzela umphakathi. Le nyunyana esitatimendeni iveze ukuthi lo mbiko ongahlali kahle awugqamisi kuphela inkinga yokulahlekelwa kwabantu abanamava kwezempilo kodwa ukhuluma ngqo nenkinga ekhona ezibhedlela yokushoda kwabasebenzi ekubeni bekhona odokotela abangaqashwa. UNobhala Jikelele wenyunyana uDkt Cedric Sihlangu, uthe yize uMnyango wezeMpilo ukubhekelela ukuthi baqeqeshwe iminyaka emithathu kodwa uyehluleka ukuza nesu lokuthi labo dokotela asebenamakhono bakwazi ukuqasheka emuva kokuqeqeshwa. Uthe minyaka yonke umnyango uhlale ukhala ngenkinga yesabelomali okuyiyo abathi yenza kube nzima ukuthi baqashe odotela asebephothule izifundo zabo, kodwa asikho isisombululo esibambekayo sokuxazulula le nkinga. Uthe lokhu kudala ukuthi kube nenkinga yokufudukela kwamanye amazwe kodokotela. Uthe ziningi izingqinamba emkhakheni wezempilo ezikhona ngenxa yale nkinga, waveza ukuthi bafuna ukuthi lolu daba lusukunyelwe ngokushesha nguMnyango wezeMpilo.

Ngeke sikwazi ukuba nesimo sodlame kulolu daba,’’ kusho uNxumalo.Nakuba ededeliwe ngoshwele uPistorius kodwa umndeni kamufi, uReeva phambilini uke wakuveza ukuthi kaweneme ngesinqumo ngoba ukholwa wukuthi akakahlunyeleliswa kahle isimilo.

Ekuqaleni kwesonto, eDonsamahoho, oLundi, kuhlangane izigodi eziwu-25, kubhiklwa ingoma kanti okuhlaba umxhwele ukuthi kudilika amabhinca eGoli, azohlangana nawaKwaNongoma naseMahlabathini.Lo mcimbi waminyaka wonke usuhlanganise ngisho izigodi ebezingabhekani kodwa manje sezingamathe nolimi ngenxa yothando lwesintu. Umgqugquzeli walo mcimbi, uMnuz Sizwe Zulu, uveze ukuthi kulo nyaka kwenzeke okwehlukile kwatheleka neNkosi yaKwaPhindangene, uZuzifa Buthelezi, umholi we-IFP uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa kanjalo nemeya yaseZululand uMnuz Thulasizwe Buthelezi."INGOMA ikhule kakhulu kodwa idinga uxhaso ngoba uhulumeni ubengakaze ayihambele. Ukufika kwabaholi kusinikeze ithemba ngoba iMeya uButhelezi ikwaze nokuhlonza izinkinga zentuthuko esisalele kuzo. Kuwujabulise kakhulu umphakathi nokubona inkosi yesizwe inyathela okokuqala ngqa kule ndawo, nomholi uHlabisa wamukelwe kahle. Kuningi esingafisa ukukushintsha ngeNGOMA ngoba ayigcini ngokuhlanganisa umphakathi kodwa igqugquzela ukuthula nokubambisana," kusho uZulu.INkosi uButhelezi iveze ukuthi kuyayijabulisa ukubona kuqhubeka umsebenzi owaqala uMntwana waKwaPhindangene osekhotheme."Ngifikelwa umunyu nokho ukuthi uMntwana akasekho ukuzibonela lobu buhle obungaka," kusho iNkosi yakwaButhelezi.IMeya yeseZululand, uMnuz Thulasizwe Buthelezi, ithembise ukuthi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuthi bayawuxhasa minyaka yonke lo mcimbi."Siyazi izindawo zamakhosi bezikhungethwe yizimpi, ukudilika kwezinsizwa eGoli zifike kunemcimbi efana nale emakhaya kwenza ukuthi zihlalisane kahle futhi zazane kangcono."Ingoma ngaphezu kokuba yenza izintombi nezinsizwa zivikeleke ezintweni ezingalungile kodwa iphinde ibasize ekuvocavoceni imizimba , bafundiswe nenhlonipho," kusho uButhelezi.UMengameli weIFP, uHlabisa, uveze ukuthi uyawuthakasela kakhulu lo mcimbi njengoba uhlanganisa intsha nabadala. SIYAQHUBEKA nokuhlukanisa amazwe omhlaba isicelo esifakwe iNingizimu Afrika sokuba inkantolo yamacala omhlaba (International Court of Justice) iphenye iqhaza elibanjwe elaKwa-Israel empini eqhubeka eGaza.Izwe eliyisikhondlakhondla kwezomnotho, i-United States of America (Melika), seliphumele obala lagxeka isicelo seNingizimu Afrika esizolalelwa ngesonto elizayo.Kulesi sicelo iNingizimu Afrika ifuna kuphume isivimbelo esizonqanda i-Israel ukuba iqhubeke nokuhlasela eGaza.Kusukela kuqale impi ye-Israel neHamas, sekushone abantu abangaphezu kuka-22 000, iningi labantu abashonile ngabasePalestine.IHamas iyona eyagadla kuqala, i-Israel yabe isiziphindisela.Selokhu yaqala impi, elakuleli belilokhu lizwakalisa ukweseka abantu basePalestine.Esicelweni esingamaphepha anga-84 esifakwe yiNingizimu Afrika ngasekupheleni konyaka owedlule, elakuleli lisole i-Israel ngokuqinisa isandla.Kepha iMelika yona isola elakuleli ngokuvikela iHamas.Okhulumela umkhandlu wezokuphepha eMelika, uMnuz John Kirby, uthe isicelo esifakwe elakuleli asinabo ubufakazi."Uma uzokwenza izinsolo ezibucayi njengalezi kufanele ube nento ebambekayo. Esikubonayo esicelweni izinsolo nje ezingenabo ubufakazi. Thina akukho lapho sibona khona i-Israel ibhubhisa abantu.”UKirby uthe bazosamukela isinqumo esizothathwa inkantolo yamazwe omhlaba."Siyayihlonipha kakhulu inkantolo yamazwe omhlaba ngoba inikezwe umsebenzi obalulekile. Sizosihlonipha isinqumo sayo.”I-Israel ivele nayo isisigxekile isicelo seNingizimu Afrika.Okhulumela uhulumeni waKwa-Israel, uMnuz Eylon Levy, uthe bona bayazivikela kwiHamas athe ihlose ukuqeda ngabantu baKwa-Israel.ULevy usole elakuleli ngokuvikela iHamas."Umhlaba uyanibuka, ngelinye ilanga niyophendula ngezenzo zenu.”ULevy uthe bazosiphikisa isicelo esifakwe yiNingizimu Afrika, wathi bazothumela abameli abasezingeni eliphezulu ukuba bayobamela.Amazwe asephumele obala, azwakalisa ukweseka isicelo seNingizimu Afrika, yiTurkey neMalaysia.Umnyango wezokuxhumana namazwe angaphandle eTurkey, uthe ufuna ukubona kuthathelwa izinyathelo labo abandakanyeka ekubulaweni kwabantu abangaphezu kuka-22 000.Esitatimendeni, lo mnyango uthe isicelo esifakwe iNingizimu Afrika sizokwelekelela ukuqeda impi eqhubekayo.Ihhovisi lezokuxhumana namazwe angaphandle eMalaysia lona lithe bazoseseka isicelo esifakwe elakuleli."Lesi sicelo sizonikeza i-Israel ithuba lokuba iphendule ngokubulawa kwabantu emhlabeni wamaPalestine. ElaKwa-Israel linesibophezelo sokuba lipheze ukubulala abantu eGaza.”Ekhaya, amaqembu amaningi ezepolitiki azwakalisa ukuseseka isicelo esifakwe elakuleli.

IMVULA yakamuva ebibonakala ezingxenyeni eziningi zezwe emasontweni edlule, ilekelele ukuthi kunyuke izinga lamanzi nokuyinto ebidingeka kakhulu kuleli kodwa uhulumeni usanxusa emiphakathini ukuthi iwonge. Umbiko woMnyango wezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle okhishwe ekuqaleni kwesonto, uveza ukuthi amanzi agciniwe ezinqolobaneni zezwe lenyuke lafinyelela ku-89.8% kuleli sonto, esuka ku-86.2% wangesonto eledlule. Yize kunjalo lokhu kukhombisa ukuncipha uma uqhathanisa no-94.3% wangesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka owedlule. Ngokwesitatimende esikhishwe umnyango, izifundazwe eziningi zithole amanzi athe xaxa kuleli sonto, ngaphandle kweGauteng kanye neWestern Cape okuthiwa khona amanzi anciphile ngo-0.4% no-1.2% ngokulandelana. Yize kube nemvula eGauteng, izinga lamanzi lehlile lafinyelela ku-85.9% kuleli sonto kanye no-86.3 ngesonto eledlule. Lokhu kungukwehla okukhulu uma uqhathanisa ngesikhathi esifanayo ngonyaka owedlule lapho amanzi ayeku-101.8%. EWestern Cape kwehle kwafinyelela ku-82.3 kuleli sonto kanti ngeledlule kufinyelele ku-83.5%. Lokhu kukhombisa ukwenza kangcono uma uqhathanisa no-61.2% wangonyaka owedlule ngesikhathi esifanayo. ELimpopo kuleli sonto izinga lamanzi beliku-81.7%, ngeledlule liku-78.8%, eMpumalanga ngeledlule belingu- 92.5%, kuleli sonto lingu-95.4%, eNorth West ngeledlule beliku-79.9% kuleli sonto liku-80.1%. ENorthern Cape kuleli sonto lifinyelele ku-81.5% lisuka ku- 80.8% wangeledlule. E-Eastern Cape lifinyelele ku- 84.7% kuleli sonto lisuka ku-84.2% wangeledlule. KwaZulu-Natal lisuke ku-82.3% wangesonto eledlule lafinyelela ku-84.2% kuleli sonto kanti eFree State lifinyelele ku- 92% kuleli sonto lisuka ku -86.4% wangesonto eledlule.Umnyango uyakuvuma ukuthi kukhona izindawo ezisenenkinga yamanzi kwezinye izingxenye zezwe kanti uyagcizelela ukuthi kunemizamo yokulungisa le nkinga yokushoda kwamanzi. Ngokwesitatimende, omasipala bayalekelelwa ngoxhaso oluhlukene okukhona kulo neRegional Bulk Infrastructure Grant nezinsiza zokwakha, ukuvuselela nokulungisa ingqalasizinda yamanzi. Ngonyaka owedlule, uNgqongqoshe uMnuz Senzo Mchunu uxhumane nezinhlaka ezehlukene ukuzama ukuxazulula izingqinamba ezivimba ukuthi kuqhubeke izinhlelo zengqalasizinda okuzoholela ekutheni kube nokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi okunozinzo. Umnyango uthe uyanxusa ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuwonga futhi babike uma kukhona abacekela phansi ingqalasizinda yamanzi.

Okunye okumqoka ukuthi azibandakanye ezinhlelweni zomphakathi zokulwa nokuhluknyezwa kwabantu besifazane, ezihlonzwe yibhodi leCSPB,” kusho uNxumalo.Nakuba ezophuma ngoshwele uPistorius, umndeni kaNksz Steenkamp ubulokhu uzwakalise njalo ukuthi awukholwa ukuthi ukufanele ukunikwa ushwele.Nyakenye, uNkk June Steenkamp, ongunina kamufi, wabhala incwadi enza izethulo ebhodini likashwele (CSPB).Wathi ubona sengathi akazisoli uPistorius emuva kwento ebuhlungu kangaka ayenza kubona."Ukuzisola nokuhlunyeleliswa isimilo kuhambisana nokuthi umuntu ahlambuluke ngakho konke nangokwethembeka ngobugebengu abenza bese amukela nesijeziso. Akekho umuntu ongathi uyazisola kodwa ebe engakhulumi iqiniso lonke,’’ washo kanje uNkk Steenkamp, encwadini.

Waphinde waba ingxenye yelinye icala elithinta umbango wokuhola iNFP. Kulapho okwavela khona ukuthi unobulungu bamaqembu amabili ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ubebhekene nezinsolo ezibucayi, ngeshwa ke wakhetha ukungaveli phambi kwekomiti eliqondisa ubugwegwe.”UMmakau uthe isigungu esiphezulu sizophinde sihlangane sizobhunga ngesikhundla sikaMlotshwa kuMasipala wasoKhahlamba."Kuzoshaya uMgqibelo sesisithathile isinqumo.”Imizamo yokuthola uMlotshwa ukuze aphawule ayizange iphumelele njengoba ucingo lwakhe belukhala lungabanjwa, futhi engazange awuphendule umbuzo awuthunyelwe.Isolezwe libone umyalezo uMlotshwa awuthumele emalungwini eqembu, ewanxusa ukuba angatatazeliswa izindaba zokuxoshwa kwakhe.Kulo myalezo, uMlotshwa uveze ukuthi lolu daba uzolufaka enkantolo."Yinkantolo ezonquma ukuthi ubani osephutheni. Loyo osephutheni uyena okuyodingeka akhokhele izindleko zecala.”UMlotshwa wenze izinsolo zokuthi abamxoshayo bathunywe iqembu lezepolitiki angazange alidalule, ukuba bazophazamisa umkhankaso wabo wokhetho."Nginxusa ukuba sigxile ekukhankaseleni ukhetho. ISISHIPHELENE ebuholini obusha beNFP obakhethwa engqungqutheleni eyayingenyanga eyedlule.Umengameli weqembu, uMnuz Ivan Barnes, ubhekene ngeziqu zamehlo nonobhala jikelele, uMnuz Teddy Thwala, njengoba besabisana ngokufakana ezinkantolo.UThwala usabisa ngokufaka isicelo sokuthi kuhlakazwe ubuholi ayingxenye yabo.Okuqhathe laba holi yisikhalo esifakwe yilungu leqembu eliphonsela inselelo imiphumela yengqungquthela okwakhethwa kuyo la baholi.Ilungu leqembu elifake isikhalo likhala ngokuthi kwaba nomkhonyovu kule ngqungquthela eyayiseThekwini.Emva kwesikhalo, uThwala nekomiti lezokhetho kwiNFP banquma ukuthi kumiswe abaholi abakhethwa engqungqutheleni kuze kube kuphothulwa uphenyo.UThwala nekomiti lezokhetho banqume ukuthi ithimba lesikhashana ebelikade lihola iNFP ngaphambi kwengqungquthela kube yilo elenza imisebenzi yeqembu ngale sikhathi kusamiswe ubuholi.UBarnes uzwakalise ukungahambisani nokumiswa kwabo, kanti ngakolunye uhlangothi uThwala yena uyahambisana nokumiswa kwabo.Encwadini yabameli ebonwe yiSolezwe, uBarnes uthe akukho emthethweni ukumiswa kwabo."Ikomiti lezokhetho kwiNFP alinawo amandla okuchitha imiphumela yengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi. Inkantolo kuphela engakwazi ukuchitha imiphumela yengqungquthela.”UBarnes uthe yena uzoqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe wokuhola iqembu."Ihhovisi likanobhala jikelele yilona okufanele libhekane nesikhalo esifakiwe. Isinqumo esingekho emthethweni esithathwe yikomiti lezokhetho kanye nehhovisi likanobhala jikelele asisho lutho kithina. Ukubuyiswa kwethimba lesikhashana ebelihola iNFP akukho emthethweni.”Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uThwala uthe uBarnes akanawo amandla okuphikisana nesinqumo sekomiti lezokhetho."Zonke izinto ezithinta ukhetho kwiNFP zisingethwe ikomiti lezokhetho kanye nehhovisi likanobhala jikelele. Njengoba sikhuluma nje abaholi abakhethwa engqungqutheleni bamisiwe kuze kuba kuphothulwa uphenyo.”UThwala uthe uzophoqeleka ukuba afake uBarnes enkantolo uma eqhubeka nokuphikisana nesinqumo sokumiswa kobuholi."Kuzongiphoqa ukuba ngiyofuna isivimbelo esizokunqanda ukuba uqhubeke nokuhamba uzibiza ngomengameli weqembu. Kungenzeka futhi ngicele inkantolo ukuba ichithe imiphumela yengqungquthela yangenyanga eyedlule.”INFP ivele iye kule ngqungquthela ibhekene nezinkinga zobuholi.Uhlangothi olwakhethwa ukuba luhole iNFP engqungqutheleni eyayingo-2019, lwayiduba ingqungquthela yangonyaka owedlule.Imiphumela yengqungquthela okwakhethwa kuyo lo buholi okwakukhona kubo nomsunguli weNFP, uNkk Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi, yahlakazwa yisinqumo senkantolo, kepha icala selidluliselwe phambili.INFP isengcupheni yokungakwazi ukungenela ukhetho lwakulo nyaka uma yehluleka ukuxazulula umbango wobuholi.

Kuthiwa ufike wabingelela, bathi ukuxoxaxoxa kancane, kwagcina kungena indaba yengoma ezohlukanisa unyaka,” kusho umthombo.Uqhuba umthombo, uthe abatholanga kahle ukuthi umufi ubehamba nayiphi ingoma, nomsolwa ngokunjalo kodwa kuvele kwacaca ukuthi umsolwa akahambisani nale ebishiwo umufi ngoba ugcine esemshaya."Umphonse amaqupha ambalwa elandelana, nomufi ebona ukuthi uyashaywa, wabuyisela ngawo naye. Kuthe uma kucaca ukuthi sebelwa okwangempela, umfowabo kamsolwa wamphosela untshumetshu,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi yiwo untshumetshu umufi agcine egwazwa ngawo inxeba elilodwa esifubeni ohlangothini lwangakwesobunxele.Umalumekazi kamufi, uNkk Nozipho Biyela, uthe nakuba bezwile ngandlebenye ukuthi bekubangwa ingoma kodwa ngeke bame ngonyawo bavume ngoba konke okwenzekile kwenzeke bengekho. Uthe bona babuye bacabanga nokuthi bebebanga ingoma (esinwayo) njengoba bobabili bebeseqenjini lengoma endaweni."Thina sifike endaweni yesigameko sekonakele, uMvelo ubesethule. Okushiwo abantu ngembangela yokufa kwakhe, asinaso isiqiniseko sakho ngoba besingekho. Umuntu owazi kahle ukuthi umbulaleleni, wuye umbulali,” kusho uNkk Biyela.Uqhube wathi bona sibashaqisile isigameko ngoba bebazi ukuthi umsolwa nomufi bangamathe nolimu."Bebezwana, bengabangani, besingakaze sikucabange ukuthi ngelinye ilanga angamenzakalisa ngalolu hlobo,” kusho uNkk Biyela.Uthe umufi nomsolwa bakhule bengabangani endaweni futhi abamazi umsolwa njengomuntu onodlame noma osebenzisa izidakamizwa.Uveze ukuthi isitolo okubulawe kuso umufi asiqhelile nekhaya, yize kunjalo, bamfice esethule umufi ngesikhathi bebizelwa endaweni yesigameko.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aseNtambanana abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-24 oyamaniswa nesigameko sokubulawa kowesilisa oneminyaka engu-25."Umufi kuthiwa ugwazwe endaweni yaseBhokisini. Umsolwa bekulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo izolo,” kusho uNetshiunda.

IWUSONGE kabi unyaka ka-2023 iNingizimu Afrika, ngesikhathi kushona umbhali wemidlalo yeshashalazi, uMbongeni Ngema. Kwathi kusakukhuzwa umhlola yavula u-2024 ngesililo ngemva kokushona koqweqwe lomthwebuli wezithombe zomzabalazo wakuleli, uPeter Magubane.Le ngqalabutho yomthwebuli edabuka eVrededorp, eGoli, idlule emhlabeni ngoMsombuluko seyineminyaka ewu-91.UMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, uthe iNingizimu Afrika, igqemeke udume lwengozi ngokuhamba emhlabeni kwalo mthwebuli ngesikhathi sokuqala konyaka okugujwa ngawo ukuphela kweminyaka ewu-30, kwatholakala inkululeko kuleli."Njengoba sibheka uhambo lwenkululeko nenqubekela phambili kwezombuso wentando yeningi kuleli, izithombe zikaPeter Magubane ziyohlale zisemqoka ekuvezeni ukuthi siphuma kuphi."Egameni likahulumeni nesizwe, ngidlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini kaMagubane, kubangani benkakha yethu nakozakwabo abagcwele umhlaba wonke jikelele. Impilo yakhe eningi uPeter Magubane ubeqongelela izithombe ngomlando womzabalazo wethu nangempilo yezwe lethu." Uthe uMagubane usebenzise ikhono lakhe lokushutha ngokuthi axoxe ngeminyaka yokuqala yokubusa kukaDkt Nelson Mandela.Ukhale esifanayo uNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko, amaSiko nezeMidlalo eGoli, uMorakane Mosupyoe, waduduza abomndeni ngemva kokuwa komuthi omkhulu.UMagubane wahlukunyezwa kakhulu ngamaphoyisa obandlululo, waboshwa, wavalelwa kwakhe ukuba anganyakazi ngenxa yezithombe ayezithwebula. Seyikhululiwe iNingizimu Afrika ngo-1994, uMagubane waqashwa njengomthwebuli osemthethweni kaMandela. Ushicilele incwadi ekuthatha ikubeke ngezithombe zezibhelu zaseSoweto, esihloko sithi June 16. UNkomose, okuyisithakazelo sakhe, uwole inqwaba yemiklomelo ngalo msebenzi wakhe. Kuyona kubalwa iLifetime Achievement Award kwiNational Press Photographers' Association (NPPA) kuma-United States International Awards. Ubuye wahlonishwa ngendondo yethusi ye-Order of Ikhamanga kwathi uNgqongqoshe wezobuCiko, amaSiko nezeMidlalo uMnuz Zizi Kodwa, wambungaza ngomklomelo weVan Topeka Af Living Legends Recognition Series (VTALLRS) nyakenye.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela kungakaziwa ukuthi ingqalabutho kwezobuntatheli izofihlwa kuphi futhi ngaluphi usuku.
UKUBAMBISANA kwamalungu omphakathi, ithimba labezimo eziphuthumayo nabatshuzi abasebenza ngaphansi kophiko lwamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku kuthele izithelo ezinhle kusindiswa ababili abebebhajwe emfuleni.Inkampani yabezimo eziphuthumayo i-IPSS Search and Rescue ikhiphe umbiko ngabantu abamuke ngemoto emfuleni ogudla ilokishi KwaDabeka ngoLwesibili ntambama.Ivideo ethunyelwe abezindaba, ikhombisa owesilisa osemotweni evule umnyango ngenhloso yokugwema ukuthi imoto ingamuki namanzi.Kusize ukuphuthuma kwabatshuzi abasebenze ngokuzinikela ukusindisa abebesemotweni ebisemfuleni obudla izindwani."Ithimba elihlanganisa uphiko lwabatakuli lwamaphoyisa kaMasipala weTheku, olwabatakuli lwamaphoyisa akwa-SAPS eThekwini, olwezicishamlilo eThekwini, i-EMRS, Netcare 911 nongcweti kwezokutakula kwi-NSRI uPaul Bevis, IPSS Ballito, uphiko lwezinhlekelele lwamaphoyisa kamasipala, uphiko olusiza umphakathi lwe-Marshall Security nabeSTART Rescue, libe nenguyazana ngokuthi kuzosetshenzwa kanjani ukuze kutakulwe laba bantu."Ngemuva kwalokho, abatshuzi banikele emanzini nesikebhe esincane beqonde ngqo emotweni ebibhajwe emfuleni,” kusho okhulumela abe-IPSS Search and Rescue uSamantha Meyrick.Leli thimba lisebenze ngempumelelo likhipha owesifazane emotweni waze wabekwa endaweni ephephile.Babuyele khona emotweni beyotakula owesilisa obesesele yedwa, ngenhlanhla naye wakhishwa engenamyocu.
BALINGANISELWA ku-39 asebeshonile ngenxa yesimo sezulu KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kushiwo okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu, uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi.UMngadi uthe kusuka ngo-Okthoba kuze kube yimanje isimo sezulu sesidlule nemiphefumulo yabangu-39 kanti emuva kwemvula yakamuva kubhekwa abahlanu abasadukile. "Abanye bebeshawa wumphezulu, abanye beminza, abanye bemuka nezimoto, abanye bedilikelwa yizindlu. Njengamanje simi kwabayisihlanu isibalo sabasabhekwa,” kusho uMngadi.Omunye osabhekwa owesilisa waseMgungundlovu okuthiwa umuke namanzi emfuleni uMsunduzi ngaseHenley Dam ngeSonto.Lona wesilisa kanye nababili abehamba nabo kuthiwa baminze ngesikhathi imoto ebebehamba ngayo imuka namanzi kulandela ukubhidlika kwebhuloho.Ngokusho kokhulumela abezimo eziphuthumayo i-IPSS Medical Rescue uKelsey-Jae Meyrick, ebebekule moto bebengumndeni.IMOTO ebihamba amalungu amathathu omndeni amuke emfuleni uMsunduzi eMgungundlovu Isithombe: IPSS Medical Rescue Uthe ngosuku lwesigameko bathole umbiko wokuthi sekukhona imoto esimuke namanzi. Uthe ngenxa yokuqinisa kwemvula nokungakhanyi ngokwanele kwendawo, ukucingwa kwabamukile kube sekuhlehliselwa uMsombuluko."NgoMsombuluko imoto igcine itholakala. Ikhishwe amalungu ombutho wamasosha, iSouth African National Defence Force khona emfuleni. Ngeshwa kutholwe izidumbu ezimbili ngaphakathi emotweni, esengane nesowesifazane, zadluliselwa emaphoyiseni,” kusho uMeyrick.Uveze ukuthi esowesilisa asikatholwa kanti izinhlaka ezehlukene okukhona kuzo i-IPSS Search and Rescue, Port Shepstone SAPS Search and Rescue, START Rescue, Metro Police Search and Rescue neMi7 basaqhubeka nokucinga.Khonamanjalo, eSundumbili eMandeni, kutakulwe isidumbu somfana oneminyaka eyisikhombisa ngalo iSonto.Lo mfana uminze emfuleni iNembe ngesikhathi ezama ukuwela.Mayelana nalesi sigameko, uMeyrick uthe uphiko lwabo lweSearch and Rescue kanjalo nabeRural Metro Fire Department abafike endaweni yesigameko ngokuphazima kweso, bafike basithola isidumbu somfana ngesikhathi becinga.Isolezwe libuye lathola nokuthi iNdwedwe nayo ayisalanga ngaphandle ezindaweni ezikhahlamezekile njengoba kuthinteke imigwaqo eyehlukene kule ndawo, isikole iSogodi Primary, imizi nengqalasizinda kagesi.IMeya yaseNdwedwe, uMnuz Sam Mfeka, ithe alinganiselwa kwayisikhombisa ama-ward akhahlamezekile. Kuwona uthe kuthinteke kakhulu ingqalasizinda efana nemigwaqo, ekagesi kanjalo nezindlu ezidilikile.Uthe bamatasa baqoqa imininingwane ngesibalo esiqondile sabakhahlamezekile, nokho wathi akubanga khona muntu olimalayo noma oshonayo.Uthe seluqalile ukuhanjiswa nosizo oludingwa abakhahlamezekile.UNgqongqoshe wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi ukuqinisekisile ukuthi isibalo sabadlule ngemvula enamandla ngosuku olwandulela uNcibijane simi kwabathathu, wabe esedlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini elahlekelwe yizihlobo.Uveze ukuthi kule mvula yakamumva, zimbili izifunda ezikhahlamezeke kakhulu, okunguMgungundlovu neLembe."Ngaphansi koMgungundlovu kumuke abathathu ngesikhathi imvula enamandla icekela ibhuloho elinqamula kule ndawo kwagcina kumuka imoto ebihamba abathathu. EMandeni kumuke oyedwa, kwaphinde kwakhahlamezeka nemizi eminingi nemigwaqo,” kusho uNkk Sithole-Moloi, othe amathimba abo ezinhlekelele ajutshwe kulezi zindawo ayobheka umonakalo.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, eMnambithi kusaqhubeka ukucingwa kwabantu abamuka namanzi ngosuku olwandulela uKhisimusi. KUFE oyedwa, kwalimala abane kushayisana mahlanze izimoto ezimbili kuR74 ngaKwaDukuza ngoMsombuluko.Okhulumela abezimo eziphuthumayo, i-IPSS Medical Rescue, uKelsey-Jae Meyrick uthe ngokombiko abawutholile, kushayisane izimoto ezimbili ebezihamba ngesivinini esiphezulu.ENYE yezimoto ezishayisane mahlanze kuR74 ngaKwaDukuza Isithombe: IPSS Medical Rescue"Ngeshwa umuntu oyedwa ushonele endaweni yesigameko emva kokuthi etholwe ebambeke ngaphakathi kweyodwa yezimoto ebezihlafazeke kakhulu,” kusho uMeyrick.Uqhube wathi uphiko lwabo lwe-Advanced Life Support luphinde lwanika izingane ezimbili, kuzona obekukhona nencane kakhulu, usizo lokuqala njengoba nazo bezilimele kabi."Ezinye iziguli ezimbili zibe nemihuzuko engatheni, zona zinikwe usizo ngabe-EMRS,” kusho uMeyrick.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe amaphoyisa aKwaDukuza aphenya icala lokubulala ngokungenhloso kulandela ingozi lapho kushayisane khona izimoto ezimbili emgwaqweni uR74."Omunye wabebephakathi kulezi zimoto ushonele endaweni yesigameko, kwathi abanye balimala,” kusho uNetshiunda.
AKUNGABAZEKI ukuthi lo nyaka uzoqala ngezinkinga ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njengoba nezinhlangano zezitshudeni zikuvezile ukuthi uma izikhalazo zazo zingalungiswa, nakanjani kuzoshuba.Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi minyaka yonke kuba neziteleka ezehlukene ezithinta indaba yokuxhaswa yisikhwama iNational Students’ Financial Aid Scheme. Akugcini ngezoxhaso kodwa nendaba yezindawo zokuhlala izitshudeni, kuhlale kuyindaba egudwini. Izitshudeni zazikhala ngokushiywa ngaphandle kwalabo abaziwa nge-missing middle, abazali babo abathathwa njengabahola kakhulu ngakho abakwazi ukuthola uxhaso.Ukuze uxhaswe kudingeka ukuthi abazali bakho bahole ngaphansi kukaR350 000 ngonyaka.Kube neziteleka ezikhungweni ezehlukene, ezinye zazo kwacekelwa phansi ngokushiswa kwengqalasizinda ebalulekile.Ezikhungweni osekufana nesiko ukuthi kuyabhikishwa kuzona, iDUT, UKZN, Wits, UCT nezinye.E-UKZN ophikweni lwaseMgungundlovu kwashiswa ihholo. Obekukhalisa izitshudeni uhlelo olusha lokukhokhwa kwemihlomulo yezitshudeni. Bezikhala nangendawo yokuhlala, ukuphucwa uxhaso kozakwabo abanye okwatholakala ukuthi kwakungafanele ukuthi baluthole.Le mihlomulo ibikhokhwa yizinkampani ezine, ezigcine ziphucwa umsebenzi yiNSFAS emva kokuba kutholakale ukuthi obeyisikhulu esiphezulu salesi sikhwama, uMnuz Andile Nongogo, waba nesandla ngesikhathi kukhethwa enye yezinkampani.UNongogo wagcina ekhonjwe indlela ngabaphathi balesi sikhwama emuva kophenyo lwabameli abazimele abathola ukuthi kukhona okungahambanga kahle ngesikhathi kuqokwa ezinye zalezi zinkampani.Okunye obekukhalisa izitshudeni ukuphuza ukuphendula kweNSFAS ngalabo abaxhasiwe kanjalo nalabo abebelinde izimpendulo emuva kokukhalaza ngokungaxhaswa.Inhlangano yamanyuvesi, i-Universities South Africa, ikhalile ngesikalo sikaR45 000 ngonyaka sokukhokhela indawo yokuhlala.Le nhlangano yakhala ngokuthi ezinye zalezi zikhungo zibiza kakhulu ngakho le mali incane. I-NSFAS yakhala ngokuthi ayinayo enye imali yokuthi chatha ngaphezu kwalesi sikalo.Nenhlangano yamakolishi amakhono, iSouth African Public Colleges Organisation, yakhala ngokuhamba kancane kohlelo lokubuyisa izimpendulo kweNSFAS kulabo abasuke befake izikhalazo ngoxhaso.NoNgqongqoshe weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha, uDkt Blade Nzimande, wahlaba ikhwelo kulesi sikhwama ukuthi sisheshe siphendule kungaze kusuke izibhelu izitshudeni sezibhikisha zikhala ngokuhamba kancane kwalolu hlelo.Nenhlangano emele imikhandlu yezitshudeni, iSouth African Union of Students, yanxusa ukuthi labo abachithwayo ekutheni bathole uxhaso kumele basheshe baphendulwe kungaze kulindwe umzuzu wokugcina bese kuyima bephendulwa.Le nhlangano ibisho lokhu emuva kokuvulwa kohlelo lokufakwa kwezicelo zoxhaso kulesi sikhwama, okuqale ngenyanga edlule.Lolu hlelo luzovalwa ngoJanuwari 31 kulo nyaka.UNzimande umemezele ukuthi ngo-2024 luzoqala uhlelo lokuxhaswa kwe-missing middle, kodwa okukhalisa abaningi indaba yokuthi singase sehle isibalo sabaxhaswayo, njengoba kulo nyaka beyisigidi abaxhaswe yiNSFAS. Ibamba lesikhulu esiphezulu seNSFAS, uMnuz Masile Ramorwesi, sisanda kudalulela ikomiti lezemfundo ePhalamende ukuthi zibalelwa ku-87 000 izitshudeni ezingase zingalutholi uxhaso ngenxa yokunqanyulwa kwesabelomali somnyango.Lokhu kuthukuthelise izinhlangano zezitshudeni eziveze ukuthi kuzosuka umsindo uma ngempela kugcina kwenzeka lokhu ngoba kumele ngabe siyandiswa isibalo sabaxhaswayo kunokuthi sehliswe.Izitshudeni zifuna kunyuswe nemihlomulo eziyithola nyanga zonke kwiNSFAS kanjalo kuphinde kube namahhovisi alesi sikhwama kuzona zonke izifundazwe ukuze kube lula ukufaka izikhalazo.Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma sekuvulwa emanyuvesi, umsindo uzosuka njengoba emancane amathuba okuthi umnyango neNSFAS bahlangabezane nalezi zimfuno.

LIBOSHIWE iphoyisa okuthiwa lidubule labulala umuntu obekade esendleleni eyothenga ugesi egaraji eliseSomerset West, eCape Town.Kubikwa ukuthi isigameko senzeke emgwaqweni uR44 ngabo-3 entathakusa ngoLwesibili.Iphoyisa eliboshiwe bekulindeleke ukuthi livele eNkantolo yeMantshi yakuleya ndawo ngoLwesithathu.Okhulumela uphiko oluqaphe izenzo zamaphoyisa, i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate (Ipid), uMnuz Phaladi Shuping, uthe iphoyisa libekwe amacala okungelokubulala, elokutholakala nezinhlamvu nelokushaya.UShuping uthe kuyasolakala ukuthi abantu abane, okungabesilisa ababili nabesifazane ababili, bebekade behamba emgwaqweni uR44. NJENGOBA kuphela unyaka nje, abantu abangamalungu ezitokofela bahleka bodwa ngoba bathole inzuzo enhle ezitokofeleni ebebezidlala. Abanye bayakhala ngoba izithukuthuku zabo zonyaka wonke zemuke namanzi ngenxa yokuqolwa.Izitokofela kuleli zilima indima ebalulekile emnothweni ngoba abantu bazisungulela izidingo ezingefani kusukela ekuthengeleni imindeni ukudla nezibiliboco zangamaholidi kaDisemba, ukubeka imali yokuthenga umfaniswano wesikole wezingane, ukuthengisana izimpahla zokwakha, izimpahla zasendlini, izimoto kwesinye isikhathi kubekiswane imali yokuqala amabhizinisi.UMnuz Andrew Lukhele usihlalo weNational Stokvel Association of South Africa esungulwe ngo-1998, uthi izitokofela phambilini bezingavumelekile, ababezidlala bebengakwazi ukuvula ama-akhawunti ezitokofela ngoba amabhange abengakholelwa kuzo futhi ebona sengathi zizoncintisana nawo. Enye inkinga kwakungukuthi zazeyamaniswa nepolitiki ngoba kwakungahlukaniseki phakathi komhlangano wesitokofela nowepolitiki kanti ngalezo zikhathi kwakungavumelekile ukuhlangana kwabantu. "Izitokofela zokuqala ezasungulwa, zazisungulwe ukuthengisana imfuyo njengoba igama lisho lithi, 'stock fall’. Abantu bokuqala abebesidlala babesizana ukuze bathenge imfuyo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu basuka emakhaya bayosebenza ezimayini, abanye baze bashonele khona. Kulapho kwaqala khona kwaba noshintsho endleleni ezidlalwa ngayo; kwaba khona abadlala izitokofela zokuthi bakwazi ukungcwaba izihlobo ezishonele ezimayini ngesizotha. ONGOTI bathi abantu bangaqhubeka nokudlala izitokofela zokudla kodwa kumele bengeze imali kwazise ukudla sekumba kakhulu eqolo"Ngokuhamba kwezikhathi kwashintsha, kwabekwa imali yokuthenga ukudla inyama nezinye izinto ezidingeka ngesikhathi kungamaholidi. Manje sekushintshe kakhulu, izitokofela sezithuthukile nezinhloso zazo nazo sezithuthukile," kusho uLukhele.UMnuz Bulelani Balabala wenhlangano ethuthukisa osomabhizinisi, iTownship Entreprenuer Developer, uthe abasungula amabhizinisi abangakwazi ukuboleka imali emabhange kuyenzeka bahlangane bathengisane imishini, izimoto nezinye izinto abazidingayo ukuze basebenze."Amatekisi amaningi athengwa ngemali yezitokofela ezidlalwa ngabanikazi bamatekisi. Kuya ngokuthi abahlangene babe namuphi umbono. Abanye bahlanganisa imali banike umuntu oyedwa ngenyanga athenge into ayifunayo, abasebenzayo abayibiza ngomholiswano, abanye basuke befuna izinto ezifanayo. Bavumelana ngesikhathi abazobeka ngaso imali kancane kancane ize ihlangene, bakwazi ukuthenga lokho abavumelene ngakho. "Izitokofela zamanje ezinye zibizwa ngama-Crowd Fundings. Ziyasiza kakhulu kulabo abacwile ezikweletini nalabo abangakwazi ukuboleka isamba esikhulu emabhange ngoba amabhange asebenzisa amaphuzu athile ukuze akuboleke imali," kusho uBalabala.Uthi ezinye izitokofela zinamaphepha emigomo ebhalwe phansi ezinye zinezivumelwano zomlomo kuphela kuya ngosayizi, inhloso yaso nokuthi imalini ebekwayo futhi ibekwa kuphi.ULukhule uthe ukudlala isitokofela kutshala umkhuba omuhle ofundisa ukonga imali ngoba ayibekeki uma uwedwa futhi kuba lula ukuyikhipha uma kwenzeka kuvela isimo esithile."Kulinganiselwa ekutheni imali ebekwa ngabangamalungu ezitokofela kuleli inguR50 Billion ngonyaka. Leso isilinganiso nje ngoba amanye amalungu ezitokofela namanje awakayigcini emabhange imali yawo ngenxa yomlando wazo izitokofela nokuthi abanye babolekisa ngayo. Bangaphezulu kuka-800 000 abantu abangalungu ezitokofela ezibhalisiwe, lesi sibalo siyazi ukuthi singaphansi kwesibalo sangempela," kusho uLukhele.UNksz Winisile Kunene uthe udlala izitokofela eziningi kuso kukhona esibekelwe ukuzijabulisa asidlala nozakwabo emsebenzini. Babeka uR50 njalo ngesonto ngoba bahola ngesonto.UNksz Sizile Khumalo uthe bengabangani abahlanu baqala ukubeka imali ndawonye besasebenza ndawonye sekuphele iminyaka ewu-15 bonga ndawonye"Saqala ngoR500 ngenyanga, uma sithole ibhonasi sibeke uR1 000. Inhloso yethu kwakungukuzakhela umnotho, uma sibona ithuba sithatha ingxenye yemali sithenge amasheya noma siyitshale kwenye indawo. Kule minyaka sibeka ndawonye sisayikhiphe kanye, sakhipha uR60 000 umuntu ngamunye senza izinto ezihlukene, abanye balungisa imizi, bakhokhela izimoto nokunye," kusho yena.
LO nyaka ube ngomunye weminyaka okugobhoze kakhulu igazi ezindaweni ezehlukene zesifundazwe iKwaZulu-Natal.Kuchitheke igazi labesifazane ababeyizisulu zobugebengu obuyisihluku kodwa osebejwayelekile, kwathi kwezinye izigameko bazithola belahlekelwa imiphefumulo yabo ngesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa ngokobulili.Phakathi kwazo kwaba ngesokubulawa kukaNksz Sindi Ncanana (28) wakwa-H, eMlaza, wagwazwa, wanqunywa.Isidumbu sakhe satholwa ngo-Okthoba, sigqitshwe ethuneni elingashoni eduze komjondolo ohlala isoka lakhe.Umndeni wakhe wawukade umgcine ngoJulayi, ezolandwa ngodli isoka lakhe. Isolezwe ngaleso sikhathi lathola ukuthi umndeni wakhe uqale ukusukuma emva kwezinyanga ezimbili, umbona engabuyi ekhaya, engashayi nocingo, naye engathinteki.Kwezinye kubonakale kubulawa ngesihluku amalungu ezinhlaka eziqapha ubugebengu emphakathini emalokishini ikakhulukazi lawo akhele iTheku; okuyiNanda, Ntuzuma, KwaMashu noMlaza.Zilinganiselwa ku-12 izigameko okubikwe ngazo zokubulawa kwalaba ebebethenjiwe ngokuba sekhaleni lempi yobugebengu.Esakamumva, kube esokubulawa kukaMnuz Mnakiseni Mngadi (50) ngo-Okthoba, eBhambayi, eNanda.UMngadi uhlaselelwe kwakhe ngemvula yezinhlamvu.Kubuye kwabonakala amaphoyisa eqotha imbokodo nesisekelo ezigebengwini ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule.Phakathi kwezinye izigameko; kwaba esenzeka kwa-B KwaMashu, lapho amaphoyisa alalisa uyaca ezigebengwini ezinhlanu.Zazisolwa ngokuba ngongqondongqondo ekubanjweni inkunzi izimoto zemali, nakho okuke kwabonakala kudla lubi eThekwini, ezinyangeni ezedlule.Esinye isigameko esishaqishayo kwaba yileso sokushaqwa komnikazi wejoyinti ngoMashi, nonyaka, okuthiwa wayethume owesilisa waseBhukhanana, eMpangeni, ukuthi ayobulala umuntu abuye nekhanda lakhe. Lona wesilisa wagcina ebanjwa nengalo kamufi ongumakhelwane wakhe. Umufi, uMnuz Joseph Mchunu (58) kuthiwa wahlaselwa ngumsolwa wesilisa ebuya kophuza, wamnquma uqhoqhoqho, wabuye wamjumpula nengalo.Kuphinde kwabonakala ukwanda kwezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu bomndeni owodwa kanyekanye. Kulezo kukhona nesase-Unit 14, eMbali, eMgungundlovu ngo-Ephreli, lapho kwadutshulwa kwabulawa khona abayishumi bomndeni owodwa. Kubona kwakukhona nowesifazane owayezithwele nowesifazane owayephila nokukhubazeka, ehamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo.Khona eMgungundlovu, KwaMpande, kwaphinde kwangqongqiswa amaphara ayishumi ngoMeyi. Laba bahlaselwa ngabantu abangaziwa endlini eyase iphenduke isidleke sewunga kule ndawo. Abafi babesolwa ngokuba wuhlupho emphakathini ngobugebengu.Ukubulawa komculi u-AKA nomngani wakhe eThekwini, kuFlorida Road ngoFebhuwari, kwaba indaba egudwini kanti kuze kube manje akekho oseboshiwe. Isihlava sokubulawa kwamakhansela naso sibonakale siqhubeka eKZN nonyaka, kwaze kwaba bokusola ukuthi umthelela wakho ukubuswa ngokubambisana komasipala njengoba uma kushone ikhansela kuvela ithuba lokuthi kube nokhetho lokuchibiyela. Esigamekweni sakamuva, kudutshulwe uSotswebhu we-DA kuMasipala uMngeni esemzini wakhe, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu. Amakhosi nezinduna nabo bebesocongwa nokwaze kwaphoqa uhulumeni waseKZN ukuthi aqhamuke nezindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabaholi bendabuko impilo yabo esengcupheni kubalwa uhlelo lokubabiyela imizi nokufaka amalambu akhanyisa bha.

Bayisithupha abantu abangakatholakali abasafunwa,” kusho uMngadi.Uqhube wathi luyaqhubeka uhlelo lwabo lokutakula olwenziwa abatshuzi abavela ezinhlakeni ezehlukene eMnambithi.UMngadi uthe umphathiswa womnyango udlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini eshonelwe ngalesi sikhathi.Uthe uhulumeni uzibophezele ukweseka yonke imindeni okuhlanganisa nokululeka ngokwengqondo labo abashonelwe."Uhulumeni uzongenelela nangesikhathi kwenziwa izinhlelo zokungcwaba abashonile. KUBATSHAZWA isihluku sowesilisa wakwa-A KwaMashu okuthiwa unqume uqhoqhoqho intombi yakhe ngemuva kwengxabano esuke beseBridge City.Kuthiwa uSphesihle Mthembu (28) ubulawe ngesihluku ngempelasonto, yisoka lakhe leminyaka Isolezwe elinawo amagama alo kodwa eliwagodlile ngoba alikakaveli enkantolo.Ilungu lomndeni, elicele ukuba kugodlwe igama lalo, lilandisa Isolezwe ngakho konke okwenzekile libabaze isihluku abulawe ngaso umufi. "Indlela abulawe ngayo ibuhlungu kakhulu,'' lisho kanje.Lithe uthuthuva phakathi kwalaba ababili lususwe ukuthi umufi ushayele ucingo owesilisa athandana naye emcela ukuba amphuthumisele izingane ezimbili zamantombazane eBridge City ngoba ufuna ukuziluka amakhanda ngaphambi kokuba baye emakhaya KwaHlabisa.Leli lungu lomndeni lithe nebala lo wesilisa wenze njalo, wathatha izingane ezimbili zamantombazane waya nazo lapho okuthiwa akaziyise khona.Lidalule ukuthi ingane eyodwa yentombazane eneminyaka engu-13 ngeyabo bobabili, umfana oneminyaka emihlanu ngokamufi amthola kwenye indoda."Ngesikhathi seyifikile indoda kube nokuxabana okukhulu phakathi kwabo kodwa akekho owaziyo ukuthi bebebangani. Baxabane kakhulu indoda yaze yasola umufi ngokuthi umbukanisa nabantu,'' kuchaza leli lungu lomndeni.Lithe indoda inengekile yahamba yamshiya umufi nezingane yayomlinda enkundleni yezemidlalo eseduze nalapho abahlala khona.Ilungu lomndeni lithi kuvela ukuthi umufi uqhamuke kule ndawo ehamba yedwa, izingane zisele ngemuva."Lo wesilisa uvele wamngenela ngenduku wamshaya ikhanda laze laba mabokoboko. Ngemuva kwalokho kuthe uma ebona ukuthi akafi wabe esemnquma uqhoqhoqho ngommese,'' lisho kanje.Lithe ngenhlanhla ngesikhathi lo wesilisa enza yonke lento bekukhona owesilisa obedlula obonile konke obekwenzeka wase eyababikela ukuthi ubani obulele umufi.Ngemuva kokuba lo owesilisa embulele lo wesifazane uzamile ukubaleka kodwa amaphoyisa agcina embambile ambopha.Liveze ukuthi laba bobabili bebehlala ndawonye ehostela KwaMashu."Laba bese benesikhathi eside kakhulu bethandana kodwa iqiniso ukuthi udadewethu ubehlukumezekile kakhulu kulolu thando. Nathi asazi ukuthi kungani ebengafuni ukuphuma kulona,'' echaza.Liveze ukuthi umufi waze wakhulelwa ingane yenye indoda ngenxa yakho ukungaphatheki kahle othandweni.Kodwa uthi izinto babuye bazilungisa babuyelana.Iselula kamufi nemali bekungasekho.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, usiqinisekisile isigameko. Uthe amaphoyisa aKwaMashu abophe owesilisa onemiminyaka engu-34 ngecala lokubulala owesifazane emgwaqweni uKhowa.
KUBULAWE amakhansela angu-18 kwangu-40 ashonile KwaZulu-Natal, kusuka ngoNovemba 2021. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi inhlangano yohulumeni basekhaya esifundazweni, South Africa Local Government Association (Salga), inesithangami sabezindaba.USihlalo weSalga eKZN, uMnuz Thami Ntuli, uveze ukuthi ukusocongwa kwamakhansela yiyona ndlela ehamba phambili eyimbangela yokushona kwawo esifundazweni. Uveze ukuthi kulawa makhasela angu-40 ashone kusuka ngoNovemba 2021, angu-17 ashone ngokwemvelo, amathathu ashone ngezingozi zezimoto kanti amabili azibulele. Uveze ukuthi kule minyaka emibili, ezweni kuvalwe izikhala zamakhansela angu-167 kanti angu-40% kuwo bekungamakhansela ama-ward bese kuthi u-60% bekungamakhansela amele amaqembu awo.Uthe iKZN ibheke odlameni lwezepolitiki nodlame lwamaqembu epolitiki ngisho lwangaphakathi emaqenjini.Uthe kwesinye isikhathi kusetshenziswa ukucekelwa phansi kwempahla nodlame ukusabisa abaphathi bomasipala namakhansela ukuthi bavume izimfuno zangaphandle. Ephawula ngemibiko yezezimali komasipala, uthe abanye omasipala benze kangcono emibikweni yoMcwaningi maBhuku onyekeni obuphela ngoJuni 2023.UNtuli uthe abanikazi bemizi basebenzisa yonke imali ukukhokhela izikweletu zemizi kanti bakhathazekile ngokunyuka nokungehli kwama-interest rates. Uthe ukunyuswa kwawo kunomthelela ongemuhle komasipala ngoba kwenza kube nzima ukuthi bahlinzeke ngezidingo nokuthi bakhokhele abasebenzisana nabo.
UYAQHUBEKA umkhankaso wamaphoyisa wokuphepha nokuvikela izakhamuzi ngamaholidi okuphela konyaka osuvundulule nezigelekeqe ebekade zifunwa uthuli.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kuzwelonke, uBrigadier Athlenda Mathe, uthe baqinise nesandla ekunqandeni izingozi zomgwaqo ngezivimbamgwaqo abanazo ezithe chithi saka.Ngokwezibalo zoMnyango wezokuThutha kuzwelonke, bangaphezu kuka-700 abashone ezingozini zomgwaqo esikhathini esingamasonto amathathu kuDisemba 2023.Kusukela ngoDisemba 22, amaphoyisa abophe abashayeli abangu-2 500 abebephuzile. Esikhathini esifanayo bangu-850 abantu ababoshelwe ukudlonya ezikaFaro bese besusa uthuthuva emphakathini."Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imoto esemgwaqweni ikulungele nokuthi umshayeli wayo usesimweni esamukelekile. Sibophe abebeshayela bephuzile abangu-4 488 kusuka ngo-Okthoba 15,” kusho uBrig Mathe.Mayelana nokutshalwa kwamaphoyisa ngoNcibijane, uthe bayazi ukuthi yisikhathi esiphithizela kakhulu ngakho zizoqiniswa ezokuphepha.Uthe izakhamuzi nabavakashi kumele bazizwe bephephile uma besenxanxatheleni yezitolo nasemgwaqweni.Ukhiphe isixwayiso kwabahweba utshwala ngokungemthetho ethi bazozalelwa yinja endlini."Izidakamizwa notshwala yizona ezinomthelela omkhulu ezenzweni zobugebengu obuyingozi. Yingakho sizoqina isandla ekulweni nesihlava sobugebengu banoma yiluphi uhlobo,” usho kanje.Uthe amaphoyisa asebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izinhlaka zezokuphepha emphakathini.Ube esenxenxa abantu ukuba bahlale beqaphile futhi basebenze ngokubambisana namaphoyisa ekusabalaliseni ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuliwe nobugebengu ngempumelelo.Kuphinde kwaxwayiswa abahweba ngeziqhumane nabantu abazobe bezisebenzisa ukuba abakwenzayo bakwenze ngokukhulu ukuqikelela nokucophelela.UBrig Mathe unxenxe abazali nabanakekeli bezingane ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayazigada uma zisebenzisa iziqhumane.Amaphoyisa athi umkhankaso wawo ulwa nokungena eNingizimu Afrika kwabofika abangenazo izincwadi ezibagunyaza ukuba kuleli futhi baqinisa ezokuphepha emingceleni yezwe besebenzisana namasosha, uMnyango wezaseKhaya nabanye.Bangu-11 000 abokufika asebeboshelwe ukuba kuleli nokungemthetho. Baxhakathiswe ezinxanxatheleni zezitolo, ezivimbamgwaqweni, emarenki nakwezinye izindawo.Sebebonke bangu-75 000 abantu ababoshwe ngamaphoyisa kusuka ngo-Okthoba. Abawu-500 ngamacala okubulala, abangu-604 ngawokuzama ukubulala, kuthi abangu-470 ngawokudlwengula. Abantu abangu-6 700 baboshelwe amacala okushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza. Ababoshelwe amacala okuzama ukugqekeza bangu-408 kwathi abangu-561 baboshelwa ukutholakala nezibhamu nezinhlamvu okungekho emthethweni.
KUNGENE kwelinye igiya ukukhulelwa kwezingane ezingakavuthwa ukuba ngomama njengoba ubufakazi buhlale obala ngamantombazane abelethe ngosuku lukaKhisimusi nonyaka. Abasebenza nezingane bathi asibethusi isibalo esiphezulu samantombazane amancane abelethe ngoKhisimusi kodwa ongoti bezempilo bathi mkhulu umonakalo ongadaleka ngenxa yokuthi imizimba yezingane ezibelethayo isuke ingakabi sezingeni elilungele ukubeletha nokukhulisa abantwana.Ngokwezibalo zakamuva zezingane ezizalwe ngoKhisimusi ezikhishwe uMnyango wezeMpilo zingu-1 708, kuzo ezingu-145 onina baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 kuya kwengu-18.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMpilo kuleli, uMnuz Foster Mohale, uthe isibalo esiphezulu samantombazane amancane abelethe ngoKhisimusi siyakhathaza futhi sikhomba ukuthi aqale ukuya ocansini esemancane kakhulu njengoba ebelethe enale minyaka anayo."Omama abasebancane imizimba yabo isuke ingakakulungeli ukuthi ithwale izingane. Ngenxa yalokhu kuyenzeka babelethe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, bahlushwe isifo sokwehla nokwenyuka komfutho wegazi okudala izinkinga uma sebebeletha nezinye izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo uma sekumele banakekele izingane," kusho uMohale.UNkk Ayanda Khumalo Gwaji wehlangano egqugquzela ukuziphatha ezinganeni, iphinde inakekele izingane ezizalwa emindenini empofu nezizalwe zinegciwane lengculazi, iSiza Commmunity Care, uthe asethusi lesi sibalo ngoba izingane zamanje ziqala ukuya ocansini zineminyaka eyishumi."Esikutholayo thina esisebenza nezingane ukuthi amantombazane kuyenzeka kube nabantu abadala abawajwayeza ucansi bewanukubeza esemancane, aze ajwayele ukuya ocansini bese kuba yiwo enza izinto ezithile ebafaneni abawontanga ezizobaheha ukuze baye ocansini nawo ngoba asuke eselujwayele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuzalwa emndenini ompofu kunomthelela wokuthi intombazane igcine iziphonse ebafaneni ukuze ithole izinto ezinhle," kuchaza uNkk Gwaji.Uqhube wathi: "Kulo nyaka ngokubambisana noDkt Maud Mthembu wophiko olubhekele izifundo zenhlalakahle yomphakathi, eNyuvesi yaKwaZulu- Natal, sethule incwadi ebizwa ngokuthi Ibhengela lesithembiso, ekhuluma ngamantombazane amabili aneminyaka ewu-14 afunda esikoleni samabanga aphezulu. Enye iseyintombi nto enye isinengane, sibheka izinkinga ezihlangabezana nenengane.”Uqhube wathi izinhlelo abanazo ziluleka abafana namantombazane hhayi amantombazane kuphela ngoba baqonde ukwakha abafana namantombazane abazokwazi ukuthatha izinqumo eziyizo ngempilo yabo, bangajahi ukuya ocansini.UMphathiswa wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, uthe: "Mhlawumbe njengomphakathi sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi sibuyekeze izinkolelo nemikhuba yethu uma kuza ezindabeni ezithinta ucansi, ngoba le ndlela yamanje ayisasebenzi.”Unxuse abazali nabanakekeli ukuthi bayeke ukubheka ucansi njengento "engamukelekile’ ."Kungcono sikujwayele ukukhuluma nezingane zethu ngalo. Asigqugquzele ukuzithiba kodwa sazi ukuthi akuzona zonke ezizokwenza lokho. Asikhulume nazo ngokusetshenziswa kwamakhondomu, kanye nokugwema ukukhulelwa," kusho uNksz Simelane.UDkt Maud Mthembu ongumbhali wencwadi, Ibhengela lesithembiso, ucashunwe kweminye imithombo yezindaba, ethi ukukhulelwa usemncane kudala izinkinga emphakathini, akugcini ngezinkinga zezempilo kuphela. "Ukuba nengane emncane kugcina sekuthinta impilo yakho yonke okuba ukufunda, kwesinye isikhathi nayo ingane ayondleki ngendlela. Kuyenzeka ukuthi naye umama osemncane ukhuliswe ugogo kuba umthwalo ophindekile uma naye eseletha umntwana emhlabeni," kusho uDkt Mthembu.UNkk Precious Ndlela wenhlangano ehlola izintombi, iHlalangentombi, uthe ukuhlolwa kwezintombi okuhambisana nokwelulekwa ngezinto ezithinta ucansi kungenye yezinto ezisiza ekutheni intombazane izigcine, ingayi ocansini ize ikhule ngokwenele. Ngokwezibalo zaseKZN, ngoKhisimusi kuzalwe izingane ezingu-235, okungamantombazane angu-114 kanye nabafana abangu-141. Kulezi zingane kukhona amawele amane. Komama abasebancane abangu-49, abayisithupha baneminyaka engu-15, abathathu baneminyaka engu-16, abangu-11 baneminyaka engu-17, abanye abangu-11 baneminyaka engu-18 kanti abangu-18 baneminyaka engu-19.
SIKHALELWE ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoKhisimusi isangoma saKwaMakhutha esisolwa ngokudlwengula size sikhulelise ithwasa.Lo wesilisa, Isolezwe elinawo amagama akhe kodwa elingeke lize liwadalule okwamanje, kuvela ukuthi uyisangoma esaziwayo endaweni.Kuthiwa amaphoyisa asingenele ekuseni isangoma asilanda ayosivalela. Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo olazi ukusuka nokuhlala udaba."Isangoma silandwa nje, bese kuphele izinyanga ezintathu litetile ithwasa leli okuthiwa lisivulele icala lokusidlwengula,” kusho umthombo.Leli thwasa kuvela ukuthi lineminyaka engu-18. Kuthiwa lashiya phansi isikole ukuze liyophothula ubungoma.Kuvela ukuthi isangoma besilala ngenkani nethwasa selokhu lafika esigodlweni salo eminyakeni emibili eyedlule.Ngokusho komthombo, bekungelula ukuba ithwasa liyiveze le ndaba ngenxa yokuthi isangoma singumuntu osatshwayo kakhulu endaweni.Umthombo uthe indaba ize yavela ngemuva kokuba ithwasa libhale kwiFacebook ngakho konke okwenzekile ngemuva kokuba seliqede ukuteta."Ngikutshela ukuthi ngabe akakabanjwa lo bhuti ukuba ithwasa alizange libe nesibindi sokuthi liyobhala kwiFacebook ngakho konke okwenzekile,'' kuchaza umthombo.Uqhuba umthombo, uthe isangoma sizame kaningi ukuyovala umlomo umgilwa ngemali kodwa kwanhlanga zimuka nomoya."Ingane bese ikhathele ukuba yisigqila socansi salesi sangoma. Yingakho nje ibone ukuthi kuhle imane iliphalaze lonke iqiniso,'' usho kanje.Isolezwe likhulume noNkk Sthe Mavela ongumphathi wabelaphi bendabuko esiyingini saKwaMakhutha.Uthe kubaphathe kabi kakhulu abakuzwile ngoba kudicilela phansi igama labo njengabelaphi bendabuko."Izigameko ezinjengalesi kakumele zenzeke. Okubuhlungu kakhulu zidweba isithombe esingesihle nje impela ngathi belaphi bendabuko,'' kusho uNkk Mavela.Uthe uzwile ngalesi sigameko wathi utholile nokuthi isangoma siboshiwe ngoKhisimusi.Uthe kakade vele izangoma ezenze amahlazo alolu hlobo kumele zigqunywe esitokisini."Ayikho enye indlela, izangoma ezibandakanyeka ezintweni ezifana nalezi kumele ziboshwe,'' usho kanje.Owesifazane osondelene nomgilwa wale waphetha ukuphawula ngesigameko, wathi njengomndeni abakathandi ukukhuluma ngaso.Kodwa uvumile ukuthi senzekile.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, usiqinisekisile isigameko.Uthe kunecala lokudlwengula elivulwe emaphoyiseni aKwaMakhutha."Ukuvulwa kwaleli cala kulandela ukudlwengulwa kwentombazane eneminyaka engu-18,'' usho kanje.
