Lo mlisa uphuthunyiswe esibhedlela ukuze athole usizo lokuqala.Kulokhu, amaphoyisa aphenya icala lokubulala.
KUBOSHWE isalukazi sabekwa icala lokuhweba ngezidakamizwa erenki yamatekisi yaseSweetwaters, eMgungundlovu.Lo wesifazane oneminyaka engu-61, ukhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoLwesithathu.Kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMgungundlovu ngoLwesine ngecala athweswe lona.Okhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo uthe amaphoyisa alunywe indlebe ngokudayiswa kwezidakamizwa okuqhubeka erenki."Amaphoyisa (oKlebe, uphiko iCrime Intelligence neTast Team yaseMgungundlovu) anikele endaweni abekade etshelwe ngayo afica umsolwa ehlezi emotweni. Kube sekuseshwa imoto kwavundululwa izingcezu zeCocaine ezingabiza uR140 000,” kuchaza uMhlongo.Uqhube wathi omunye wabasolwa ubalekile kodwa zasikhalela isalukwazi.Uthe kutholakale nemali enguR37 327 okusolakala ukuthi itholakale ngesikhathi kuthengiswa izidakamizwa.
BABESENDLELENI ebuyela ekhaya emuva kokuthi bebanjwe inkunzi emcimbini abasacingwa abamuke neveni abebehamba ngalo emfuleni oseMnambithi ngeSonto ebusuku.Lokhu kudalulwe yisihlobo sabamukile, uNkk Winnie Jooste, othe lwaba yinhlekelele kubagilwa ubusuku okwenzeka ngabo isigameko.UNkk Jooste waseRoosboom uthe abagilwa babesuka eMabhekazi ngesikhathi bewolwa amanzi achitheka emfuleni iBellspruit owawudla izindwani.Kuthiwa amanzi achithekela kuthelawayela uN11 kanti abagilwa bazozithela khona.Lo wesifazane uphawule kanje ekhuluma neziko lezindaba leSABC eMnambithi izolo."Bavelelwa inhlekelele besemotweni eyayishayelwa umalume wabo owayebabuyisela ekhaya emuva kokuthi bephangiwe. Sibe noKhisimusi omnyama, angisayiphathi-ke ekaNcibijane, yini ngempela esizobe siyenza?” kubalisa uNkk Jooste.Udalule ukuthi ngoKhisimusi bavuka ngezindaba ezimbi zokuthi izingane zikababekazi wakhe ezingu-10 zimuke nomfula.Uthe bathungatha ngalolu suku bathola izidumbu ezintathu engeza ngokuthi kwabamuka kukhona nezingane ezintathu enye ebizoqala uGrade 1 ngonyaka ozayo.Uqhube wathi kuyabalimaza ezingqondweni nasemphefumulweni ukulinda ngoba ukuhamba kwesikhathi kukhomba ukuthi hleze bangatholakali abamukile."Asikwazi nokuhlela imingcwabo yasebetholakele ekubeni kusenabantu abane abasathungathwa abangakatholakali. Sicela kwandiswe amathimba abatakuli kubhekwe izihlobo zami,” kubalisa uNkk Jooste.Izulu elimbi, imfucuza kadoti nezihlahla eziwele lapho bekuhamba khona amanzi kuthiwa zenza kubenzima ukuthola abamukile.UMphathiswa wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, uthe bangu-10 abantu osekuqinisekiswe ukuthi bashonile ngenxa yemvula ehambisana nokuduma kwezulu esifundazweni.Udalule nokuthi bangu-13 abadukile abasathungathwa futhi sebelande amathimba abatakuli baseThekwini, ePort Shepstone nakwezinye izindawo bezolekelela."Kusatholakale abantu abayisikhombisa (kule ndawo), kulesi sibalo abanye baphuma emndenini owodwa wakwaMsimango. Abathathu babo sebetholakele abanye abathathu nesihlobo basadukile,” kuchaza ungqongqoshe.Uqhube wathi abamukile bebehamba ngeveni beyisishiyagalolunye phakathi kukhona nabasemndenini wakwaMthembu.Ubalule nesigameko seFord Bantam emuke ihamba ababili kwatholakala oyedwa omunye umuntu usacingwa. Kukhona neVW Polo ebhajwe emfuleni, okutholakalale umuntu oyedwa omunye wamuka. NaseMandeni emfuleni iMasende kumuke ababili kwatholakala oyedwa.Uthe babekade bexwayisile ngale mvula eyingozi nokuthi abahlala endaweni engezansi komfula eMnambithi abathole enye indawo yokuhlala. Uthe abantu abazange basuke bethi kufinyeleleka kalula emisebenzini.
KULINDELEKE ukuthi ubaba nendodadana yakhe bavele ngoLwesithathu enkantolo yeMantshi eKlerksdorp ngamacala okweba imfuyo.Laba baboshwa ngoLwesihlanu ngemuva kokuthi amaphoyisa aqapha ubugebengu eKlerksdorp encinzwe indlebe ngemoto esolisayo elayishe imfuyo."Bese kunecala elivuliwe ngokwebiwa kwezimvu ngesikhathi amaphoyisa encinzwa indlebe ngabasolwa abahamba ngemoto elayishe izimvu. Amaphoyisa alandele umkhondo wale moto nebala kwatholwa izimvu ezinesitembu salezi okubikwe ukuthi zebiwe,” kusho uLieutenant Colonel Amanda Funani okhulumela amaphoyisa eNorth West.Abasolwa abaneminyaka engu-19 no-39 baboshwe besekhaya ngemuva kokuthi behluleke ukuchazela amaphoyisa ngemfuyo etholakale kubo."Kulo muzi bekunezimoto ezimbili egcekeni iveni iNissan 1400 ne-Toyota Conquest nazo okuthe uma kuphenywa kwatholakala ukuthi zebiwe emagaraji amabili ahlukene aseKlerksdorp ekuqaleni kwale nyanga.”
IZINYUNYANA zothisha zisola uMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal ngokungaqini kwezokuphepha ezikoleni njengoba kwanda izigameko zokuhlaselwa nokubanjwa inkunzi kothisha.Kuthiwa othisha nabafundi basesikoleni Insizwakazi Primary, esisendaweni yaseMbhedula, eMariannhill, basathuka izanya njengoba ngoMsombuluko kungene abasolwa ababili emagcekeni esikole bakhomba othisha ngezibhamu babaphuca amafoni, imali nama-laptop.Kuthiwa baqale babuza uthishomkhulu wesikole, kuthe uma kuvela ukuthi akekho, babaphoqa ukuthi babanikeze lezi zimpahla. Kwenzeka lokhu nje bekusabatshazwa isenzo sokuzama ukusoconga uthishomkhulu wesikole Indonsa High, esiseNewcastle, ngesonto eledlule, odutshulwe amahlandla amathathu kodwa waphuma engenamyocu.Inkinga yokungaphephi ezikoleni sekunesikhathi eside izinyunyana zothisha nabazali bekhala ngayo nangokuthi izikole eziningi azinabo onogada. UNobhala weSouth African Democratic Teachers Union KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomarashiya Caluza, uthe akukho nakancane ukuphepha ezikoleni."Izikole zisanda kuvulwa nje kodwa seziziningi izigameko esezibikiwe. Lokhu kuyakhathaza kakhulu ngoba uma othisha nabafundi behlaselwa kuba nzima ukufundisa nokufunda. Lolu dlame nobugebengu kulokhu kuqhubeke njalo kodwa akukho umnyango okushoyo okunikeza ithemba,” kusho uNksz Caluza.UMengameli weNational Teachers Union, uMnuz Sibusiso Malinga, uthe kuyadumaza ukuthi kuzo zonke izikhungo zikahulumeni ziqinisiwe ezokuphepha, njengoba iningi lazo ligadwa ngonogada abazimele, kodwa izikole azinakiwe."Asazi ukuthi uhulumeni ulinde ukuthi kuze kufe bani ngempela. Ngeke isikole esinabafundi abangu-1000 uthole ukuthi sigadwe ngunogada oyedwa, nakhona ongakuqeqeshelwe ukugada, umsebenzi wakhe okuwukuvula isango. Ngisho iziteshi zamaphoyisa zigadwa yizinkampani zonogada ekubeni amaphoyisa ezifundele ezokuphepha futhi enezikhali zokuzivikela kodwa kuhlukile kothisha nabafundi njengoba bona impilo yabo isengozini nsuku zonke,” kusho uMalinga.Uthe ukuqiniswa kwezokuphepha akwenzelwa nje abafundi, abasebenzi nothisha nje kuphela kodwa kungabuye kusize ekunciphiseni izinga lokuntshontshwa kwempahla yesikole njengamakhompyutha. Uthe kwesinye isikhathi othisha bayaphoqeleka ukuthi uma kuvalwa izikole baqiqinge amakhompyutha beyowagcina emizini yabo ukubalekela ukuthi ebiwe, okuyinto ebathwesa omunye umthwalo, ibeke nomsebenzi wabo engcupheni ngoba ngokomthetho ukugcina impahla yesikole endaweni yakho akuvumelekile.Kuze kwashaya isikhathi sokushicilela aboMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni bengayiphenduli imibuzo abathunyelelwe yona.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe amaphoyisa aseMariannhill aphenya icala lokubamba inkunzi."Lokhu kulandela ukuthi othisha besikole bebanjwe inkunzi ngabasolwa abangaziwa ngoMsombuluko. Kubikwe kuthi abasolwa bathathe imali, amafoni nama-laptop bashaya bachitha,” kusho uLieutenant Colonel Gwala.
LUYINZUKAZIKEYI udaba lodokotela abangamathwasa okuthiwa umnyango awubafakanga ezibhedlela ukuze baqeqeshelwe umsebenzi ekubeni kade uthe ukwenzile.Udaba, oluphume komunye umthombo wezindaba obhala izindaba zezempilo kuphela, luthe nakuba uMnyango wezeMpilo kade umemezele ukuthi odokotela abangamathwasa abazoqeqeshwa ngonyaka ozayo sebefakiwe ezikhungweni zezempilo kodwa kusenabangu-182 abasale ngaphandle kulolu hlelo.Kuthiwa kulabo dokotela kubalwa ama-Radiographer, ama-Physiotherapists, ongoti bezokudla, odokotela bamazinyo nama-Environmental health Practitioners.Kusukela ngo-1998 eNingizimu Afrika odokotela, osokhemisi abebefundela iziqu zabo baphoqelekile ukuthi benze uqeqesho-msebenzi emtholampilo noma esibhedlela sikahulumeni unyaka owodwa noma emibili ngaphambi kokuthi bathole iziqu zabo.Isitatimende seSouth African Committees of Dental Deans (SACDD) sithe ukwehliswa kwesabelomali kudale ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngekusasa lokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya.Uziphendulela kulokhu uMnyango wezeMpilo, uthumele isitatimende uthi kukhona ukushoda kwezinye izindawo kodwa umnyango uyalulungisa udaba, wathi ngokwazi kwawo odokotela okusadingeka ukuthi batholelwe izikhala odokotela bamazinyo abayisishiyagalombili, ongoti abeluleka ngokudla ukudla okunempilo abayisishiyagalombili, ama-physiotherapist angu-38 nama-Enviromental Health Practioners angu-118."Ukushoda kwezinye izindawo kubhekwana nako ngokushesha,” kugcizelela umnyango.Uqhube wathi uthole izicelo zabasebenzi bezempilo abangu-10 386, kuzo bangu-9 395 asebetholelwe izikhala.Uhlelo lokufakwa ezikhungweni kwabafundela ubudokotela sekunesikhathi lubhekene nezinkinga. NgoJulayi kuwo lo nyaka izitshudeni okwakumele zingene kulolu hlelo zihlangabezane nenkinga ngenxa yokushoda kwemali yokuzikhokhela.
USUKU okwethulwe ngalo iqembu elisha uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) Party, luqondane nosuku olwaba nzima emlandweni we-ANC ngesikhathi kuqembuka iCongress of The People (COPE). Owayengumengameli we-ANC nezwe uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ngoMgqibelo, kaDisemba 16, wenze isimemezelo esishiye abaningi bekhexile.Indida: Nakuba uZuma ememezele iqembu kodwa ushiye abaningi nemibuzo uma ethi akashiyile kwi-ANC futhi uyoze afe eyilungu layo. Uthe kodwa lokhu akwenzayo ukwenzela ukulungisa i-ANC abona sengathi ibheke eweni. Lokhu kungadala ukuthi i-ANC ibambe iyeke ingazi izothini.Kuyaqala ngqa emlandweni we-ANC ukuthi umengameli wayo nobengumengameli wezwe, aphumele obala athi akaseneme aze avule iqembu lakhe limelane noKhongolose. I-ANC iwumbutho omdala oneminyaka engu-111 wasungulwa futhi usubuse izwe iminyaka engu-30.UZuma umemezele ukuthi ngeke ayikhankasele i-ANC futhi ngeke ayivotele okhethweni lukazwelonke ngonyaka zayo. Uthe uhamba nombutho omusha uMkhonto weSizwe kodwa akashiyile njengelungu likaKhongolose.UZuma uhlale kwi-ANC iminyaka cishe engaphezu kuka-60, wayihola ezigabeni ezehlukene njengoba egcine esengumengameli wayo wase ejutshelwa kwesikamengameli wezwe. Ungomunye wosopolitiki abadumile nabanohlonze kuleli. Ukuqhamuka kwakhe neqembu elisha kwehlukanise imibono kubantu bakuleli.Umlando omubi:Abawukhumbulayo umlando bazofakaza ukuthi ngoDisemba 16, 2008, kwazalwa iCOPE eyayiphuma kuKhongolose. Kuchaza ukuthi kulo nyaka kuphela iminyaka engu-15 kwaqembuka iCOPE eyafika kwezwakala, yawathola futhi amavoti yaba nezihlalo ePhalamende.Abasunguli beCOPE babengeneme ngokukhethwa kukaZuma njengomengameli wenhlangano engqungqutheleni eyayisePolokwane, eLimpopo ngo-2007. UZuma waqumba phansi uMbeki owayefuna ukubuyela kwesikamengameli ihlandla lesithathu. Ababeseka uMbeki bathi bangamane bahambe kunokuthi baholwe wuZuma. Kwahamba isikhathi, kwavela ukuthi iCOPE ihlaselwe yizinkinga nemibango yezikhundla nayo yagcina yehlelwa amandla nokwesekwa.Okunye okuqaphelekayo wukuthi umbutho omusha ohamba noZuma wethulwe ngosuku okwamenyezelwa ngalo umbutho we-ANC wezempi uMkhonto weSizwe (MK), ngoDisemba 16, eSharpvile, eGauteng. UZuma wethule umbutho wakhe eGauteng nokuyinto engase ichaze okuthile kwezepolitiki.UMkhonto weSizwe kwakuwumbutho we-ANC wezempi owabunjwa wuMnuz Nelson Mandela ngo-1961, wahlakazwa ngo-1993. Lo mbutho waduma kakhulu futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu emzabalazweni wenkululeko.Kuvela udaba lweqembu likaZuma nje, ingwevu uMnuz Mavuso Msimang kade isanda kumemezela ukuthi iyashiya kwi-ANC, ikhala ngenkohlakalo edla lubi nezinye izinkinga eziyixakile. UMsimang ubuye washintsha umqondo emuva kokubonisana nabaholi benhlangano.I-ANC ayisheshanga ukuphendula into ecacile:Nakuba uZuma esephumele obala kodwa i-ANC kuzwelonke ibingakaphumeli obala ngokuthi izizwa kanjani futhi zikhona yini izinyathelo ezomthathela zona. Ukungasheshi kwe-ANC ukuphendula kungase kusho lukhulu maqondana nokusinda kodaba ebhekene nalo.UMengameli kaKhongolose, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, ukhulume wakha phezulu ebuzwa ngalolu daba. Ubezwakala ukuthi uzama ukuphawula ngobunono uRamaphosa."Siyazi ngesimemezeleo sikaZuma futhi besilalele sonke. Umuntu nomuntu unelungelo lokusho ukuthi uzovotela liphi iqembu futhi abeke nezizathu zakhe. Okwamanje yilokho nje esifisa ukukubeka ngalolu daba,’’ kusho uRamaphosa. UKhongolose waseKZN uzilahle amathambo:UZuma kuyaziwa ukuthi udabuka eNkandla, KwaZulu-Natal, nokwenza lesi sifundazwe kube yisizinda sakhe esikhulu nalapho anabalandeli khona abaningi. Nakuba ihhovisi le-ANC kuzwelonke belingakaphawuli ngokuphelele kodwa uKhongolose waseKZN uzilahle amathambo wabiza isithangami sabezindaba.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ehambisana namadlelandawonye, ulibeke ngembaba elokuthi uZuma udivose umbutho wakhe.'’Uma uganiwe bese umkakho ethi usakuthanda kodwa usegane enye indoda, kuchaza ukuthi usekudivosile phela. Ngabe umosha isikhathi sakho nje ngoba usekubeke kwacaca ukuthi ukhetha yiphi indlela,’’ kusho uMtolo.Uthe izingwevu nababengabaholi benhlangano bahlala beyigxeka, bekhala ngokuthi izinto azihambi kahle kodwa eyokuvula elinye iqembu iyethusa. UMtolo uthe isenzo sikaZuma sinokungaziphathi kahle futhi kufanele kuqondakale ukuthi umuntu uzijoyinela yena inhlangano eyedwa.Isasasa kubantu ngeqembu likaZuma:Ngemuva kokuthi uZuma ememezele uMkhonto weSizwe kucacile ukuthi kube nesinye isahluko kwezepolitiki ngoba kube nesasasa elikhulu. Leli qembu limemezele ukuthi selijoyinwe abantu abangaphezu kwesigidi emahoreni angu-24. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bekuchwaza inkundla, abantu bejabula.Lokhu kudlondlobala kweqembu likaZuma akufanele kwethuse i-ANC kuphela kodwa namanye amaqemu ezepolitiki kufanele akhathazeke. Kubhekwe okhethweni, kungenzeka kuthuthe amalungu amanye amaqembu ajoyine kuZuma.Indlela ebheke phambili: Amehlo athe njo kwi-ANC njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi iveze ukuthi izimisele ukumisa kanjani ngodaba lukaZuma njengoma enze isimemezelo esinzima kangaka. Akwaziwa ukuthi i-ANC izomthathela ziphi izinyathelo uZuma njengoba esephumele obala ngeqembu.OWAYENGUMENGAMELI, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, akasayingeni eye-ANC kodwa usehamba noMkhonto weSizwe iqembu elisha elizongenela ukhetho Isithombe: BONGANI MBATHA/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY (ANA) OWAYENGUMENGAMELI, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, akasayingeni eye-ANC kodwa usehamba noMkhonto weSizwe iqembu elisha elizongenela ukhetho Isithombe: BONGANI MBATHA/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY (ANA)
ITHIMBA labatshuzi ngokubambisana nenkampani yezimo eziphuthumayo basebenze ngokuzikhandla bethungatha abantu okuthiwa baminze bezama ukuwela umfula waseMandeni.Ngokombiko othunyelwe inkampani yezimo eziphuthumayo iIPSS Medical Rescue, kuthiwa abantu abathathu bebezama ukuwela umfula eMandeni ngesikhathi bemuka namanzi."Sithole umbiko ngabantu abathathu okuthiwa bamuke nomfula eMandeni, kwajutshwa ithimba labatshuzi elisebenza ngaphansi kweMhlali SAPS K9 nabaseMpangeni, namaphoyisa aseSundumbili,” kusho i-IPSS Medical Rescue ngesitatimende.Ngesikhathi kusathungathwa laba abathathu, kubonakale isidumbu sengane eneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili sidindilizile buqamama nawo umfula okuthiwa bamuke kuwo.Leli thimba liqhubeke nomsebenzi wokuthungatha abanye kwaze kwaba wukuthi amaphoyisa anquma ukubuyela emuva emndenini yalaba abalahlekile ukuze athole umbiko oqondile ngokwenzekile."Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa epheka ngemibuzo izihlobo nabangani kuvele ukuthi laba ababili bakwazile ukuphuma emanzini.”Kuthiwa laba bobabili baphuthume ekhaya ngemuva kokusinda emfuleni.
ZIMKHALELE ngempelasonto owesilisa wasePolokwane osolwa ngokuhlanganisa itulo lokubulala unkosikazi wakhe. Lo msolwa (45) okubikwa ukuthi uwuthisha kubikwa ukuthi zimkhalele ngoMgqibelo emuva kokuthi amaphoyisa ancinzwe indlebe ngalezi zinsolo. Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uBrigadier Hlulani Mashaba uthe amaphoyisa aqoqe yonke imibiko ayithole ngalolu daba. Amaphoyisa enze uphenyo olunzulu athola nokuthi lo thisha useyikhokhile ingxenye yemali yokuthi kubulawe unkosikazi wakhe. Ngesikhathi enza konke lokhu ubecashe ndawana thizeni nokuyilapho amaphoyisa emvumbulule khona."Umsolwa wenze isivumelwano sokukhokha u-R15000, uR5000 ubesewukhokhile nokuholele ekutheni amaphoyisa ambophe emuva kwakho." kusho uBrigadier Hlulani Mashaba .Eqhuba uBrigadier Hlulani Mashaba uthe umsolwa uthathiwe wayovalelwa esitokisini maqede wabekwa icala lokuzama ukubulala. "Inhloso yokuhlela itulo lokubulala ayikakaziwa okwamanje. Indaba yodlame lobulili ngeke ishiwe ngaphandle. Umsolwa uzovela enkantolo kaMantshi ePolokwane ngoLwesithathu" kusho uBrigadier Hlulani Mashaba
LIGCINE lidume lasithatha isikhulu sikaMasipala wesiFunda iZululand okutholakale ukuthi bese sisebenze iminyaka singenazo iziqu ezifanele. Isolezwe Ngempelasonto lithole ngomthombo walo ongaphakathi kumasipala ukuthi kuhlale umkhandlu waphuma nesinqumo.UMasipala wesiFunda iZululand ozinze oLundi, usezandleni ze-IFP kanti phambilini, uke waphathwa yi-NFP. Ngaleso sikhathi imeya kwaba wuNkk Zanele kaMagwaza-Msibi.Kuleli sonto, kuhlale umhlangano oyisipesheli wesigungu esilawula umkhandlu kwase kuhlala nomkhandlu wamakhansela onke ephelele. Kuthiwa kudingidwe udaba kwase kuvotelwa ukuthi sichithwe.Kuthiwa isikhulu lesi sasiqashwe kudala njengoba sesixoshwa manje kuvela indaba yeziqu. Kuthiwa uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, yiwona othimule indaba yesikhulu.Leli phephandaba libone incwadi lapho umnyango utshela khona umasipala ukuthi isikhulu kasifanelwe wukuba sesikhundleni. Umnyango wayalela umkhandlu ukuthi uluthathele izinyathelo lolu daba.Kuthiwa umasipala uqale wabhalela isikhulu usazisa ngokuthi siyephucwa abaqaphi, ngeke sisagadwa kanti Isolezwe ngempelasonto liyibonile incwadi ekhuluma ngabaqaphi. Emuva kwalokho, kulandele incwadi ebhalwe emuva kwesinqumo somhlangano wamakhansela. Isolezwe ngempelasonto liyibonile incwadi yokuxoshwa kwesikhulu.Incwadi yokuxoshwa ikubeka kucace ukuthi uphenyo lomnyango yilona oluholele ekutheni sixoshwe."Uphenyo lukamphathiswa womnyango luveze ukuthi ukuqokelwa kwakho esikhundleni akuhambisani nemibandela efanele. Ngenxa yaleso sizathu, umhlangano wangoDisemba 20, uthathe isinqumo sokuthi kunqanyulwe isivumelwano sakho sokubenza,’’ kusho incwadi esayinwe yimenenja kamasipala.Incwadi ithi kufanele abuyisele kumqashi onke amathuluzi okusebenza abengakuyena. Imenenja kamasipala ishayelwe ucingo kaningi lungabanjwa, yathunyelelwa umyalezo, yangawuphendula.Okhulumela umasipala, uNksz Zanele Mthethwa, uthe akekho emsebenzini ngakho akanayo imininingwane ephelele ngalolu daba.

AMAPHOYISA esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape afuna abantshontshelwe imfuyo bangayithola, lokhu kulandela ukubanjwa kwekhehla nendodana nenqwaba yemfuyo okusolwa ukuthi eyokwebiwa. Lesi sigameko senzeke eMncwasa ngaphandle kancane kwaseMqanduli lapho amaphoyisa ebophe khona leli khehla (69) nendodana (29) yalo.Okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe uCaptain Welile Matyolo uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa asukumele ukwebiwa kwemfuyo emphakathini nokuholele ekutheni uphenyo luwaholele kulo mndeni. Laba basolwa btholwe neziklabhu eziwu-42 nezimbuzi eziyisikhombisa. Yonke lemfuyo uma ihlanganiswa yenza imali ebalelwa ku-R50 400 ngenani lase mgwaqeni. UCaptain Matyolo uthe akugcinanga lapho laba basolwa baphinde batholwa nesamba semali esingadalulwanga." Iziklabhu eziyisikhombisa sezihlonziwe abanikazi bazo ababili bebebikile ngokwebelwa. UNGOTI wezepolitiki, uSolwazi Bheki Mngomezulu, ubona ukusungulwa koMkhonto weSizwe, kuzobuyisa ababesekhempini kaMnuz Jacob Zuma, ababaziwa ngeRadical Economic Transformation (RET) Forces. UMngomezulu ubephawula ngodaba oluyindaba egudwini lokusungulwa kweMK ehamba noZuma..Abantu abaningi basamangele emuva kokuthi uZuma ethule iqembu lakhe uMkhonto weSizwe, wamemezela ukuthi ngeke akhankasele aphinde avotele i-ANC ngonyaka ozayo. Kusalokhu kubatshazwa izinkumbi zabantu abaqhubeka nokujoyina uMkhonto weSizwe.Abebeseka kakhulu uZuma ngaphakathi kwi-ANC bebedume ngeleRadical Economic Transformation (RET) Forces, okusho ukuguqulwa kwezimo zomnotho ngokungananazi.Ikhempu ye-RET ithande ukuphelelwa amandla emuva kokungena kukaMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa. Amanye amalungu ayo axoshwa eqenjini, amanye alandelwa amacala, ahamba izinkantolo.UMngomezulu uthe akungabazeki ukuthi labo bantu ababekwiRET bazobona ikhaya elsha eqenjini likaZuma."Bazoqala phansi bazihlele kabusha manje ngoba sekuvulwe leli qembu ngoba babehamba naye uZuma. Bavele abeneme ngendlela uZuma aphathwa ngayo bekholwa wukuthi uyahlukunyezwa,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.UMngomezulu uthe uZuma uzoxaka amaqembu amaningi KwaZulu-Natal ngisho i-ANC uqobo izothwala kanzima."UMkhonto weSizwe ufike kuvele kukhona izinkinga kuKhongolose, ubuqembuqembu obuhlasele ezingeni likazwelonke. Kukhona izinkinga zokungahanjiswa kahle kwezidingo. Namanye amaqembu njenge-IFP ne-DA bazoshayeka ngokwamavoti,’’ kusho uMngomezulu.Omunye umhlaziyi wezepolitiki, uSolwazi Mcebisi Ndletyana, uthe abantu beRET babezenza izishoshovu bephusha isiqubulo abaziyo ukuthi sisondelene nokuhlupheka kwabantu. Uthe ngenxa yokuthi bangabantu abangosomathuba, kungenzeka bathutheleke kuZuma.Uthe uZuma uzovuka nenkindlane yamavoti KwaZulu- Natal ngenxa yamandla anawo kulesi sifundazwe. "UZuma ucishe afane nenkosi KwaZulu-Natal, abantu bakholelwa kuyena kakhulu. Udaba lokuthi ungumZulu ludala umehluko omkhulu ngoba abantu baseKZN ipolitiki bayiyamanisa kakhulu nobuzwe. Ubufakazi bokuthi unamandla uZuma yizibhelu zango-2021,’’ kusho uNdletyana.Uthe i-ANC iyazi kahle ukuthi uZuma unamandla KwaZulu-Natal ngoba yamjuba khona ekuqaleni wavukuza amavoti kubantu ababengakholelwa kuKhongolose.I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal isivele iphawulile ngalolu daba lukaZuma. Emuva kwalokho iqale umkhankaso wokuhambe izifunda zayo iyozibikela ngalolu daba nokufanele kwenzeke ngalo.

UMNYANGO wezoLimo, ukuHlelwa kabusha koMhlaba ukuThuthukiswa kweziNdawo zaseMakhaya kuleli, uxwayisa izivakashi ezizobe zivakashele KwaZulu-Natal, e-Eastern Cape, eLimpopo nasezindaweni eziseduze kwemingcele yezwe, ukuthi ziqaphele zingalunywa izilwane okungenzeka ukuthi zinamarabi.Umnyango uthe isifo samarabi sidlangile ezindaweni ezigudle ulwandle KwaZulu-Natal. UMnuz Reggie Ngcobo okhulumela uMnyango wezoLimo kuzwelonke, uxwayise izivakashi ukuthi zingalokothi zithinte amakati noma izinja ezingazazi ezizibonayo. Uma zikhona kungcono zishayele ucingo izikhungo ezibhekelele lezi zilwane ukuze kugwemeke ukuthi zilunywe izinja okungenzeka ukuthi zinamarabi.Ulwazi olugcinwe isikhungo esibhekelele izifo ezithathelanayo kuleli, iNational Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), olumayelana nesifo samarabi, luveza ukuthi kulo nyaka izigameko zamarabi ezibikiwe ziyisishiyagalombili. Kuthiwa zine KwaZulu-Natal, e-Eastern Cape zintathu, eLimpopo sisodwa. Nyakenye, kubikwe izigameko eziyishumi, ezimbili KwaZulu-Natal, ezinhlanu ezibikwe e-Eastern Cape nezintathu ezibikwe eLimpopo."Izindawo ezivamise ukuhlupha ngesifo samarabi kakhulu eKZN kuvamise ukuba izindawo ezingasogwini lolwandle kodwa isifo samarabi ungasithola noma ngabe ukuphi kuleli. Okunye okuba umthethela ukuthi abantu abavakashayo kuyenzeka ukuthi basuke kwezinye izindawo bephethe izilwane ezingagonyiwe. Lokhu okuholela ekutheni izindawo ezaziwa ngokuthi isifo samarabi asikho mandla sigcine sesikhona. Enye inkinga esinayo izinja eziyimihamb’ima ezingagonywa uma kugonywa izinja namakati," kusho uNgcobo.Unxuse abafuye izinja namakati ukuthi bazigome, wathi uma lungekho uhlelo lukahulumeni lokugoma ngaleso sikhathi, umuntu angakwazi ukugoma inja noma ikati ekudokotela wezilwane okhona endaweni. Waqhubeka wafakaza bekhona abezindaba kodwa beqopha iphimbo kakhe kuphela kungavezwa izithombe.Kwake kwenzeka okungajwayelekile ngesikhathi ummangalelwa wesihlanu, uFisokuhle Ntuli, esabisa ufakazi phakathi enkantolo elinganisa ngezandla sakumsongela ngokumdubula. Udaba lwabikwa ejajini kwadlalwa i-video kaNtuli ebonakala enza ngezandla lokhu ayekade esolwa ngakho. Kwathi uma ebuzwa, wathi akasakhumbuli nokuthi ubethini ngoba kuningi abakuxoxayo bengabamangalelwa.Kuqaphelekile ukuthi abameli bashintshiwe impela kuleli cala lokufa kukaMeyiwa. Kummangalelwa wokuqala kuya kowesine babeqale bemelwe wuMnuz Teffo ehambisana noMnuz Timothy Thobane. Kwenzeka okungajwayelekile uTeffo eboshwa phakathi enkantolo phambi kwabantu, kwavela nakwithelevishini.UTeffo wamemezela ukuhoxa ecaleni ngoba ekhala ngempatho engeyinhle ayithola enkantolo, uThobani wathi ukusala kodwa naye wagcina eshiya. Kwafika u-Adv Sipho Ramosepele, Adv Charles Mnisi, Adv Zithulele Nxumalo. Kuthe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwapikwa u-Adv Thulani Mngomezulu owafika namagalelo abonakalayo abaningi bewababaza.UKelly ngesikhathi kuqala icala wayenommeli ayemjube ukuthi alandele udaba, uNksz Magadalene Moonsamy, owaxoshwa yijaji enkantolo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela ukuthi uNksz Moonsamy uhoshe, imfe akaseyena ummeli kaKelly.Bekuyinto ejwayelekile ukuthi abantu bahlatshwe wukugula ecaleni lokufa kukaMeyiwa. IJaji uMaumela nalo lakhala ngokugula ngaphambi kokumiswa kwalo. U-Adv Ramosepele wake wakhala ngokugula ethi kunento emxina esifubeni laze laguqa icala. U-Adv Mngomezulu uke wagula izikhawu nokuthe okokugcina kwathiwa icala liyaguqa. Ummangalelwa wesihlanu uNtuli naye wake wakubika ukugula laze laguqa icala labuya ngakusasa esengcono.Kubuye kwasuka esinamathambo ngesikhathi abanye babamangalelwa behilizisana nojele phakathi enkantolo. Isisusa somsindo kwaba indlela ojele abayalela ngayo abamangalelwa ukuthi bahlale kanjani enkantolo. Ayehlanga kahle kubamangalelwa, bagcina bebabambana ngezandla.Kulindeleke ukuthi icala libuyele enkantolo ngoJanuwari wonyaka ozayo, liqhubeke nokuqulwa.
LIBONGA uNkulunkulu ngokulinikeza amandla okuthi likwazi ukugcina seliphothule ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo salo ibandla labasindisiwe, iChrist Revelation Church.Leli bandla eselineminyaka engu-12 laba khona, lisungulwe ngonyaka ka-2011. Isakhiwo salo sise-Unit 18, eMbali, eMgungundlovu.Umsunguli walo uMfu Musawenkosi Ndumo, uthe bayambonga uNkulubkulu ngokuma nabo ngesikhathi kuqhubeka umsebenzi wesakhiwo.UNdumo ugcizelele ukuthi lona bekuwumsebenzi obungelula nje nhlobo.Uncome amalungu aleli bandla ngokuma aqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi ugcina ufezekile.Ubonge kakhulu nakosomabhizinisi athe belula isandla kulo msebenzi kaNkulunkulu wesakhiwo."Namhlanje sithanda ukuthatha leli thuba simbonge kakhulu uNkulunkulu ngokuma nathi kusona sonke lesi sikhathi sakha indlu yebandla. Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje, bekungelula nje nhlobo kodwa uNkulunkulu emuhle sikwazile ukuthi lo msebenzi siwuqale size siwupothule,'' usho kanje.Uthe zibe khona izingqinamba ebudeni bendlela kodwa baphikelela besizwa nguNkulunkulu."Okokuqala nje, okwavele kwaba yinkinga enkulu kwaba ukuvumbuka kweCovid-19,'' kusho yena.Eqhuba, uthe umnikelo wesakhiwo waqala phansi wabonakala uza ngonyawo lonwabu ngesikhathi sekukhona iCovid-19.Uthe bathe besababaza lokho, nesimo somnotho saseNingizimu Afrika samane sintengantenga ngendlela exakile. Nalokho futhi uthe kwaba nomthelela ongemuhle kulokho ababekuhlosile."Yize kwakukhona lezi zingqinamba kodwa siqhubekile saphikelela. Yingakho nje namhlanje sihlangene sonke lana,'' kubeka uNdumo.IMeya yesiFunda uMgungundlovu, uKhansela uMzi Zuma, ilincomile ibandla ngokuqala lize liphothule umsebenzi omkhulu kangaka.UZuma uthe wonke amalungu aleli bandla kumele aziqhenye ngomsebenzi omkhulu akwazile ukuthi awenze ngenkulu impumelelo.Intshumayelo yosuku yenziwe nguMbhishobhi Phumlani Ndlovu oseyingwevu ekushumayeleni iZwi likaNkulunkulu.
UKUNGAQONDI ngokuphelele kwabazali iqhaza okumele balibambe ohlelweni lokusokwa kwezingane zabo kudala izinkinga ezingaholela ekutheni izingane zibolelwe ubuntu bazo.Abezempilo bathi uma zinganakekelwa ngendlela izilonda zokusoka ziyabhibha, okungaholela ekutheni abafana balahlekelwe ubuntu babo, kade kuthiwa kwenziwa izaba zokuthi bangangenwa izifo kalula.UDkt Siyabonga Nzimande ongomunye wosihlalo bomkhandlu wengculazi eThekwini, obuye abambe iqhaza ekusokweni kwabafana okwenziwa ngodokotela, uthe inqwaba yabafana ayibuyeli ezikhungweni zezempilo emuva kwezinsuku ezimbili ukuze bahlolwe ukuthi ukuhlinzwa kuhambe kahle, abagezi ngamanzi antukuntuku kathathu ngosuku, bafika emakhaya bageze ngamanzi anosawoti ogubha isilonda, abanye amathuluzi abo abawaqoqi ukuze ahlale emile, bavuvukale izilonda zibhibhe."Uma sifona singodokotela sibuza ukuthi ingane injani ngemuva kokusokwa, omunye umzali ukutshela ukuthi akekho eduze kwengane usemsebenzini noma ukwenye indawo . Uma siyivakashela ingane sithole ukuthi enye ibisaba ukugeza, isivuvukele okudala ukuthi isilonda sibhibhe, umzali obethi uyigadile akakaze abe khona selokhu yabuya kodwa wayeyihambisile, wasayina nokuthi ayisokwe," kusho yena.Uthe umfana ophuma kosokwa kusuke kudingeka ukuthi ahlolwe ngabezempilo ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbili esokile, ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa nangemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-15, bese elinda amasonto ayisithupha kuya phezulu ukuthi aphole kahle."Abafana asebekhulile abalindi isikhathi esibekiwe baya ocansini ngoba befuna ukubona ukuthi amathuluzi abo ayasebenza yini. Lowo mkhuba uyingozi ngendlela eyisimanga ngoba umfana angathola isifo socansi, kwesinye isikhathi nayo iHIV uqobo ngoba ukusoka kwehlisa amathuba okuyithola kodwa usuke esengayithola," kuxwayisa uNzimande.UMnuz Phakamani Ndlovu wePhakamani Empowerment egqugquzela ukuthi abesilisa basoke, uthe abazali baba yingxenye yalolu hlelo baphinde bafundise ngokuthi umfana uma esebuyela ekhaya kumele bamsize kanjani"Abanye izingane zabo bazigeza ngemithi ethile befuna basheshe baphole, abanye babagcoba u-vaseline kanti akumele kugcotshwe isilonda. Abanye uma sibafonela athi babuke ngeso babona ukuthi kuyaphola kanti iso lomsebenzi wezempilo nelomzali ojwayelekile alifani," kusho uPhumlani.

Ngazama ukuvula inkampani yonogada kodwa kwangahamba kahle ngenxa yokuthi kwakudingeka imali eningi, engangingenayo. Ngaze ngaqashwa esitolo ngasebenza ukushaya isisefo. Bengihola uR4 000 ngenyanga,” kusho uNksz Dladla.Uthe esitolo ubekhuluma nabantu abahlukene ngempilo nangenkinga yokuswela umsebenzi kanti abanye babekhuluma ngezolimo.UNksz Lihle Dladla weYummmmylee Poultry Farming uthi abesifazane mabangasabi ukuqala amabhizinisi Isithombe:sithunyelwe "Emuva kwesikhathi ngisebenza esitolo nganquma ukubhalisa inkampani yami yezinkukhu, iYummmmylee Poultry Farming, ngo-2021. LUPHENDUKE imbibizane kubanikazi bezikole ezifundisa ukushayela, uhlelo lukahulumeni KwaZulu-Natal lokulekelela amalungu omphakathi ngokuwathathela izincwadi zokushayela mahhala, olwethulwe ezinyangeni ezedlule.Lolu hlelo oluqhutshwa wuMnyango wezokuThutha esifundazweni olwaziwa nge-Thuthuka Driving Skills Development, kuthiwa kusacutshungulwa izicelo ezivela kusona sonke isifundazwe njengoba umnyango uhlose ukwamukela ezingu- 4 000 kuphela. Ukufakwa kwezicelo kuvalwe ngo-Okthoba, kanti umnyango uthi uthole ezevile ku- 40 000 nokuyinto ephenduke inselelo ekuhlungeni ngokushesha eziphumelele ngenxa yokuphindaphindeka kwesibalo esasilindelekile.Okhulumela inhlangano eyengamele izikole zokufundela ukushayela KwaZulu-Natal, Ubumbano Driving Schools Operators Association, uMnuz Mzwandile Zondi, uthe isibalo esikhulu sabantu abasabeke ithemba ekutheni bazobizwa kulo 4 000 ofunwa wumnyango, senza amabhizinisi abo angayenzi inzuzo."Abantu abasezi ezikoleni ukuzofundela ukushayela ngoba bathemba ukuthi bazophumelela kulolu hlelo lwamahhala, osekugcina sekusilimaza thina njengoba kungakabi bikho okucacayo ukuthi kwenzekani ngokubizwa kwabo. Inkinga esesibhekene nayo isicishe ifane naleyo esasibhekene nayo ngesikhathi kuhlasela ubhubhane i-Covid 19, njengoba namanje thina nabasebenzi bethu singazi ngempela ukuthi sizomisa kanjani kulesi sikhathi samaholidi ukubhekela imindeni yethu njengoba singenzanga nzuzo,” usho kanje.Yize le nhlangano yayilujabulela lolu hlelo lusamenyezelwa kwazise kulindeleke ukuthi luhlomulise izikole zokufundela ukushayela njengoba abantu abazothunyelwa kuzona bezokhokhelwa wuhulumeni, kodwa uthe sebenokukhathazeka ngamabhizinisi abo kwazise luzoqhubeka. Uthe akulona kuphela olushaya kuzwele, zikhona izinhlelo ezifanayo nakomasipala osekwenza noma umuntu kungabe ubezipatanisela imali yokufunda, alinde inhlanhla kugcine kungezi muntu ukuzofunda. Uthe lolu daba baluxoxa nomnyango ukubheka ukuthi yisiphi isixazululo okungaqhanyukwa naso kule nkiyankiya.Okhulumela umnyango esifundazweni uMnuz Kwanele Ncalane, uqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo ayaqhubeka yize kube nokugqoza ngenxa yesibalo esikhulu sezicelo ezifinyelele kubona."Inhloso kahulumeni ukusiza umuntu ohluphekayo ongakwazi ukuzenzela izincwadi zokushayela ngoba kungekho mali engena kuyena. Noma kunjalo, uhulumeni uhlose futhi ukufukula amabhizinisi ikakhulu iningi lawo eliphethwe abantu bakithi, ngakho siyanxusa ebantwini ukuthi abanamandla, bangalindi ukuthi babizwe kulolu hlelo ngoba vele uma ubheka baningi izicelo zabo ezingazophumelela ngenxa yesibalo esincane esifunekayo, nesibalo sabantu asebevele befake izicelo,” kusho uNcalane.Uthe bayaxoxisana nabanikazi bezikole zokushayela ukubheka ukuthi bangasizakala kanjani, waveza ukuthi abantu abangaphumelelanga kulolu hlelo, imininingwane yabo izogcinwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uma luphinde luvuleka babonelelwe.
KUDONSWE ngendlebe abakhipha imali emishinini yasemabhange ekhipha imali (ATM) ukuba baqaphele njengoba sekuyisikhathi samaholidi.Ibhange iFNB lithe njengoba kuphithizela namaqola ayaphithizela afuna intuba yokuqola abantu imali abayisebenzele kanzima.UNksz Zibu Nqala, obhekelele izindaba zokukhishwa kwemali eFNB, uthe ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba abantu bavamise ukukhipha imali eningi ukuze bagibele ikakhulukazi uma beya emakhaya.Uthe lokhu kwenza amaqola abacuthele emishinini yemali ngakho kufanele bahlale beqaphile.Ube esekhipha la masu ambalwa- Fundisisa kahle okushiwoyo ngaphambi kokufaka inamba eyimfihlo yokukhipha imali.- Ungayisebenzisi imishini yokukhipha imali elimele futhi ungaphoqi ukufaka ikhadi lakho uma lingavumi.- Uma kukhona ongakuboni kahle emibhalweni ekhonjiswa kwi-ATM noma kufilizela, ungalokothi ufake inamba eyimfihlo. Suka kulowo mshini.- Ungayiniki muntu inamba yakho eyimfihlo yokukhipha imali futhi ungayibhali phansi.- Naka ukukhipha imali uma usemshinini wokukhipha imali, ungalokhu ubuka abazama ukukuphazamisa noma ukubuza okuthile ngesikhathi umatasa nokukhipha imali.- Fihla umshini wokukhipha imali uma ufaka izinamba zakho eziyimfihlo.- Zikalele ukuthi uzokhipha malini ngosuku.- Qaphela abantu ongabazi abakugqugquzela ukuthi usebenzise umshini wemali othile.- Kungakuhle ukuthi usebenzise uhlelo lokukhipha imali emshini wemali olungadingi ukuba usebenzise ikhadi lakho (cardless withdrawals)."Siyacela abantu baqinisekise ukuthi basebenzisa zonke izindlela zokukhipha imali abazinikwe yibhange labo. Bangakhipha imali ezitolo uma bethenga, bangasebenzisa ama-app asemafonini, bathumele imali ngeselula ngaphandle kokuyoyikhipha. Siyacela baqaphele kakhulu kulesi sikhathi,” kusho uNksz Nqala.Uphethe ngokuthi abasebenzisa izinhlelo za-online bangalokothi baciphize ama-link abangawazi, baqaphele kuzo zonke izindawo lapho besebenzisa khona imali.
KUKHALWA ngekhansela le-ANC, ku-ward 75, eLamontville, okuthiwa likhetha iphela emasini ekupheni izaguga ama-voucher okudla akhishwe wuMasipala weTheku.USihlalo we-EFF ku-ward 75, uMnuz Clive Mali Mlotshwa, uthe baze baphelezela izaguga ziyoqhinqa emahhovisi ekhansela lakule ndawo kuleli sonto ukuze libanike izimpendulo ngokunganikwa kwezinye izaguga ama-voucher.Kuthiwa uMasipala weTheku ukhiphe ama-voucher angu-500 aqondene no-ward 75, ukuthi anikwe izaguga. I-Voucher ngayinye eyenani lika-R650 futhi ivumela izaguga ukuthi zithenge ukudla kukaKhisimusi ePick n Pay."Into ebuhlungu ukuthi kunezaguga ezibuza ukuthi zona zishiywe ngoba zinjani zingayitholi impendulo ekhanseleni. Okuphinde kufake usawoti esilondeni ukuthi kunezingane ezibonakala ezinxanxatheleni zezitolo zichoma ngawo lama-voucher kanti ezinye izaguga zithola amabili kuya phezulu umuntu emunye. Siyile ehhovisi lekhansela siyobuza ngalesi senzo kodwa asizitholanga izimpendulo ezicacile kwesimfice ehhovisi lalo. Lona alitholakali njengoba lingazibambi nezingcingo zethu ukuze lisicacisele ukuthi kwenzekeni ngama-voucher ezaguga. Abawatholile sithole ukuthi bangabangani balo ikhansela,” kusho uMlotshwa.Kuthintwa ikhansela elithintekayo, uMnuz Sibusiso Siveshe, lithe abasho kanje bayifaka kwipolitiki indaba yama-voucher kube kungenjalo."Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ama-voucher aphumile angu-500. Inkinga esibhekene nayo ukuthi awanele ukuthi atholwe yizona zonke izaguga. Isibalo sawo asinyuki njengoba kuseyilesi ebesiphuma nangesikhathi esedlule kanti izalukazi ziyanda njengoba sekukhona asebeseminyakeni yokuthi bakwazi ukuhlomula. Abanye bebeneminyaka engaphansi esikhathini esedlule kanti manje sekumele bawathole ngenxa yeminyaka yabo njengoba kubhekwa abaneminyaka engu-65 kuya phezulu. Enye inkinga ukuthi abantu baseLamontville babheka izaguga ezikule ndawo kuphela kanti uWard 75 mkhulu. Kukhona abasehostela eWema, umphakathi wamaNdiya nabanye abangekho eLamontville kodwa abakuyona iWard yethu,” kusho uSiveshe.Uthe okwenze abanye bangawathola ukuthi bebenza isiqiniseko sokuthi kuhlomula wonke umuntu waku-ward 75 ngaphandle kwabaseLamontville. Uhlelo athe balusebenzisile ookuthi emndenini kunikwe isaguga esisodwa ngoba kuyenzeka zibe ziningi emzini owodwa. Uveze ukuthi kweminye imindeni bebebheka asebebadala kakhulu."Kukhona imindeni enesaguga esineminyaka engu-95 kodwa uthole ukuthi indodakazi yaso ina-65. Bonke labo bantu bayizaguga kodwa bekuphoqa ukuthi sinike lo ona-95 simyeke lona-65 ukuze ama-voucher angabi maningi emndenini owodwa,” usho kanje.USiveshe uthe lolu hlelo lwama-voucher lunzima kubona njengabaholi ngoba lugcina selubenza bathukwe sengathi kukhona abawadlile kube kungenjalo.

Udaba siyalwazi futhi asilubalekeli. Besilindele ukuthi sizolokhu sikhuluma size siluphothule,” kusho uMsweli.Uthe kulikhuni ukusho ukuthi yimalini efunwa yilaba bantu ngoba lokho kungesinye sezizathu esidala kube nokubambezeleka ekukhokheni ngoba kusamele iqale iqinisekiswe.Uveze nokuthi kunabantu umasipala owabaqasha ukuthi bahlwaye ulwazi baqinisekise yonke into ngalolu daba."Sizimisele ukuthi igcine ixazululekile le ndaba. Kukhokhelwane uma kukhokhelwana. Sibabuyisele emakhaya abasebenzi isanda kwenzeka le nto yokuchithwa kwendle emahhovisi kodwa namhlanje (esho izolo) kuyasetshenzwa,” kusho uMsweli.Uveze ukuthi izolo laba bantu baye emahhovisi engamele imali kamasipala benza okufanayo.Uthe luyinzukazikeyi udaba lwabo ngoba kukhona kubona abasebenza bengagunyaziwe, bengacelwanga umasipala ukuthi basebenze.Uthe inkinga ekhona njengamanje ukuthi umkhandlu usahlabe ikhefu, umhlangano olandelayo wamakhansela usekupheleni kukaJanuwari 2024.

UNGQONGQOSHE kagesi, uDkt Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, uthe alukapheli uhlelo lokunqamuka kukagesi kodwa into eyenza ukuthi ungacimi njengamanje wukwehla kukagesi odingekayo ngenxa yokuthi abezimboni basavalile.URamokgopa usho lokhu ngoLwesine esithangamini nabezindaba."Izimboni ezinkulu ezisebenzisa ugesi omningi zivalile, yingakho sibona ugesi unganqamuki kulezi zinsuku. Simatasa silungisa imishini yethu yokuphehla ugesi ukuze ingafi singalindele. Sisebenzisa lesi sikhathi samaholidi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ugesi uyanda ezweni ngokuthi sisheshe siyivuselele kahle imishini yethu,” kusho uRamokgopa.Uthe ugesi okhona njengamanje uwu-27 700MW kanti odingwa ngabantu okwamanje uwu-24 695MW.Ebusika ugesi obudingwa ngabantu ubuwu-33 000MW.URamokgopa uthe okwamanje ugesi ngeke ucinywe kodwa kuzocaca kahle uma sekuvule izimboni ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zithela izithelo ezinhle ngempela yini.Uveze ukuthi kulezi zinsuku eziwu-14 ezidlule ugesi ongekho ngenxa yemishini efa bengalindele uwu-12 245MW.Wathi yilesi sizathu esenza ukuthi basebenzele ukuyilungisa imishini ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle.Ubalule ukuthi akukubi kangako ohlangothini lokufa kwemishini ngoba ebusika ugesi obungekho ngenxa yokufa kwemishini ubungaphezu kuka-15 000MW kodwa manje wehlele ku-12 245MW.NgoDisemba 18 uthe imishini ebifile ibithathe ugesi ongaphansi kuka-11 000MW kodwa abakwazanga ukuhlala kuleli zinga njengoba kube neminye imishini efayo.Uthembise abantu bakuleli ukuthi imishini iyalungiswa ukuze ngonyaka ozayo izinga lokunqamuka kukagesi ngenxa yemishini efa kungalindelwe lehle.Wenze isibonelo ngesiteshi sikagesi iDuvha esinogesi omningi kangangokuthi sekuthiwe akucinywe omunye umshini ukuze ulungiswe.URamokgopa uthe bayaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwethula izinhlobo zikagesi ezehlukene okukhona kuzo ophehlwa ngamalahle, owenuzi, owelanga, owomoya nowegesi.URamokgopa uthe okwamanje ugesi usazokhanya kodwa kuzocaca kahle uma sekuvule izimboni ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zithela izithelo ezinhle ngempela yini.
UMNDENI wakwaGcaba wosomabhizinisi bezokuthutha odumile ikakhulukazi KwaZulu-Natal, uthi uthembe ingalo yomthetho ukuthi ibambe izigilamkhuba ezidubule zabulala ilungu lawo. UMnuz Langa "Mantunta” Gcaba (43), udutshulwe wabulawa ngoMsombuluko, eQuarry Heights, eThekwini.Kuthiwa uthelekelwe abantu abangaziwa bamdubula bashaya bachitha emuva kwalokho. Akawaziwa ukuthi ukubulawa kwakhe kuhlobene nani ngoba kuthiwa uhlaselwe engazelele lutho.Ilungu lomndeni elixoxe neSolezwe, uMnuz Sthe Gcaba, uthe umfowabo ubengeyena umnikazi wamatekisi kodwa ubengumshayeli odumile. Uthe ubeneminyaka ecela kwengu-25 eshayela futhi ubenza umsebenzi ngokukhulu ukuzimisela nokuthembeka. Uthe bazomkhumbula kakhulu ngeqhaza lakhe nanjengelungu lomndeni.Uthe umfowabo ushayele kakhulu amabanga amade esebenzela erenki yaseDurban Station isikhathi eside. Silahlekelwe kakhulu ngoba ubewumuntu ozithobile kakhulu futhi ubengesona isixhwanguxhwangu, siyamangala nje ukuthi ubulaweleni,’’ kusho uGcaba.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseGreenwood Park aphenya icala lokubulala."Amaphoyisa asebenza udaba lwecala lokubulala emuva kokuthi owesilisa oneminyaka engu-43 ubudala, edutshulwe ngabantu abangaziwa eQuarry Heights. Uphuthunyiswe emtholampilo kodwa kwatholakala ukuthi useshonile,’’ kusho uConst Ngcobo.
IMEYA kaMasipala waseThekwini, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, inengwe yinkulumo yomholi we-IFP, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, ethi iTheku lingcolile.UKaunda ukhwele wadilika kuHlabisa emsola ngokuhambela kuphela izindawo ezinenkinga.Uthe uHlabisa angeke aziqonde izinkinga ezibhekene nalo masipala ngoba akakaze abe yimeya kamasipala omkhulu njengeTheku.Lokhu ukusho ehehebeni lombhalo alifake ezinkundleni zokuxhumana lapho ebephendula khona inkulumo kaHlabisa.Enkulumeni yakhe, uHlabisa uthe ukungcola kwedolobha kuxosha izivakashi.UHlabisa ubekhuluma ngesikhathi evakashele izindawo ezahlukene kuleli dolobha, lapho ebehlola khona ukulungela kwalo ukwamukela izivakashi njengoba sekuqale amaholidi kaDisemba.Kulolu hambo obelungoLwesithathu, uHlabisa uhambele izingxenye ezahlukene zedolobha ezikhungethwe inkinga yobugebengu nokungcola.Ezindaweni azihambele kubalwa naleyo egcwele abantu abahlala emgwaqweni, i-Albert Park, waphinde wayohlola namabhilidi angasanakiwe.Emva kokuphothula uhambo lwakhe, uHlabisa uthe ubuholi bomkhandlu buyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi.UKaunda uthe ziningi izindawo ezinhle eThekwini uHlabisa akhethe ukungazihambeli."UHlabisa bekumele nimqalise lapha eSibaya Development abone inxanxathela yezitolo entsha nezindawo zokuhlala ezintsha. Bekufanele aye eMdloti ayobona umsebenzi owenziwe wumasipala ukuvuselela leya ndawo emuva kwezikhukhula, adlule e-Oceans Mall, Gateway, Cornubia Development, nimyise eBridge City, abone ihhotela i-The Octavia eTafuleni.”UKaunda uthe umasipala uyazazi izinkinga ezisezindaweni ezihanjelwe uHlabisa.Uthe kuyinto ejwayelekile ukuthi emadolobheni amakhulu abatshali bezimali bashintshe indawo endala, baqale izakhiwo endaweni entsha, nathe lokhu kuholela ekutheni indawo endala igcine ingasanakiwe."Amaningi amadolobha anjengoNew York, Boston, Copenhagen namanye ayesebole ngaphezu kweTheku, engcolile, kungalandelwa imithetho yedolobha futhi nezinga lobugebengu liphezulu. Bheka namhlanje asevuselelwe asezingeni lomhlaba.”UKaunda uthe sebeqale uhlelo lokwazi wonke umuntu ongena edolobheni ukuthi usuka kuphi nokuthi yini emlethe lapha.Uthe akulula ukususa laba bantu abahlala phansi kwamabhuloho, wathi bavikelwa yizinhlangano zamalungelo abantu.Uthe bayaqhubeka nokungenelela odabeni lwamabhilidi angasanakiwe, wathi baxoxisana nabanikazi balezi zakhiwo.UKaunda uthe uHlabisa angeke akuqonde okuningi ngoba akakaze abe imeya kamasipala omkhulu.UHlabisa wayeyimeya kaMasipala iBig Five Hlabisa.
ALAHLWE elakubo amaphoyisa ayisishiyagalolunye KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng, ekhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngamacala okugwazisa.Okhulumela iRoad Traffic Management Corporation (RTMC), uMnuz Simon Zwane, uthe ukuboshwa kwabasolwa kwenzeke njengoba kuqhubeka izinhlelo zezokuphepha zamaholidi okuphela konyaka.Uthe ababili babasolwa bangamaphoyisa oMkhandlu waseTshwane."Ukuboshwa kwabo kuze emva kokuba befune imali engu-R1 500 kumshayeli wetekisi. Uphinde waveza nokuthi bebengazi bona ukuthi umsolwa unesibhamu, wabuye wathi abamazeli zidakamizwa azisebenzisayo.Uveze ukuthi umsolwa utholwe ehlathini khona endaweni lapho ebebaleke wayocasha khona emva kokwenza isigameko.Umthombo, ocele ukungadalulwa, uthe bebuvele bungebuhle ubudlelwano bukaNkk Mkhize nendodana yakhe engumsolwa.Uthe umsolwa ubevame ukuchukuluza uNkk Mkhize ethi akamthandi futhi uyimbangela yokuthi angalungelwa yilutho."Asazi-ke noma yikho lokhu okuholele ekutheni agcine esenza kanje,” kusho umthombo.Uveze ukuthi amakhanda abagilwa atholwe sekulandelwa amaconsi egazi, abehambe econsa aze ayofika endlini yangasese.Ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Mhlengi Cele, lithe isimo simuncu endaweni kulandela isigameko, lathi abantu basathukile kwazise siyaqala ukwenzeka isehlakalo esifana naalesi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseMid-Illovo abophe owesilisa oneminyaka engu-54 eSigodini."Uboshwe kulandela isigameko sokubulawa kukanina (83) nendodakazi (39) yakhe okusolwa ukuthi babulawe nguye lona wesilisa eLuzizi eMid-Illovo ngoLwesithathu,” kusho uConst Ngcobo.Uqhube wathi imbangela yokubulala ayikaziwa kanti umsolwa kulindeleke ukuthi avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseRichmond namuhla.

SIMUNCU isimo ethempelini lamaNazaretha, Ekuthuleni, eNkandla emva kokuthi inhlalisuthi iphihlize umshumayeli ngesagila kubangwa ukungena ethempelini.Isolezwe lithole ngomthombo walo ongashayi eceleni ukuthi kumanje kunecala eliseNkantolo yeMantshi eNkandla, emva kokuhlaselwa kukaMshumayeli uMnuz Bonguyise Ntombela.Kuthiwa uhlaselwe yinhlalisuthi uMnuz Mbongiseni Maphumulo.Umthombo waleli phephandaba uthe yize icala lisenkantolo kodwa selubikwe nasenduneni yendawo, uMnuz Moses Nxumalo.AmaNazaretha aseNkandla akwisekhethe engaphansi kobuholi boNyazilwezulu."Indaba isuswe ukuthi inhlalisuthi uMaphumulo avimbele uMshumayeli Ntombela ukuthi angene ethempelini ukuzokhonza. Le nhlalisuthi isola uNtombela ngokuthi wagenca izihlahla ezisethempelini wamiswa yibandla. Ngesikhathi ezongena ethempelini, imtshele ukuthi akakavumeleki ukungena esontweni, base beyahilizisana lapho. Inhlalisuthi ayibange isachitha sikhathi yavele yagadla kuqala kumshumayeli. Kuthe kusalanyulwa lapho yadonsa isagila yalitheza phezulu kumshumayeli. Balanyulwe sekukubi umshumayeli esebomvu yigazi,” kusho umthombo.Kuthintwa umshumayeli Ntombela, uthe imphethe kabi le ndaba ngoba akazi ushayelweni."Okubuhlungu ukuthi kuzoyiwa entabeni ngoJanuwari ungahlanjululiwe umuzi wenkosi (ithempeli) njengoba kwachitheka igazi khona. Icala belingenile ngoDisemba 12, lizobuyela ngoJanuwari eNkantolo yeMantshi, eNkandla. Njengoba udaba lusenduneni mina anginankinga luyoxoxwa khona ngoba ngijahe luxazululeke ukuze siye entabeni sekugezwe nomuzi wenkosi,” kusho uMshumayeli Ntombela.UMaphumulo uvumile ukuthi uyasazi isigameko."Mina ngangingalwi noMshumayeli uNtombela, kodwa ngambuza ukuthi uza kanjani ethempelini ngoba wamiswa futhi akayilandelile imigudu efanele ukuthi abuyiselwe enkonzweni. Kunokuthi angiphendule kahle wavela wangichapha ngenhlamba, wangitshela nokuthi angiyilutho. Elokungabi yilutho lingicasule kakhulu. Kuvele kwamnyama amehlo ngazithola sengikuyena ngesibhakela. Isagila ngasihlwitha kuyena ngamshaya ngaso. Banehaba abathi ngamphihliza ngaso ikhanda kodwa ngamshaya esithweni nje, salanyulwa,” kusho uMaphumulo.Induna yendawo, uMnuz Moses Nxumalo uthe selubikiwe lolu daba kuyena, kodwa usanxuse ukuthi abefundisi abaphethe amaNazaretha kwisekethe yaseNkandla baludingide ngaphakathi ebandleni. Uthe inkinga ukuthi abefundisi abaphethe isekhethe babili, okunguShandu odabuka eShowe noMfundisi Thokozani Gumede. Ngokwazi kwakhe uthe isekethe ayikwazi ukuba nabefundisi ababili, okuyiyona into abona ukuthi idala ukungezwani kumalungu ebandla njengoba kukhona abahamba noGumede abanye bahamba noShandu.Kuthintwa uShandu (elingatholakalanga igama lakhe) uvele wabhoka ngolaka wathi ngeke esaphawula ngoba lolu daba seluyiswe ephepheni.Umfundisi Gumede uthe noma engazi ukuthi lufike kanjani ephepheni kodwa uyalwazi futhi basazama ukululungisa.Okhulumela uNyazilwezulu, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, uthe kumele balulungise ngokwesonto lolu daba."Inkinga ukuthi uma unecala onalo elingakapheli esontweni awukwazi ukuya entabeni eKhenana njengoba kuyiwa khona ngoJanuwari. Kuzomele balulungise ngokushesha ngoba bazovaleleka. Noma ngabe luyalungiswa ngokwenkantolo kodwa kumele luxoxwe nasesontweni ngoba luthinta isonto, akwanele ukuthi lube senkantolo,” usho kanje.

Uphambene nomthethosisekelo wenhlangano futhi kwawona uMkhonto weSizwe kufanele uthathelwe izinyathelo ngokusebenzisa igama lombutho wezempi ngokungekho emthethweni,’’ kusho uZikalala.UZuma wabuzwa ngokuthi akasabi yini ukuthi i-ANC ingase imshushise, wathi cha akanankinga ayoke ilokothe ikwenze lokho.UZikalala uthe kunobufakazi obukhomba ukuthi i-ANC iyazisukumela izinto okukhalwa ngazo eziyizinkinga nezingase ziyinyunde kubavoti. Uthe kumanje kunohlelo lokuvuselela kabusha i-ANC futhi lokhu kubonakala ngemigomo ebekiwe yokukhethwa kwabantu abazoyimela ePhalamende."Uma ubheka nje, uqabane uMavuso Msimang uvumile ukubuyela ekhaya emuva kokuthi ethole isiqiniseko sokuthi konke akhala ngakho kuzolungiswa. Sivumelene nehhovisi likanobhala-jikelele ukuthi abantu abanogcobho akufanele bafakwe ohlwini,’’ kusho uZikalala.UZikalala uthe kufanele basebenzele ukuthi babe nomkhankaso wokhetho onohlonze. Uxwayise ngokuthi kodwa kufanele bakugweme ukulutha abantu bebathembise izulu nomhlaba ngemali kahulumeni engekho nayo.Uthe i-ANC kufanele ifingqe imikhono izimisele, iye kubantu ukuze bayethembe ngoba kungenjalo iyobuya nenduku yombangandlala okhethweni.
UMFELOKAZI oboshelwe icala lokubulala umyeni wakhe obeyiphoyisa ufisele izilokotho ezinhle zikaKhisimusi abasemzini namalungu omphakathi abesenkantolo ngesikhathi esebuyela esitokisini.UNkk Nongcebo Faith Ntombela ubevele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngoLwesithathu.Bekuqhutshekwa nokulalelwa kwesicelo sakhe sebheyili kodwa isinqumo sagodlwa.Kulindeleke ukuthi imantshi isikhiphe ngoLwesine ngesonto elizayo isinqumo.Usukume ebhokisini labasolwa eseshona phansi emgodini wama wabuka abebekade bethamele icala.Uphakamise isandla sangakwesokudla waphimisa amagama athi: "Nginifisela uKhisimusi omuhle.''Nabo abasemzini namalungu omphakathi baphendulile ngokufanayo bathi bamfisela uKhisimusi omuhle azowuchitha ezitokisini.Njengenjwayelo ubebonakala eswenke econsa efake izibuko futhi emamatheka.Lo wesifazane ubhekene necala lokwakha itulo lokubulala nelokubulala umyeni wakhe, uCaptain Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela, owayeyiphoyisa likaMasipala waseThekwini.Ngaphambi kwalokho uNkk Ntombela ubuze izintatheli ukuthi kungani zihlezi zimthwebula izithombe kodwa zingabe zisamphathela iphepha ukuze azibone.UNkk Ntombela ugqigqa enkantolo ufuna ibheyili noMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo onguthishomkhulu esikoleni samabanga aphansi iMpumulwana, KwaMaphumulo.Omunye oboshelwe leli cala yisiboshwa okuthiwa siyingozi, uKhulani Cele, ovele udonsa isigwebo sikadilikajele ngecala lokubulala.Umphenyi wecala, uMnuz Sibusiso Ntshangase, waveza enkantolo ukuthi uCele unobudlelwane bezothando noNkk Ntombela.Enkantolo izolo bekugcwele kakhulu njengoba bekulindeleke ukuthi kuphume isinqumo sokuthi laba bayayithola yini ibheyili.Eziphendulela ngokushiwo nguNkk Ntombela, uMnuz Nkosinathi Ntombela (oyiwele likamufi) uthe abanankinga nakushilo inqobo nje uma ezogcina egwetshiwe."Asinankinga nokuthi uthini, vele useyafana nje nenyoka esifile. INHLANGANO edlelana ne-ANC, iSanco, ngeke imthathele izinyathelo usihlalo wayo waKwaZulu-Natal, uJacob Zuma, osanda kunxenxa abantu ukuthi bavotele inhlangano ezobe incintisana ne-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, uMkhonto weSizwe.Ubuholi beSanco KwaZulu-Natal buthe yize bunesivumelwano sokuthi bazokweseka i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo, amalungu abo anelungelo lokuzibandakanya nanoma iliphi iqembu lezepolitiki alithandayo.Unobhala we-Sanco KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sizwe Cele, uthe uZuma uzoqhubeka nesikhundla sakhe.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba, eThekwini, izolo."Udaba lukaZuma seluvaliwe, azikho izinyathelo azothathelwa zona. Yebo engqungqutheleni kazwelonke yeSanco savumelana ngokuthi sizokweseka i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo. Kodwa umthethosisekelo wethu uyasho ukuthi wonke amalungu enhlangano anelungelo lokuzibandakanya nanoma iliphi iqembu lezepolitiki. Asikho isigaba somthethosisekelo wethu esisigunyaza ukuthi sithathele uZuma izinyathelo. Umhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwiSanco KwaZulu-Natal unqume ukuthi uZuma aqhubeke nesikhundla asiphethe.”UCele uthe i-ANC iyona okufanele ibhekane nodaba lukaZuma."UZuma uyilungu le-ANC elidala njengoba esehlale kuyo iminyaka engu-62. Uqokelwe ezikhundleni eziningi kwi-ANC okubalwa kuzo nokuba umengameli iminyaka eyishumi. Lokhu kusitshela ukuthi uZuma uyilungu le-ANC eliqavile. Le-ANC uZuma axabane nayo, ayikamthatheli izinyathelo. Kungani ke thina kufanele simthathele izinyathelo? Thina sinezinkinga eziningi ezikhungethe abantu bakithi okufanele sibhekane nazo. I-ANC iyona okufanele ibhekane nodaba lukaZuma.”UZuma uzithintele ebuholini be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ngesikhathi ememezela ukuthi ngeke ayikhankasele i-ANC okhethweni oluzayo.NgoMsombuluko ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal kanye namadlelandawonye baba nesithangami nabezindaba, lapho bagxeka khona isimemezelo sikaZuma.Isithangami sabanjwa emva komhlangano wamadlelandawonye.Okwaqapheleka kuleso sithangami ukungabi khona kobuholi beSanco.UCele uthe banquma ukungabi ingxenye yesithangami nabezindaba ngenxa yokuthi abavumelani nendlela ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal obusingathe ngayo lolu daba.Ukhale ngokuthi ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal bubukela phansi ubuholi beSanco.UCele uphinde wakhala ngokushiywa ngaphandle kwabaholi be-Sanco ngesikhathi kuhlanganiswa uhlu lwabazomela i-ANC esiShayamthetho saKwaZulu-Natal kanye nasemkhandliwini wezifundazwe.Yize benalezi zikhalo, uCele ugcizelele ukuthi abavumelani nombono kaZuma wokuthi abantu bangayivoteli i-ANC."Thina sizoqhubeka nokukhankasela i-ANC. INKOSI uBryce Mthimkhulu yesizwe saMaHlubi ithi intshisekelo yokusiza abantu abahlwempu yiyona eyenze yahlangana namanye amakhosi kwasungulwa iqembu elizongenela ukhetho ngonyaka zayo.Isiphithiphithi samaqembu silokhu siqhubeke njalo njengoba izwe libheke okhethweni lukazwelonke ngonyaka ozayo. Ukhetho lubhekwe ngabomvu, wonke amaqembu athembisa izulu nomhlaba kubavoti.Inkosi ithe baphezu kwemizamo yokuba nomcimbi omkhulu enkundleni yezemidlalo, iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini phakathi kukaJanuwari 20 kuya ku-27 ngonyaka ozayo. Ithe kodwa ngeke kuze kushaye uFebhuwari uphele kungenzekanga.INKOSI uBryce Mthimkhulu ithi izongenela ukhetho ngeqembu elididiyelwe amakhosi ngoba uzimisele ngokusiza abantu Isithombe : SITHUNYELWEIsolezwe lihlolile lathola ukuthi iqembu elishiwo yinkosi liyavela ohlwini lwe-IEC njengeqembu elibhalisile. Inkosi ithe kunesigungu samakhosi esibizwa nge-United House of Monarch kodwa sona asilona iqembu lezepolitiki kulapho abahlangana khona.Inkosi uMthimkhulu ithe i-African Rennaisance Unity (Aru) isungulwe yabhaliswa ngo-2019 kodwa kwangangeneka kahle okhethweni ngoba isikhathi sase singavumi. Inkosi ithe bafuna nokuthi izwi labaholi bendabuko lizwakale, bameleleke kuhulumeni."Mina ngingumuntu osiza abantu kakhulu ngezindlela ezehlukene, ngifundisa izingane mahhala futhi nginikele ezinhlelweni ezehlukene. Ngibone ukuthi kufanele singenele ukhetho ukuze yonke le misebenzi siyenze ngaphansi kweqembu,’’ kusho inkosi.Ikhale kakhulu ngenkohlakalo ethe idla lubi, yathi kufuneka amakhosi ngoba wona asondelene nabantu futhi athembekile. Ibuzwa ngokuthi akulona yini elinye lamaqembu angoqhibukhowe avela ngokhetho kuphela, inkosi ithe ayinaso isizathu sokwenza lokho.’"Ngikahle mina angixakekile kangako kodwa ngibona kufanele ngisize abantu ngendlela ethe thuthu. Umuntu ongabe esho njalo ngabe ezibhedela nje,’’ kusho inkosi.
OSOMABHIZINISI bamazwe angaphandle abazinze eNingizimu Afrika, bathembisa ukunqanda izinkinga esezibadelele amazinyo abushelelezi kwizakhamisi zakuleli.Basolwa ngokuwisa osomabhizinisi bakuleli njengoba baziwa ngokudayisa izimpahla zabo ngamanani aphansi.Baveze ukuthi bazolungisa lesi simo ngesikhathi bekhuluma embizweni yosomabhizinisi yokugubha ukubuyisana nabakuleli ebikwaHlabisa muva nje.UMnuz Joseph Yusuf obemele osomabhizinisi bangaphandle, uthe sekufike isikhathi sokuthi baziveze ekulekeleleni abantu basemphakathini abakuwona nabaqhuba kuwona amabhizinisi abo."Konke kusele kithina njengosomabhizinisi ekutheni sizisondeze kumalungu omphakathi akhombisa ukuseseka kakhulu emabhizinisini ethu. Ngikholwa ukuthi lesi sinyathelo esisithathayo sizolekelela kakhulu ekutheni sibuyisane namalungu omphakathi nosomabhizinisi bendawo. Abantu abaningi bakholwa ukuthi ukufika kwethu kuleli kubamoshele ekuqhubeni amabhizinisi abo ngokukhululeka. Baphinde babone sengathi siphinde sabaphuca iqatha emlonyeni ngokuvula amabhizinisi ezweni labo. Yingakho kuyisifiso sethu ukuthi sisebenzisane nomphakathi ukuze nathi sicobelele ngolwazi lwethu engikholwa ukuthi luzolekelela kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni osomabhizinisi bendawo abasebancane,” kusho uYusuf.Uthe ukholwa ukuthi leli gxathu lizolekelela kakhulu ekulweni nobubha entsheni eswele imisebenzi.UNksz Ayanda Khuzwayo obengomunye wentsha ebihambele umcimbi, uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi basondele ezinhlelweni zabo.

BEZIDLA lubi izigameko zobugebengu nokubanjwa kwenkunzi ezikoleni KwaZulu-Natal, ezibikwe kulo nyaka.Izikole bezithathwa njengezindawo ezingenabo ubungozi obungako bokuhlasela kwezigebengu kodwa muva nje, othisha sebefundisa bejeqeza kwezinye izikole ikakhulu ezindaweni ezidume ngokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa.Ngenyanga edlule, kuthiwa imigulukudu ebizenza abazali abebezofunela izingane izikhala zokufunda ngonyaka ozayo, ingene esikoleni i-Lingelihle Primary eHluthankungu, eHighflats, yakhomba othisha ngezibhamu yabaphoqa ukuthi bakhiphe amaselula, ubucwebe yaphinda yathatha amakhompyutha esikole emini kabha kuqhubeka ukufunda.Kwenzeka lokhu nje, amaphoyisa asaphansi phezulu athungatha abasolwa okuthiwa babamba inkunzi othisha ababili ababanjwa bengena esikoleni abafundisa kusona eBrooklyn Heights esiseChartsworth, esigamekweni esenzeke ngo-Agasti. Kuthiwa bakhonjwa ngesibhamu kwathathwa imali namaselula othisha ngaphambi kokuthi abasolwa babaleke ngezinyawo.Abazali bezingane ezifunda esikoleni samabanga aphansi iVezokuhle esiseMgungundlovu, kudingeke babhikishe bavale umgwaqo odlula ngakusona ngamathayi avuthayo, bekhala ngezigameko zobugebengu, okuthiwa zenzeka ngaphakathi esikoleni okusolwa izigebengu imvamisa ezisuke ziqhamuka ngaphandle.NgoMeyi walo nyaka, amalungu omphakathi atitinye kanzima abasolwa, emva kokuthi kuthiwa bangene esikoleni iThornwood Secondary, esiseMariannhill, kuqhubeka ukufunda bakhomba abafundi ngamathoyizi ezibhamu bezama ukubaphuca amaselula. Uthishomkhulu wasesikoleni Indonsa High esiseNewcastle, ekuqaleni konyaka usinde kukubi edutshulwa ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole, ekuseni kungakaqali nokufunda waphuma engenamyocu.Uthisha waseSandakahle Primary eMlaza, waphuthunyiswa emtholampilo elimele emva kokuhlaselwa abasolwa ababili engena nje emasangweni esikole okuthiwa babezama ukuduna imoto yakhe, kwasiza ukumemeza kwabafundi kwaphuma amalungu omphakathi abajaha. ISIKHUNGO esithekelisa ngegazi kuleli ISouth African National Blood Service (SANBS) sicela umphakathi ukuthi unikele ngegazi kulesi sikhathi samaholidi kaKhisimusi ukuze kwenyuke igazi elikhona ezinqolobaneni zalo.UNksz Thandi Mosupye wophiko lwezokuxhumana nentengiso eSANBS, uthe: "Sibhekene nengwadla yokushoda kwegazi kanti izikhungo zezempilo ngalesi sikhathi zivamise ukuba nesibalo esithe xaxa sabezimo eziphuthumayo ezingalindelekile, okudala umphumela othusayo uma sishodelwa igazi. Sinxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi babambisane nathi kulesi sikhathi esinzima. Isidingo segazi sihlala sikhona njalo, kodwa manje igazi esinalo liya ngokuya lincipha nokungaholela ekutheni sehluleke ukusindisa iziguli ezithembele egazini elinikelwa umphakathi. Uma sekuqale isikhathi samaholidi isibalo sabantu abasinikelela ngegazi siyehla ngenxa yokuvalwa kwezindawo zokusebenza, nezikhungo zezemfundo ephakeme."Le nhlangano ithe uhlobo lwegazi oluphansi kakhulu ezinqolobaneni uB-positive no-O-positive." Igazi i-B-positive iwuhlobo lwegazi olubalulekile ezigulini ezishodelwa igazi i-anemia ezidinga ukumpontshelwa igazi njalo. Igazi u-O-positive lidingeka kakhulu ngoba lihambisana negazi elingu-80% wabantu bakuleli. Igazi esinalo ezinqolobaneni lenele ukusetshenziswa izinsuku ezithathu kanti kudingeka ukuthi igazi lihlale lenele izinsuku ezinhlanu," kusho uNkk Masupye.

Ugogo wengane nonina babalekile, kabaziwa ukuthi babhace kuphi njengoba lesi sigameko sishaqise amalungu omphakathi,” kusho umthombo.Induna kule ndawo, uMnuz Mfaniseni Mnomiya, ithe yazisiwe ngalesi sigameko yavuka izolo, yanikela kulo muzi ethe kukaMagabela."Kule ndawo ngenxa yokuthi kunezindlu ezihlala abantu abehlukene abanye baqashile, akungcwatshelwa egcekeni kodwa kunendawo yamathuna. Ngesikhathi ngifika, akekho engikwaze ukukhuluma naye wakhona kulo muzi njengoba kuvela ukuthi abantu bakhona abekho babalekile. Kodwa amalungu omphakathi asilandisile ngokwenzekile kumbiwa isidumbu. Yinto esishaqisile nokuthi asiyazi imbangela eholele kulesi simo,” kusho uMnomiya.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Mhlabunzima Memela, uqinisekise ukuthi ihhovisi lomnyango elikuleya ndawo lazisisiwe ngesigameko."Ngebhadi, akukho muntu kuloya muzi ngakho abasebenzi bomnyango bese begcina bethembela kwabakutshelwa amalungu omphakathi. Siyawagqugquzela amalungu omphakathi abike ngezimo ezifuze lezi emaphoyiseni ngakho sisishayela ihlombe isenzo selungu lomndeni sokubika ngalolu daba ukuze isidumbu sengane sihlolwe kutholakale nembangela yokushona kwayo,” kusho uMemela.Uxwayise amalungu omphakathi ngokungcwaba kungalandelwa imigudu efanele, wathi uma umuntu eshonele ekhaya kufanele kulindwe amaphoyisa nabezempilo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isidumbu siyahlolwa futhi siyenziwa nesitifiketi sokushona. Uthe uma bengenawo amandla okungcwaba, uhulumeni uhlale evule izandla ukusiza imindeni ehluphekayo ukuze kugwemeke izimo ezifuze lezi ezingagcina sezenza abantu bavulelwe amacala obugebengu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseNew Hanover avule idokodo ngokufa komuntu emva kokumbiwa kwalesi sidumbu.
SIBASHIYE bebhocobele abaholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal namadlelandwonye isinqumo sowayenguMengameli waleli qembu, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, osesungule iqembu elizoncintisana ne-ANC okhethweni ngonyaka ozayo. Ememezela leli qembu elibhaliswe ngegama elithi uMkhonto weSizwe ngempelasonto, uZuma unxenxe abantu ukuba bavotele le nhlangano entsha ngoba i-ANC "ayiselona leli qembu alijoyina”.Ubuholi be-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, ezinyangeni ezedlule obamemezela ukuthi buzosebenzisa uZuma emikhankasweni, buthe isinqumo sikaZuma sifana nokuthi uzixoshile kwi-ANC.Lokhu bakusho emva komhlangano wesigungu esiphezulu kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal obuhanjelwe abaholi bamadlelandawonye obuseThekwini, izolo.UNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Bheki Mtolo, uthe uZuma ukhombise ukungaziphathi kahle."Eminyakeni engu-111 kwasungulwa i-ANC, kungokokuqala ukuba kube nomholi oqavile onxenxa ukuba abantu bangayivoteli i-ANC, bavotele enye inhlangano. Noma phambilini beke baba khona abaholi abake bagxeka i-ANC, kepha abakaze bathi ayingavotelwa i-ANC. Ngesikhathi enza isimemezelo sakhe, ukhulume kabi nge-ANC.”UMtolo usole uZuma ngokuzama ukudukisa amalungu e-ANC."Iqiniso ukuthi leli qembu athi alivotelwe alisiwona uMkhonto weSizwe wangempela. UMkhonto weSizwe wangempela yilona oweseka i-ANC, esinawo lana. Leli qembu lisungulelwe ukuba lidukise abantu ukuba bacabange ukuthi liwuMkhonto weSizwe lona oyingxenye ye-ANC. UMkhonto weSizwe wangempela uzokube ukhankasa nathi, unxusa abantu ukuthi bavotele i-ANC.”UMtolo uthe akasiboni isidingo sokuthi i-ANC ixoshe uZuma, wathi uzixoshe yena ngokunxenxa abantu ukuthi bavotele inhlangano yepolitiki ezokube incintisana ne-ANC okhethweni."Le nto iyafana nje nenkosikazi ehamba ithi ishade nawe ekubeni isishade nenye indoda. Ukushada kwayo enye indoda kusho ukuthi asisekho isidingo sesahlukaniso ngoba vele isikushiyile.”IPhini likaNobhala we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, lithe abanalo uvalo lokuthi isinqumo sikaZuma sizokwenza ukuthi sinciphe isibalo sabantu abazovotela i-ANC esifundazweni."Njengamanje semukela amalungu aqhamuka ezinhlanganweni ezahlukene futhi senza kahle ezinkethweni zokuchibiyela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-ANC iyakhula. Asinalo noluncane uvalo.”IPhini likaSihlalo we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uNksz Nomagugu Simelane, lithe yize bephoxekile ngokwenziwe uZuma, uthe abazisoli ngokumeseka kule minyaka eyedlule.I-ANC KwaZulu-Natal ibihlezi yeseka uZuma kuxhaxha lwamacala asezinkantolo abebhekene nawo.Bekulindeleke ukuthi ubuholi beSanco KwaZulu-Natal, buhlangane izolo, ebusuku, ukuzobhunga ngodaba lukaZuma.UZuma uwuSihlalo weSanco KwaZulu-Natal, kanti iSanco idlelana ne-ANC.

UZuma wayeyingxenye yawo lo mbutho, waze waba wumkhuzi wawo.Uhlakazwe ngokusemthethweni ngo-1993, ngesikhathi sekusondele ukhetho lukazwelonke lwentando yeningi.UZuma wesule esikhundleni sikamengameli ngo-2018, emuva kokuthi i-ANC yayimshishibeza ngolumabhaxa sekukhona ubuholi obusha benhlangano.UZuma uhlale kwi-ANC iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-60, wayihola ezigabeni ezehlukene waze waba wumengameli wayo amahlandla amabili. UNgizwe wagcina ezinikela emaphoyiseni waboshwa wavela enkantolo wahamba icala waze walinqoba.

Ngakho ke akulula ukuba sengingahamba ngibuza ukuthi kungani sithathe isinqumo esithile.”UMnuz Musa Ntsibande, wenkampani iStrauss Daly, uthe bebengakaziswa ngokuqashwa kwabo kabusha.UNtsibande uthe bayaqhubeka nokumela iSilo kanye nabanye abantwana basendlunkulu emacaleni athinta umbango wamafa eSilo esasabuza, uGoodwill Zwelithini kaBhekuzulu.Leli cala lalifakwe nguNdlunkulu wokuqala kaMdlokombane, uSibongile Winfred Dlamini Zulu, wasesigodlweni kwaKhethomthandayo.Undlunkulu ufuna uhhafu wamafa njengoba ethi umshado wakhe neSilo esesabuza wawuhlanganisa amafa.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu yamchitha kepha walidlulisela phambili icala.

Kuthiwa uRadebe nayehamba naye, bahlasela umgilwa ona-26 owayezihambela emgwaqweni eqeda kuqathazwa yimoto yasemsebenzini wakhe eyayimlethile.Kuvele ukuthi ngesikhathi ehla, laba babehleli emotweni ethile eyayimi kulo mgwaqo ayezohamba kuwo. Kuthiwa bamkhomba ngesibhamu, bathatha umholo wakhe onguR3 000, isikhwama esasinezimpahla zokusebenza, iselula namateki. URadebe okuthiwa wayephethe isibhamu wadubula umgilwa owalimala kanzima umgogodla.Laba kuthiwa badlulela enxanxatheleni yezitolo iDube Village, lapho bafika khona bashaya abathengi ababephuma kwesinye sezitolo. Ngesikhathi kufika amaphoyisa ezama ukunqanda uRadebe nahamba naye okuthiwa basebevuke indlobane, wadubula wabhekisa ngakuwo, namaphoyisa aphendula ngendlela efanayo. Walimala waphuthunyisa emtholampilo oseduze, kwathi owayehamba naye wakwazi ukudlubulundela abeleke.Kwatholakala kuyena iselula kamgilwa, wabe eseboshwa. Ngesikhathi umshushisi kuleli cala, uKaystree Ramsamujh ehola ubufakazi, umgilwa waveza ukuthi ukulimala ngesikhathi ebanjwa inkunzi akukavumi ukuphola futhi usathuka izanya uma ephuma emsebenzini eya ekhaya.Emva kokucutshungulwa kobufakazi obunekelwe inkantolo, imgwebe iminyaka ewu-15 ngecala lokubamba inkunzi, emihlanu kwelokuzama ukubulala, ewu-10 kwelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nonyaka kwelokutholakala nezinhlamvu. Isigwebo sakhe uzosidonsa kanye kanye.Inkantolo iphinde yamephuca ilungelo lokuphatha isibhamu.OKhulumela uphiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe bayasemukela lesi sigwebo."Sincoma ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kophiko lwezokuShushiswa koMphakathi namaphoyisa. Abantu bakuleli bahleze bekhalela ukuthi abantu abenza njengommangalelwa baboshwe baphinde bashushiswe ngempumelelo. Uhlelo lwe-National Development Plan 2030 lukhuluma ngokuphepha komphakathi ngakho lokhu kuwukusabela ekhelweni lalolu hlelo,” usho kanje.
AWUJIKI uVukayibambe we-ANC (ANCYL) ngokuthi ufuna sande isibalo sentsha ezojutshelwa ePhalamende, eziShayamthetho nakuhulumeni ngemuva kokhetho lwangonyaka ozayo.Le ntsha ithi kumele bangabuyeli ezikhundleni zabo ongqongqoshe abahlulwe ngumsebenzi.Umengameli walolu phiko uMnuz Collen Malatji, uthe abajiki ekhweleni labo lokuthi bafuna u-50%, kuya phezulu wentsha kulezi zikhundla.Uthe labo abacabanga ukuthi bayadlala, bayaphupha ngoba lokhu kuzokwenzeka."Sifuna intsha kulezi zikhundla, akukwazi ukuthi kungagcwala abantu abadala. Uma kungenzeki lokhu, kusho ukuthi bazobe bephaka impi ne-ANC Youth League.” USihlalo kazwelonke we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe, wagxeka lolu phiko ngalezi zimfuno, wathi kumele igxile ekuwineni izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme njengoba ibhaxabulwa wuphiko lwentsha lwe-EFF, iyeke eyezikhundla.UMantashe wathi ngeke kwenzeke njengokuthanda kwalolu phiko.UMalatji ugxeke ukuncishiwa kwesabelomali sesikhwama esixhasa izitshudeni ngemali yokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo wathi akumele lesi sabelo sincishiwe."Akukwazi ukuthi kungathi kukhulunywa eyokufuqa eyamakhono entsheni, ekubeni kuncishiswa isabelomali seNSFAS. Sifuna kufakwe abantu abafuna ukusebenza, basebenzele intsha.” Uthe bazoxoxa noMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngokuthi basuswe labo ngqongqoshe abangawenzi umsebenzi wabo.Ugxeke nalabo abathi uma sebeshiya kwi-ANC, ababiza abezindaba ekubeni bajoyina le nhlangano ngabodwana.

Kuthiwa umsolwa ungene emotweni wazama ukubaleka kodwa onogada bamhlala ezithendeni, wangena emgwaqweni ophelayo, kwabe usezivalele ekhoneni, zamkhalela.Ikhansela lendawo uMnuz Phumlani "Mapu” Gumbi, ebelikhona kwenzeka lesi sigameko njengoba nalo belidlala ngalolu suku, lichaze uNdlovu njengomuntu obengenalo udlame, ozithandela ibhola okungenzeka ukuthi ulaka lwakhe beluhambisana nokuthi ubeseqiwe uphuzo."Sihlela ukuvakashela umndeni, yize simadolonzima ngoba asazi uzosithatha kanjani ngoba yithina esamlanda ukuthi azovimbela leli qembu njengoba ubenekhono elimangalisayo ezintini. KUHLUKENE imibono kwizazi zepolitiki emuva kokuthi lowo owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ememezele ukuthi ngeke ayivotele i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo.Ngosuku lokubuyisana uZuma ushaqise abaningi ememezela ukuthi uzovotela iqembu elisha elibizwa ngokuthi uMkhonto Wesizwe njengoba engeke asebenzisane ne-ANC eholwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Isazi sepolitiki esizimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, sithe isenzo sikaZuma siphambene nemigomo ye-ANC ekubeka kucace ukuthi uma ujoyina le nhlangano uzimisele ukuyeseka.Uthe silubeka obala uqhekeko olukhona kule nhlangano.Ubalule ukuthi i-ANC izithola ibhekene nesimo esinzima lapho kuyiphoqa ukuthi yenze okuthile ngoZuma kwazise usesigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwayo."UZuma akafunanga ukuthi azixoshe kodwa ushiyele i-ANC ukuthi kube iyona ezithathela isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe. Uwumuntu okwaziyo ukuthola uzwelo ngoba uma i-ANC imxosha uyobe esekhala ngokuthi inhlangano aseyisebenzele iminyaka engaphezu kuka-60 isimxoshile. Okuzoba nzima kwi-ANC wukuthi uma ingamxoshi izokwenzanjani ngaye ngoba uhlala esigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwenhlangalo lapho kuzobe kubhungwa ngezinhlelo zokhetho nokunye njengoba kuqala unyaka,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe okwenziwa wuZuma nokwenziwa wuThabo Mbeki akufani neze ngoba uMbeki akazange amemezele ukuthi uzosebenzisana nelinye iqembu kodwa wathi ivoti lakhe liyimfihlo.Ekhuluma kwiNewzroom Afrika, uSolwazi Andre Duvenage oyisazi sepolitiki esizinze eNyuvesi yaseNorth West, uthe akayiboni i-ANC ixosha uZuma ngenxa yogazi analo njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni."UZuma ucuphe i-ANC ukuthi imxoshe. Angiboni kwenzeka lokho ngoba noThabo Mbeki wenza okucishe kufane nalokhu okwenziwe wuZuma emuva kokuba exoshiwe. Wathi ngeke ayivotele i-ANC futhi ngeke aphume kuyona. Akazange axoshwe ngakho noZuma angimboni exoshwa. Into engenzeka wukuthi i-ANC ingazama ukuxoxa naye ngoba ukumxosha kuzoyilahlekisela ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uDuvenage.Wenze isibonelo sokuthi uZuma unawo amandla ngoba ngo-2021 ngesikhathi eboshwa kwabheduka izwe, kwayizibhelu zikaJulayi, KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng.Uthe uZuma uzosebenzisa ithuba lokuthi abe nekusasa elingamgqigqisi enkantolo uma i-ANC ikhetha ukuxoxa naye.UMnuz Mafika Mndebele okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayamhlonipha kakhulu uZuma njengomakadebona kodwa lokhu akwenzile bakubona kuyindlela yokuzama ukususa abantu kwi-ANC.Ucele bonke abantu ukuba bavotele i-ANC ngoba iyona eyithemba labantu. Wathi uZuma uyena owabafundisa ukuthi akekho umuntu obaluleke ukudlula i-ANC ngakho abantu mabaqhubeke nokuyeseka.

Izithunywa ezisethembe ngokuyisa phambili iqembu, zisinike umyalelo wokuthi sidale ubumbano, sinxenxe amalungu asebuholini baphambilini - abengekho kule ngqungquthela - ekutheni sibuyisane ukuze sikwazi ukuliyisa phambili. Izithunywa zithe kumele sidale ukuthula, silwe nesihlava esifaka ehlazweni sokugijima izinkantolo,” usho kanje.Uthe bazophinde belwele ukulungisa isimo ne- Independent Electoral Commission ikwazi ukubabuyisela ohlwini lwamaqembu angenele ukhetho.Abanye abaqokwe nguMnuz Milton Sokhela okhethwe ngo- elethu kwesePhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela kwesikaSihlalo, uMnuz Rodney Hlatshwayo kwesePhini likaSihlalo, uMnuz Teddy Thwala kwesikaNobhala-Jikelele noNksz Sithembile Msomi kwesephini lakhe.Bekuyingqungquthela yesibili yokukhetha ubuholi baleli qembu elisungulwe ngo-2011 nguKaMagwaza Msibi owayesuka kwi-IFP. Yize kunjalo, ubuholi obuqokwe kweyango-2019, obusafake isicelo sokuthi kubuyekezwe ukuhlakazwa kwabo njengoba inkantolo yayinqume kanjalo phambili emva kwezikhalo zokuthi akuhanjiswanga ngesikhathi buqokwa, uyaphikisana nale ngqungqutthela. Lobu buholi buveza ukuthi buzokuphonsela inselelo ukuhlala kwale ngqungquthela. Kubona kukhona uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe, kanti buthi njengoba inkantolo ibavumelile ngenyanga edlule ukuthi bangasifaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kokuhlakazwa kwabo, ngakho ubuholi babo busamile kuze kuphume isinqumo.
Bathuka izanya abahlali basemijondolo iPopo Molefe, eBoitekong, esifundazweni iNorth West, kulandela isigameko esishaqisayo sokubulawa kwabantu bezidlela ijiki egcekeni ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Kuthiwa kugasele oshayasibhamu abangaziwa ngabo-9.15, emzini okuyo le ndawo, bavulela ngenhlamvu kwabebesegcekeni.Kufe abesilisa abahlanu nabesifazane abane.UThandile Mampolo, ongomunye wabasindile, uthi ubuhlungu ngokwenzekile ngoba ulahlekelwe wumngani wakhe abemthanda kakhulu."Besihleli siziphuzela, kwangena abantu esangweni bavulela ngenhlamvu kuwo wonke umuntu, sonke sivele salala phansi, baqhubeka badubula. Laba bantu bebehambe bedubula sesilele phansi, nami ngivele ngazenza osefile ngalala ngathula,” kusho yena.UBrigadier Sabata Mokgwabone, okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uthi ngokombiko abawutholile bekuyiqoqo labantu abakhuluma isiXhosa abebehlangene egcekeni lalo muzi bephuza utshwala ngesikhathi behlaselwa."Kuthiwa bahlaselwe ngabasolwa abebekhuluma isiSuthu. Abagilwa abayisishiyagalombili bafe ujuqu, kwathi oyedwa washonela esibhedlela. Bayisishiyagalombili abathelwe ngamachaphazelo,” kusho yena.Uthi imbangela yokuhlaselwa kwalaba kayaziwa okwamanje futhi akukaboshwa muntu.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLieutenant General Sello Kwena, uhlanganise ithimba elikhethekile elizophenya ngalokhu.
UBEKE eqhulwini ukuphepha kwabafundi nokubaluleka kwemfundo, uMasipala i-Alfred Duma ngesikhathi wethula iphrojekthi yokwakhiwa kwebhuloho lezinyawo, elidle izindodla zemali.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yawo uMnuz Zama Sibisi, edalule ukuthi bethule iphrojekthi esizweni sakwaZwane eMangweni ngenxa yomfula ongaweleki uma ugcwele.Udalule ukuthi ibhuloho lidle u-R6.9 million. "Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi le mali izosetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa inhlalakahle yabantu,’’usho kanje.Ukuvulwa kwesikole esisha kule ndawo, iMfumbulwane Primary, uthe yikhona okubakhuthazile ukuthi bakhe ibhuloho."Uma singalakhi leli bhuloho, lokhu kuchaza ukuthi abafundi balesi sikole esisha ngeke baze baye esikoleni. Kokunye kungenzeka bazame ukuwela kanti kakuphephile,''usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi babone kungcono ukuba babeke phambili ukuphepha kwabafundi basikole.IMeya uSibisi ithe kakumele kube khona okukhinyabeza imfundo yabantu bakule ndawo.
