Sikholwa wukuthi ngeke kube khona izinkinga uma seliphothuliwe,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi ziningi ezinye izinhlelo ezihlabahlosile abanazo, abahlose ukuzisebenzisela ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi wakule ndawo.Ngalo lolu suku kwethuwe usonkontileka ozokwakha ibhuloho, iSikwayo Holdings.Usonkontileka uveze ukuthi umsebenzi uzowenza nabantu basendaweni ukuze kuzoba yibona abahlomula ngamathuba omsebenzi.Ilungu lomphakathi lasendaweni, uNksz Nonhlakanipho Magwaza lithe kube yigxathu elihle elithathwe wubuholi base-Alfred Duma."Njengoba sekwakhiwe lesi sikole, bese kuphoqa ukuthi libe khona ibhuloho elizodala ukuthi bangabi nankinga abafundi uma bewela,’’usho kanjena.
SIYENYUKA isibalo samaqembu ahlangana ngenhloso yokuketula i-ANC emandleni, okhethweni olubhekwe ngabomvu lukazwelonke lwangoyaka ozayo.Lokhu kulandela ukungena kwamaqembu i-Ekhethu People’s Party, ezinze eGauteng ne-United Christian Democratic Party, eyasungulwa ngowayengumholi waseBophuthatswana, uMnuz Lucas Mangope.Leli qembu lizinze eNorth West kanti womabili azoba yingxenye yokhetho ukuze ancozule amavoti kaKhongolose. Isitatimende senhlanganisela yamaqembu abambisene okuyi-DA, IFP, FF Plus, ActionSA, ACDP, ISANCO, UIM neSNP, samukele lawa maqembu kule nhlanganisela. Sithe sinethemba lokuthi lawa maqembu azodla amavoti e-ANC kulezi zindawo. "Sifuna ukunika abavoti into ehlukile kunalokho abakunikwa i-ANC. Sinxenxa abantu bakuleli ukuthi basondele bavotele inqola ehambayo.” Le nhlanganisela ithembisa ukuthi kuzoba nokulingana ngakwezomthetho, amandla azobuyela kohulumeni basekhaya, kuzoliwa nenkohlakalo, kuzolethelwa abantu izidingo ezibafanele."Kuzohlinzekwa ngemfundo nezempilo ezisezingeni, kukhuliswe nomnotho ontengayo. Sizosebenza ngamandla ukubumba abantu bakuleli ukuze kube nezinguquko kuleli.” Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, usephufumule ezinkundleni ezehlukene ngokuthi le nhlanganisela yamaqembu ngeke iyiketule le nhlangano.URamaphosa wathi bayazi ukuthi ikuphi okudingwa ngumphakathi ngakho bayazilungisa izikhalazo zawo.Waveza ukuthi abeseka i-ANC abawavoteli amanye amaqembu uma bengeneme kodwa bamane bajezise le nhlangano ngokuthi bangayi kovota, bazihlalele emakhaya.Namhlanje abaholi be-ANC okubalwa noRamaphosa basonga imihlangano abebeyihambele yokuchazela abantu ngabakwenzile selokhu bathula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho lwango-2019.Lo mhlangano usongwa e-Alberton Civic Centre Ekurhuleni, eGauteng.
SEKUZE kwejwayeleka ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki agqigqe eNdlunkulu kaZulu, eyokotha iSilo futhi lokhu kukhona okuthile okukuchazayo ngobudlelwano bepolitiki yamaqembu nobukhosi. Cishe wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi osopolitiki uma kukhona into abayenzayo, basuke belele emqondweni othile wokuthi bahlomule amavoti.Kuyacaca ukuthi amaqembu lawa aqonda kabanzi ukuthi amandla obukhosi nokuthi uma ebonakala eduze kweSilo cishe lokhu kungakha isithombe esithile kubantu abangaphansi kwaso. Amahele lawa ayokotha iSilo, aqala ukwanda kakhulu manje njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke oluzoba ngonyaka ozayo.Awafiki nje ngezandla kodwa asuke eqhuba imihlambi yezinkomo akhuleka ngazo kusona iSilo. Akugcini lapho, kuba nenimhlangano ebanjelwa esithe okugcina kungaziwanga ukuthi kuxoxwani kuyona. Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi wonke amaqembu akhuluma kahle ngeSilo kwabezindaba esho khona ukuthi siwuhlaka olubalulekile futhi ayaseseka.ISilo siphila ngomgomo wokuthi asihlangene naqembu lezepolitiki kodwa simukela wonke umuntu uma efisa ukusondela eyokotha ebukhosini. ISilo sikaZulu siphethe ubukhosi obukhulu, obudumile nobuhlonishwayo emhlabeni nokuchaza ukuthi kunezinkumbi zabantu abangaphansi kwaso. Ubukhosi bukaZulu budala kakhulu futhi budume ngamaqhawe aziwayo emlandweni.ISilo siphinde sengamele umhlaba omkhulu KwaZulu-Natal ngaphansi kwebhodi Ingonyama Trust ehlala isematheni nosopolitiki bephikisana ngayo ngakhulu.Into enkulu kosopolitiki wukucubuza amagabade kubantu bese bethola amavoti azobasondeza emandleni. Inhlangano ebusayo i-ANC nabaholi bayo abajutshwe kuhulumeni bayagqigqa kakhulu ukuyokotha iSilo. I-ANC yona uma iziphendulela ngokuzihuqa eSilweni ithi inakekela ubuholi bendabuko ngoba buyingxenye ebalulekile yokubuswa kwezwe.UKhongolose uma ucubungula imbangela yokwehlelwa amavoti KwaZulu-Natal, ukubeka kucace ukuthi udaba lweSilo neNdlunkulu kaZulu lunomthelela. Bakubeka kucace ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthi kulungiswe ubudlelwano benhlangano nendlunkulu futhi kulekelelwe ukudala uzinzo.UNobhala -Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, egcina ukuvakashela iSilo wakhuleka ngezinkomo eziwu-10 ngoMeyi nonyaka. Kwasabalala ukukhuluma okuthi i-ANC ibizama ukuthenga iSilo kodwa kwachithwa lokho, kwathiwa kushiwo abantu abangaqondi ngosiko."Ukuvakasha kwethu siyobona iSilo kuyingxenye yokuthi sihlale sixhumene nezinhlaka ezibalulekile emphakathini. Siyazi ukuthi ubukhosi bubaluleke kanjani. Siyaseseka iSilo ngayo yonke indlela,’’ kusho uMbalula ephawula ngohambo lwakhe ukuyokotha.Ufakazi wokuthi indlunkulu ithathwa njengebalulekile kosopolitiki, wukuthi uhulumeni uqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwayo ngesabelomali unyaka nonyaka. ISilo sinikwa izimoto neminye imihlomulo ehambisana nesikhundla sayo.Indlunkulu neSilo kuze kubangwe amaqembu ezepolitiki ejikijelana ngamazwi esolana ngezinto ezehlukene. Kuke kwaba nomdonsiswano oshubile phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC esifundazweni ngodaba lweSilo.I-ANC yayikhala ngokuthi i-IFP isebenzisa indlunkulu negama leSilo ukuzigayela amavoti. I-IFP ibihlala ikuchitha lokhu, ithi yinto engekho yona ayixubi iminxa ehlukene iSilo nenhlangano. Obekudala umsindo wukuthi umsunguli we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ongasekho ibiwundunankulu kaZulu isikhathi eside.I-IFP isanda kuhamba nayo iyokotha iSilo yakhuleka ngezinkomo okuthiwa zicela kwezingu-20. Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz uMkhuleko Hlengwa, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba wathi bavakashele iSilo ukuzosiduduza ngokulahlekelwa wundunankulu waso inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi."Kukhona ubudlelwano obukhona ngoba umsunguli we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ibuwundunankulu kaZulu. Sithe asivele sizoduduza iSilo ngokulahlekelwa kwaso. UShenge ubambe elikhulu iqhaza ezindabeni zobukhosi endlunkulu. KUBUKEKA sengathi abaculi bakamaskandi abasagcini nje ngokuqhudelana ngengoma kule mihla kodwa sebethelelana nangomkhuba omuhle wokuvusa imizi yakubo ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Omaskandi bayaziwa ukuthi bakhonze ukuchoma nangomswenko kodwa sebeswenkisa nemizi yasemakubo manje.Umculo kamaskandi kule minyaka, ubonakale ungenisa kakhulu ngisho kubantu abangebona abasemakhaya. KUMBA eqolo ukudla njengoba igilosa yomndeni onamalungu amahlanu kuya phezulu isibiza uR5, 314.63.Ngo-Okthoba ibibiza uR5, 297.58 kanti ngonyaka odlule yayibiza uR4, 835.96.UMnuz Mervyn Abrahams wenhlangano eyenza ucwaningo ngentengo yokudla nesimo senhlalo, iPietermaritzburg Economic Justice & Dignity Group, uthe ukudla kubiza ukudlula amaholo.Uthe ukudla okubiza kakhulu ngamaqanda njengoba enyuke ngo-18% nenyama yenkukhu okubalwa amaphisisi, amanqina, izingingila nezibindi.Uthe ngisho amasi anyukile kanjalo nethini likafishi, okusho ukuthi abampofu abakwazi ukuthenga ukudla okunomsoco.Uveze ukuthi u-anyanisi yiwona owehle kakhulu ekudleni okusetshenziswa cishe nsukuzonke ngabantu. Njengamanje isaka eliwu-10kg ka-anyanisi libiza uR32,82 lisuka kuR106,53. Amazambane nawo ehle ngo-11% njengoba u-10kg usuwuR130,02 usuka kuR145,3.Ukhale ngokuthi amaholo asamile kuR4, 473.92 kubasebenzi abahola kancane kodwa ukudla kulokhu kunyukile ngenxa yamandla emali.Uthe abesifazane sebethenga ukudla okukhulu ngamaqoqo (combo) ukuze bazame ukonga bese bethenga amaveji nezithelo kubadayisi basemgwaqweni."Ucwaningo silwenza kwabesifazane ngoba yibona abenza igilosa njalo ngenyanga. Bathenga ukudla okungamaqoqo ukuze bonge imali. Bathwala kanzima ngoba isibonelelo sezingane siwuR510 kanti ukudla okunomsoco kwengane kuwuR946.98. Sifuna isibonelelo sabantwana okungenani sibe wuR760 ngenyanga,” kusho u-Abrahams.Uthe bazoqhubeka nomkhankaso wabo wokuthi kunyuswe izibonelelo zikahulumeni kusukela empeshenini yabadala, isibonelelo sezingane nesabangasebenzi ngenxa yokuthi ayikho imisebenzi kuleli.
ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini siyihleke usulu indaba yezinkinga zezinkantolo esibhekene nazo, sathi uZulu uyayazi inkosi yawo, labo abasiphikisayo bayoze bavume. INgonyama ibikhuluma emcimbini wokwethulwa kohlelo lwamanzi enkundleni yezemidlalo eZibukweni, eJozini.Umcimbi ubuhlelwe wuMnyango wezaManzi nokuHanjiswa kweNdle futhi ubuhanjelwe wuNgqongqoshe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu nezinye izikhulu zikahulumeni. UNomthebe wesizwe sikaZulu ubemenywe ukuthi azokwethula inkulumo kulo mcimbi.Indaba esegudwini kulezi zinsuku wudaba lwesinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu ePitoli, esithe uMengameli uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa akalandelanga imigudu enika iSilo isitifiketi. URamaphosa wanika iSilo isitifiketi sobukhosi ngo-Okthoba 2022, phambi kwezinkumbi zabantu enkundleni yezemidlalo iMoses Mabhida.Udaba lwasenkantolo belufakwe wuMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu uyise omncane weSilo esibusayo.Umbango wobukhosi bukaZulu, waqala ukushisa phansi emuva kokukhothama kweSilo uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngoMashi 2021. ISilo salandelwa eduze wuNdlunkulu uMantfombi uMaDlamini Zulu, ozala iSilo esibusayo.ISilo sitshele abantu ukuthi akonakele lutho, inkosi iyodwa KwaZulu."Ngiyazi ukuthi nithi noma ningibheka nithi hheyi kazi ucabangani ngoba izinkantolo zimhlezi entanyeni. Sizwe sikaMageba, ngeke ngithini ngoba nani niyawazi umthetho wezinkantolo. Angikwazi ukuphawula ngalolu daba. Ngininikeza udolo qina wokuthi akonakele lutho, inkosi yenu niyayazi. Bayoze bathi bhuti nazo izinkantolo lezi,’’ kusho iSilo siqhuma yinsini.Umphakathi obugcwele itende unanele ngenhlokomo kukikizwa nensini iqhuma phezulu. ISilo sithe kuhle impela uma abantu behleka ngoba ukuhleka kuyaluxosha usizi. ISilo siphinde sacela ukuthi kukhulekelwe indlunkulu ngalesi sikhathi sathi siyamethemba uNkulunkulu."Ngicela ukuba nisikhulekele siyindlunkulu nikhulekele nawo amacala lawa akhona...kodwa uNkulunkulu uzoba naso isizwe sikaZulu ayimele indlela eyiyo neqiniso,’’ kusho iSilo.ISilo sikhuluma kanjena nje, uMengameli uRamaphosa usanda kumemezela ukuthi uzofaka isicelo sokwedlulisa isinqumo senkantolo emchithile. URamaphosa uthe nakuba udaba luqhubeka ezinkantolo kodwa iSilo sisekhona siyabusa.Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana u-Africa Zulu wendlu yasOnkweni, esitatimendeni asithumele, uthe bayabonga ngegxathu likamengameli lokufaka isicelo sokwedlulisa udaba."Siyasemukela futhi siyasincoma isinyathelo sikamengameli nokuthi aqinisekise ukuthi iSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini yisona esisesihlalweni. ISilo sizoqhubeka sisebenze ngokuzinikela sibeke phambili inhlalakahle yabantu baso,’’ kusho uMntwana u-Africa.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sithi yisona esisahleli esihlaweni, akushintshe lutho nakuba zikhona izinqumo zezinkantolo Isithombe: BONGANI MBATHA/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY (ANA)

OWESIFAZANE waKwaNdengezi, ePinetown, uNksz Nonhlanhla Sibisi, uthukuthele uyaveva ngokuhlehla kwecala elivulelwe uyise wengane yakhe, uMnuz Siyabonga Shezi (29). Icala lokubulala elibhekene noShezi lihlehliselwe uJanuwari 31 ngonyaka ozayo. UNksz Sibisi (27) uthe usecabanga nokuzibulala ngoba kuyamhlukumeza ukulokhu ebona umuntu amsola ngokubulala indodana yakhe eneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye, uSfundo Sibisi, ngesihluku. Uthe usegqigqe eNkantolo yeMantshi yasePinetown kusukela ngoJanuwari kwaze kwaba wuDisemba, kulokhu kugidwa esicelweni sikamsolwa sokudedelwa ngebheyili."Kufanele ngabe kade leli cala laqulwa laphela ngoba liyangihlukumeza mina. Ngikhathele ukubonana nobuso bomuntu owangibulalela ingane. Ukulokhu kukhulunywa ngomntanami engasekho nakho kuyangihlukumeza kakhulu ngoba angikapholi. Sengize ngicabange nokuzibulala ukuze ngithole ukuphumula emoyeni," kubalisa uNksz Sibisi. Uthe leli cala liyamphundla nasezimalini njengoba kufanele angayi etohweni alibambayo uma kuwusuku lwecala.UNksz Sibisi usola uShezi ngokubulala ngesihluku uSfundo Shezi ngoba efuna ukuqaqa yena. Eqhuba, uthe kwakunguJanuwari 13 kulo nyaka ngesikhathi uShezi ethatha indodana yabo lapho ayeyishiye khona kwamakhelwane, wayoyiklinya ehlathini ngentambo yesikhindi eyayisigqokile."Ngafonelwa nguyise wengane engitshela ukuthi angiphuthume ngilande isidumbu sayo ehlathini singaze sidliwe yizilwane zasendle. Ngathi uma ngimbuza ukuthi ukwenzeleni lokhu, wathi ubengiqaqa, efuna ukungizwisa ubuhlungu engingasoze ngabulibala impilo yami yonke."UNksz Sibisi uthe ingane yakhe yaficwa iklinywe ngentambo yesikhindi eyayisigqokile, ilele ngendlela eyayikhombisa ukuthi ize yaphuma umphefumulo ipaquza. Uthe kwenzeka lokhu nje ubevele engasathandani noyise wengane ngoba ubemhlukumeza futhi kunezincwadi zesivimbelo anazo. UNksz Sibisi uthe bebebanga ukuthi umsolwa ubefuna amnikeze ingane ahlale nayo ukuze kubo bamnikeze indlu yomxhaso. "Mina bengithi akayokhokha kuqala ekhaya ngoba akakaze wayihlawula futhi ubengayondli. Ubelokhu engemuhle kahle empilweni aze angafiki nasenkantolo uma kuzolalelwa icala lakhe.Emaphepheni abhalwe ngummeli wakhe uMnuz Mannie Witz, uthi u-Agrizzi wagqunywa ejele eJohannesburg Central ngo-Okthoba 2020, emuva kokunqatshelwa ibheyili. Uveza nokuthi ngaphambi kwalokho wayedalule wonke amaphepha nezincwadi zodokotela eziveza kabanzi ngesimo sempilo yakhe edalula nesifo sikashukela.U-Agrizzi ubevame ukuvela enkantolo ephethe isigubhu nepayipi elixhume emakhaleni elimsiza ukuphefumula. "Emuva kwalokho watholakala esitokisini edindilizile waphuthunyiswa esibhedlela ngenhlanhla wathola usizo, wavuka qingqo. Wadluliselwa esibhedlela esizimele lapho afike wangeniswa egunjini labagula kakhulu wahlala izinsuku ezingu-50,’’ kusho ummeli.

Isifiso esikhulu sika-Abelokuhle ukugxila kwiCoding and Robotics nezibalo aze aphothule u-matric ukuze ezokwazi ukuba unjinyela ngelinye ilanga. "Bengilokhu ngiphasa kakhulu izibalo ngenzela ukuthi ngikwazi ukuba udokotela kodwa ngashintsha sekufika iCoding and Robotics. Ngiyithandiswe nawukuthi uthisha uShezi uyifundisa kamnandi. "Ngiyafisa athole uthisha ozokwazi ukuqhubeka naye akwazi nokwenza neminye imsebenzi emikhulu. Nokuthola umfundaze wezikole ezinezinsiza ezanele ukuthuthukisa ikhona lakhe," kusho uShezi. Ephetha, uShezi uveze ukuthi ukusebenza ngokubambisana nozakwabo nothishomkhulu wesikole kwenze ukufaka iCoding and Robotics kwalula eBonisanani.U-Abelokuhle ugila izimanga nje, isimo sasekhaya asisihle futhi useyakwazi nokubona konke okwenzekayo nokuyisifiso sakhe ukukhula ashintshe isimo abaphila ngaphansi kwaso. Ngibonga isikole ebefunda kuso nothisha abakwazi ukumkhuthalela bakhombise nezwe ikhono lakhe. Ngiyafisa athole usizo lokufunda aze agogode," kusho uNksz Thabethe.Lo msebenzi ka-Abelokuhle sewujikeleza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, abantu abawuvali umlomo bafisa noMnyango wezeMfundo umsukumele ukuze ezoqhubeka enze neminye imsebenzi.BAVALE unyaka ngegiya eliphezulu eBonisanani Primary, u-Abelokuhle Thabethe enza amarobhothi ngezobuchwepheshe ngolwazi alucotshelelwe uthisha wakhe uMnuz Sandile Shezi Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent NewspapersU-ABELOKUHLE Thabethe nonina uNksz Sabekile Thabethe nothisha wakhe uMnuz Sandile Shezi Isithombe: Tumi Pakkies/ Independent Newspapers
IPHINI likaMongameli, uMnuz Paul Mashatile, lithi kunengwadla yabantu abadla imishanguzo yengculazi bayishiye phakathi bese kubuyisela emuva umgqigqo wokulwa negciwane. Uthe uhulumeni usehambe ibanga elide ekutheni alwe nengculaza kodwa bayaganga abayeka imishanguzo ingakapheli. Wathi kumele kunqandwe lokho kusemanje."Sinenkinga yokuthi abantu abaqala imishanguzo kodwa asikwazi ukubagcina ngoba babuye bashiye. Kufanele sifake umfutho omkhulu ukuze silungise lolu daba,’’ kunxusa uMashatile.Iphini lithe uma abantu beyidla kahle imishanguzo bangaze bafike ezingeni lapho igciwane lingasatholakali egazini kanti lokho kuyobe kusho ukuthi abasakwazi ukulidlulisa kwabanye.UMashatile uthe nakuba kunjalo, abagqugquzeli ukuthi abantu baye ocansini olungavikelekile ngoba zikhona ezinye izifo ezithathelanayo ngokocansi. Ucele ukuthi abaholi bomphakathi bangayeki ukugqugquzela abantu ukuba bazithibe futhi bafunde ngengculaza emphakathini.Ngokusho kwephini likamongameli uhulumeni unomgomo wokuthi ube usuyinqobile ingculaza ngo-2030. Uthe okukhathazayo wukuthi iNingizimu Afrika, isavela njengezwe elinabantu abaningi abahaqekile.Ukhuze abacwasa abantu abahaqekile babakhiphe inyumbazana emphakathini, wathi mabapheze ukwenza njalo.
AWENEME ngokuhudula izinyawo kwamaphoyisa, umndeni wengane yaKwaMagwaza, eNkandla, osekuphele unyaka ingangcwatshiwe.ULusakhanya Mkhize (2) isidumbu sakhe esagcina sitholwe sicwiyiwe ngo-Septhemba nyakenye, wayekade elahleke kwamakhelwane lapho ayegadwe khona ngo-Januwari. Kuthiwa ulimi namanye amalunga omzimba kwakungekho.Unina kamufi, uNksz Nonto Mkhize, ubalisa ngamaphoyisa awasola ngokuthi amenzela phansi.Ukhala ngokuthi kuze kube yimanje akakwazi ukuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokufihla indodana yakhe ngesizotha.Uthi amaphoyisa alokhu emtshela ukuthi imiphumelo yolibofuzo ayikabuyi ePitoli."Bebelokhu becasha ngokuthi kusalindwe imiphumela yolibofuzo lwalabo abashona engozini oPhongolo kanjalo nalabo abashona ngomlilo khona oPhongolo,” usho kanje.Uthi unabo abantu abajwayele oPhongolo abamtshela ukuthi kade yabuya imiphumela yolibofuzo lwalabo bantu amaphoyisa akhuluma ngabo futhi sebaze bangcwatshwa.INGANE eyaduka, uLusakhanya Mkhize Isithombe: SITHUNYELWE"Konke lokhu akungiphathi kahle ngoba nami ngifuna ukufihla ingane yami,” echaza.Uqhube wathi ufuna kube khona oboshwayo ngodaba lokulahleka kwengane yakhe, itholakale seyishonile.Phakathi kwabantu athi ufuna bavalelwe, owesifazane owayemgadele ingane."Miningi imibuzo enginayo ngaye ngoba ngosuku eyalahleka ngalo ngathola ukuthi ilahleke ngabo-9 ekuseni kodwa yene waze wangitshela ngabo-12 emini. Okungenza ngibe nemibuzo ukuthi ngamthumela umyalezo ngabo-9 ekuseni ngifuna enze izaba kwazise ingane yayiphethwe yisisu. Esikhundleni sokuthi angitshele ukuthi ingane seyilahlekile wavele wavuma lokhu engangikusho kwaphelela lapho,” usho kanje.Uthe okunye okumdidayo ukuthi la okwagcina kutholakala khona isidumbu sengane, eduze kwakhona kunomuzi wesihlobo salapho eyayigadwe khona.Ubuye waveza nokuthi bayazibuza bayaziphendula ukuthi kungani isidumbu sengani singazange sisheshe sitholakale ngoba lapho esagcina sitholwa khona yindawo ephithizelayo.Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa awazange athathe izithombe endaweni yesigameko ekhala ngokuthi awayiphethe ikhameraUthe futhi kunezinsalela zesidumbu amaphoyisa avele azishiya kanjalo, kuzona kukhona amazinyo nezingubo ayezigqokile umufi.Uveze ukuthi zimbili izingane ayekade ezicelele ukuthi zigadwe uLusakhanya nenye eyayineminyaka emihlanu kwazise yena kukhona itoho owayelibamba esikoleni sendawo kanti elinye ilungu lomndeni elalijwayele ukusala nazo lalinendlela izinsuku ezimbili.Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ezocinga umkhondo ngezinja, uveze ukuthi umakhelwane walapho ingane eyayigadwe khona wala waphetha ukuthi angene acinge kubo. Uthi agcina engacinganga ngempela nokwaba yinto eyamumangaza. Uthi waze wavuma emuva kwamasonto amabili nokuyinto athi yabashiya nemibuzo.Uthe ngosuku lokuqala akubanga nankinga, ngolwesibili kwabe sekwenzeka lo mshophi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, uthe idokodo lokufa komuntu lisaphenywa amaphoyisa aseKombe. "Amasampula olibofuzo athathwa kodwa angamesha. Kuphinde kwathathwa amanye,” kusho uLt Col Gwala.

ISAZI somnotho, uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa sithi ukwehla kwamandla emali asuke ku-5,9% ngo-Okthoba eya ku-5,5% ngoNovemba kufanele kuthathwe njengezindaba ezinhle ngoba kuzokwehlisa intengo kaphethroli nodizili ngoJanuwari.UDumisa uthe okwamanje iBhange loMbuso, iSouth African Reserve Bank (Sarb), akaliboni liyehlisa imalimboleko ngenxa yokuthi lifuna amandla emali abe phakathi kuka-3% no-6%."Kuyizindaba ezinhle ukuthi amandla emali ehlile njengoba ebe ku-6.9% ngo-Okthoba. Kuhle ngoba kuzokwehlisa intengo kadizili nophethroli. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa intengo yokudla ezitolo ngoba ukudla okuningi kuthuthwa ngamaloli futhi abalimi basebenzisa udizili kakhulu emaplazini abo,” kusho uDumisa.Uthe uma ikomiti leSarb lihlangana ngonyaka ozayo, lizobheka lezi zibalo bese liyishiya iku-8.25% imalimboleko.I-StatsSA iveze ukuthi yize amandla emali ehlile kodwa ukudla kusaqhubeka nokubiza.Kuvele ukuthi intengo yenyama isuke ku-3.4% ngo-Okthoba yaya ku-3,5% ngoNovemba.Ukuqubuka komkhuhlane wezinkukhu nakho kube nomthelela ekunyukeni kwenyama yenkukhu namaqanda. Intengo yamaphisisi enkukhu isiwu-7.3% isuka ku-5.5% ngo-Okthoba. Eyamaqanda selokhu kwaqubuka umkhuhlane wezinkukhu inyuka ngo-10,6% njalo ngenyanga kanti lokhu kusho ukuthi isifinyelele ku-39,9% kulo nyaka isuka ku-24,4% eyayikuwona ngo-Okthoba.Intengo kashukela, uswidi nama-desserts isiku-18.5% isuka ku-17.6% ebikuwona ngo-Okthoba.Kuvele ukuthi intengo kashukela omhlophe inyuke ngo-21.4% eyoshukela onsundu inyuke ngo-23.7% bese kuthi ekashokoledi inyuke ngo-11.8%.Kuvele ukuthi isinkwa nama-cereals kwehlile njengoba kuku-8.5% ngoNovemba kusuka ku-8.8% ngo-Okthoba.Intengo yamafutha nayo yehle kancane njengoba iku-23.5% isuka ku-23. 6%.Abanemizi babike ukuthi kunyukile ukubiza oplamba nabalungisa ugesi njengoba sekumi ku-7.4% kulo nyaka.Imithi ethengwa ekhemisi inyuke ngo-7.5%. Imithi abazithengela yona abantu abasuke bengayaleliwe wudokotela, okubalwa ama-vitamin inyuke ngo-13.2%, owesilungulela unyuke ngo-12.6%, owezinhlungu 12.3% bese owomkhuhlane wanyuka ngo-10.3%.
IMEYA yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, igqugquzele izivakashi ukuba zize ngobuningi bazo kuleli dolobha ngoba kuningi okuzozijabulisa.UKaunda usho lokhu izolo ngesikhathi kuvulwa indawo yokuhamba izivakashi ebhishi laseMhlanga ebizwa nge-Whalebone Pier.Uveze ukuthi kudle uR3.2 million ukuyivuselela le ndawo eheha inqwaba yezivakashi.Uthe kumabhishi awu-23 aseThekwini, mathathu kuphela avaliwe njengamanje wacela izintatheli ukuba zibalekelele ukudlulisa lo myalezo."Amabhishi ethu aphephile ukuthi kubhukude abantu. Ahlolwa kabili ngesonto, yithina nezinye izikhungo ezizimele. Siyayishicilela nemiphumela yokuhlolwa kwawo njengomasipala onakekelayo. Njengamanje amabhishi avaliwe akusiwona okubhukudwa kuwona. Kusavalwe ibhishi lasePipeline, eliseWinkelspruit neliseBluff. Azize izivakashi zizojabula eThekwini,” kusho uKaunda.Uthe izinsuku azifani ngemiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamabhizinisi ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi abezindaba balokhu bewudlulisa umyalezo emphakathini njalo uma sekunemiphumela emisha.Uthembise ukuthi ubumnandi buseThekwini njengoba kuza impelasonto enkulu."Kuningi okuzojabulisa abantu eThekwini, sinemicimbi yobumnandi, amabhishi anamanzi afudumele, amahhotela amahle, iziqiwi nokunye okuningi. Sisebenzisana nosomabhizinisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ezokuvakasha zihamba kahle kulo Disemba futhi nobugebengu buqashwe ngisho nangamakhamera,” kusho uKaunda.UMnuz Musa Mbhele oyimenenja kaMasipala weTheku, uthe benza kahle kangcono kunabanye omasipala abahlola amanzi asemabhishi emva kwamasonto amabili.Naye uhambe emazwini kaKaunda, wagqugquzela abantu ukuthi batheleke ngobuningi babo emabhishi ngoba konke bakubeke obala bewuMasipala weTheku.

Banemindeni, baya emakhaya balindiwe ukuthi bafike bephephile. Akulungile uma sesibathatha ngomthwalo esakha imali ngawo,” kusho uNkk Chukunga.Omunye umshayeli wetekisi ubesemanzi te ephekwe ngebhodwe elincane ngungqongqoshe, emkhombisa namaphutha asetekisini alayishe kulona abagibeli elokhe exolisa engaqedi.Ungqongqoshe ubehlola ukuthi umshayeli nemoto ahamba ngayo kusesimweni esikulungele ukuba semgwaqweni, ehlola izincwadi zabashayeli ne-disk yemoto ukuthi akuphelelwe isikhathi nokuthi abagibeli bawafasile amabhande, ebaqwashisa ngokuphepha.Ukhale ngabashayela bephuzile, wathi iningi lezingozi emigwaqweni zakamuva uthola ukuthi linotshwala phakathi."Engozini esuke imbandakanya izimoto ezimbili uthola ukuthi omunye wabashayeli uphuzile, abulale lona ongaphuzanga. Osephuzile akangashayeli, okungenani akagoduke ngemoto ekhokhelwa ngebanga elihambile noma ngetekisi,” kusho ungqongqoshe.Ubalule nokuthi iningi lezingozi lenzeka kuthelawayeka uN3 uma ubheke eThekwini, abantu sebevalile emisebenzini noma bezochitha amaholidi.Ungqongqoshe namaphoyisa bebemisa imoto bese beqwashisa namagibeli ngezindlela zokuphepha emgwaqweni.Ukhumbuze nabahamba ngezinyawo, wathi aweqi noma yikuphi futhi ulinda irobhothi libe kuhlaza bese uyawela.BEKUJULUKA umshayeli kwinyakanyaka yesivimbamgwaqo eMariannhill Toll Plaza eThekwini, izolo ekuseni Isithombe: Sibonelo Ngcobo/Independent MediaUkhale ngabashayela izimoto ezingenazo izinombolo, amathayi ayizimpandla, nezimoto ezingathelile."Kunomshayeli esimmisile imoto yakhe ebingenayo i-number plate ngaphambili kodwa ikhona ngemuva. Omunye kade yaphela i-disk, wawathenga ama-number plates, kodwa akawafakile uhamba ngemoto kube sengathi iseyintsha yize kade saphela isikhathi eyayibekelwe lokho,” kuchaza ungqongqoshe.Uthe yibona laba bantu abashayisa abanye emgwaqweni bese bedla phansi ngoba kusuke kungekho okuzobaveza, yibona abadala izinkinga emgwaqeni.UNkk Chikunga uthe bafake izinsiza-kusebenza namaphoyisa amaningi emigwaqweni emikhulu evame ukuba nomthamo omningi wezimoto ngalesi sikhathi sokuphela konyaka.
IZOQHUBEKA ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beNFP njengoba inkantolo ichithe icala ebelingathikameza ukuhlala kwengqungquthela.INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu ichithe icala ebelifakwe uhlangothi olungahambisani nengqungquthela okuhlelwe ukuba iqale ngoLwesihlanu, eThekwini.Lolu hlangothi okungabaholi beNFP abakhethwa engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu eyayingo-2019, belifuna ukuthi inkantolo inqume ukuthi ilona kuphela uhlaka lobuholi olusemthethweni kwiNFP.Lobu buholi bahlakazwa isinqumo senkantolo sango-2021, kepha busanda kusidlulisela phambili lesi sinqumo.Ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi yona ihlelwa ubuholi besikhashana obakhethwa emva kokuhlakazwa kobuholi bango-2019.Inkantolo ilukhiphile ohlwini lwamacala aphuthumayo udaba obelulalelwe izolo.Ijaji Nompumelelo Radebe uthe angeke akwazi ukukhipha isinqumo ngokushesha."Udaba olufakwe enkantolo ludinga ukuthi kunikezwe zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo isikhathi esanele sokuba zifake amaphepha azo. Lolu udaba ongeke lukwazi ukulalelwa njengodaba oluphuthumayo. Abebefake icala basangabuya bafake esinye isicelo.”Oyingxenye yethimba lesikhashana elihola iNFP, uMnuz Teddy Thwala, uthe isinqumo senkantolo sisho ukuthi ingqungquthela izoqhubeka."Kudala sisho kubo bonke abafowethu esinabo kwiNFP ukuthi akuhlale ingqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi. Ingqungquthela kuphela eyosisiza. Ukufakana ezinkantolo angeke kusisize ngalutho. Ukuqulwa kwamacala ezinkantolo kungathatha ngisho iminyaka emihlanu. Ngingasho ukuthi iNFP inqobile ngoba besingasazi ukuthi kuzokwenzekalani njengoba bekusenaleli cala.”UThwala oyingxenye yabahlela ingqungquthela, uthe amalungiselelo ahamba kahle."Silindele izithunywa ezingaphezu kuka-600. Izithunywa ziqhamuka ezifundazweni ezinhlanu.”UThwala uphakanyiselwe kwesikanobhala jikelele kule ngqungquthela.Uthe ingqungquthela iyithuba lokwakha kabusha iNFP."Leli ithuba lokuvuselela kabusha iNFP, sikhombe indlela eya phambili.”Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubuholi obakhethwa ngo-2019, busamile ekutheni ingqungquthela ezoqala kusasa ayikho emthethweni.Owayekhethwe njengonobhala jikelele ngo-2019, uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe, uthe abantu abahlela ingqungquthela abasiwona amalungu ethimba lesikhashana elaliqokwe ukuba lihole iNFP ngesikhathi kuhlakazwa ubuholi.UMdletshe uthe nengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beNFP KwaZulu-Natal eyayikulo nyaka, yayingekho emthethweni.Umbango wobuholi usuholele ekutheni iNFP ihluleke ukungenela ukhetho.UMNUZ Teddy Thwala, oyingxenye yethimba elihlela ingqungquthela yeNFP, nophinde aphakanyiselwe kwesikanobhala jikelele Isithombe: Sithunyelwe
KUKHALWE ngokuphulwa kwemithetho evikela abasebenzi namalungelo abo ezimbonini zakwaSithebe, eMandeni, okuthiwa kunezinkampani eziholela abasebenzi u-R4 ngehora.Lokhu kuvele ochungechungweni lokuhanjelwa kwale ndawo okuqalwe ngoMsombuluko, okuphothulwe izolo, ngaboMnyango wezokuQasha nabaSebenzi.Kuvele okushaqisayo kulolu hambo njengoba kuthiwa kunabanye abasebenzi abasebenza ngaphandle kokunikezwa izimpahla zokubavikela.Kuthiwa abanye bahogela ukungcola namakhemikhali alapho abasebenzela khona. Abanye abasebenzi kuthiwa balala khona lapho abasebenzela khona.Kuvela ukuthi abanye abaqashi baphinde basebenzise abokufika kuleli abangenazo izimvume zokuba seNingizimu Afrika.UMhloli Jikelele emnyangweni, uNkk Aggy Moiloa, uzwakalise ukushaqeka kwakhe ngakubonile.Uthe ngokubekwe umthetho, umsebenzi kumele ahole u-R24 nangaphezulu ngehora.Uthe abanye abanikazi bezinkampani bebengafuni ukubavulela besebenzisa inkani yabo."Abaqashi bathe bekusanda kufika abanye ebebekade bezohlola. Bebethalalisa uma sibabuza ngokuphula kwabo imithetho ngale ndlela. Sibe sesibanikeza isexwayiso sokuthi abashintshe indlela yokwenza futhi balandele umthetho. Uma kungenjalo sizobavulela amacala sibafake nasenkantolo,'' usho kanje.Uthe kulokhu kuze kwadingeka ukuthi basebenzisane namaphoyisa njengoba bekukhona abanye abaqashi abebengafuni ukubavulela.Uveze ukuthi kwenye inkampani umqashi ubezoholela abasebenzi imali yaleli sonto ngoJanuwari 2024.UNkk Moiloa uthe bamtshelile ukuthi kumele abakhokhele manje ngoba kuza amaholidi kaKhisimusi."Asibiki uma sizofika sizohlola enkampanini. Uma sithola isikhalazo noma sincinzwa indlebe ngokuphulwa komthetho sifika qathatha,” kusho uNkk Moiloa.Ube esekhipha isexwayiso asibhekise kwabanye abaqashi nezinkampani eziphula imithetho wathi bazothathelwa izinyathelo zomthetho ngoba kuyicala abakwenzayo.Uveze ukuthi cishe zonke izinkampani abazihambelile iyodwa nje vo ebonakale yenza kangcono.Zonke ezinye uthe aziyigcini nhlobo ngisho imithetho elawula imihlomulo etholwa umuntu uma egula, elimele noma esekhefini lokuyoteta.

Kuze kube nalezi zinguquko nje, yingenxa yokuthi iNew Nation Movement yaya enkantolo ifuna abangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela babe yingxenye yokhetho lukazwelonke.” IPhini likaNgqongqoshe lezaseKhaya, uMnuz Njabulo Nzuza, lithe akukanqunywa ngodaba lwama-signature adingekayo emaqenjini amasha azongenela ukhetho.Odabeni lweminikelo uNzuza uthe kuzanywa ukunqanda inkohlakalo kulabo abanikela ngoba bebheke okuthile.Usho lokhu nje, iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo inqume ukuthi kumele kwehliswe isibalo sama-signature kwabangenela ukhetho ngokuzimela uma sebengenela ukhetho.Le nkantolo ayidalulanga lutho mayelana namaqembu angamelelekile ePhalamende ukuthi wona kusadingeka yini ukuthi athole phakathi kwama-signature angu-10 000 kuya ku-14 000, ukungenela ukhetho.Kulo mhlangano kuvele ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo umphakathi uzonikwa ithuba lokuphawula ngaphambi kokuba uye eMkhandlwini weziFundazwe ePhalamende lapho kuzobe sekushayelelwa isipikili sokugcina ngaphambi kokhetho.

NGEKE zisaholwa eposini izibonelelo zikahulumeni njengoba iSouth African Social Security Agency (Sassa) nePostbank imemezele ukuthi kuzogcinwa ngoMashi wonyaka ozayo.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba yiSassa nePostbank, kuvele ukuthi kusukela ngoJanuwari wonyaka ozayo uhlelo lokuhola izibonelelo eposini luzobe luqedwa. Abokugcina ngci ukuhola ngeposi bazoholelwa ngoMashi wonyaka ozayo.Ngo-Okthoba Isolezwe labika ukuthi bawu-5.3 million abantu abahola izibonelelo zabo eposini.Kucelwe abahola eposini ukuthi baqale ukusebenzisa ezinye izindlela zokuhola izibonelelo zikahulumeni.Kumenyezelwe ukuthi ikhadi lokuhola izibonelelo zikahulumeni eposini elibizwa ngeSassa Gold card, liyakwazi ukukhipha imali kuma-ATM amabhange ahlukene nasezitolo.Phakathi kwezitolo ezidumile eziholela abantu izibonelelo kubalwa uBoxer, Shoprite, Pick n Pay, Spar, Usave neCheckers.Izinyunyana zabasebenzi baseposini zisole uhulumeni ngokuzama ukuliwisa njengoba esezomisa ukuholwa kwezibonelelo kulona.Zithe zizoxoxa ngalolu daba njengoba kuza izingxoxo zokudilizwa kwabasebenzi.AbePostbank babalule ukuthi abantu bagqugquzelwa ukuba basebenzise ezinye izindlela zokuhola ngenxa yokwanda kwezigameko zokugqekezwa kwamaposi bese kwebiwa imali yezibonelelo.Babuye baveza ukuthi kusukela ngo-2018, babezibophezele ekwethuleni ezinye izindlela zokuholela abantu.ISassa ithe njengoba kuwuDisemba, u-98% wabahola izibonelelo usebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuzihola. Yathi ngeke kube nokuphazamiseka okutheni ngalezi zinguquko ezintsha.Ithembise ukuthi abekho abazosala ngaphandle njengoba kushintshwa izindlela zokuhola.Iphinde yakhumbuza abantu ukuthi amakhadi akwaSassa azobe esasebenza ngonyaka ozayo ngeke aphelelwe yisikhathi ngoDisemba.
INHLANZI ishelwe ngamanzi kubalisa ababili baseMozambique okuthotholakale ukuthi bakuleli ngokungemthetho ngesikhathi kuqhutshwa umkhankaso wokulwa nobugebengu KwaHlabisa.Umkhankaso ubuhlelwe yi-Immigration Unit ngokubambisana namaphoyisa.Kuqhutshwa lo mkhankaso nje, idolobha laKwaHlabisa kuthiwa liyisizinda okucanasa kuso abantu abathutheleka khona ngenxa yemisebenzi.U-Warrant Officer Sthembiso Nene obehola umkhankaso uthe izephulamthetho eziboshiwe zigcinwe esiteshini samaphoyisa saKwaHlabisa."Sithole ukuthi amaphepha abantu esibabophile awasabavumeli ukuba baqhubeke babe seNingizimu Afrika njengoba amaphepha abo ekhomba ukuthi asephelelwe yisikhathi,” kusho uNene.IMeya yaKwaHlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, ithe iyabakhathaza le ndaba yabantu abaphuma emazweni angaphandle abangenazo izimvume zokuba kuleli ngoba idala ukuthi kwande izigebengu ezingabopheki."Sinabantu abadayisa izidakamizwa okugcina kuvela ukuthi basuka kwamanye amazwe bahlale kuleli ngokungemthetho. Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi leli thimba libambisane namaphoyisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwezakhamuzi njengoba kuyiwa emaholidini kaKhisimusi,” kusho uKhumalo.Kuthiwa abantu baseMozambique bangena kalula kuleli besebenzisa upotsho osesangweni elisenombolweni yesithupha eManguzi.Kuthiwa bakwazi ngisho nokungena notshwala obungumbombayi bawele emfuleni obakhiphela eManguzi.Muva nje, kubanjwe abasolwa abebelibhekise e-Mozambique bedlula e-Kosi Bay bephethe amalambu okukhanyisa emgwaqweni ezigidi zamaRandi abebiwe eThekwini.
ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini, sithi sisadla amathambo engqondo ngesinqumo senkantolo esithinta ukunikwa kwaso isitifiketi sobukhosi. IJaji Norman Davis, laseNkantolo eNkulu eNorth Gauteng, likhiphe isinqumo lichitha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Umbango wesihlalo seSilo waqubuka emuva kokuthi kukhotheme esidala ngoMashi 2021. ISilo salandelana eduze noNdlunkulu uMantfombi Madlamini-Zulu.Icala lalifakwe wuMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu ongumfowabo weSilo esakhothama uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu. Ubecele inkantolo ibheke ukuthi kwaba semthethweni yini ukunikwa kweSilo isitifiketi.IJaji lithi uRamaphosa akalandelanga imigudu efanele enika iSilo isitifiketi. Okhulumela iSilo, uMntwana u-Afrika wendlu yasoNkweni, uthe iSilo sizwile ngesinqumo. Uthe kodwa ngeke bathande ukwanda kakhulu."Ihhovisi leNgonyama liyasazi isinqumo senkantolo esikhishwe yiJaji Davis ngoMsombuluko. ISilo, yithimba laso lezomthetho nabadala basendlunkulu basacubungula isinqumo ukuze baphume negama ngegxathu okufanele lithathwe,’’ kusho u-Afrika.URamaphosa uke wabuzwa ngabezindaba ngalolu daba, uthe uyazi ngesinqumo senkantolo kodwa akafuni ukwanda kakhulu ngaso. Uthe wudaba lwaseNdlunkulu kaZulu okufanele lusingathwe yiyona.URamaphosa uthe naye uzobonisana nabameli bakhe kodwa wanxusa ukuthi kungabi wudaba oluzodala izinkinga, noma umsindo. Isinqumo senkantolo sikubeka kucace ukuthi umbango wokuthi wubani iSilo, ubungahlangene nalolu daba.Ijaji lize lisho nokuthi udaba lokuthi wubani iSilo lwafakwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lwaqedwa. Besingekho isidingo sokukhuluma ngalo. Ijaji liyalele uRamaphosa ukuthi abuyele emuva, kuqokwe ikomiti elizosebenza udaba lwasendlunkulu.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sithi sisacubungula isinqumo senkantolo esiveza ukuthi akulandelwanga imigudu ngesikhathi sinikwa isitifiketi Isithombe: SIGCINIWE
I-EEF isabisa ngokuvula unyaka u-2024, ngemibhikisho, ifaka ingcindezi ukuba kukhonjwe indlela uNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, emsola ngokuthi umhlulile umsebenzi wakhe.Lokhu kuvezwe uMengameli we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ngempelasonto, ekhuluma namalungu aleli qembu eWestern Cape.UMalema uthe sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi akhonjwe indlela uGordhan onguNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHululumeni."UPravin uyena omosha leli lizwe futhi kumele kubekwe emahlombe akhe yedwa ukufadabala kwezinkampani zikahulumeni,” kusho uMalema.Lo mholi ukufanise nehlazo okwenzeka kwaTransnet, enkampanini eyakha izikhali iDenel, neyezindiza i-SAA, abaziqhenya ngayo.UMalema uthe esikhathini esedlule, uGordhan watshela izwe imbudane uma ethi izwe libuswa yidlanzana.Uqhube wathi umuntu onamandla okususa uGordhan esikhundleni asiphethe yinjinga enguMnuz Johann Rupert, okuyiyo athe yamenza ungqongqoshe."UCyril (Mengameli Ramaphosa) akanawo amandla, uyisichuse nje. Umengameli wangempela useStellenbosch, owasabisa ngokuguqisa ngamadolo umnotho wezwe uma uZuma (uMnuz Jacob) engambuyiseli esikhundleni uGordhan,” kusho uMalema.Uthe yinto embi ukuthi iPosi lizodiliza abasebenzi abangu-6 000. Uthe imbangela yalokho wukuthi umsebenzi walo aliwenzi uhambelane nesikhathi samanje esisebenzi ubuchwephesheUkhale nangokugqoza kwezitimela ezihamba amabanga amade athe wabhalela ungqongqoshe wezokuThutha ngakho kodwa kwacweba iziziba.Muva nje, uthe kuvele kwathalaliswa, bathi bayazama ukusibuyisela lesi sitimela, sajama endleleni kwaphoqa abagibeli ukuba baluqedele ngamabhasi uhambo lwabo.Ube esechaza ngokumiswa kwamalungu abo ePhalamende, athe kwenziwe kwaqondanisa noFebhuwari ngonyaka ozayo, ukuze angaphazanyiswa uRamaphosa uma ethula inkulumo ayibhekise ezweni."Abasho (iPhalamende) ukuthi sizokumisa ngoDisemba kodwa bawujombile noJanuwari, baya kuFebhuwari. Bafuna uRamaphosa angaphazanyiswa kulokhu, abe nesikhathi esimnandi uma esethula inkulumo okungeyokugcina. Yisinqumo esihlangene nepolitiki esithathiwe futhi okungamele sikhathaze amalungu e-EFF,” kusho uMalema.La malungu ayisithupha uMalema, iphini lakhe uFloyd Shivambu, uNobhala we-EFF uMnuz Marshall Dlamini, abangabakhulumeli be-EFF oMnuz Sinawo Tambo noVuyani Pambo noDkt Mbuyiseni Ndlozi. Laba balahlwa ngecala lokudala udungunyana ePhalamende nokudweba isithombe esimbi ngezwe.
SIHLANGABEZANE nembibizane enkantolo isitshudeni esibhekene necala lokubulala obenguthisha.UBafana Mahungela osolwa ngokubulala uthisha waseGoli, uKirsten Kluyts, uvele phambi kweNkantolo yeMantshi yase-Alexandra, eGauteng, ngesicelo sebheyili.Lesi sitshudeni esineminyaka engu-21 ubudala, sizwe sesisenkantolo ukuthi sibhekene nanecala lokudlwengula njengoba sibekwe icala elihleliwe lokubulala lo thisha owayeyingxenye yomqhudelwano wokugijima i-MyRun, eGeorge Lea Park, ekupheleni kwenyanga ka-Okthoba, isidumbu sakhe satholwa onqenqemeni lwepaki.Njengamanje uBafana usebhekene namacala okudlwengula, ukugebenga nokubulala ngesihluku.Lo msolwa oyisitshudeni eVarsity College eSandton, ungene ebhokosini lofakazi ngoLwesithathu njengoba kuqhubeka ukulalelwa kwesicelo sakhe sebheyili.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi kumthusile ukuboshwa kwakhe ngaleli cala ngoba wabikela abantu ngesikhathi ebona umuntu elele epaki kodwa engazi ukuthi usefile.Uthe leli cala liwuthusile nomndeni wakubo njengoba kuvele nezindaba zokuthi umama wakhe wamelwa yenhliziyo ngesikhathi ezwa ukuthi uboshelwe icala lokubulala.Ummeli wakhe, u-Adv Itumeleng Masako, uthe abatshelwanga ngamacala angeziwe nokuthi icala lokubulala seliguqulelwe kwelokubulala okuhleliwe.Ukulalelwa kwesicelo sebheyili kuhlehliselwe umhla ka-18 kwephezulu ngemuva kokuthi abammeli bacele ukubona i-video evezwe uMbuso njengobufakazi obuthinta lo msolwa.
KWEHLISE umthwalo emndenini kasomatekisi waseXobho owabulawa, ngesikhathi iNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini igweba abayisikhombisa abebesebenza enkampanini yonogada, udilikajele neminyaka ewu-30 ngamacala okubulala, ukuzama ukubulala, ukushaya nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla.ULangelihle Bailey (37), uPhumlani Siyaya (37), uBonisile Lili (28), Bhekisisa Mhlongo (41), Sehliselo Dladla (40), uMandla Masango (57) noNjabulo Cele (46) ababengonogada enkampanini eyayigada erenke yaseXobho iVimbeni Security bagwetshwe ngamacala okubulala uMnuz Christopher Madondo okuthiwa wayewusomatekisi othenjwayo ngaphansi kukasoseshini waseXobho.Laba kuvele ukuthi badinwa ukunqanyulwa kwenkontileka yale nkampani yokugada umsebenzi erenke okuthiwa yayiqashelwe wona emva kokuthi kwakudlange udlame embonini ngo-2015. Kuthiwa usomatekisi ngamunye wayekhokha u-R2 000 ngetekisi ekhokhela ukugadwa kwamatekisi akhe yile nkampani eyayibhekelele uzinzo, okwathi ngo-2018 sekudambe udlame, uMadondo wabeka umbono wokuthi inqanyulwe inkontileka phakathi kukasoseshini nale nkampani ngoba isimo sabe sesezinzile, udlame lungasekho. Abasebenzi bayo bathukuthela bagana unwabu, banikela erenke bashaya ngesihluku abashayeli, bacekela phansi impahla, bazama ukudubula nabanye abebekhona namaphoyisa ayezama ukudambisa isimo, okuyilapho kwashona khona uMadondo.Bagwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala, iminyaka ewu-24 umuntu ngamunye kwamathathu okuzama ukubulala, emithathu kwawokucekelwa phansi kwempahla nonyaka owodwa kwelokuphazamisa ukusebenza komthetho. Izigwebo bazozidonsa kanye kanye.Umfelokazi kaMadondo uNkk Nombuso Madondo, uthe nakuba besijabulela isigwebo, kodwa kusabaphethe kabi ukuthi ababethume laba abakaboshwa."Sidlule kokuningi siwumndeni njengoba ubaba bekunguyena owondlayo futhi enobuhlakani nangaphakathi kukasoseshini enikeza izeluleko ezibalulekile kangangoba kuyimanje uma kunezingqinamba embonini, bayasho ukuthi ukube kusekhona yena ngabe uqhamuka nesixazululo,” kusho uNkk Madondo.Ukhale ngokukhishwa phambili kwabanye abathathu abebeboshiwe ngoba kuthiwa ubufakazi abuhlangani njengoba bebewu-10 sebebonke abebeboshiwe.Lethula isigwebo ijaji, liveze ukuthi okuvezwe wummeli wababoshiwe ezama ukubashwelezela akukwenzi ligudluke esigwebeni esibekiwe."Ukuhlaselwa kwamaphoyisa esemsebenzini yikhona okwenza leli cala libe bucayi kakhulu. Izigameko zokudutshulwa kwamaphoyisa ziyanda kuleli, uma zingagwenywa abantu bakuleli ngeke bavikeleke,” usho kanje.Ummeli wabo ufake isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesigwebo nokulahlwa icala kwabamangalelwa, okuvunyelwene ngokuthi sizolalelwa ngoFebhuwari 9, wonyaka ozayo.

Basolwa nangokushintsha imininingwane yasemabhangi alezi nkampani bafake awezihlobo zawo okwaholela ekutheni bakhokhelwe uR24 million,” kusho uCol Mogale.Bonke abasolwa kulindeleke ukuthi bavele enkantolo yamacala athinta imali ePitoli, ngoLwesithathu.Le ndawo yeshashalazi phambilini ibijwayele ukusetshenziswa uma kuqoshwa bukhona uhlelo oluthungatha amakhono olukhonjiswa bukhoma kuMzansi Magic, ama-Idols.Muva nje, lolu hlelo belusingathelwa eMosaiek Teatro, eseRandburg, eGoli.

BAPHITHENE amakhanda futhi bashaqekile abazali babafundi baseGobindlovu High, KwaMafunze eMgungundlovu, abaxoshwe esikoleni kwathiwa abangabuyi ngonyaka ozayo ngoba sebefeyile kabili ibanga elilodwa.Laba bazali bathi abazi ukuthi izingane zabo bazoziyisaphi ngoba asikho isikole esisamukela abafundi ngalesi sikhathi, ekubeni sebenikwe nezincwadi ezithi bayasuswa ohlwini lwabafunda kulesi sikole.Omunye wabazali ocele ukungavezwa, utshele Isolezwe ukuthi akazi ukuthi uzoyiyisaphi ingane yakhe ebiyenza uGrade 10, esifeyile kabili leli banga.Uthe ekuqaleni konyaka abaphathi besikole bababiza babatshela ukuthi uma izingane zabo ziphinda zifeyila, kuzomele baziyise kwezinye izikole ngoba ngeke besazamukela.Uveze ukuthi batshelwa ukuthi nalezo ezihluphayo ngeke zikhuze ibuya kulesi sikole. "Sazitshela ukuthi bayazisabisa izingane ngale nkulumo ukuze ziphaphame, zibhukule. Ngesonto eledlule sibizelwe esikoleni kwathiwa asizolanda amaripoti, siphinde sisayine ukuthi siwathathile ngoba bebengawaniki izingane. Sishaqekile sekukhishwa nezincwadi eziqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zethu azingabe zisabuya ngoba zifeyilile.” Uthe othisha bayazihlangula kulesi senzo njengoba nesigungu esilawula isikole singayazi eyalo mthetho, wokuthi akuxoshwe abafeyilile.Omunye wabazali ingane yakhe ebiyenza uGrade 11, uthe akazi ukuthi ingane izothathwa kusiphi isikole njengoba izikole eziningi zingabamukeli abafundi abazokwenza uGrade 10 kuya kwa-matric, ngoba basuke sebekhethe izifundo abazozenza baze baqede.Uthe uye emahhovisi abahloli abashayele uthishanhloko, bembuza ngalesi senzo, njengoba bethe abayazi le nto ayenzayo ukuthi uyisuselaphi."Kwabona abahloli bakhuze umhlola, bathi abazi ukuthi ukuthathaphi lokhu akwenzayo ngoba abafundi abafeyilile kabaxoshwa, kunalokho bayadudulwa. Asinazo ezinye izikole esizobayisa kuzona, ikakhulu njengoba owami esezoqeda. Imfundo yilungelo lengane, akumele licindezelwe,” kusho umzali obeveva yintukuthelo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni, uMnuz Muzi Mahlambi, uthe bazothumela abahloli abazoyoxazulula lesi simo.Umgomo woMnyango wezeMfundo uyakuvumela ukuthi umfundi adudulwe uma esefeyile kabili ibanga. Minyaka yonke abafundi bayadudulwa, baze bafinyelele ngisho kwa-matric, lapho bebhala khona zonke izifundo zabo.Kulo nyaka sinyukile isibalo sabafundi abadudulelwe ku-matric njengoba bengu-55 221. Lesi sifundazwe yisona esinabafundi abaningi abaduduliwe njengoba bengu-13 500.
I-IFP itshelwe ukuba ikhohlwe ukuthi izokwazi ukugudluza i-ANC emandleni ngaphandle kokusebenzisana ne-EFF.Ungoti utshele amalungu e-IFP ukuthi nakuba i-ANC ingeke ilunqobe ngamalengiso ukhetho oluzayo, isangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokuqhoqhobala izintambo zoMbuso ima ingasebenzisana ne-EFF. Lokhu kuhlaluke engqungqutheleni yemigomo ye-IFP ebanjwe eMpangeni.Ungoti oqhamuka kwisikhungo i-Social Research Foundation, uMnuz Gabriel Makin, uthe ucwaningo lwabo lukhombisa ukuthi i-ANC ngeke ithole izihlalo ezanele ukuthi ibuse ngokuzimela okhethweni oluzayo, kodwa wathi amaqembu aphikisayo kofanele ahlangane wonke uma efuna ukugudluza i-ANC.Ukusho lokhu ephendula umbuzo wemeya yoMasipala waseMhlathuze, uMnuz Xolani Ngwezi, obuze ukuthi amaqembu aphikisayo angakwazi yini ukuketula i-ANC ngaphandle kokusebenzisana ne-EFF.I-EFF ayisiyo ingxenye yamaqembu aphikisayo anesivumelwano sokusebenzisana, futhi yahoxa ekusebenzisaneni ne-IFP komasipala baKwaZulu-Natal.UMakin uthe ucwaningo lwabo lukhombisa ukuthi uma i-ANC yenze kabi okhethweni oluzayo izothola u-42%."Kodwa ke kuzoncika ekutheni i-ANC izokhankasa kangakanani ngaphambi kokhetho. Ukhetho selusemome. I-ANC izoqala ikhankase. Uma izinto ziyihambele kahle, ingagcina ithola noma u-46%. Uma sikhuluma iqiniso, wonke amaqembu aphikisayo kofanele abambisane ukuze kugudluke i-ANC. I-EFF mhlawumbe izothola u-10%. Uma uhlanganisa lokho nokuzotholwa i-ANC, uyabona ukuthi i-ANC izoqhubeka nokuphatha.”Ucwaningo luqagula ukuthi i-IFP izothola u-6%.Ingqungquthela ye-IFP eqhubeka eMbizo Hall kwakufanele ibanjwe ngo-2020, kepha yaphazanyiswa wukubheduka kobhubhane iCovid-19.Ethula inkulumo yokuvula ingqungquthela, umengameli weqembu, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uthe imigomo ye-IFP ngeke ishintshwe ukuthi sebeyingxenye yamaqembu anesivumelwano sokuketula i-ANC.UHlabisa uthe i-IFP izolukhankasela ngokuzimela ukhetho oluzayo."Siyaqhubeka nokuba iqembu elizimele. Akukho mkhankaso esizowenza ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu. Wonke amavoti azotholwa i-IFP, azokuya kwi-IFP.”UHlabisa uthe imigomo abazoqhamuka nayo kule ngqungquthela kufanele ibe izimpendulo ezinkingeni ezikhungethe izwe."Kuzo zonke izinketho esizingenele kusukela ngo-1994, sihlezi sazisa abantu ngemigomo yeqembu. Kuze kube manje imigomo ye-IFP iyaziwa, asikaze sishintshe. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi izikhathi ziyashintsha, kuqhamuke nezinkinga ezintsha. Kufanele sibuye siyibuyekeze imigomo yethu. Ngo-1994 alikho iqembu elalikhuluma ngokulwa nenkohlakalo kanye nokucishwa kukagesi. Okhethweni oluzayo iqembu elingenaso isisombululo kulezi nkinga ngeke lilibone elidlalayo okhethweni.”Lena ingqungquthela ye-IFP yokuqala kusukela kwaguqa umsunguli wale nhlangano, inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi.UHlabisa uthe njengeqembu bayaqhubeka nokulandela izimfundiso zikaButhelezi.Ingqungquthela izosongwa namhlanje.
ISIKHUNGO esibhekelele ukuthi imikhiqizo edayiselwa abantu isesimeni iNational Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS), sinxusa amakhasimende athenge usimende, i-Econo Cement CEM ukuthi awubuyisele emuva.Lo simende i-V/ A S-V 32,5N kutholakale ukuthi awukho ezingeni elifanele. Lesi sikhungo sithi besilokhu sithola izikhalazo eziphuma emphakathini ngalo simende, okuholele ekutheni sithathe isinqumo sokuthi siwuhlole.ISIKHUNGO esibhekelele ukuthi imikhiqizo edayiselwa abantu isesimeni National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications (NRCS) sinxusa amakhasimende athenge usimende, i-Econo Cement CEM ukuthi awubuyisele emuva ISITHOMBE: FACEBOOK UDkt Duncan Mutengwe uthe imvume evumela abakhiqizi balo simende bawudayise ihoxisiwe."Isinyathelo sokuthi kubuyiswe lo mkhiqizo silandela uphenyo olunzulu olwenziwe iNRCS oluhlanganisa ukuthathwa kwamasampula nokuhlolwa kwawo, ukuze kubheke ukuthi usezingeni elifanele yini. Imiphumela iveze ukuthi usezingeni eliphansi. Ukuqhubeka kwawo udayiswe kungadala izinkinga zokuthi izakhiwo nemigwaqo eyakhiwe ngawo zidilike kalula, ” kusho uMutenge.Lo simende udayiswa eMpumalanga, KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng."Ingozi ukuthi usimende njengomkhiqizo obalulekile ekwakheni uma ungaphephile amabhilidi akhiwe ngawo angadilika, imigwaqo ibhoboke okungadala ingozi kubantu," kusho uNkk Rhoda Masupye oyi-Inspection Manager kwiNRCS.UNkk Masupye uthe amakhasimende asewusebenzisile lo simende angaxhumana neNational Consumer Commission. "Umsebenzi wethu awufinyeleli ekutheni ikhasimende eseliwuthengile usimende linxephezeleke, ugcina ekubhekeni umkhiqizo ukuthi usesimeni yini,” kuchaza uNkk Masupye. Uthe okwamanje awukho umbiko abawutholile obubatshela ukuthi kunezakhiwo esezike zadilika ezakhiwe ngalo simende.
ZIZOFIKA zigawulwe zabekwa izigebengu ngamaholidi kaKhisimusi, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibamba izimoto zemali nabaphuma emabhange.Lokhu kudalulwe nguNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa uMnuz Bheki Cele ePitoli izolo, ethula uhlelo lwezokuphepha ngamaholidi okuphela konyaka.Udalule ukuthi ngoLwesine, kuzokwethulwa amaphoyisa amasha angu-10 000 aphuma ekolishi.Uthe amaphoyisa azotshalwa ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhungethwe wubugebengu. "Siphaka impi, siyibhekise kunoma ngubani okhetha ukusebenzisa indlakadla ukuze enze ubugebengu. Izigebengu zenza noma yini ukuze zithole imali ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka,” kusho uCele.Udalule ukuthi amaphoyisa athele othulini ngenhlamvu izigebengu eziyingozi ezingu-62 ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule.Ukhuze abadayisa utshwala ngokungemthetho, wathi abayeke ngoba amaphoyisa azofika abuthathe avale indawo obudayiswa kuyona. Uxwayise osomabhizinisi abanamalayisensi okuhweba ngotshwala, wathi mabalandele umthetho. Ukhuthaze abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphile, uma kukhona okusolisayo bancinze amaphoyisa. Ubalule uhlelo lwabo, wathi luziqu zinhlanu; balwa nodlame lwangokobulili, kuqine ezokuphepha emingceleni, baqinisekise ukuthi iyalandelwa imithetho yamadolobha.Bazoqinisa ezokuphepha emigwaqweni futhi balwe nobugebengu, kubalwa obokuphanga kusetshenziswa udlame nokuvukuza ngokungemthetho.Uthe kuvamisile ukubanjwa kwezimoto zemali ngalesi sikhathi sonyaka nokuphangwa kwabasuke beyokhipha imali emabhange. Uthe kuyacaca ukuthi kunabathile abanikeka izigebengu ulwazi.Uthe sekunomkhuba omusha lapho izigebengu zisebenzisana nabesifazane uma zigila imigilingwane, khona kungezonakeka.UCele uthe bangu-187 abantu abagwetshwe odilikajele abangu-247 ngamacala odlame lwangokobulili.Uthe balwa nokukhiqizwa kotshwala ngokungemthetho, ukushushumbiswa kwabantu bezidakamizwa, ebalula iCocaine eshaqwe echwebeni laseThekwini nelaseGqeberha.
UBOSHIWE owesifazane okuthiwa ubephuze ngokweqile amanzi amponjwana, ozame ukubalekela amaphoyisa amhubhe ambamba esivimbagwaqweni ebesiseMgungundlovu.Kuvela ukuthi ngesikhathi efuthiswa, ehlolwa izinga lotshwala egazini lakhe lakhe, kutholakale ukuthi lingu-1.26mg, okuyisikali eseqe kayisihlanu kunalokhu okugunyazwe wumthetho.Ube esekhalelwa amasongo kaSigonyela nabanye abashayeli ababalelwwa ku-18, babekwa amacala okushayela bedle utshwala.UMnyango wezokuThutha KwaZulu-Natal uthe ziyaqhubeka izivimbamgwaqo kusona sonke isifundazwe, lapho kumiswa khona izimoto zihlolwe nabashayeli nokuthi abaphuzile.Ukuboshwa kwalo wesifazane kushayelwe ihlome nawuNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka. UHlomuka uyalele amaphoyisa ukuthi ayiqinise le mikhankaso nakwamanye amadolobha esifundazweni.Okhulumela uMnyango, uMnuz Kwanele Ncalane, unxuse abashayeli ukuthi baqikelele ukuthi abaphuzi utshwala bese bengena emgwaqweni."Umuntu akomele ngasekhaya noma kubekhona umuntu ozokwazi ukushayela imoto ongabuthinti nhlobo utshwala. Yizinto esizogxila kuzona ngokohlelo lwethu lokuphepha lwalesi sikhathi,” kusho uNcalane.Uthe uhlelo ludidiyelwa yizona zonke izinhlaka zezokuphepha kusukela komasipala kuyofika phezulu kwiSAPS.Uthe bazokanisa kusona sonke isifundazwe njengoba kubhekwe kwimpelasonto ende eqala ngoNovemba 15.Lapha uthe bazobe beqinisekisa ukuthi amaphoyisa akhona emigwaqweni engothelawayeka, eyimingenelo yasemalokishini nalapho kuhlala khona abantu nasemathaveni asebenza umathanda, ephula imigomo yokusebenza."Abashayeli abacophelele ngoba kunemigwaqo eminingi esetshenzwayo esifundazweni okuzokwenza isiminyaminya njengaku-N3 phakathi kwaseMgungundlovu naseThekwini,” kusho uNcalane.Uthe esinye isiminyaminya sizoba naku-EB Cloete (edume ngoSpaghetti Junction) mawuphuma enkabeni yedolobha eThekwini, lapho kuhlangana khona uN2 noN3, eThekwini.UNcalane ubalule nokwakhiwa komgwaqo uN2 eMdloti, nalapho uchezukela KwaMashu, wathi imizila incishisiwe.Ube esekhuthathaza abashayeli ukuthi bahlele uhambo lwabo, basuke kusenesikhathi futhi bashayele ngokucophelela.Kusukela ngoDisemba 1 nonyaka, abashayeli abangu-241 babekwe amacala okushayela ngesivinini, kwaboshwa abangaphezu kuka-18 ngokushayela bephuzile, abawu-73 bezithuthi zomphakathi baboshelwa ukungabi nawo ama-permit, abawu-12 abashayela amatekisi baboshelwa ukulayisha ngokweqile.Kuboshwe abangaphezu kuka-54 ngokushayela ngamalayisensi asedlulelwe isikhathi, abangu-26 babekwa amacala okusika lapho kungagunyazwe khona, kwathi abangu-81 babekwa amacala lokulayisha umthwalo ngokweqile.
USOMLOMO woMkhandlu weTheku, uMnuz Thabani Nyawose, uthi kunezikhalo ezilethwe ehhovisi lakhe ngesikhekhelembana esishaywa ngamakhansela ngamavawusha okudla kwezaguga. UNyawose ubike lokhu emhlanganweni wokhandlu wokugcina kulo nyaka obuse-ICC, eThekwini izolo.Lolu daba lubangwe kakhulu, kucishe kwayophela ihora kuphikiswana ngalo, kujikijelwana ngamazwi ayiziswana. Kukhona nabebesola amakhansela ngokusebenzisa amavawusha ukucubuza amagabade kubavoti njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi le vawusha ibiza uR650 ngayinye kanti iward ngayinye ithole angu-500. UNyawose uthe kunesikhalo ngokuthi kukhona amavawusha agcina engafikanga kwabafanelwe wukuwathola. Kuze kwavela isikhalo sokuthi amakhansela angenawo amawadi awaphethe nawo kufanele anikezwe amavawusha, kungabi ngaphethe amawadi kuphela.USomlomo Nyawose udonse ngendlebe amakhansela ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi amavawusha ahamba ngendlela."Ngiyawaxwayisa lawo makhansela angenzi kahle, ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi ahambisa kahle amavawusha. Tholani indlela yokusebenzisana namakomiti amawadi ukusabalalisa amavawusha.’ Emuva kwalokho kusuke omkhulu umsindo kubangwa ukuthi yimaphi amakhansela okufanele anikwe amavawusha awasabalalise. Amakhansela abeqhoshelana ngokuthi lawo aphethe amawadi yiwona aphethe, bese kuthi lawo afakwe ngohlu lwamaqembu mawabe semuva.IMeya uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda ize yacela ukuthi udaba luphindiselwe ekomitini likasomlomo luyoxoxwa kabusha ngoba wonke amaqembu asuke emelelekile lapho.Umbango uqhubekile kwajikijelwana ngamazwi, kwaze kwacasuka uSomlomo uNyawose, wathi ukuwabuyisela endleleni amakhansela abedloba."Bafowethu, ngiyanicela akuvumelekile ukuthi uma kukhona okungakuphethe kahle bese uchitha izandla kuzakwenu. Akuvumelekile ukuthi uma kukhuluma ikhansela umemeze, noma ngabe kunzima ukwemukela imibono yabanye abantu. Asilinde ithuba lethu,’’ kusho uNyawose.Lubangwe njalo lolu daba kwaze kwafika lapho uNyawose enquma khona ukuthi amakhansela amawadi yiwona azoqhubeka nokusabalalisa amavawusha okudla kwezaguga. Kuzwakale amazwi amakhansela amaningi abenganelisekile, kwezwakala izwi lekhansela lesifazane lithi: "Yingakho benezisu ezinkulu nje.”Kuphinde kwethulwa nombiko ngamakhansela e-EFF aphazamisa umhlangano, atholana phezulu namaphoyisa. Kuthiwa aqondiswa ubugwegwe, anikwe ithuba lokwenza izethulo bese kuthathwa isinqumo.
BADLA ngamapayipi abesilisa abathandana nabanye ezindaweni zasemakhaya lapho kulindeleke ukuthi indoda izibandakanye nokwenziwa amanye amadoda, ikakhulu ezintweni zamasiko nemikhuba.Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi kunesigcawu samadoda athandana namanye ebesihambisana nomkhankaso wezinsuku eziyinsuku ezingu-16, zokunqanda ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, i-16 Days of Activism Against Women and Children Abuse, ebesihlelwe inhlangano iLinzwa Foundation KwaDlangezwa, ngaseMpangeni.Kulesi sigcawu kuhlaluke ukuthi izinto ezifana nokuhlinza uma kuhlatshiwe, ukumba emathuneni nemidlalo efana nokungcweka yinto okulindelwe ukuthi abafana bayenze ngale kokuphoqwa. "Sifisa ukuthi lo mkhuba uphele ngoba abanye abantu abaqondi ukuthi ukubiza umuntu ngamagama kungukunyathela ilungelo lakhe,” kusho uSibiya.
ABAGIBELI bezitimela ePinetown bazohleka bodwa njengoba kuzovulwa umzila wesitimela owalinyazwa yizikhukhula, wavalwa.Kulindeleke ukuthi kusasa uvulwe umzila wezitimela wasePinetown, eThekwini, owacekelwa phansi yizikhukhula zango-Ephreli 2022.Kuvela nokuthi ngesikhathi somvalelandlini amasela ayeseqalile ezenzela kwingqalasizinda yalo mzila eyintshontsha, enye eyicekela phansi.Inkampani kahulumeni eyengamele izitimela, iPassenger Rail Agency of South Africa (Prasa), KwaZulu-Natal ithe zashaya kwazwela izikhulula ngo-Ephreli 2022.UYAVULWA ngoLwesihlanu umzila wezitimela ePinetown osulungiswe kabusha emuva kokucekelwa phansi yizikhukhula futhi amasela eba ingqqalasizinda Isithombe: SithunyelweUMnuz Zama Nomnganga, ongumkhulumeli wePrasa eKZN, uthe uqale ngoSepthemba 2023 umsebenzi wokulungisa umonakalo."Umsebenzi ulandelwe ukuthi abeRailway Safety Regulator bawuhlole izikhawu lo mzila ukuze bathole ukuthi usukulungele yini ukusetshenziswa abagibeli bezitimela. UMMELI ongumhlaziyi wezomthetho, uMnuz Mpumelelo Zikalala, uthi akukashintshi lutho ngesikhundla seSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini kuze kuphele isikhathi esibekiwe sokwedlulisa isinqumo senkantolo. Uphinde waphawula nokuthi ukuba sesihlalweni kweSilo esikhona manje ngokwesintu akukhona obekufakelwe inselelo kulesi sinqumo esikhishiwe.Izolo iNkantolo eNkulu, iNorth Gauteng, ichithe isinqumo sikaMengameli, uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, sokunika iSilo isitifiketi. IJaji uNorman Davis lithe isinqumo sikamengameli sasingekho emthethweni. Ijaji likubeke kwacaca ukuthi isicelo ebesilethiwe kulona esokuthi libheke ukuthi kwakusemthethweni yini ukuthi uRamaphosa akhiphele isitifiketi iSilo uMisuzulu.UZikalala uthe nakuba siphumile isinqumo kodwa asishongo ukuthi iSilo asisuswe esihlalweni."ISilo sisekhona futhi kunesikhathi esiba yizinsuku eziyishumi kuya kwezingu-14 sokwedlulisa isinqumo. (Futhi) Nangokwesintu iSilo sisekhona esihlalweni ngoba inkantolo ibibheka ngokomthetho nangokwesilungu,’’ kusho uZikalala.Isicelo ebesifakwe enkantolo, esiphonsela inselelo isinqumo sikaRamaphosa, safakwa nguMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu kanti sibe sesilalelwa ngokuhlanganyela nesikaMntwana uSimakade kaZwelithini. Ijaji lithe bekungekhona okwalo ukusho ukuthi ubani ofanelwe wukuba yisilo ngoba lolo daba lwaqedwa eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu, lwaluhlalelwe yiJaji Mjabuliseni Madondo. Lithe alinamandla okuthi kudluliswe kulo lolu daba lokuthi ngubani ofanelwe wukuba yisilo ngakho isinqumo sikaMadondo sisamile. Lona belibhekene nesicelo nendlela eyalandelwa ukuze uRamaphosa afinyelele esinqumeni sokunika iSilo uMisuzulu isitifiketi. Umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi bukaZulu uqubuke emuva kokwebuza kweSilo uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu ngoMashi 2021. ISilo salandelwa wuNdlunkulu uMantfombi (uMaDlamini) Zulu, ozala iSilo esibusayo.URamaphosa wedlulisela isitifiketi sobukhosi eSilweni ngo-Okthoba 2022 phambi kwezinkumbi zabantu enkundleni iMoses Mabhida, eThekwini. Kwakuchwaza inkundla kwaze kwafika inkosi yaMaSwati, uMakhosetive Dlamini (uMswati III), enguninalume weSilo esibusayo.UMntwana uMbonisi kaBhekuzulu, ongumfowabo weSilo esakhothama uZwelithini kaBhekuzulu, wafaka isicelo sokuthi inkantolo ichithe isicelo sikaRamaphosa. Udaba lwalalelwa ngo-Okthoba 19 nonyaka njengoba isinqumo siphuma manje sivuna abafake isicelo.Ngokwamaphepha esinqumo, Isolezwe elinawo, iJaji Davis ebinzeni 62, likubeka kucace ukuthi isinqumo sikaRamaphosa siyachithwa."Ngithole ukuthi isinqumo sikamengameli sokwemukela iSilo uMisuzulu kufanele siqalwe phansi sibukwe kabanzi ngokukaSection (6)(2)(d) we-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000 (PAJA). Umengameli wehlulekile ukulandela iLeadership Act kuSection 8(4) no8(5),’’ kusho iJaji uDavis.IJaji uDavis liyalele nokuthi kuqokwe ikomiti elizophenya kabanzi udaba lombango wesihlalo bese liphakamisa okufanele kwenzeke. BAKHALA ngokuxoshwa emsebenzini yimeya kuMasipala waseBaqulusini, abasebenzi abane abasebenza ohlelweni lwe-Expanded Public Work Progamme, okuthiwa bahlanganyele namalungu omphakathi kubhikishelwa ukukhishwa kukagesi wezinyokanyoka, eHlobane.Kulo mbhikisho kushone uMnuz Thokozani Masondo (28), okuthiwa uhlangabezane nenhlamvu izidlulela, okusolakala ukuthi iqhamuke ngasohlangithini lonogada bakamasipala abebejutshwe ukuzodambisa isimo ngesikhathi umphakathi ubhikisha.UMasondo ungumshana kaMnuz Sanele Mazibuko ongomunye wabathathu okuthiwa bakleliswe yiMeya, uMnuz Khehla Mkhwanazi, ekutheni bathathelwe izinyathelo ngokuba yingxenye yombhikisho nokumchapha ngenhlamba.Kwi-video okuthiwa iqoshwe ngaphambi kokubulawa kukaMasondo, uMkhwanazi lapho ekhuluma khona namalungu omphakathi emhlanganweni, uzwakala ezishaya isifuba ngokuba wumqashi, ngakho okungekho umsebenzi onelungelo lokumgibela ekhanda osebenza kumasipala aphathiswe wona, wayalela nemenja kamasipala ukuthi ibhekane nalaba basebenzi.Okunye okushiwo kule video ecishe ibeyimuzuzu beyisikhombisa uthi; "... Ngithi mina ngeke ngivume ukuthi ngibuyiselwe emuva ngama- EPWP athile nje angenzi kahle. Bese ngisho amane aseHlobane. Ngithi ngimi lapha nje ngishaqekile, ngishaqwe ukuthi abantu abaqashwe wuMasipala waseBaqulusini, kade bengichapha ngenhlamba emgwaqweni, futhi betshela mina njengomeya wabo ukuthi abangifuni nokungibona, sengathi ngiyile nto nje. Ngithi mina MM (municipal manager), njengoba ulana eduze kwami, uma ukwazi okukufanele, ngicela udile nale nto. Ngoba akukwazi ukuthi uma kukhona umsebenzi wakamasipala noma ngabe ucasulwe yini, bese ekhwela ekhanda kimi…”Uphinde ezwakale eveza ukuthi into yakhe nomunye walaba basebenzi i-personal.Ngesikhathi Isolezwe lithinta lo msebenzi, uqinisekise ukuthi bobane baxoshwe uMkhwanazi kodwa azikho izincwadi abanikezwe zona zokuxoshwa. Uthe okumdida kakhulu okwenze kwamcacela ukuthi uxoshiwe, ukuthi kuze kube manje akakaze awuthole umholo wakhe wangenyanga edlule, ngakho kuyamxaka ukuthi uMkhwanazi ubeqonde ukuthini ngalawa mazwi.Umasipala uzichithile izinsolo zokuxoshwa kwalaba basebenzi. Esitatimendeni sawo esithunyelwe Isolezwe, uMkhwanazi uthe abasebenzi baqashwe ngaphansi koMnyango yemiSebenzi yoMphakathi ngakho abekho abaxoshiwe."Bonke laba basebenzi basakleliswe ohlwini labasebenzi kumasipala. Ngakho akusilona iqiniso ukuthi labo abazibandakanya nombhikisho womphakathi ongagunyaziwe, sebexoshiwe,” kubhalwe kanje.Kulesi sitatimende, uqinisekise ukuthi ukuzibandakanya kwabasebenzi embhikishweni ongagunyaziwe, kuphambene nemigomo yabasebenzi.Amalungu omphakathi abethutheleke eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseVryheid obekulindeleke ukuthi kuvele kuyo unogada okuthiwa uboshwe ngoLwesihlanu emva kokudutshulwa kukaMasondo, kodwa kwavela ukuthi wabuye wadedelwa.

Phambilini kwakufanele kuphume isinqumo kodwa imantshi yabika ukugula, kwahlehla njengoba isinqumo siphume namuhla.USibiya ungummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni lokufa kukaMeyiwa owadutshulwa wabulawa ekubo kwentombi yakhe, uKelly Khumalo, ngo-2014. USibiya uboshwe namanye amadoda amane okusolwa ukuthi ayathinteka kulou daba lukaMeyiwa.Abaphenyi becala lokufa kukaMeyiwa bathi ngesikhathi bephenya uSibiya bathola ukuthi ushushumbisa izidakamizwa. Kuthe sebethi bayombophela lelo cala, bathola izinhlamvu zesibhamu emkhukhwini ayehlala kuwona.Abaphenyi bathi uSibiya wavuma ukuthi izinhlamvu ezakhe ehostela lapho ayeyokhomba khona isibhamu kodwa lowo muntu wangatholakala. Kulindeleke ukuthi uSibiya agwetshwe ngasekuqaleni konyaka ozayo.

Kuwona kunguyise, uMnuz Zenzeleni Biyela nodadewabo uNkk Lindi Mthembu.Abanye ebebekhona uSotswebhu we-NFP eZululand, uMnuz Siphamandla Ntombela.Emva kokufika kwalabo ebebezomeseka uZimdollar, kube sekutheleka yena nge-BMW emhlophe. Le moto ibiphelezelwa ngenye emhlophe iGTI.Iqale yama endaweni epaka izimoto ngaphandle wenkantolo.Ithe isuka yayongena esiteshini samaphoyisa eShowe, esingaphesheya komgwaqo maqede wehla kuyo, wangena ngaphathi esiteshini.Ubegqoke ingubo yakhe kanokusho emnyama, ngaphezulu wayeleka ngebhantshi elimhlophe, ezinyaweni efake izicathulo eziphakeme ezimhlophe, wanezela ngezibuko ezimnyama.I-BMW ibe isiphuma esiteshini samaphoyisa, yayoma ethunzini ngaphandle wenkantolo. Emva kwehora, babe sebehlakazeka ebebezomeseka.UZimiphi wathunyelelwa amasamanisi ambizela enkantolo ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule. Ngesikhathi enikwa amasamanisi, amaphoyisa athi uzobekwa icala lokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni, elezinhlamvu zesibhamu nelokutholwa nempahla entshontshiwe njengoba kwavela ukuthi ezinye zezibhamu ezatholwa kwakhe, zazebiwe komunye umuzi oseRichmond ngo-2016

OKLEBE bagasele bavimbezele babopha abasolwa abayisishiyagalombili ngamacala enkohlakalo, ukufoja, ukushushumbisa imali nokuphula umthetho wokusetshenziswa kwemali kahulumeni, okuyisigaba 86 (1).Umsuka waleli cala ukhonjwa kuJanuwari 2016 lapho uMnyango wezeMfundo esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape wacela ihhovisi likandunankulu ukuba lilekelele kutholakale amakilasi angu-72 esikhashana nefenisha yakhona eGqeberha nase-Uitenhage.Kwaqokwa inkampani ezofaka ithenda engaphezu kuka-R20 million, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela ulwazi oluthi kunezikhulu eziphezulu ezaphambanisa uhlelo ekulandeleni inqubo yokuthengwa kwempahla ngendlela engafanele, ngesikhathi kuqashwa le nkampani. Kuphinde kwasolwa ozokwenza umsebenzi okhethiwe, wayexhumene kakhulu nezikhulu eziphezulu ehhovisi likandunankulu."Kubuye kwavela ukuthi yize umsebenzi ungenziwanga ngendlela, kunamakilasi angazange ahanjiswe lapho ayedingeka khona, kodwa imali eyayibekelwe lo msebenzi yasetshenziswa yaphela. Udaba lwabikwa koKlebe ukuze baqale uphenyo.NgoMsombuluko mhla ka-11 kwephezulu uphiko loklebe oluphenya amacala abucayi enkohlakalo e-East London lubambisene nozakwabo emahhovisi kazwelonke, amaphoyisa aphenya inkohlakalo kanjalo neGauteng National Intervention, bakwazile ukubopha abasolwa abayisishiyagalombili abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-43 no-71."Kwababoshiwe kukhona izikhulu eziphezulu ehhovisi likandunankulu kanjalo nabaqondisi benkampani ethintekayo.Laba bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eZwelitsha, ngoLwesibili.

OWAXOSHWA ekubeni yikhansela eThekwini, ushintshe ebusweni, wafuna ukuhamba imantshi isakhuluma naye iqeda kumncisha ibheyili.Abangani nezihlobo nabo bavele badangala ngesikhathi bezwa imantshi ithi uMnuz Mzimuni "Mzi” Ngiba uzobuyiselwa ezitokisini.Imantshi uMelanie de Jager ngoLwesihlanu ithe awekho amaphuzu amasha futhi anqala avezelwe inkantolo uNgiba nabathathu aboshwe nabo. Icala lihlehliselwe uJanuwari 2024.UNgiba noMnuz Nkosinathi Ngcobo, Sandile Mzizi noSifiso Mlondo bathweswe amacala awela esigabeni sesithupha; okungamabili okubulala namabili okuzama ukubulala.Bayaphika ukuthi yibona ababulala uMnuz Siyabonga Mkhize, owayezoba yikhansela, nelungu le-ANC, uMnuz Mzukisi Nyanga eCato Crest, eMayville ngo-Okthoba 2021.La madoda abesechithwa okwesibili yinkantolo esicelweni sawo sebheyili, kwazise ngo-Agasti 2022 kwenzeka okufanayo."Inkantolo kumele izenelise ukuthi ngempela amaphuzu esicelo sebheyili sesibili masha futhi ayikaze iwezwe esikhathini esidlule. Ngeshwa akukho okunqala eniza nakho, nalawo maphuzu amasha eniwavezile awachazi ukuthi ngininike ibheyili. Kuyobe inkantolo ayibenzi ubulungiswa uma inikhulula,” kuchaza imantshi.UNgiba kwale ngisho ezikhalela, ethi akasesebenzi, umholo wakhe wokugcina ekubeni yikhansela likaMasipala waseThekwini uwuthole ekupheleni kukaSepthemba nonyaka.Imantshi ithe vele kuba njalo uma umuntu egcinwe ngaphakathi ezitokisini, akaholi engasebenzanga.Imantshi ithe yiwona la madoda abambezela icala lawo ekutheni liqhubekele phambili ngoba bekubukeka engakulungele ukuqala kwalo.Iveze nokuthi uMbuso ubukade ukuphikisa nokuthi abamangalelwa banikwe ibheyili, uwasola nangokuxhumana nofakazi esejele. Lokhu kuthiwa kuphoqe obezokuba wufakazi ahoxe ngenxa yokwesatshiswa.Kuthe uma uNgiba etshelwa ukuthi akayitholi ibheyili, wasukuma wama ebhokisini labasolwa efuna ukuhamba kodwa wavinjwa wukuthi abamangalelwa ababili abebeseceleni esandleni sakhe sokudla kabanyakazi, balalele imantshi.Lokhu kumphoqile ukuthi naye ame ngoba indlela yokudlula ingekho.Abebekade bezokweseka la madoda baphume belandelana enkantolo begcwele indumalo.Le wadi izoba nokhetho lokuchibiyela ngoDisemba 13.
NKOSIKHONA CELEKUBE ongaphansi nongaphezulu phakathi kwabefundisi bebandla laseZayoni, uKuphila KwaMakhristu bebanga umnikelo wabazalwane.Ngokuthola kweSolezwe Ngempelasonto isigameko sishiye amalungu ebandla eliseSteadville, eMnambithi, ebambe ongezansi ezizwa ehlazekile.Umthombo oyilungu lebandla obukhona ngesikhathi sesigameko uthi bekuwusuku nje olujwayelekile, kwakhonzwa kwaqedwa kwathi sekunomhlangano wabaholi obuzosheshe uphele, inhloko yebandla uMbhishobhi Zimele Zikhali, wabuza ukuthi umnikelo ugcine kubani.Kuthiwa unobhala webandla uwukhombe kuMfundisi Zenzele Chagwe. Waphindisela uChagwe, kwasuka esinamandla, namakholwa esememeza ebabaza. "Kuze kwalamula abazalwane kubonakala ukuthi isimo sibi kakhulu phakathi kwabo. Imali yomnikelo ugcine eyidubile uZikhali wahamba nayo uChagwe,'' kusho umthombo.Kuvela ukuthi imali yomnikelo yangalolu suku ibingu-R7 500. Uthe ngesikhathi uZikhali esungula ibandla wamthembisa ukuthi bazolihola bobabili babambisane.Wamthembisa nokuthi kukhona ayomhlephulela khona emnikeleweni wamakholwa. Uthi manje sekuphele iminyaka ewu-10 ibandla lasungulwa uZikhali imali uyitamuza yedwa nomndeni wakhe."Umkami kwayena manje ungibiza ngendoda eyisithithithi edlala enye indoda. Lo muntu akaze nangelilodwa ilanga angihlephulele okuncane,'' kubalisa uChagwe.Uveze ukuthi akaboni ukuthi usazophinde abuyele kuleli bandla. Ukuqinisekisile ukuthi impela umnikelo okuthiwa uhambe nawo, uwuthathile. Uthe mncane kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nomnikelo ohlale uthathwa nguZikhali ophila kahle ngenxa yemali yebandla.
IWUNDABUZEKWAYO ividiyo esabalale ezinkundleni zokuxhumana iveza owesifazane ehlaselwa ngabesifazane bemsola ngezinsolo zokuthi usabalalise izinkulumo zokuthi uNyazilwezulu lulala namakhosazana eBuhleni, naye useke walala nalo.Lo wesifazane elingaziwa igama lakhe uvela kwiFacebook egqoke umnazaretha eshawa ngabesifazane abazwakala bekhuluma kodwa bengaveli, bebuza ukuthi usebenzela bani njengoba engcolisa igama loNyazilwezulu? Uthi uma ethi uzama ukuchaza kuqhume impama agcine esebheke phansi. Abesifazane abamthethisayo bakhuluma kanyekanye futhi bambamba nangesidlozana. Kukhona oze abize igama lomunye umholi wamaNazaretha, uebuza ukuthi uthunywe nguyena yini ukuthi angcolise igama loNyazilwezulu. Yonke imibuzo ugcina engayiphendulanga njengoba bengamniki thuba bemxina nangezimpama.KuFacebook, kuthiwa intokazi ikhonza ethempelini Ekujuleni kwaMbonambi, kodwa umkhokheli wethempeli kuthiwa uthe ayikhonzi khona. Lokho sikusho ngoba akekho ovelayo kodwa sizwa amazwi abo kuphela. Noma kunjalo kodwa asikugqugquzeli ukushawa kwabantu. Uma kungukuthi ngampela ikushilo lokhu okuthiwa ikushilo nayo yenze iphutha kodwa esingasho ukuthi akumele ishawe. Bekumele uma inezikhalo iye emaphoyiseni kunokuthi ikhulume ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lento yenza sisole ukuthi kunomkhankaso wokudicilela phansi isithunzi senkosi uNyazi,” kusho uMncwabe.

Ummeli kaJub Jub u-Adv Terrence Baloyi, uthe usadinga isikhathi ukuze axoxe kabanzi nekhasimende lakhe.Uthe kunezinto ezithile abasalinde ukuthi uMbuso ubanike zona ezizokhomba indlela ngokuthi icala limi kanjani bese bezilungiselela kahle. UJub Jub ufike enkantolo efake ijakhethi enkulu, ebukeka engaxwayile kakhulu kodwa ebhokisini ubelokhu ebheke phansi.UJub Jub uboshwa nje, ubuya khona ezikhindini lapho ayedonsa khona ngecala lokushayela budedengu nokubulala ngokungenhloso emuva kokushona kwabafundi abane abashayisa ngemoto.
INkantolo eNkulu yaseWestern Cape isinqume ukuthi osolwa ngokushisa iPhalamende, uMnuz Zandile Mafe akakulungele ukubhekana naleli cala.UMafe ubebhekene necala lokushisa iPhalamende eKapa, ngoJanuwari wango-2022.Phambilini inkantolo yakhipha umyalelo wokuthi uMafe ayohlolwa isimo somqondo.NgoMsombuluko emini iJaji Nathan Erasmus lithe liyahambisana nombiko wongoti, othi uMafe akakulungele ukubhekana necala."Yisona isinqumo sami leso, sokuthi uMnuz Mafe akakulungele ukulandela okwenzeka enkantolo futhi azivikele kahle, ngakho akekho esimweni sokuthi abhekane naleli cala,” kusho ijaji.
Kuboshwe abasolwa abangu-415 ngezinsolo zamacala ahlukene Ekurhuleni, eGatuteng phakathi koLwesihlanu neSonto ekuseni ngeesikhathi amaphoyisa enomkhankaso wokulwa nobugebengu.Amaphoyisa abeqhuba umkhankaso i-Operation Shanela, ehambisana nakamasipala waseKurhuleni, awomgwaqo aseGauteng, CPF, uMnyango wezaseKhaya nezinye izinhlaka zezokuphepha.Abasolwa boboshelwe amacala okukhona kuwo awokutholakala nezibhamu ezingekho emthethweni nokunye.Ngokwesitatimende sawo, amaphoyisa abeqaphe isimo e-Edenpark ngesikhathi ehlangana nowesifazane owatshele ukuthi uphuma esiteshini ukuyovula icala lokudlwengula futhi uyamazi umsolwa."Amaphoyisa anikele lapho kuhlala khona umsolwa. Amficile umsolwa futhi ngesikhathi eseshwa, utholakale nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu ezingu-11,” kusho isitatimende.Ngosuku olufanayo amaphoyisa abezulazula ePrimrose emijondolo ebizwa ngokuthi yiseMarathon, azithele phezu kowesilisa osekhulile obekunento evela enqulwini. Kuthe ngesikhathi eseshwa watholwa nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni nezinhlamvu ezine.Esinye isibhamu sitholakale nezinhlamvu ezine eKatlehong ngesikhathi kuseshwa khona ebusuku ngoMgqibelo.E-Ivory Park kuboshwe abasolwa abangu-40 ngezinsolo zokushayela bephuzile.Umkhuzi wamaphoyisa esifundeni Ekurhuleni uMajor General Anna Sithole uwancomile ngemizamo yawo yokwehlisa ubugebengu nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abasolwa bayaboshwa.
NKOSIKHONA CELEUMFELOKAZI wephoyisa elabulawa ngokudutshulwa maphakathi nonyaka, ujola nofeleba wenkabi odonsa udilikajele okuyiyo esolwa ngokuqasha inkabi eyabulala umyeni wakhe.Lokhu kuvele ebufakazini obethulwe phambi kwenkantolo yiphoyisa eliwumphenyi, uWarrant Officer Sibusiso Ntshangase ecaleni elibhekene noNkk Faith Ntombela ongummangalelwa wokuqala ekufeni kukaCaptain Zwelakhe Ntombela owayeyiphoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku izolo enkantolo yeMantshi eMlaza.UNtshangase ngoLwesihlanu ubekade elandisa inkantolo ngobufakazi asebuqoqile kuze kube yimanje.UKhulani Cele(ojola nommangalelwa), ongowaKwaMaphumulo, uchazwe njengenkabi esatshwayo KwaZulu-Natal. Isolwa ngokuqhuba umsebenzi wobunkabi ikhona ejele. UNkk Ntombela ubekade ezocela ibheyili kanye nommangalelwa wesibili uMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo onguthishanhloko esikoleni saKwaMaphumulo.Uthe itulo lokubulawa kukamufi lahlangiswa ocingweni nguNkk Ntombela kanye naye uCele.Uthe kwavunyelwana ngokuthi umufi uzobulawa ngesibhamu sakhe, kusetshenziswe imoto yakhe yohlobo lweSuzuki ebomvu futhi adutshulwe ngesibhamu sakhe.Uveze nokuthi itulo lokuqala lokusocongwa kukamufi ngophoyizeni laphunza.Uthe kunesikhathi lapho khona uNkk Ntombela ahamba khona nenkabi eyadubula baya epulazini eliKwaDukuza beyothenga uphoyizeni wokudlisa umufi."UNkulunkulu emuhle alizange liphumelele lelo tulo ngoba laba bobabili bangenazo imvume yokuthenga epulazini lomoba,''echaza.Umufi waphuma eya esitolo eyothengela umkakhe okuthile. Uveze ukuthi ngesikhathi eya esitolo wayekade ephelezelwa yindodakazi yakhe.Kwathi uma sekufanele eyovala isango, uNkk Ntombela wenqabela indodakazi ukuba imphelezele uyise ukuyovala isango.Kwathi sekuqhuma isibhamu indodakzi yaphumela emnyango yafica uyise esedindilize phansi kugobhoza igazi."UNkk Ntombela yena ngaleso sikhathi wayezimele nje everandi,''kulandisa uNtshangase.Uveze ukuthi indodakazi yamemeza icela usizo kwaze kwasondela omakhelwane.Kodwa abakwazanga ukumbamba owayedubula ngoba wayebasikaza ngesibhamu.Ubonakale ehwaqabala ebusweni uNkk Ntombela ngesikhathi uNtshangase eveza ukuthi naye ucishe wathola amachaphazelo ngoba uyena owavala izimali zikamufi kwaMetropolitan.Bonke lobu bufakazi obethulwe wuNtshangase uthe ufuna busetshenziselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi laba ababili abayitholi ibheyili.Uthishanhloko yena ushintshe abameli njengoba esezomelwa ngabanye.Icala lihlehliselwe uDisemba 13 ukuze kuqhutshekwe nesicelo sebheyili.
UBUZWE nawummeli wakhe unesi ukuthi kwakumayelana nani ukushayelana kwakhe izingcingo nomfowabo ngezinsuku okwathunjwa ngazo umyeni wakhe owatholakala eseshonile?U-Adv Siphelele Zwane ongummeli kaNksz Nompumelelo Goncalves uphonse lo mbuzo eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini, ngoLwesine.UNksz Goncalves uthe wayeshayela ucingo ubhuti wakhe, uMnuz Nkosinathi Zungu, ongummangalelwa wokuqala ecaleni ngoba efuna ukuthi amsize kokuthile angakuchazanga.Uqhube wathi noZungu wayenza okufanayo, amthinte ocingweni uma kukhona usizo aludingayo.Umbuzo kaZwane usuka kokuvezwe ngumshushisi u-Adv Krishen Shah kuthangi, lapho ethe kunoxhaxha lwezingcingo nama-SMS okungaphezu kuka-50 phakathi kukaNksz Goncalves noZungu ngosuku okwasocongwa ngalo umufi.Laba ababili baboshwa bathweswa icala lokuthumba nelokubulala uMnuz Nkosi Timmy Langa owayengunjiniyela kwaTransnet.UMbuso usola ukuthi uLanga wathunjwa ngoSepthemba 29, 2020, izinsalela zesidumbu sakhe zatholakala oZwathini, eNdwendwe, ngoNovemba walowo nyaka.UZwane ubuze lo mmangalelwa wesibili ukuthi wayeyokwenzani esitolo esidayisa impahla yokwakha esisenkabeni yedolobha iPinetown?UNksz Goncalves uthe akasakumbuli ukuthi yini ayeyoyithenga.Phambilini, indoda eyavuma leli cala yagwetshwa iminyaka engu-20, yabe isiphenduka ufakazi woMbuso, yathi enkantolo lona wesifazane waya kothenga isicabha esisha njengokomyalelo wayo noZungu.Yafakaza ngokuthi isicabha esidala sacekeleka phansi ngobusuku abathumba ngabo uLanga besebenzisa indlakadla.Kodwa uNksz Goncalves ubuchithile lobu bufakazi wathi kwaziqondanela nje ukuthi abe kulesi sitolo ngalolu suku olulandela okwathunjwa ngalo umyeni wakhe."Kwaziqondanela nje ngoba asikho isicabha esafa nesisha esafakwa ekhaya, yonke into yayinjengoba injalo endlini,” kuchaza uNksz Goncalves.Njengenhlalayenza, ubevele azibukele utolika oseduzane kwakhe, ancishe amehlo abasuke bethamele icala, abameli nejaji.Uze wakhuzwa nguShah, emsola ngokuthi udelela inkantolo ethi indlela
