uSolwazi Bonke Dumisa. lilihlehlisele uJanuwari 18, wonyaka ozayo, icala okulindeleke ukuthi uShah noZungu bethule izethulo ezendlalela ukukhishwa kwesinqumo sokuthi ayabalahla amacala abammangalelwa noma baphuma phambili.
AKHALE ngokuthwala kanzima amakhosi uma ehambele imicimbi esuke ihlanganisa umengameli nephini likamengameli wezwe, athi abaqaphi balaba baholi bawabuza ipasi nesipesheli.Amakhosi athi sekugcina kuba nzima kuwona ukuthi athamele le micimbi ngoba amanye anqatshelwa nokuthi angene lapho kusuke kunemicimbi khona.Lokhu kuvezwe nguSihlalo weNdlu yobuHoli boMdabu neKhoi-San, inkosi Thabo Milton Seatlholo, emhlanganweni wokuvala unyaka obusePhalamende.Uthe sekukaningi amakhosi ekhala ngendlela aphathwa ngayo kule micimbi kahulumeni, esuke ihanjelwe ikakhulu yiPhini likaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Paul Mashatile."Amakhosi athwala kanzima. Enye inkosi yajikiswa wonogada beyibuza ukuthi ifunani la. Yinto okumele siyiqondise ehhovisi lephini likamengameli ngendaba yonogada bakhe. Kwamina kuke kwaba nesehlakalo lapho kwakunomcimbi wephini likamengameli eFree State, angizange ngiphatheke kahle. Kungenza ugcine usuxoshwa emcimbini wakho ngoba bengakwazi labo abaqapha umengameli, noma iphini likamengameli. Uma ungasayi kule micimbi, kuzoba sengathi uphikisana nabo ekubeni kungenjalo ngoba usaba ukuphoxeka.”Usho lokhu nje onogada abayisishiyagalombili baMashatile bahamba icala lokushaya abanye abantu ababehamba ngemoto eFourways eGoli.Labo nogada babonakala kwividiyo bekhahlela kanzima abantu ababehamba ngePolo ngoJulayi. Ebuzwa mayelana nalesi sehlakalo ePhalamende uMashatile, wathi ngeke akwazi ukwanda ngaso kakhulu njengoba kusaqhubeka icala enkantolo.Kulo mhlangano kunxuswe ukuthi uma sekuvulwa iNdlu yabaHoli boMdabu ngonyaka ozayo, amakhosi kumele avunule."Akumele sigqoke amasudi nezinto eziwubukhazikhazi kodwa kumele kuvunulwe ngokwesintu sethu. Indlu izovulwa ngoFebhuwari 22, 2024.”Amakhosi axoxe ngezinto eziningi ezithinta nombiko weStats SA, obuveza ukukhula kwesibalo sabantu kuleli.UMnuz Ashwell Jenneker, oyiStatistical Operations and Provincial Coordination kwi-Stats SA, uveze ukuthi abantu sebengu-62 million kuleli, wathi bayashiya ezindaweni ezisemakhaya bafudukela emadolobheni. Uveze ukuthi bafudukela eGauteng, besuka KwaZulu-Natal naseLimpopo, wathi abase-Eastern Cape bafudukela eWestern Cape.
BADUDUZE uNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa kwamaBhizinisi amancane, uNkk Stella Ndabeni Abrahams, nobengumyeni wakhe uMnuz Thato Abrahams, abamemezele ukuthi bayehlukanisa. Bakhiphe isitatimende ngokuhlanganyela bebika ukuthi sekufike ekugcineni.UNgqongqoshe ubuye abe yilungu lesigungu esiphezulu se-ANC kanti uke waphatha nezinye izikhundla kuhulumeni nasenhlanganweni yakhe.U-Abrahams ungusomabhizinisi owaziwayo futhi ubevamisile ukubonakala nomkakhe emcimbini kahulumeni beswenke beconsa. UNgqongqoshe wasinela u-Abrahams ngo-2012, okusho ukuthi umshado wabo ubuqeda iminyala engu-11 njengoba uhlukana nje.Phambilini kwavela imibiko emaphephandabeni ithi bahlala ngokuba nezinkinga emshadweni wabo. Esitatimendeni balibeka ngembaba elokuthi bayehlukana kodwa abachazi ukuthi yini edale ukuhlukana."Emuva kweminyaka ewu-11 yomshado sithathe isinqumo esisicubungule kabanzi, sabona ukuthi kufanele sehlukane ngokuthula nokuvumelana. Yisinqumo sethu sobabili futhi sifisa bonke abantu basihloniphe basinike nelungelo lasesithe,’’ ngokobhalo wesitatimende.Bathe lokhu bakwenze nakuba kade bethandana impela kodwa sekufike ekugcineni."Yebo, besithandana impela kodwa sinqume ukuthe sithi khumu. Sehlukana nje, siyahloniphana kakhulu futhi sizoqhubeka nokuba abangani. Siyohlala sizikhumbula izikhathi ezimnandi ebesinazo ndawonye njengomfazi nendoda,’’ ngokwesitatimende.Bathe bayazi ukuthi abantu bebenabo indlela yonke futhi bebeseka zikhathi zonke bayakubonga kakhulu lokho. Bathi bayabonga nokuthi bazoqhubeka nokubeseka nakuba sebehlukana ngezindlela.Emuva kokufakwa kwesitatimende ezinkundleni zokuxhumana abantu babaxhume eduze ngamazwi enduduzo futhi babafisela okuhle kodwa.USifiso Nhlengethwa kaDube, uthe kumuncu kodwa wathi sengathi nabanye abantu bangabonela kubona ngendlela yokusingatha ngobunono udaba lokwehlukanisa olubucayi.UPerth Mdladlamaba naye uphose esivivaneni. "Camagu mhlekazi, amathamsanqa wodwa kulokho okuzokwenzeka ngekusasa lenu,’’ kusho uMdladlamba.UNdumi Nobhongo Nkunzi-Ngonyama uthe kudala ewa evuka nabo bobili."Bengiyingxenye yohambo lwenu ebuhleni nasebubini, ngike ngaya naseWelkom, ngiyokweseka uMamotse. Akwehli kahle neze lokhu kimi kodwa kuyaphoqa ukuthi ngeseke isinqumo senu. Sengathi uMdali anganihola endleleni futhi angingabazi ukuthi nizobambisana kahle ekukhuliseni izingane,’’ kusho uNdumi.
IHLELELWE uFebhuwari wangonyaka ozayo impelasonto yokugcina yokubhalisela ukuvota okhethweni oluzayo.Ikhomishini yezokhetho imemezele ukuthi impelasonto yokugcina yokubhalisela ukuvota izoba ngoFebhuwari 3 no-4, ngo-2024.Okhulumela ikhomishini uNkk Kate Bapela, uthe iziteshi ezingu-23 296 zokuvota zizovulwa kusuka ngo-8 ekuseni zivalwe ngo-5 ntambama ngalezi zinsuku.Uthe abazobe beqala ukubhalisa bamukelekile wathi nalabo abazobheka imininingwane yabo ukuthi isayiyona."Sebengu-26.8 million abantu abasemqulwini wokuvota emva kokuvula ukuthi bazobhalisa nokuzibheka ngenyanga edlule. Sethemba ukuthi ngempelasonto yokugcina baningi abazophuma size sidlule nesibalo sabaphume ngenyanga edlule.”UNkk Bapela uthe abaneminyaka engu-16 bangabhalisela ukuvota. Wadalula ukuthi abakuleli abahlala kwamanye amazwe bazoba nethuba lokuyobhalisa ezindlini zamanxusa kusuka ngoJanuwari 26 kuya ku-27, ngonyaka ozayo."Sizohambela nezikhungo zokuhlunyeleliswa kwezimilo kuleli ukunxenxa iziboshwa ukuthi zivote. Zizobhalisela ukuvota kusuka ngoJanuwari 30, kuya kuFebhuwari 1, 2024, njengoba sizohambela lezi zikhungo sisebenzisana noMnyango wezokuHlunyeleliswa kweziMilo.”Uqhube wathi kuzoba nomkhankaso wokugqugquzela abantu ukuthi bavote ezinkundleni ezehlukene. Ugqugquzele abantu ukuthi baqhubeke babhalisele ukuvota kanti bangashayela ku:0800 11 8000, kusuka ngo-8 ekuseni kuya ku-5 ntambama phakathi nezinsuku. UKHALE ngaphansi umholi weBuild One SA (BOSA), uMnuz Mmusi Maimane, ne-Independent Candidates Association (ICA), abebefake isicelo sokuthi kubhekwe udaba lokwabiwa kwezihlalo ePhalamende.IPhalamende lakuleli linezihlalo ezingu-400, sezizonke kanti zabiwa ngokwesibalo samavoti atholwe ngamaqembu. UMaimane wehlukana neDA wasungula iqembu elisha.Udaba lokhetho luyindaba egudwini ngoba sekubhekwe ku-2024 lapho uhulumeni uzophelelwa yisikhathi bese kukhethwa kabusha.Udaba belufakwe eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, yabe isikhipha isinqumo izolo ichitha uMaimane ne-ICA. IJaji Nonkosi Mhlantla elethule isinqumo, lithe amajaji avumelane ngazwi linye kulolu daba. Ijaji lithe udaba olulethwe nguMaimane nabe-ICA, luyezwakala lunohlonze lukhuluma ngezindaba ezimqoka kodwa abagculisekile ngamaphuzu abawabekile.Abebemangalelwe nguMengameli uCyril Ramaphosa, nguNgqongqoshe wezaseKhaya uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, nePhalamende.URamaphosa wasayina umthetho othi abangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela bazokwabelwa izihlalo ezingu-200 kwezingu-400 ePhalamende. Abangenele ukhetho ngokuzimela bakhala ngokuthi lokhu kuwukuphuca abantu amandla.Bebecela inkantolo ukuthi iwuchithe lo mthetho kushintshwe lokhu kodwa bangaphumelela. Bebephakamisa ukuthi babelwe izihlalo ezingu-350 ePhalamende.Amaqembu amatasa alungiselela ukhetho lukazwelonke okulindeleke ukuthi lube olwehlukile kakhulu selokhu kwabuswa ngentando yabantu kuleli.Amehlo asethe njo kumengameli ukuthi akhombe usuku lokhetho lapho ziyobe zidlana imilala khona kubangwa amavoti.Kulindeleke ukuthi sithi xaxa nesibalo samaqembu azongenela ukhetho.
KUNZIMA emndenini womfundi, oduke ekuqaleni konyaka izinsalela zesidumbu sakhe ezazilokhu zitholakala ngamancozu, zithukuswe emhlangeni ososebeni lomfula, eMelville, KwaDukuza.UPhilasande Shange (7) owabulawa ngesihluku, ngoJanuwari, ngaphambi kokuthi kuvulwe izikole, ubhekene nezinkinga njengoba namanje usabhacile emva kokuthola imiyalezo eyayiwusongela ngokuwenzakalisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, usahleli emakhandleleni kwazise izinsalela zesidumbu zelungu lawo zisaduve emakhazeni, kulindwe imiphumela yolibofuzo.Udadewabo kanina kamufi, uNksz Ntombi Shange, uthe bukhulu ubuhlungu obubhekene nomndeni, ikakhulu unina njengoba bonke bagcina ngokuthi basuke eNtshawini, lapho babakhe khona ngaphambi kwesigameko, babhaca ezihlotsheni ngenxa yama-SMS ayebasongela. Okwenza isimo sibe sibi kakhulu ukuthi kuze kube yimanje abakangcwabi njengoba sekubalwa izinsuku kuphele unyaka lesi sigameko senzeka."Okubuhlungu ukuthi asaziswa lutho ngokuqhubekayo, noma siya esiteshini samaphoyisa, kuvele kuthiwa icala seliphethwe abanye abangaphezulu. Okokungcwaba ingane, emaphoyiseni bavele bathi nabo abazi njengoba kusalindwe imiphumela yolibofuzo,” kubalisa yena.Uthe ngenxa yalesi simo, amalungu omndeni - ikakhulu uninakhulu wengane - usehlala ngokugula okukholakala ukuthi kungenxa yobuhlungu obudalwa wusizi ababhekene nalo. Uthe okubuhlungu ukuthi akusekho nemali yokulungiselela umngcwabo kwazise bese behlanze ngedela ngokufihla ingane yabo kangangoba abakudingayo ukugcina nje usiko ngokuyifihla ngesizotha futhi ngenxa yesimo osekuyokuba yinto yomndeni.Umufi wayephasele u-Grade 2 eMelville Primary. Wagcina ukubonakala ngoJanwari 5, 2023, okuthiwa wayethunywe u-anyanisi esitolo ngumakhelwane. Ngesikhathi umphakathi, amaphoyisa nomndeni bematasa bethungatha lo mfundi okwase kuphele izinsuku ezine elahlekile, elinye ilungu lomndeni kuthiwa lathola i-SMS evela enombolweni engaziwa ibayelela lapho kuthukuswe khona izinsalela zomzimba. Baya lapho abafica kubekwe ikhanda nengalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi baphinde bathola enye i-SMS eyabaholela kwezinye izicubu zomzimba ezase zithanda ukonakala okukholakala ukuthi ezikamufi, nazo zazithukuswe emhlangeni osebeni lomfula.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColone Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa asaphenya, akukaboshwa muntu.Ngesikhathi ememezela izibalo zobugebengu zekota yesibili ka-2023/024 ngenyanga edlule, uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa, uMnuz Bheki Cele, uthe ingwadla yokusilela emuva ngeminyaka emibili kumasampula olibofuzo angu- 240 000 obekumele enziwe, seyiphelile, eqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi sewuqhubeka ngendlela ejwayelekile.
UMHOLI we-DA KwaZulu-Natal ushiye angalazi eqenjini elibusayo wathi yilona elisekhaleni ekuqothweni kosopilitiki esifundazweni.UMnuz Francious Rodgers usho kanje ethula inkulumo emgcwabeni kaSotswebhu kuMasipala uMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu (46) ngoMgqibelo.IKHANSELA leDA ebelinguSotswebhu kuMasipala uMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu odutshulwe wafa kwakhe Isithombe: Sithunyelwe UNdlovu udutshulwe wafa kwakhe eMasosheni, eHowick ngoLwesibili.IDA ikhiphe umehlokaboni kaR1 million kongalekelela nolwazi oluzoholela ekuboshweni kwababulali bakaNdlovu.URodgers uthe ukubulawa kosopolitiki akuyona into emane izenzekele kodwa iyahlelwa."Sibhekene nenkinga ye-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. Iyona ephehla ukubulawa kosopolitiki. Abasakwenzi kuphela bebodwa kodwa sebebhekise nakwiDA,” kusho uRodgers ngokucasuka.Uthe ukubulawa kukaNdlovu ngeke kube yize leze, ababulali bakhe bazotholakala.URodgers uze wathi akanavalo, uyanikela ngempilo yakhe ngakho akuhlukanwe phansi namakhansela eDA kubhekwane naye.Okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal uMnuz Mafika Mndebele uchaze uRodgers ngokuthi akanabo ubuntu, usebenzisa ukufa ukuze agayele iDA ivoti.UMndebele uthe abohlanga bayazotha uma kunesifo futhi abakhulumi amanga phezu kwesidumbu."Asisebenzisi isidumbu ukukhankasa. IDA isebenzisa ukufa komuntu ukuze ithole ithuba lamavoti. Lokhu kukhomba ukungabi nazwelo, akunasisindo futhi kuwubuwula,” kusho uMndebele.Umufi ushiye emhlabeni inkosikakazi nabantwana omncane wabo onezinyanga eziyisithupha.
KUHLATSHWE ikhwelo emphakathini ukuthi ufake iso ezikoleni zingagqekezwa noma ziphenduke indawo yokudlalela izigebengu njengoba zizovalelwa amaholidi.Leli khwelo lihlatshwe nguNgqongqoshe weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uNkk Angie Motshekga, othe bayakhathazeka njalo uma izikole zizovalwa isikhathi eside ngoba babuya sekukhona okonakele.Uthe ngesikhathi zivaliwe ziphenduka inkundla yokudlalela yezigebengu."Sinxusa imiphakathi ukuthi isisize ifake iso izibheke izikole njengoba kuzovalwa. Siyakhathazeka njalo uma kumele kuvalwe isikhathi eside ngoba sibuye sekonakele.”Uthe ukubambisana ikhona okuzosiza kule nkinga ababhekene nazo ngoba akuzona zonke izikole ezinonogada."Ngamaholidi ikakhulu kaDisemba, sibuya sekwagqekezwa kwathathwa izinto eziningi. Akuvikelwe impahla yezingane ukuze ngonyaka ozayo zikwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezishiywe abanye abafundi.”Kuhlale kukhalwa ngobugebengu obuhlasela ezinye zezikole njengoba naKwaZulu-Natal, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo, uNkk Mbali Frazer, uke wakhala ngokugqekezwa kwezikole.Izikole zigqekezwa kwebiwe amakhompyutha nezinye izinsiza zokufunda nokufundisa.Kwesinye isikhathi kuze kwebiwe ukudla okuphekelwa abafundi kanjalo namabhodwe okuphekwa ngawo.Umnyango usebenzisana namaphoyisa endawo ukuqapha izikole. Umnyango kazwelonke ubuye wanxusa abazali ukuthi baqikelele ukuthi abafundi babuyisa izincwadi.Umyalezo okhishelwe abazali ubalule ukuthi abafundi abalahle izincwadi abazali kumele bangenelele."Izincwadi zokufunda kumele zibuyiswe uma sekuphela unyaka ukuze zikwazi ukusetshenziswa ngabanye abafundi ngonyaka olandelayo. Uma umfundi elahle incwadi umzali kumele abambe iqhaza ngokuthi ithengwe leyo ncwadi ukuze nabanye abafundi bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa ngonyaka olandelayo.”Izikole zihlale ziyalelwa ukuthi zibe nohlelo lokuqoqa izincwadi ezisuke zikhishelwe abafundi.Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze njalo ngonyaka kungathengwa izincwadi ezintsha, kunalokho kugcwaliselwe kulezo ezivele zikhona.

KUTHOLOZA isomi ejele kuZamani Zulu (39), ogwetshwe udilikajele ngecala lokubulala umkhwekazi wakhe efuna ukubuyiselwa izinkomo zamabheka ngoba aliwe yingoduso. UZulu ugwetshwe yiNkantolo yesiFunda saseShowe emuva kokulahlwa amacala.Isigameko esiholele ekugwetshweni kukaZulu senzeka ngoDisemba 2021, esigodini KwaKhoza, eShowe, esashiya abomndeni bethuthumela.Okhulumela uphiko lwezokushushusa (NPA) KwaZulu- Natal, uNkk Natasha Ramkisson-Kara, uthe uZulu ulahlwe yicala lokubulala, wukuthumba, wukushaya ngenhloso yokulimaza ingoduso nelokuphatha isibhamu ngokungemthetho.Kuvele ukuthi uZulu waqonywa yintombi wayilobola, baba nengane, wase ehlala ngokuyihlukumeza eyishaya yaze yamala. Ingoduso leyo yase ithola elinye isoka nokuthe uZulu uma ekuzwa lokho sasuka isidumo. Kuthiwa uZulu wayithatha ingoduso wayoyivalela endlini thizeni engasahlali muntu eyishaya, ethi ababuyelane kodwa yamchitha.NgoDisemba 12, isoka elisha lathumela abakhongi beyokhulekela isihlobo esihle kubo kwengoduso kaZulu. Konke kwahamba kahle bemukeleka abakhongi emuva kwalokho, ingoduso yaba nohambo yaya eThekwini.Ithe isanda kuhamba ingoduso wafika uZulu ezoyifuna, watshelwa ukuthi ihambile nokwamthukuthelisa kakhulu waqala waba nodlame. Wasuka wahamba wasonga ngokuthi uyabuya. Wabuya ebusuku engasadle nkobe zamuntu, ememeza esangweni ethi abamvulele bathi uma benqaba wajomba isango wangena.Wangena wasabisa abalamu bakhe, wafuna ngodli umkhwekazi wakhe. Uthe uma emthola wamtshela ukuthi ufuna izinkomo zakhe zamabheka kodwa umkhwekazi wathi akalande abakhongi ayebathumile kuqala.Emuva kwalokho, uZulu wathukuthela kakhulu wahlasela umkhwekazi wakhe ngesibhamu nokwathi uma ezama ukubaleka wamdubula ngemuva phambi kwabalamu bakhe. Kuthe uma uZulu eqeda ukudubula umkhwekazi wakhe washaya wachitha.Amaphoyisa athola ukuthi uZulu ubonakale kubo nokwathi uma efika amthola kade edla ushevu, ezama ukuzibulala. Ambopha amyisa esibhedlela. Watholwa nesibhamu eduze kwakhe ngesikhathi eboshwa nokuvela ukuthi yisona ayegila ngaso umkhuba.Esibhedlela bamelapha wavuka qingqo, wabhekana namacala akhe wagqigqa inkantolo aze amlahla. Ugwetshwe udilikajele kwelokubulala umkhwekazi, iminyaka eyishumi kwelesibhamu, wagwetshwa iminyaka emihlanu kwelokuthumba neminyaka emithathu kwelokushaya. Kusho ukuthi wudilikajele neminyaka ewu-18 isigwebo sakhe sesisonke.UNkk Kara weNPA uthe bayasemukela isigwebo futhi banethemba lokuthi sizobathusa nabanye abangase bacabange ukugila imikhuba efanayo
UZOQHUBEKA abhadle esitokisini uMnuz Emmanuwela David, ongummangalelwa wokuqala nosolwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekugqekezweni kwepulazi likaMengameli wezwe uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa.Kwagqekezwa, kwebiwa limali engamadola epulazini likamengameli ngo-2020, okuthiwa yayithukuswe nakosofa bakhona. Kuthiwa uDavid uhlobene nowayesebenza eplazini naye oboshiwe wathola ibheyili.UDavid ubefake isicelo sebheyili eNkantolo yeMantshi eBela Bela, eLimpopo, kwase kuphuma isinqumo ngoLwesihlanu. IMantshi uPredeshni Ponnan, ithe uDavid ukhombise ukungethembeki nokukhomba ukuthi angase alibalekele icala."Ngokwemigomo yezomthetho yokuqulwa kwamacala obugebengu, ummangalelwa wokuqala akakwazanga ukugculisa inkantolo ukuthi kuzoba wubulungiswa ukumdedela ngebheyili. Ngakho-ke ibheyili ngeke ayithole,’’ kuphetha imantshi.Kuvele ukuthi uDavid wake waboshelwa icala lokweqa umngcele ngokungemthetho wahlala ejele izinyanga eziyisithupha. Kuthiwa ngaphambi kokugqekeza epulazini likamengameli wayeqale wagqekeza kwelinye eliseduze nalo.Umbuso udalule nokuthi buningi ubufakazi obuyamanisa uDavid necala. Ubufakazi bamaselula bumkhomba endaweni yesigameko ngosuku esenzeka ngalo. Kuthiwa emuva kwesigameko wayenemali eningi eyifaka ebhange enye wathenga ngayo imizi nezimoto.Kunofakazi ongumshayeli wemoto eyaqashwa nguDavid, okuthiwa wayikhokhela ngemali engamadola.
INKAMPANI ephakela ugesi kuleli nehlaselwe yizinkinga i-Eskom, isiqoke uMnuz Dan Marokane njengesikhulu esiphezulu. I-Eskom imemezele igama likaMarokane ngoLwesihlanu, yathi iyamethemba kakhulu.Bese kunesikhathi i-Eskom ithungatha isikhulu esiphezulu futhi baningi abagadla zephuka, kwavela ukuthi umqashi akagculiseki ngabo.Isikhundla sesikhulu esiphezulu e-Eskom sivuleke emuva kokuhamba kukaMnuz Andre du Ruyter owahamba kungasekuhle. UMarokane wayevele esebenzela i-Eskom kodwa wamiswa ngesikhathi ephikisana nokugwamandwa kwamandla ombuso, wagcina ehambile.I-Eskom ithe iyamethemba uMarokane, uneziqu zobunjiniyela bamakhemikhali, une-MBA futhi uneminyaka engaphezu kuka-20 esebenza ezikhundleni eziphezulu. UMarokane ubesebenzela iHullet nayo ebihlaselwe yizinkinga yaze yashiywa obeyisikhulu esiphezulu.UMarokane kulindeleke ukuthi ajoyine i-Eskom ngoMashi 2024 bese uyasha umsebenzi.
ZIVUME ngo-elethu izindlu zakwaButhelezi eziwu-22, ukuthi inkosi uNtuthukoyezwe Zuzifa Buthelezi, ifanelwe wukuthatha isihlalo sobukhosi esishiwe nguyise ongasekho. Inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ibiyinkosi nondunankulu kaZulu, ikhothame ngoSepthemba emuva kokudunguzela.Inkosi entsha yakwaButhelezi iyizibulo likaShenge ongasekho, alizalelwa nguNdlunkulu u-Irene Thandekile Buthelezi naye ongasekho emhlabeni.UMntwana waKwaPhindangene ubengumsunguli we-IFP, owayihola isikhathi eside kanti ubeyilungu lePhalamende futh ubesedonse isikhathi eside cishe kunawo wonke.Nakuba isikhundla sobukhosi bekungesakhe kodwa ubesibambise uMnuz Mpikayise Buthelezi. Okhulumela umndeni kaShenge, uDkt Ngqengelele Buthelezi, uthe kulandelwe yonke imicikilisho yokuhlonza inkosi.Uthe kube nomhlangano kwavunyelwana ngodaba lobukhosi, wathi bazoxhumana nohulumeni bese kulandelwa konke njengokomthetho. Uthe okunye bazobuye bakuchaze ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngalolu daba.
INHLANGANO ebhekelela abathengi kuleli, iNational Consumer Commission (NCC) isixwayise abantu ukuthi baqaphele amaqola acuthele imali yabo.Iveze ukuthi ibone anda amaqola ikakhulukazi azenza sengathi anezinkampani zokutshala imali, amabhanoyi nolunye uhlobo lokuqola.Lokhu kwenze ukuthi iNCC isebenzisane neSouthern African Fraud Prevention Services (SAFPS) ukuza nezindlela zokulwa nokuqolwa kwabantu.I-SAFPS yinhlangano exwayisa ngokuqolwa, ubugebengu obuthinta imali nangokwebiwa kwemininingwane yabantu. Inezindlela ezisebenzisayo ezisiza abantu ukuba bazivikela ekuqolweni.I-NCC iveze ukuthi isifake uhlelo olubizwa ngeYima olusetshenziswa yiSAFPS ukusiza abantu ukuthi bazivikele.IYima izotholakala kwi-website yeNCC ukuze abantu bakwazi ukushesha babone ukuthi ama-website abangena kuwo asemthethweni yini.UKhomishana weNCC, uNksz Thezi Mabuza, uthe ukusebenzisana kwabo neSAFPS kusho ukuthi bazokwazi ukunciphisa izigameko zokuqolwa kwabantu futhi babasize ukuba bazivikele."Sithole ukuthi abantu baqolwa uma bethenga online ngakho sibone kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe uhlelo lweSAFPS olubizwa yeYima. Sicela abantu bacabange kabanzi ngaphambi kokuthi bathenge okuthile online. Sicela bacabange noma befuna ukudlala amabhanoyi noma befaka imininingwane yabo yasemabhange. Njalo ngamaholidi kaDisemba, abantu baqolwa imali yabo abayisebenzele kanzima. Sikhlolwa wukuthi iYima izobasiza ukuthi bazivikele ikakhulukazi uma bethenga online,” kusho uNksz Mabuza.UNksz Nazia Karrim wakwaSAFPS, uthe iYima wuhlelo lwabo oluvikela abantu.Uveze ukuthi ngenxa yalo bakwazile ukubona ukuthi izigameko zokuqolwa kwabantu uma bethenga noma behehwa ukuthi bangene emabhanoyini zinyuke ngo-33%."Amaqola akwazi ukuthengisa abantu izimoto ezingekho, iYima iyasiza ukuthi abantu babone ukuthi bangena kwi-website esemthethweni. Amanye amaqola azenza izinyanga, akhiphisa abantu imali ebathembisa umcebo. Sithole ukuthi izigameko zokuqolwa zize zifake ukunukubezwa ngokocansi ikakhulukazi kubantu besifazane. Siyacela abantu baqaphele, bangathembi kalula,” kusho uNksz Karrim.Ubaxwayise ngokulandela ama-link ikakhulukazi abawathola ezinkundleni zokuxhumana noma kwizikhangisa ezivela kwi-internet.IYima iyatholakala ku-www.yima.org.za nakwi website yeNCC www.thencc.org.za
INGWADLA yokudlanga kwezigameko zokwesula kwamaphoyisa ophiko iSpecial Task Force eyosebenza ezinkampanini zonogada ezizimele, isilethe ukukhathazeka ebuholini bombutho iSouth African Police Service, KwaZulu-Natal.Lokhu kuvele ezimpendulweni zikaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uGeneral Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi ekhuluma nabezindaba kwethulwa izimoto ezintsha zamaphoyisa eziteshini ezehlukene, emcimbini obuseThekwini ngoLwesithathu.UMkhwanazi uthe nakuba kukhona ukuthi amaphoyisa alolu phiko alaxaza umsebenzi ayosebenzela lezi zinkampani ngenxa yokuthenjiswa imali ethe xaxa, kodwa kufanele kubhekisiswe ukuthi akukho yini ezinye izinhloso ezenza abanikazi bezinkampani bawanxenxe ekutheni asebenze kuzo."Kuyangikhathaza uma emaningi kangaka amalungu alolu phiko ayeke umsebenzi ayosebenza ezinkampanini ezizimele. Kwenza sizibuze umbuzo ukuthi ikuphi inhloso. Izinkampani zonogada zinayo imali, siyavuma. Badonswa yiyona kodwa umbuzo uthi ngabe badonswa yiyona kuphela? Yingakho sesithe sicela basibhekele kahle laba abasebenza ophikweni lwezobunhloli, ukuthi kwenzakani, ekutheni umsebenzi nje abawutholayo noma mhlawumbe kukhona okunye abahambela khona”usho kanje.UMkhwanazi uthe nakuba ukwesula kwamaphoyisa kudlange kulolu phiko oluqeqeshwa ngezinga lombutho wezempi, kodwa zikhona izikhalo ezifanayo nasophikweni iNational Intervention Unit.Phambilini izinyunyana zamaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, iSouth African Police Union nePolice and Prisons Civil Rights Union, zikhale ngokufanayo zifuna uhulumeni akusukumele ukwesula isigubhukane kwamaphoyisa, zikhala ngokuthi kumele kubhekisiswe imihlomulo anikezwa yona.Engqungqutheleni yokukhetha ubuholi bePopcru ngenyanga edlule, uNobhala-jikelele weSouth African Communist Party uMnuz Solly Mapaila, enkulumeni yakhe, wasola isenzo sabanikazi bezinkampani zonogada ezizimele njengemizamo yokuzinika amandla amakhulu kunohulumeni, okungabeka uMbuso engcupheni.Mayelana nokushoda kwezinja emaphoyiseni, uMkhwanazi uthe sebexhumene nehhovisi likazwelonke elithembisile ukuthi kuzothinkuqala unyaka, kube nezinja ezingi eziqeqeshwayo, waveza ukuthi ukuqeqesha inja ekutheni isetshenziswe kulo mbutho kubhekwa izinto eziningo kubalwa nokuthi iphile kahle, okwenza kuthathe isikhathi ukuthola izinja ezifanele.
UTHATHE elinye igiya umbango womholi weNew Nazareth Baptist Church, umfundisi Mthembeni Mpanza ogxeka uNyazilwezulu ngokuzibiza ngoNkulunkulu, njengoba usungenwe nawumelaphi wendabuko oweseka uNyazi.Umfundisi Mpanza uthi uNyazi lwenza okungekhona ukuzibiza ngoNkulunkulu futhi nebandla lamaNazaretha akulona elakwaShembe kodwa elikaNkulunkulu.UNyazilwezulu olusamile ekutheni lona linguNkulunkulu, lwesekwe wumelaphi uZamokwakhe "King Bhaka” Nzama ngale nkulumo yalo. UKing Bhaka uthe inkinga kaMpanza akakuqondi ukusebenza kukamoya oyingcwele yingakho ebona sengathi uNyazi luyaphambuka. Le nkulumo yakhe uyenze ekhasini lakhe leFacebook lapho ebeke khona izizathu zokuthi kungani ekubona kungaphambene okushiwo wuNyazilwezulu ngokuzibiza ngoNkulunkulu.Ethintwa umfundisi uMpanza ngenkulumo kaKing Bhaka, uthe uyizwile kodwa kunezizathu ezenza akhulume kanje."Inkinga ukuthi lapha eBuhleni sekukhonza nezangoma nezinyanga okuyinto engavunyelwa wubuNazaretha. Kumele uBhaka alweseke uNyazi ngoba vele eBuhleni yilapho zikhululeke khona izinyanga nezangoma kanti ngokwenqubo yobuNazaretha akwemukelekile ukuthi ube yisangoma uma usuthathe le nkolo. Ukuvunyelwa kwazo kwenza indawo yaseBuhleni kube yikhaya lazo,” kusho uMfundisi Mpanza.UMELAPHI wendabuko uZamokwakhe "King Bhaka” Nzama ogxeka uMfundisi Mthembeni Mpanza okhala ngokuthi uNyazi akumele luzibize ngoNkulunkulu Isithombe: FACEBOOKEthintwa uKing Bhaka, uthe uMfundisi uMpanza ukhulunyiswa wukungaqondi."Angilona iNazaretha kodwa uNyazilwezulu uma luthi lunguNkulunkulu, lusuke lungaqondile lona siqu salo kodwa liqonde umoya ophila kulona kaNkulunkulu. Izinyanga nezangoma nazo zingabantu bakaNkulunkulu, akumele uMpanza azihlulele. Angikhulumeli uShembe kodwa ngikhulumela uNkulunkulu engazi ukuthi akabandlululi muntu. Kunenqwaba yezinyanga nezangoma eziya kuNyazi ngenhloso yokuthi kukhuphuke amandla ezinawo ngoba ziyazi lusetshenziswa wuNkulunkulu. Ezinye zifike ziyeke ubunyanga nobungoma zibe ngamaNazaretha. UMpanza uma ethunywe nguNkulunkulu akumele agxeke ubunyaka nobungoma ngoba uNkulunkulu uthanda wonke umuntu,” kusho uKing Bhaka.Kuthintwa uMncwabe, uthe bona njengamaNazaretha akekho noyedwa umuntu obhajadisiwe abake bembone engena nemiyeko esontweni ezokhonza."Wonke umuntu uma eze enkonzweni ugqoka umnazaretha. Izangoma nezinyanga ezivumeleke ukungena ebandleni nemiyeko yazo ezingabhajadisiwe kodwa ezisuke zizonikelela ukucela isibusiso. Alikho ilungelo lokuthi zixoshwe ngoba noma ungeyona inyanga noma isangoma wamukelekile ukuthi uzocela isibusiso kuBaba uNyazilwezulu,” kusho uMncwabe.Uthe uyayesekela inkulumo kaKing Bhaka, wathi uma umuntu ekhuluma into eyiqiniso abubalulekile ubungoma nobunyanga bakhe. Wathi ukholwa ukuthi uKinga Bhaka uphathisiwe lo msebenzi ngoba wake waxhumana naye eminyakeni eyishumi edlule elethe isibonakaliso ngobuhle boNyazi.

Kuthiwa kucekelwe phansi impahla kamasipala, yantshontshwa enye nama-generator."Umphakathi wathi ufuna usomlomo, uNonkululeko Ndlela, esikhundleni semeya ukuthi alalele izikhalo zabo. BASALE bebambe ongezansi abantu baseMazimazana, eNseleni, ngaseMpangeni, ngoLwesibili, kulandela isigameko abasifanise nensumansumane, kulala izidumbu ezintathu, iphoyisa kade leshela intombi.Kulesi sigameko kufe iphoyisa (30) okuthiwa belingekho emsebenzini, umalume (27) wentombi ebishelwa nogogo (55) wayo.Lilandisa Isolezwe ikhansela lendawo, uMnuz Msawakhe Mthethwa, lithe ngesikhathi lifika endaweni yesigameko lizithele phezu kwesidumbu sikaWele Mthombeni, watshelwa ukuthi unina, uNkk Mthombeni nephoyisa sebephuthunyiswe emtholampilo wendawo. Kuthiwa laba ababili, bathulele khona emtholampilo."Kuthiwa iphoyisa elinezihlobo eNseleni, belihamba ngemoto kule ndawo, lahlangana nentombi. Libe seliyibingelela, liyishela. Kuvela ukuthi lokhu kuthathe igxathu elibi ngesikhathi intombi ikhombisa ukungabi nandaba nobekushiwo yiphoyisa, yilapho-ke eligcine selithuka khona lona wesifazane,” kusho uMthethwa.Uthe bathole ukuthi lona wesifazane ubuyisele ngamagama ayiziswana ephoyiseni, nokuholele ekutheni iphoyisa ligcine selimshaya.Kuvela ukuthi usho ngengila lona wesifazane, kwagcina kuphuma umalume wakhe ezobheka ukuthi udliwa yini."Libona kuza umalume wentombi, iphoyisa linikele emotweni, lathatha isibhamu, lasabisa lona wesilisa. Kuthiwa naye ukhiphe ummese ezama ukulisabisa kodwa lavele lamdubula, wathulela lapho,” kubeka uMthethwa.Eqhuba, uthe kube sekuphuma ugogo wentombi, naye ezobheka ukuthi kwenzekani njengoba besekuqhuma inganono."Ufice ukuthi indodana yakhe isidutshuliwe, wabuyela endlini eyolanda esakhe isibhamu. Uthe uma ebuya naso, laphinde lahlasela ngenhlamvu libhekise kuye iphoyisa, naye wabuyisela ngayo, balimala kanzima bobabili,” kuqhuba yena uMthethwa.Uthe yilapho abaphuthunyiswe khona emtholampilo wendawo kodwa bafike bashona bekhona.Isolezwe lithole ukuthi umkhulu wentombi ungusomatekisi kodwa ubesaphumile ekhaya eyobheka umsebenzi ngesikhathi kusala kwenzeka umshophi.UMthethwa uthe namanje abantu basababaza ngendlela iphoyisa eliziphathe ngayo.Uthe bamangazwa wukuthi into encane njengokushela igcine ikhipha izidumbu ezintathu."Inganekwane le eyenzeke kule ndawo. Bekumele athi uma ezwa ukuthi ukhushukelwa wumoya ngokuphambana kwenkulumo yakhe nentombi, ashaye imoto yakhe ahambe,” kusho uMthethwa.Uthe okubakhathaza kakhulu wukuthi lokhu kwenziwe umuntu osebenza ngomthetho."Uye okuqonda kangcono ukuthi udlame alufuneki. Ukuba yisizathu sokufa kwabantu, yinto ebesingayilindele kumuntu womthetho,” kusho uMthethwa, othe okwenza ingakhulumeki ukuthi lokhu kwenzeke ngesikhathi izwe linomkhankaso wokuqwashisa ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu ngokobulili.Uveze kuthi kusekubi emndenini wakwaMthombeni kulandela isigameko, wathi ngesikhathi ephinda eyobabheka izolo, uthole ukuthi intombi isakuthola kunzima ukukhuluma njengoba ivele isikhihle esikaNandi uma iqala ithi uyakhuluma ngesigameko.Imizamo yokuzwa ukuphawula komndeni wakwaMthombeni ayiphumelela, indodana yakhona uMnuz Bafana Mthombeni, icele ukuthi ithintwe ngezikhathi zantambama kodwa kuthe uma isithintwa, ucingo ibingasalubambi.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe amaphoyisa aseMpangeni, aphenya amacala amathathu okubulala kulandela isigameko sokudubulana esenzeke eNseleni ngoLwesibili.UNetshiunda ukuqinsekisile ukuthi isigameko sibandakanya iphoyisa ebelisebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa eSikhaleni kodwa ebelingekho emsebenzini ngesikhathi kwenzeka isigameko."Kushone iphoyisa ebelingu-constable nabanye abantu ababili. SESIPHINDE safika leso sikhathi sokuhlukanisa izitokofela. Sebeqalile abanye ukukhala ngomgcinimafa obaleke nemali, abanye babanjwa inkunzi bephuma ukuyokhipha imali yabo abayilondoloze unyaka wonke.Kulo nyaka i-FNB ithathe ithuba lokucebisa abantu ukuthi bayikhiphe kanjani imali yabo, ukuze baphephe ezigebengwini.UNkk Cebile Magongo, oyiGrowth Specialist e-FNB Cash Investments, ucele abantu ukuthi bawuyeke umkhumba wokukhipha isamba semali bese beyoyihlukanisa ndawana thize.Uveze ukuthi kunezindlela eziphephile zokuhlukanisa imali, okufanele zisetshenziswe ngabezitokofela.-Okokuqala, wukuthi amalungu esitokofela afundisane ukusebenzisa izindlela zesimanje zokufaka imali, okubalwa ukuba ne-akhawunti yasebhange lapho imali igcinwa khona.-Okwesibili, wukuthi uma sekuphela unyaka imali ehlukaniswayo ifakwe kuma-akhawunti amalungu esitokofela, ukuze akwazi ukuze kungabikho ohamba ephethe izindodla zemali ngesikhwama.-Okwesithathu, wukuthi amalungu esitokofela angamemezeli ukuthi ahlukanisa nini, angazishuthi uma eyohlukanisa imali yawo futhi angazifaki ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Uthe akufanele ngisho atshele abangani nemindeni ngoba lesi yisikhathi esiphithizela kakhulu.-Okwesine, abazokhipha imali ubacele ukuthi bangakhiphi isamba kodwa bayikhiphe kancane kancane.Wathi kuhle ukuthi abafuna imali esandleni bayikhiphe emini, kusekhona onogada emabhange.-Okokugcina, ugqugquzele abadlala izitokofela ukuba balondoloze enye imali abasuke beyibekile njalo ngonyaka, ukuze bafeze amanye amaphupho abo.Uthe uyakuqonda ukuthi abantu abaningi abadlala izitokofela bafuna ukubona imali esandleni, kodwa lolu hlobo lokwenza izinto kaluphephile, ngakho wonke umuntu kufanele afunde ukusebenzisa izindlela zesimanje.Ugqugquzele amalungu estokofela ukuthi abathanda ukuphatha ukheshi mabahambe beyiqoqo uma bekhipha izimali zabo, ukuze kungabi lula ukuthi babanjwe yizigebengu ezihobile.

IZINHLANGANO ezisebenza nezingane zithi indlela engcono yokusiza ingane yakho ukuze igweme ukungena igxile ezintweni eziyingozi, ezifana nokuphuza utshwala, ukuthi ukhulume nayo ngokuvulelekile, ungathethi.UNkk Ayanda Khumalo-Gwaji weSazi Community Care yaseMlaza, okuyinhlangano ebhekelele izingane ezizalwa emindenini empofu eziphila negciwane lengculazi nezintandane, uthe isikhathi samanje asisafani nesakuqala, ziningi izinto ezikhona izingane ezifuna ukuzizwa ngoba zikhona, ezinye zazo abazali kabazazi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi bazijwayeze ukukhuluma nazo."Abazali abaningi izinkinga bazixazulula ngenduku, okuyikhona kanye okwenza ukuthi izingane zihlehle kubo, zizitholele abangani abasemaceleni abazifaka ehlathini. Uma ukhuluma nengane zama ukulingana nayo ngokucabanga, ufune ukwazi ukuthi kungani ifuna ukwenza lokho ekwenzayo, uzothola konke. "Njengamanje izingane ziphuza utshwala ngendlela eyethusayo futhi ziqala zisezincane. Bengikhuluma nazo ngalo mkhuba zangitshela ukuthi ”isukile". "Uma ngihlala nazo phansi zingixoxela ukuthi ukuthola utshwala njengamanje kulula kukhona, iziqeda ezenziwe ngobhiya, ngama-cider namawolintshi ajovwe ngogologo. Phambilini besazi ukuthi kunamakhekhe ensangu, incika notshwala uqobo lwabo. Isikhathi siba nezinto ezintsha eziheha intsha, wena njengomzali kumele ube nolwazi ukuze ukwazi ukweluleka ingane yakho," kusho yena.UNksz Nolwazi Mkhize wenhlangano iSibanye Youth Development Organisation yaseMgungundlovu, uthe: "Uma usubonile ukuthi ingane isiqalile, khuluma nayo. Uma wehluleka bese uyizamela usizo, ingaze ingene igxile otshwaleni nasezintweni eziyingozi. Yazi abangani bengane yakho. "Kungenzeka ingane ingakutsheli ukuthi isiqomile noma nikhuluma njalo kodwa kunezitayela izingane ezizenzayo zokuhlanganisa amagama azo nezithandwa zawo kuphume igama elilodwa, uzoza isizibiza ngalo noma abangani beyibiza ngalo. Funda ukwazi ngamatemu asetshenziswayo nokuthi asho ukuthini. Gwema ukunika ingane ucingo uma isencane," kusho uNkk Mkhize.

USIZI ngemva kokuthi abafundi abathathu baka-matric besikole iMnyamande High, eNtendeni eNewcastle, bebhubhe engozini yemoto ngeSonto.Abafundi okunguLuyanda Vilakazi (19), ngu-Anele Majola (18), noThandokuhle Khumalo (18), baphangalale engozini yomgwaqo kuN11 ngaseNgagane.Ingozi ibandakanye imoto encane ebebehamba ngayo neloli okushayisane mahlanze emgwaqweni, uN11.Ngokuthola komthombo weSolezwe, bebebuya kobhiyozela ukuqeda ukubhala ezindaweni ezimbili ezehlukene zokucima ukoma, okuyiseSigodini eMadadeni, naseShibhini, eSibhasha.Kuvela ukuthi abangani babo abathathu ebebehamba nabo, bayelashwa esibhedlela ngemva kokulimala."Bekushayela u-Anele, imoto kungeyesihlobo,” kuchaza umthombo.Uveze ukuthi isimo simuncu esikoleni kulandela ingozi."Bekungumbhiyozo nje wabo wokubungaza ukuqeda ukubhala ebebezihlanganisele wona njengabangani. Kubuhlungu ngoba besithi sesiqedile okonyaka njengoba sekuqediwe ukubhala, besingalindele ukuthi kungehla umshophi ofana nalo,” kusho umthombo.Uphethe ngelithi abashonile bebengabafundi abahloniphayo, abangezona izixhwanguxhwangu bewuthanda umsebenzi wabo wesikole futhi bekungangatshazwa ukuthi bazophasa.Unina kaLuyanda, uNksz Ayanda Mkhwanazi uthe bathole ucingo kumqeqeshi wabo webhola, ethi abaphuthume esibhedlela ukuyombheka ngoba uzwa kuthiwa behlelwe yingozi."Sinikele khona, ngeshwa asangamfica. Sathola ulwazi lokuthi yena uphelele endaweni yesigameko,” kuchaza uNksz Mkhwanazi.Uqhube wathi ubuhlungu ngokushona kwakhe ngoba ubesalindele lukhulu kuye."Ubekubheke ngabomvu ukuthi ayoqhuba izifundo zakhe eWits University ngonyaka ozayo. Ubeze esho ukuthi uma esefundile, uzongakhela umuzi, angithengele nemoto. Ngilimele ngoba ubenamaphupho amahle, ebengisalindele ukuthi azofezeka,” kusho uNksz Mkhwanazi.Uthe ubehlonipha uLuyanda, engumntwana olungile futhi ethanda imfundo nebhola, wathi ubephuza nje ngaleso sikhathi uma ezinamele.Uthe kwenzeka isigameko nje babethathane nabangani ngoMgqibelo, bengabantu abazobuya ngoMsombuluko.UMphathiswa wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal uNkk Mbali Frazer, uzwakalise ukushaqeka ngesigameko, wadlulisa amazwi enduduzo emndenini yabashonile, wafisela abathathu abasesibhedlela ukululama okuphuthumayo.UNkk Frazer uhambele imindeni yabashonile izolo. "Ukulahleka kwemiphefumulo esemincane kangaka kuyishwa, ikakhulu ngoba sesilinde imiphumela ka-matric yanonyaka. Kubuhlungu ukuthi eyabo izophuma sebengasekho emhlabeni,” kusho uNkk Frazer.Uhambe emagameni kaNgqongqoshe walo mnyango kuzwelonke, uNkk Angie Motshekga, onxuse abazali nalabo ababheke abafundi ukuthi babaqaphe ngeso lokhozi ngalesi sikhathi."Imigubho abazenzela yona abafundi uma bebungaza ukuqeda ukubhala asiyigqugquzeli ngoba ingabeka impilo yabafundi engcupheni,” kusho uNkk Frazer.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu Natal, uConstable Thenjiswa Ngcobo, uthe amaphoyisa aseNewcastle, avule icala kulandela isigameko lapho iloli lishayisane nenye imoto emgwaqweni ochezukayo eNgagane, kuN11.Uthe kusolakala ukuthi bekunabantu abayisithupha ngaphakathi emotweni encane, abathathu bashonele endaweni yesigameko kwathi abanye abathathu baphuthunyiswa esibhedlela esiseduzane.

Ishaye kwazwela imvula ebihambisana nesichotho ezindaweni ezakhele isifundazwe.Ngokwesitatimende esithunyelelwe abezindaba wuMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana nobuHoli boMdabu esifundazweni, izindawo ezakhele oMasipala waseMsunduzi, iHarry Gwala nowaseMzimkhulu, zithintekile ngenxa yalesi simo. Sixhumene neminye iminyango okubalwa owezokuHlaliswa kwaBantu nowezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi ukuthi ilethe usizo oludingekayo,” kusho uNkk Sithole-Moloi.Uxwayise umphakathi ukuthi uhlale uqaphile njengoba kusalindeleke ukuthi siqhubeke isimo sezulu esingesihle.

Uthe iMbube ifana nobaba wawowonke umuntu wendawo.UMENGAMELI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, nobuholi baleli qembu beyokotha iSilo oLundi. Siyabonga ukuthi afike uMalema azokhonza njengokwesintu. Ingonyama iyamemukela ngezandla ezimhlophe,’’ kusho uMntwana uVanana.UMalema ephawula kwabezindaba, uthe bebezozethula kuBayede ngoba bazoke bagxile esifundazweni besebenza indaba yamavoti. IMAYINI i-Impala Platnum eseRusternburg izoba nenkonzo yesikhumbuzo yabavukuzi abangu-13 abashona kugqashuka ikhebuli elidonsa ikheshi elihambisa abavukuzi emgodini.Lesi sibhicongo esidlule nemiphefumulo yabavukuzi abangu-11 abafe ujuqu ngoMsombuluko mhla ka-27 Novemba 2023, ababili bashona sebesesibhedlela."Kuyadabukisa ukuthi i i-Implats ibika isigameko esibucayi sezokuphepha okubandakanya intambo yomoya, kwenzeke namhlanje ntambama ohlangothini lwe-shaft 11 e-Impala Rustenburg esifundazweni iNorth West. Ikhebuli eligqashukile yilona elidonsa ikheshi ehambisa abasebenzi emgodini, okuyindawo engamaleveli amathathu,” kusho isitatimende semayini ngemuva kwengozi.Le mayini ibilokhu iqhubeke njalo ngokuthumela imibiko ngokusha okuvelayo mayelana nalesi sehlo njengoba ngoMsombuluko mhla ka 4 kwephezulu, ikhiphe isitatimende ngomvukuzi ka-13 ogcine enqotshwa wukufa esesibhedlela, yabuye yaveza ukuthi bangu-23 abavukuzi abadedelwe esibhedlela ngawo uMsombuluko.NgoLwesithathu, le mayini ikhiphe uhlu lwamagama abavukuzi abadlulile emhlabeni njengoba kulungiselwa inkonzo yesikhumbuzo, ezoba senkundleni yezemidlalo ekuShaft 2 ehostela iSimunye kuyo le mayini.Uhlu lolu luveza ukuthi bayisishiyagalombili abavukuzi badabuka esifundazweni i-Eastern Cape, bathathu abaseLesotho, uyedwa owaseRustenburg, omunye osenonyaka esebenza kule mayini ungowaseGauteng.
KULINDELEKE ukuba babingelele imantshi abasolwa abahlanu abayamaniswa nokubulawa kwabantu abayisikhombisa, abashiswe ngempelasonto eDiepsloot, eGauteng.Esigamekweni, kuthiwa amalungu omphakathi avimbezele abasolwa ababhaxabula ngenduku ngaphambi kokuthi bashiswe endaweni okulahlwa kuyo imfucuza.Izidumbu ezinhlanu zishiswe eDiepsloot, Ext 12, ezimbili zatholakala e-Ext 13, nazo zingqongqisiwe.Umphakathi ubusola ababulewe ngokuhlukumeza abantu. Kuthiwa sekuphele izinyanga abasolwa begqekeza imizi, begebenga futhi beqala izimpi besabisa nabantu ngezibhamu.Okhulumela amaphoyisa eGauteng, uDimakatso Nevhuhulwi, uqinisekise ukuthi kuboshwe abasolwa abahlanu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-30 no-38 ubudala baboshwe ngoMsombuluko ngemuva kokuba bakhonjwe wufakazi othile ongadaluliwe."Umsolwa oyedwa ukhonjwe wufakazi ozibonele ngo-si, yena-ke wakhombisa amaphoyisa abanye abasolwa abane. Bonke bazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi eRandburg ngoLwesithathu,” kusho yena.
ZIZOMAKWA kusetshenziswa ubuchwepheshe ezinye zezifundo ezifana nemaths kwa-matric kulo nyaka.Kuzohlolwa lolu hlelo ngezifundo ezingenabo abafundi abaningi abazibhalayo ukuze lusetshenziswe nangomuso.Obhekelele izivivinyo eMnyangweni weMfundo eyisiSekelo, uDkt Rufus Poliah, uveze ukuthi zingu-184 izikhungo zokumakela u-matric kanti sebeqoke nabazomaka abangu-52 157.Uthe uma kukhona umuntu ongenawo amava okumaka, ngeke bangabaze ukumsusa.Uveze ukuthi emihlanganweni ethinta ukumaka, isifundo ngasinye basibheka ngelokhozi njengoba basuke bebheka izinto eziningi."Sibheka nendlela abafundi abaphendule ngayo ngoba asifuni kube nalabo abazoba ngabagilwa. Uma kungukuthi emaphepheni abebhalwa sibone ukuthi kube nephutha kweminye imibuzo, sizoyisusa ukuze abafundi bangagcini sebezithola bengenzi kahle ngenxa yephutha lomnyango. Njengoba sihlola uhlelo lokumaka ngobuchwepheshe, sifuna ukuhambisana nesikhathi samanje.”Uthe labo abazobe besebenzisa lolu hlelo lokumaka bazokwenza lokhu besemakhaya."Kunohlelo abazongena kulona okuzobe sekukhona kulo amaphepha okumele bawamake. Nabo bazobe beqashwe ngelokhozi njengoba kwenzeka kulabo abamakela ezikhungweni zokumaka.”Uveze ukuthi zonke izifundazwe zizobe zilusebenzisa lolu hlelo lokumaka."IGauteng iyona ezihola phambili kulolu hlelo. Kuzobe kumakwa iphepha lokuqala le-Accounting nelesibili leMaths. Kwezinye izifundazwe kuzobe kumakwa iphepha lesibili leMaths noMusic. Sifuna abamakayo babone ukuthi lolu hlelo lumi kanjani.”UPoliah uthe ngomuso lolu hlelo luzonabela nakwezinye izifundo. Uthe iSouth African Sign Language (SASL) izomakwa ekomkhulu lomnyango ePitoli. "Othisha abafundisa lesi sifundo kanjalo nalabo abangabasizi babo bazohlangana endaweni eyodwa ePitoli ukuze bamake lesi sifundo.”Uveze ukuthi uhlelo lokufakwa kwamamaki emakhompyutheni luzophothulwa ngoDisemba 23. Umkhandlu olawula izingabunjalo lika-matric, Umalusi, uzogunyaza ukukhishwa kwemiphumela ngoJanuwari 12, 2024. UNgqongqoshe woMnyango, uNkk Angie Motshekga, uzodedela imiphumela ka-matric ngoJanuwari 18 bese ngakusasa ikhishwa yizifundazwe.
ACELA ku-4 000 amaphoyisa kuleli umsebenzi wawo okungukuvikela umphakathi kodwa okungenzeka ukuthi ayizigebengu ngokwawo, okuyisimo esibeka abantu engcupheni. Lokhu kuvele ngesikhathi uNgqongqoshe uMnuz Bheki Cele ephendula umbuzo we-DA wokuthi mangaki amalungu esiphoyisa ahamba amacala kodwa ebe eqhubeka esebenza. UCele uthe kunamaphoyisa angu-3 981 abekwe amacala kodwa ayaqhubeka nokusebenza. UCele uthe esewonke amaphoyisa aboshiwe kusukela ngo-2019, angu-5 489 kodwa angu-3 981 asasebenza.Kuphinde kwavela nokuthi phakathi kwamacala amaphoyisa athinteka kuwona kukhona awokudlwengula, ukubulala, ukuzama ukubulala nokuqamba amanga ngaphansi kwesifungo.Kuvela namacala enkohlakalo nokufuna imali (ukugwazelwa), ukukhipha isibhamu emphakathini, ukugqekeza indawo yebhizinisi nokulimala komuntu ngenxa yokubeka isibhamu budedengu.Kukhona nabahamba amacala okushaya kabi ngenhloso yokulimaza, bese kuba khona necala lokulaxaza ingane. UCele udalule nokuthi eminyakeni emine edlule angu-430 amaphoyisa alahlwe ngamacala, agwetshwa kodwa abe-DA kabagculisekile ngalokhu.Ilungu lePhalamende le-DA, uMnuz Orke Terblanche, lithe kuyashaqisa ukuthi abantu abalindeleke ukulwa nobugebengu, kodwa bayizigebengu bona qobo lwabo."Kusho ukuthi sinamaphoyisa alengelwa yingozi yokuthi angase alahlwe ngamacala noma nini. Lokhu kudalwa wukuthi izinhlelo zokuqondisa ubugwegwe azishayi khona. Kuvele kuthiwe umuntu angamiswa izinsuku ezingu-60 kuphela, emuva kwalokho kuyaphela,'” kusho uTerblanche.Uphakamise ukuthi kube nohlelo lokuthi amaphoyisa amiswe, kuze kube kuqedelwa udaba losuke esolwa ngalo. Uthe akuzwakali kahle ukuthi kube namaphoyisa asebenzayo kodwa ebe ehamba amacala kwawona.Kuvela lezi zibalo nje, uCele ungaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu ngoba kukhalwa ngokwenyuka kwezinga lobugebengu ezweni. Izibalo zobugebengu ezikhishwe ekugcineni zikhombe ukuthi itshe limi ngothi. Nsuku zaphuma kuleli phephandaba sibika ngezigameko zokubulawa kwabantu ngobugebengu, ukusocongwa kwabaholi bomdabu, abesifazane ababulawa abanobudlelwano nabo kanye nezisebenzi zikahulumeni ikakhulu komasipala lapho kushisa khona umbango wamathenda. Kunjalo nje uCele usanda kulahlwe yicala ekomitini lokuziphatha kwamalungu ePhalamende. UCele watholwa enecala lokungaziphathi kahle ngesikhathi ekhaca indoda esidlangaleni eyitshela ukuthi ayithule.
INHLANGANO iNational Freedom Party (NFP) yehlukene phakathi ngengqungquthela yokukhetha ubuholi beqembu, okuvele ukuthi izoba ngesonto elizayo.Ngokombhalo wangaphakathi oputshukele kwabezindaba oshicilelwe ngoLwesihlanu yikomiti okuthiwa libhekele ezokhetho ngaphakathi eqenjini, osayinwe nguSihlalo noNobhala walo uMnuz Tswelelo Mkhombo noMnuz Bongani Nkosi, Isolezwe elinawo, uNksz Zandile Prudence Myeni oyiPhini leMeya kuMasipala weTheku, noMnuz Irvin Rowen Barnes bangenele esokuba umengameli weqembu. Lesi sikhundla sishiywe wumsunguli weqembu, uNkk Zanele KaMagwaza-Msibi ongasekho. UKaMagwaza Msibi ubeyingxenye yobuholi beqembu kuzwelonke obuqokwe ngo-2019, bahlakazwa ngo-2021 emva komdonsiswano osezinkantolo, uhlangothi olungahambisani nabo lufaka amaphepha enkantolo, lukhala ngendlela okukhethwe ngayo. Isinqumo seNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu, esigcine sivuna ababefake isikhalo okukhona uMnuz Jeremiah Mavundla kwesephini likamengameli, uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe kwesikanobhala-jikelele noMnuz Bheki Dlamini kwesikasihlalo weqembu, bahlakazwa.Lobu buholi bufake amaphepha enkantolo, bufuna kuvunyelwe ukubuyekezwa kwesinqumo sokuhlakazwa kwabo, okuthe ngenyanga edlule iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu yagunyaza ukubuyekezwa kwalesi sinqumo. Lokhu kuchazwe njengokuthi ubuholi obukhethwe ngo-2019 busamile, kuze kube kuphuma isinqumo sokubuyekezwa kokuchithwa kwabo.Njengoba lo mbhalo wangaphakathi unohlu lwamagama okuthiwa aphakanyiselwe izikhundla zobuholi bukazwelonke engqungqutheleni yezinsuku ezimbili, phakathi kukaDisemba 15 no-16 e-Olive Convention Centre eThekwini, uMdlethe uthe abanalo ulwazi ngawo njengoba ungekho emthethweni."Sivumelene ukuthi akukho ngqungquthela ezoba khona kuze kube kudlula ukhetho ngonyaka ozayo. Ukuhlala kwezingqungquthela sekusondele ukhetho, kungadala uqhekeko, iqembu lingenzi kahle okhethweni ngenxa yokuthi abanye abebelindele ukuqokwa uma bengaphumelelanga bangagcina sebedikibalisa namalungu eqembu abesekayo, kusilimaze okhethweni,” usho kanje.Leli qembu libhekane nezinxushunxushu ngesikhathi umsunguli walo uKaMagwaza-Msibi ehlaselwa wukugula ngo-2014, njengoba lehluleka ukungenela ukhetho ngo-2016, okuthe ngo-2021 labuya njengoba liyingxenye yamaqembu aphethe ngokubambisa kwabanye omasipala, okukhona kubo owaseDumbe nowaKwaNongoma Nakuba kunjalo, kulo mbiko mayelana nengqungquthela, igama likaNksz Myeni liphinde livele kwabalobizela esephini likamengameli nesikanobhala jikelele eqenjini.UMnuz Msawenkosi Sibusiso Mkhabela noMnuz Milton Ndida Sokhela bavela kwesephini likamengameli. UMkhabela igama lakhe liphinde livele embangweni wesikasihlalo lapho ebangisana khona noMnuz Melusi Gumede, yena ongenele nesephini likasihlalo, ebhekene noMnuz Khethi Mthethwa. UGumede uphinde avele kwesikanobhala-jikelele weqembu nesephini lakhe.Amanye amagama abangenele umbango wezikhundla eziphezulu abavela kulolu hlu, kwesikanobhala-jilkelele uMnuz Nhlanhla Thwala noMnuz Xolani Sibiya, bese kuthi kwesephini likanobhala-jilkelele uNksz Sithembile Felicia Msomi, uNksz Duduzile Joyce Nhlengethwa, uMnuz Khulekani Hlatshwayo noMnuz Siphamandla Ntombela."Abangenele ukhetho nababesekayo sebevumelekile ukuthi bakhankase ngendlela ehloniphekile. Lokhu kungenziwa ngendlela ephikisa inqubo ye-NFP. Kuyothathelwa izinyathelo noma wubani oyohluleka ukulandela imigomo yokuziphatha noyohluleka ukuqinisekisa ukuziphatha ngendlela ehloniphekile kwalabo abamesekayo,” kubhalwe kanje.
IKHOMISHINI yokulingana ngokobulili, iCommision for Gender Equality, ithi iyalwa nesihlava sokushushumbiswa kwabantu esibonakala sanda kuleli.Le nhlangano iphawule kanje emuva kwesigameko sokukhululwa kwabesilisa abangu-33 abebevalelwe endlini eyigumbi elilodwa eBoksburg, eGauteng, ngeSonto.Ngokusho kokhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, abathunjiwe bahlengwe ngamaphoyisa aKwaZulu-Natal.Uthe amaphoyisa azithela phezu kwalaba besilisa, elandela umkhondo womsolwa obeyamaniswa necala lokuthumba owokufika kuleli eSpringfield Park, eThekwini, ngeledlule.Okhulumela iCommision for Gender Equality, uMnuz Javu Baloyi, uthe benza konke okusemandleni ukulwa nesihlava."Sisebenza namaphoyisa nezinye izinhlaka ezilwa nobugebengu ukuqeda nya ngalesi sihlava esibukeka sidlondlobala kusukela eminyakeni embalwa edlule,” kusho uBaloyi.Uthe banemikhankaso ezweni lonke, lapho befundisa khona imiphakathi ngalo mkhuba.Uveze ukuthi kule mikhankaso, bafundisa imiphakathi okukhona kuyo abazali nezingane ukuthi baqaphele."Sisebenzisana nenhlangano yamalungelo abantu neminyango kahulumeni efana nowezaseKhaya, owezobuLungiswa neminye ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lobu bugebengu buyacindezelwa,” kusho uBaloyi.Uqhube wathi akufanele ngabe abantu abasha nezingane bayashushumbiswa bakhishwe kuleli abanye balethwe ezweni, bese kuyathulwa.Uveze ukuthi abantu bashushumbiswa ngezindlela ezingafani njengoba kukhona abakuleli abashushumbiswayo, kuphinde kushushumbiswe nabokufika. Wathi kwezinye izigameko abagilwa basuke bekhishwa kuleli kanti kwezinye basuke belethwa.Ubuye wanxusa abantu ukuthi bangathuli uma benolwazi ngezehlakalo zalobu bugebengu."Abasukume, babikele amaphoyisa, iminyango kahulumeni ethintekayo, baphinde basibikele nathi enombolweni yethu yocingo engakhokhelwa ethi 0800 007 709,” kusho yena.UNetshiunda uthe emva kokuncinzwa indlebe, amaphoyisa agasele eBoksburg, afike asindisa abagilwa, abese ebopha umsolwa oyedwa.Uthe iminyaka yabagilwa isazoqinisekiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kanti nomsolwa naye kulindeleke ukuthi avele enkantolo maduze.NgoMgqibelo, ababhekelela ukuphepha kwemingcele yakuleli namanye amazwe, iBorder Management Authority (BMA) ihlenge izingane ezingu-443 ebezisuswa eZimbabwe zilethwa kuleli. Ngesikhathi kwenzeka lokhu, kuthiwa lezi zingane zitholwe emabhasini angu-42 emngceleni waseBeitbridge. Kuvela ukuthi lezi zingane bezineminyaka engaphansi kuka-8 kanti zitholwe zihamba zodwa, bengekho abazali noma abazigadile, nokuyikho okusolise ukuthi ziyashushumbiswa. Kwesinye isigameko, amaphoyisa athole abagilwa abangu-70 eNewcastle, ngoSepthemba. Kuthiwa laba babesuswe eThekwini, bethenjiswe umsebenzi. Kuthiwa udaba lwabo lwalandelelwa emva kokuthi unina woyedwa esole ukuthi kukhona okushaya amanzi emva kokungamtholi ocingweni izinsuku zilandelana emva kokuhamba kwakhe ekhaya "eyosebenza” eMadadeni. Lona wesifazane wavula icala esiteshini samaphoyisa iBhekithemba eMlaza. NgoMashi nonyaka, amaphoyisa aphinde ahlenga abesifazane abahlanu ababeshushumbiswe eGauteng, balethwa eDurban North, KwaZulu-Natal.Ngaleso sikhathi, okhulumela amphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Nqobile Gwala, wathi laba besifazane abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-19 no-27 babethenjiswe umsebenzi wase-call centre lapho okuthiwa bebezodayisa khona ama-sim card. Kuthiwa ngesikhathi sebefika eDurban North, kwashintsha ukudla epuletini, sebetshelwa ukuthi bazosebenza umsebenzi ofaka phakathi ucansi. Kwavela ukuthi oyedwa wabo, wakwazi ukuthi ashaye ucingo, olwagcina lubasiza ukuthi bathole usizo emaphoyiseni.
KUSINDA kwehlela emindenini yababulawe ezigamekweni ezehlukene zodlame oluthinta abesifazane nezingane, KwaZulu-Natal.Laba bagilwa okuboshwe abebesondelene kakhulu nabo, okukhona kubona namasoka, isikhathi esiningi abese behlukene nawo.Imindeni yabagilwa, iningi layo lisele nezingane zabadlula kulezi zigameko. Engxoxweni neSolezwe imindeni ithe kusenzima ukudlulisa iqhubeke nempilo, emva kokugileka.UMUFI uNksz Andiswa Radebe UNkk Khanyisile Mbongwa waseNhlalakahle eMgungundlovu, ongunina kaNksz Purity Mkhize (28), uthe izinyembezi zisagcwala amehlo uma ebuka umzukulu wakhe oneminyaka emibili.Umzukulu wasinda bedutshulwa nodadewabo uLisakhanya Mkhize (3) nonina, esigamekweni okusolwa kusona uyise (esingenalo igama lakhe) okuthiwa usagqigqa inkantolo. UNksz Mkhize nengane eneminyaka emithathu bashona kuleso sigameko. Kuthiwa umsolwa wayemnuka ngokujola nomakhelwane wakhe. UMUFI uNksz Nobuhle Babongile NyideUmsolwa wazama ukumdubula kodwa wasinda emva kokuthi esebulale nomakhelwane abemsola ngokujola nengoduso yakhe. UNksz Mbongwa uthe: "Namanje akangeni (umzukulu) nangephutha ekamelweni abahlaselwa bekulo. Kunalokho, zonke izinsuku uhlale esho ukuthi 'ubaba wangidubula, nosisi nomama’. Lokhu kubuyisa bonke ubuhlungu esibuzwe kwenzeka isigameko.”Uveze ukuthi kwabashiya nemibuzo ukuthola ukuthi umsolwa ubeselaliswe esibhedlela i-Eden, engagadiwe ngamaphoyisa, wabuye wabathumela izithombe esesitokisini edla ama-burger."Lokhu kusishiye nesithombe sokuthi usazenzela umathanda. Sazibuza ukuthi yini engamvimba ukuthi aphume eze kithi azosenzakalisa,” kusho yena.Umsolwa ngesikhathi edubula abathathu, akayithintanga indodana kaNksz Mkhize angayizali, eneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. UNksz Mbongwa uveze ukuthi yona inenkinga yokudinwa kuze kweqe, ngenxa yokubulawa kukanina nodadewabo.Ilungu lomndeni kaNksz Andiswa Radebe (21) waseLovu, okuthiwa wabulawa ngowayeyisoka lakhe ngo-August 11 KwaFelekisi eManzimtoti, elicele ukungadalulwa lithe bona baphulwa umoya wukuhlehla kwecala, elithi sekwenzeke izikhawu eziningi.UNksz Radebe wafa emva kokuthi umsolwa, oshayela amatekisi emgwaze kanye emqaleni. Kuthiwa umsolwa waphambana nomufi emgwaqweni ehamba ngetekisi, wayipaka eceleni komgwaqo, wehla wamgwaza maqede wabuyela kuyo, wayishaya yazula. Waboshwa emva kwesigameko. Kuthiwa wayinqaba ibheyili.Ilungu lomndeni lithi: "Sibona sengathi udaba lwakhe inkantolo ayilusukumeli phezulu ngendlela esifisa ngayo. Ukube kuya ngathi ngabe alilokhu lihlehla kanje.”Naye uthe kunzima endodakazini kamufi, eneminyaka emihlanu, okuthiwa ihlale ithi, 'umama uzobuya angiphathele izinto ezimnandi’.Uthe lokhu kubaphula izinhliziyo ngoba kusobala ukuthi ingane ayinalwazi lokuthi unina ngeke iphinde imbone ngenxa kamsolwa.UNksz Khanyisile Nyide, ongunina kaNksz Nobuhle Nyide (23) owabulawa ngo-Okthoba 14, emva kokuxhifizwa ebusweni, wakopolotwa namehlo eNtshiyabantu, eMpendle, uthe akufunayo yena wubulungiswa.Isidumbu sikaNksz Nyide satholwa ngakusasa eduze kwesigxobo sikagesi eduze nakubo.Kwaboshwa isihlobo emva kokuba sitholwe nezimpahla zikamufi nezikhali ezigcwele igazi.UNksz Nyide uthe okomthoba inhliziyo wukuthi umsolwa agwetshwe udilikajele.
KUZOSHUBA kwabazoganga eThekwini njengoba iMeya uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ithi ubugebengu buzobe buqashwe ngamaphoyisa nangamakhamera.IMeya yeTheku, uMnuz Mxolisi Kaunda, ithi zizoqashwa nangamakhamera izigebengu kuleli dolobha Isithombe: sithunyelweIzolo, uKaunda ubehlola ukusebenza kwamakhamera esikhungweni sawo esiseduze kwaseDurban Station.Uveze ukuthi amakhamera asebenza kahle kwazise ebekhandwa kusukela ngoSepthemba.Uthe zonke izindawo ezinezinga eliphezulu lobugebengu nasenkabeni yedolobha amakhamera azobe ekhona.Ngesikhathi ehlola amakhamera ubehambisana nenhloko yamaPhoyisa kaMasipala esabambile, uKhomishana Sibonelo Mchunu nenhloko yophiko lwezinhlekelele, uMnuz Vincent Ngubane."Siyajabula ukuthi umsebenzi wokulungisa amakhamera usuphothile. ZIZOLEKELELA ekusebenzeni amacala aphathelene nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, izimoto zamaphoyisa ezingamakiwe eziyingxenye yezintsha ezidluliselwe eziteshini zamaphoyisa ezehlukene.Zingu-239 izimoto okubalwa kuzo nezithuthuthu ezintsha, ezidluliselwe eziteshini zamaphoyisa ezehlukene, emcimbini wokwethulwa kwazo izolo, eThekwini.Ekhuluma ngesikhathi kudluliselwa ngokusemthethweni izinsiza, uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal uGeneral Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, uthe inqwaba yezimoto ezingenawo umaka wamaphoyisa zizosetshenziswa ophikweni lwamaphoyisa olubhekelele amacala oDlame lwaseMndenini, ukuHlukunyezwa kwezingane, namaCala aphathelene nocansi, eziteshini ezehlukene esifundazweni."Ezinye izimoto ezinikezwa amaphoyisa zimakiwe ezinye kazimakiwe. Ezingamakiwe zizosetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa uma enza uphenyo ngamacala athinta udlame lwasemindenini, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane namacala ocansi. "Lesi sifundazwe singesinye sezihamba phambili ngalolu hlobo lwamacala ngakho asifuni ukuthi abesifazane abakuhlunyeziwe, uma kwenzekile kubafakele amehlo uma sebelandwa yimoto yamaphoyisa emakiwe ukubayisa lapho kumele bathole khona usizo. Ngesikhathi amaphoyisa ehla enyuka nabo besafunelwa usizo kumele bazizwe bevikelekile yingakho kuzosetshenziswa lezi zimoto,” kusho uMkhwanazi.Unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi aqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zihlala zisesimeni esigculisayo futhi zilungiswa kusenesikhathi uma zinenkinga, wathi uma ukubonakala kwemoto yamaphoyisa ingekho esimeni, umphathi wesiteshi uyobhekana nokuqondiswa izigwegwe.UMkhwanazi uthe abanikazi bezindawo zokucima ukoma abayilandeli imigomo elawula ukusebenza kwazo okubalwa kuyo ukuhlonipha izikhathi ezibekiwe zokudayisa, ngeke babekezelelwe. Uqinisekisile ukuthi kukhona indawo yokucima ukoma eyaziwayo, ehanjelwa ngabantu abaphezulu, okuphoqe ukuthi umnikazi wayo athathelwe izinyathelo emva kokuthi ngeSonto amaphoyisa azithele kuyo isavuliwe emva kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe.Uqinisekise ukuthi ngesonto elizayo, isifundazwe sizomukela amaphoyisa angu- 1 700 abuya ekolishi azotshalwa eziteshini ezehlukene, okungenye yezinto ezizoqinisa kakhulu umkhankaso wamaphoyisa ekulweni nobugebengu nokwephulwa komthetho ngesikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba.EZINYE zezimoto nezithuthuthu ezintsha sha, ezidluliselwe eziteshini zamaphoyisa ezehlukene KwaZulu-Natal Isithombe: DOCTOR NGCOBO/INDEPENDENT MEDIA
ZISEKUDE ukuphela izinkinga zengqalasizinda ezibhekene noMnyango wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, njengoba uzobhekana nengwadla yokulungisa izikole kulandela ukuncishiswa kwesabelomali.UMphathiswa wezeziMali esifundazweni, uNkk Peggy Nkonyeni, umemezele ukuthi esabelweni sokuphucula ingqalasizinda kowezeMfundo, kuthathwe uR296.4 million.Lokhu kuncishiswa kwalesi sabelo kusho ukuthi kungase kube nokuphazamiseka ekwakhiweni kwezikole ezintsha, ukulungiswa kwalezo ezife amawindi nezicabha, futhi ngeke aqedelwe amathoyilethi omgodi, ezinye ngeke zibiywe kanti ezinye zizoma nse izinhlelo zokuziphucula.UNkk Nkonyeni othule isabelomali esibuyekeziwe muva nje, uveze ukuthi akusona kuphela lesi sabelo sengqalasizinda esizoncozulwa kodwa kuzophinde kuthathwe nenye imali enguR8.3 million ohlelweni i-Early Childhood Development (ECD).I-ECD isanda kungena ngaphansi koMnyango wezeMfundo isuka eMnyangweni wokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi.Ohlelweni lokufundisa nge-HIV ne-AIDS, kuzoncozulwa uR3.1 million. Esabelweni seMaths, Science neTechnology, kuzoncozulwa uR8.1 million. "Lokhu sikwenza emuva kokuba uNgqongqoshe kazwelonke, uMnuz Enoch Godongwana, amemezela ukuthi kumele sehlise ukusetshenziswa kwemali kuhulumeni ngoba incane imali eqoqiwe ekubeni sisikhulu isabelo samaholo abasebenzi. I-KZN izoncozulelwa isabelo ngoR1.3 billion."UNkk Nkonyeni uthe iminyango kumele ibuyekeze indlela esebenzisa ngayo imali. Usho lokhu nje, kuvele kunokukhala ezinhlakeni ezehlukene zezemfundo esifundazweni kusuka ezikhulwini zesifundazwe kuya ezinyunyaneni zothisha.Zikhala ngokuthi umnyango uhluleka ukukhokhela izinsiza okubalwa ugesi namanzi kwezinye izikole, okwenza uvalwe kanjalo nasemahhovisi alo mnyango. Izikhulu zezemfundo zikhala ngokuthi isabelomali sokukhokhela abasebenzi asenele njengoba ingenele imali efakiwe ukuhlangabezana nokunyuswa kwaso.UNkk Nkonyeni umemezele ukuthi uMgcinimafa kuzwelonke utshale uR3.8 billion, eminyangweni wezeMfundo nowezeMpilo ukuhlangabezana nokunyuswa kwamaholo abasebenzi."Isivumelwano sokunyuswa kwamaholo kulo nyaka sidinga uR5.4 billion. UMgcinimafa ufake kuphela uR3.8 billion, kule minyango yomibili kuphela bekumele ukuthi ikwazi ukwehlisa umthwalo ebhekene nayo yokukhokhelwa kwabasebenzi. Eminye iminyango ayizange ithole lutho oluthinta ukunyuswa kwamaholo. Kuzomele ihlwaye ezinhlelweni ezithile ukuze ikwazi ukukhokhela lawa maholo. Kwayona le mali efakiwe kule minyango yomibili, ayenele ukuthi ikhokhele zonke izindleko zokunyuswa kwamaholo,” kusho uNkk Nkonyeni othe owezeMfundo uthole uR2.3 billion wamaholo kwathi owezempilo wathola uR1.5 bililion.Uveze ukuthi eMnyangweni wezeMpilo kuthathwe uR275.4 million ezinhlelweni ezehlukene okubalwa noR90.4 million, emalini yokuvuselela izakhiwo.

KUSOLWA ingxabano yomakhelwane okumanje isenkantolo kubulawa induna yesigodi saKwaGcobhoza, eMnambithi, nendodakazi yayo ngoLwesine.Kulesi sigameko uNkk Duduzile Mchunu nendodakazi yakhe, igama layo elingatholakalanga, kuthiwa badutshulwe lapho ebese kunesikhashana bebhace khona.Bahlaselwa nje, kuthiwa bebebuya enkantolo lapho okuqhubeka khona icala elibhekene nenye indodakazi kaNkk Mchunu.Umthombo olazi ukusuka nokuhlala lolu daba upotshozele Isolezwe ukuthi lesi sigameko asihlangene nesihlava sokubulawa kwezinduna namakhosi esesiphenduke insakavukela kulesi sifundazwe.Uthe basola ukuthi lokhu kuyamene nodweshu oluqale kulo nyaka, kuxabana indodakazi kaNkk Mchunu (ehamba icala) nowesilisa ongumakhelwane."Ngaleso sikhathi, indodakazi kaNkk Mchunu ehamba icala yasabisa lona wesilisa imtshela ukuthi alibambe lingashoni. Le ngxabano yagcina ingenwa nanguye uNkk Mchunu naye kukhona izinsongo azibhekise kulo wesilisa elekelela indodakazi yakhe,” usho kanje.Kuthiwa kwadlula izinyanga ezimbalwa le ndodakazi, kwathi uma ihlangana nalona wesilisa ehamba namanye amalungu omndeni wakhe emgwaqweni, yakhombisa abesilisa eyayihamba nabo ukuthi nangu lo.Umthombo uqhuba uthi lona wesilisa wadla phansi ekhumbula ukuthi ubevele esongelwa, kwagcina kudubuleka isihlobo sakhe ayekade ehamba naso.Ngemuva kwalokho, umthombo uthi kwabe sekuvulwa icala, indodakazi kaNkk Mchunu yakhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela.Umthombo uveze nokuthi ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule, kugasele abantu emzini kaNkk Mchunu badubula kodwa kwangashona muntu."Yilapho ke uNkk Mchunu agcine eseyalelwa ukuthi aye ekubhaceni. Yize ebesekubhaceni kodwa njalo uma indodakazi yakhe ivela enkantolo ubeya naye ukuyoyeseka,” usho kanje umthombo.Uthi bakholwa ukuthi abahlaseli babalandele besuka enkantolo njengoba begcine bebabulala kule ndawo ebese bebhace kuyona.Kuvela ukuthi bese bebhace esizweni sakwaMbhense esingumakhelwane wesakwaMchunu.Inkosi yesizwe sakwaMchunu, uMnuz Siyabonga Mchunu, ithe kakunambithisiseki lokhu kubulawa kukaNkk Mchunu nendodakazi yakhe.Uthe uyazi ngodaba olusenkantolo anganasiqiniseko sokuthi ngabe ukubulawa kukaNkk Mchunu kuyamene yini nalo, wathi akafuni ukuphawula lakakhulu ngalo ngoba lusenkantolo.Okhulumela uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu uMnuz Siboniso Mngadi, uthe uNgqongoqshe woMnyango, uNkk Bongi Sithole-Moloi, uyasigxeka isigameko sokubulawa kukaNkk Mchunu.Uthe kuyabakhathaza ukuthi isigameko senzeke ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika iqhuba imikhankaso yezinsuku ezingu-16 ukulwa nesihlava sokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu ngokobulili.Uthe bayazibophezela ngokuthi baqinise ezokuphepha lapho okuhlala khona abaholi boMdabu.Imizamo yokuthola umndeni wabashonile ayiphumelelanga, olunye ucingo belukhala lungabanjwa, olunye kuvaliwe.Police comment...
INHLANGANO eqoqa igazi, iSouth African National Blood Service (SANBS) isigqugquzele abantu ukuba banikele ngalo njengoba lehlile kakhulu ezinqolobaneni zayo.Esitatimendeni esithunyelwe kwabezindaba i-SANBC iveze ukuthi izobe ikanise ezindaweni ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi ezinxanxatheleni zezitolo ukuze ithole igazi elizohlenga impilo yabantu.UNkk Thandi Masupye oyimenenja yezokukhangisa nokuxhumana e-SANBS, uthe igazi elisezinqolobaneni zabo liyancipha ngoDisemba njengiba kusuke kuvalwe izikole, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme kanjalo nezimboni lapho baye baqoqe khona igazi.Uthe ukungabi bikho kwegazi elanele kunomthelela omubi kubantu abasuke belindele ukufakelwa igazi ezibhedlela nalabo abalimele kanzima ezingozini zomgwaqo nasezigamekweni ezihlukene.Ucele abantu abaneminyaka ewu-16 kuya ku-76 abaphile kahle, abanesisindo esiqala ku-50kg nangaphezuku ukuba banikele ngegazi.Ukunikela ngegazi, uveze ukuthi kuthatha amaminithi awu-30 futhi kuphephile.Ukhumbuze abantu ukuthi iphayinti ngalinye legazi abanikela ngalo lihlenga impilo yomuntu osuke esengcupheni yokufa uma engalitholi.Uthe abantu ukuthi bangakwazi ukubhalisa kwikhompyutha ukuze banikele ngegazi njengoba sebenohlelo lokugcwalisa amafomu ngekhokhompyutha.Abantu bangavakashela nebalazwe elikhombisa ukuthi ikuphi indawo eseduze nabo yokunikela ngegazi ngokungena kwi-map etholakala kwi-website ye-SANBS. Bangashayela ne-0800 11 9031 ukuthola eminye imininingwane noma bangene ekhasini le-SANBS ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.
USIHLALO kazwelonke we-ANC, uMnuz Gwede Mantashe uthi kuyayilimaza le nhlangano uma omakadebona, bephawula noma yikanjani esidlangaleni nge-ANC.Uthe omakadebona kumele bayibheke into abayishoyo ngoba kumele babuyise le nhlangano uma isinhlanhlatha."Kuyasishaya kakhulu uma umakadebona etshela izwe ukuthi le nhlangano ijikele abantu. Lokhu kukhuluma akulindelekile kumuntu ongumakadebona, okumele kube nguye obuyisa inhlangano futhi anike umkhombandlela entsheni.”UMantashe ukusho lokhu izolo evala umhlangano wezinsuku ezimbili wokucija izinhlaka ezehlukene ze-ANC ngezithinta ipolitiki, eKurhuleni.Sekuyinsakavukela ukuthi omakadebona nababengomengameli, bagxeke le nhlangano esidlangaleni, ngezinto ezingahambi kahle enhlanganweni.UMantashe uthe lokhu kugxeka akufiki ngisho ezintweni ezisuke zishiwo amaqembu aphikisayo, ngoba vele basuke bezilindele.Ugcizelele ukuthi njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo, kudingeka bawine ngamalengiso."Asifuni ukuwina ngo-50%, kumele siwine ngamalengiso. Asiphumeni siyosebenza ngamandla ukuze sidle umhlanganiso.”Obhekele ukucija amalungu ngokwezepolitiki kwi-ANC, uMnuz David Makhura, uthe wonke amalungu enhlangano kumele licijwe ngokwezepolitiki, noma kuthiwa angomakadebona.Uthe bafuna omakadebona baphefumule uma kukhona abakubona kungahambi kahle enhlanganweni."Asifuni kodwa bakhulume bekude. Kumele basondele eduzane. Siyasebenzisana nomakadebona. Yingakho nabo bebeyingxenye yalo mhlangano.”Uthe ngonyaka ozayo bazothula lolu hlelo kuwona wonke amalungu."Sizoqeqesha labo abakhethelwe kuhulumeni, abasemahhovisi, abakomasipala kanjalo namalungu jikelele ukuze baqonde ukuthi kudingekani kubona. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka ngisho kubaholi abakhethiwe.”Uthe abantu abasha bafika nezinguquko ezinqala, abadala beza namava.
SEZIZINIKELE otshwaleni ngenxa yokhwantalala olwadaleka kubulawa uninomncane ebezithembele kuye, izingane ezingamalungu omndeni wowesifazane owasocongwa umkhwenyana wakhe oyiphoyisa emva kokuhilizisana ngo-2021.NgoLwesihlanu, iNkantolo eNkulu yaseMgungundlovu igwebe uThulasizwe Ambros Dladla (54) ngecala lokudubula abulale ingoduso yakhe uNksz Vuyisile Ndlovu (41), okwenzeka besemzini wabo KwaMpumuza, eMgungundlovu.Ngesikhathi sokwenzeka kwesigameko, uDladla owayesesebenze iminyaka ewu-30 eyiphoyisa, kuthiwa wayesola umgilwa ngokuthi sekukhona omunye wesilisa ahlekisana naye futhi esethole ulwazi ukuthi benalowo makhwapheni bahlela itulo lokumsoconga.UNksz Nomusa Ndlovu ongudadewabo kamgilwa ekhuluma neSolezwe emva kokugwetshwa kukaDladla, uthe bewumndeni bayasemukela lesi sigwebo yize singeke simvuse udadewabo futhi ukufa kwakhe kudale omkhulu umonakalo kumalungu omndeni njengoba kuselikhuni ukwamukela ukuthi akasekho."Iningi lethu ekhaya sesingena siphuma ezibhedlela ngenxa yokuhlaselwa yizifo ezingamahlalakhona emva kobuhlungu obukhulu esabuzwa kubulawa udadewethu. Izingane zethu ubezithanda futhi esondelene nazo kakhulu njengoba ubengenayo ingane ngakho bezethembele kuye kangangoba ezinye zigcine seziphuza utshwala zizama ukuziba isithombe sokwenzeka ngosuku lwesigameko, kanti kwesinye isikhathi uma sihleli kuvele kube sengathi uzongena endlini ngendlela okulukhuni ngayo ukwamukela ukufa kwakhe,” usho kanje.Kuvele ukuthi uDladla nomgilwa ngesikhathi behilizisana, wadonsa isibhamu somsebenzi wamdubula amahlandla amathathu njengoba isidumbu sakhe kuthiwa sasinamanxeba okudutshulwa ekhanda, esifubeni nasemlenzeni.Emva kokusoconga ingoduso yakhe okuthiwa wabe eseyilobole waqeda sekusele umgcagco, waphendula isibhamu wasibhekisa kuye ezama ukuzibuLala kodwa akangafa.Phambilini ngesikhathi kuqhubeka ukuqulwa kwecala, ubufakazi obunekelwe inkantolo buveze ukuthi uDladla ubehlala ngokuyihlukumeza ingoduso yakhe kodwa imbekezelela.Ngesikhathi inkantolo yehlisa isigwebo, ithe ngokubuka isikhathi uDladla abesesibenzile emaphoyiseni, bekungamele enze leli cala ngenxa yokuthi umsebenzi wakhe kuwukuvikela umphakathi.Okhulumela uphiko oluphenya ngokuziphatha kwamaphoyisa i-Independent Police Investigative Directorate, uMnuz Phaladi Shuping, uthe basishayela ihlombe isigwebo esinikezwe uDladla.
KUZONCIPHA izindleko kwabafuna ukuvakashela kwezinye izifundazwe kulo Disemba njengoba iPassenger Rail South Africa (Prasa), imemezele ukuthi sezibuyile izitimela ezihamba amabanga amade.Kusukela ngoDisemba 8, izitimela ezisuka eGoli (Park Station) ziye eThekwini (Durban Station) zizotholakala ngoR170 kwabafuna ukuhlala nabo bonke abantu bese kuthi abafuna ukuhlala ngabodwana babe negumbi lokulala zibe wuR360.UNksz Andiswa Makanda okhulumela iPrasa, uthe bayazi ukuthi ngoDisemba abantu basuke benezindleko eziningi ngakho badinga ukubuyela emakhaya nokuvakasha ngemali engambi eqolo.Uthe abafuna ukonga izindleko mabagibele izitimela zabo zamabanga amade ezidume ngele-Shosholoza Meyl.Zizobe zikhona izitimela ezisuka eGoli ziye eCape Town zona zibiza uR430 kwabahlala neningi bese abafuna igumbi lokulala bakhokhe uR690.Kuthiwe zikhona nezitimela ezisuka eGoli ziye eLimpopo, kanti zona bezivele zihamba kodwa ezisuka eGoli ziye eThekwini naseCape Town bezingahambi kule minyaka emibili edlule.Imizila yalezi zitimela yayivaliwe ngenxa yokucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda yezitimela okwaholela ukuthi zingahambi ngo-2021.UNksz Makanda uthembise abantu bazobe bephephile njengoba kujutshwe nonogada.Abafisa ukuhamba ngezitimela bangashayela u-011 013 0231/2/3 noma u-012 748 7362 kumbe u-015 299 606 noma bavakashele ihhovisi leShosholoza Meyl eliseduze nabo ukuze bathenge amathikithi.
I-TRANSNET imemezele ukuthi izothula amaguzu ayisikhombisa azolekelela ukunciphisa isiminyaminya samaloli eRichards Bay.Ukulethwa kwala maguzu kusho ukuthi isibalo samaguzu athutha impahla eya echwebeni laseRichards Bay azonyukela ku-28.Umthamo wempahla ephathwa ngamaguzu nawo usuzolingana namaloli awu-452 ngesonto.Iveze ukuthi isiziqalile izinhlelo zokushintsha izinto kuleliya chweba.Ichweba laseRichards Bay lihambisa imikhiqizo yakuleli esuka ezimayini okubalwa amalahle, i-chrome nokunye kusukela eLephalale (Limpopo) kuyofika khona eRichards Bay.USihlalo webhodi laseTransnet, uMnuz Andile Sangqu, uthe bazimisele ukuxazulula izingqinamba akade benazo.Abalule kuzo ukwebiwa kwamakhebuli emizileni yamaguzu nokucekelwa phansi kwengqalasizinda yabo.Uveze ukuthi kusukela manje kuze kube wuMashi wonyaka ozayo, bazoletha amanye amaguzu ayisikhombisa echwebeni laseRichards Bay ukuze kusebenze amaguzu awu-35.Ukwanda kwamaguzu uthe kwenziwa wukuthi lawa akade efile aselungisiwe yingakho sebekwazi ukuwafaka emzileni."Ukulethwa kwamaguzu kusho ukuncipha kwesiminyaminya emgwaqweni. Sinazo nezinhlelo ezizogwema ukwebiwa kwamakhebuli asiza ukuhambisa amaguzu. Silindele ukuthi yonke ingqalasizinda yamaguzu ethu ibe isisebenza kahle ngoFebhuwari, wonyaka ozayo. Sizoqhubeka nokusebenzisana noMasipala waseMhlathuze, abamaloli nazo zonke izinhlaka ezithintekayo ukunciphisa isiminyaminya sasechwebeni," kusho uSangqu.Uphethe ngokuveza ukuthi banohlelo lokuthi amaloli athathe impahla ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwechweba ukuze angathutheleki wonke echwebeni.Uma lolu hlelo luhamba kahle kulindeleke ukuthi lusebenze ngokugcwele ngoMashi, wonyaka ozayo.Kulindeleke ukuthi kuleli sonto uMasipala waseMhlathuze ubhunge ngezinhlelo zokulwa nesiminyaminya zikahulumeni.Khonamanjalo: Izikhulu zechweba laseThekwini zithe ihamba kahle imizamo yokuthulula amakhonteyna emikhunjini njengoba besebenza ngokushesha ukwenza lo msebenzi.
